jobs.name: Millwright
jobs.description: Now hiring! Millwright Regina, SK (On-site) Annual bonus / Overtime pay eligible We are looking for a Millwright to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Regina, SK. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. As a Millwright, you will perform safe, reliable, and efficient mechanical maintenance activities to support continuous operation of the Regina chemical manufacturing facility. The Maintenance Millwright Technician is responsible for executing planned and corrective maintenance work, troubleshooting mechanical equipment failures, and supporting asset reliability and mechanical integrity. This role contributes directly to safe plant operation, equipment uptime, and effective execution of the site’s maintenance strategy. As a Millwright, you create chemistry by... Executing planned preventive and corrective maintenance work in accordance with SAP work orders, job plans, procedures, and safety requirements. You will also maintain accurate documentation by completing SAP work orders, inspections, and maintenance records. Troubleshooting mechanical equipment failures and supporting timely restoration of production during unplanned breakdown events, including participation in a rotating on call schedule with availability for evening, weekend, and emergency response as required by site operations. Installing, repairing, and replacing mechanical components including pumps, bearings, seals, gearboxes, conveyors, and associated equipment. Participating in equipment inspections, condition monitoring activities, and continuous improvement of maintenance tasks and job plans. Supporting shutdown, turnaround, and outage activities, including equipment preparation and commissioning. Participating in project design reviews, Management of Change (MOC) reviews, and other cross functional forums to provide maintenance expertise and feedback on equipment maintainability, serviceability, and reliability. Participating in safety meetings, job hazard analyses, and EHS initiatives. If you have... Interprovincial Red Seal Journeyperson Millwright (Industrial Mechanic) Certificate recognized under current Saskatchewan Apprenticeship and Trade Certification Commission (SATCC) requirements, and possess a valid Saskatchewan driver’s license or ability to obtain. Experience troubleshooting and maintaining mechanical equipment in a manufacturing or industrial environment and supporting equipment breakdowns in a 24/7 or continuous production setting, with working knowledge of industrial EHS requirements and safe work practices. Experience working within a planned maintenance and reliability‑based maintenance programs, and executing preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance work orders. Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with working knowledge of pumps, gearboxes, bearings, couplings, conveyors, rotating equipment and mechanical drives, with the ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, technical manuals, and P&IDs. Experience with alignment, rigging, precision measurements, and mechanical installation practices. Experience working with Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably SAP PM, and demonstrate proficiency in basic computer use, electronic work order systems, and maintenance documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills. About us As the world’s leading chemical company, we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! jobs.description: Now hiring! Agriculture/Horticulture Technical Services Representative - Contract We are looking for an Agriculture/Horticulture Technical Services Representative to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Ontario. This role is on the Road . Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. The Agriculture/Horticulture Technical Services Representative (12-month contract) is responsible for the execution of summer demand creation activities including large scale grower trials and demonstration sites within the region. They are responsible for providing supportive data to meet sales objectives and address product usage questions. In addition, they are accountable for providing technical training to the sales force and key influencers within the region. This includes training the sales representatives on investigative field techniques and technical support with product inquiries where necessary. As an Agriculture/Horticulture Technical Services Representative, you create chemistry by... Executing and managing all Demand Creation trials and activities, including all technical requirements such as ability to operate equipment related to spraying, maintenance and harvest. Supervising Technical Agronomy Interns who support summer demand creation activities and data collection of large-scale grower applied trials and other key projects. Coordinating third party research associated with third party demo sites. Monitoring and positively influencing key centers of influence (COI) such as universities, consultants, provincial extension staff and retail agronomists through relationship building and regular contact. Technically transferring information through the development and delivery of presentations to both external and internal customers through a variety of presentation tools. Providing technical training and reinforcement of product positioning with sales team. Supporting sales team members and a defined list of external customers within the region, ensuring that marketing, sales and technical positions are in alignment. Using generated field and university research data to develop tools that support marketing and sales tactics. If you have... Comme Représentant de Service Technique 1 1, vous créez de la chimie en... Dispensant une formation technique à la force de vente et aux principaux influenceurs de la région. Cela comprend la formation des représentants commerciaux sur les techniques d’enquête sur le terrain et, le cas échéant, une assistance technique pour les demandes de renseignements sur les produits. Soutenant également les objectifs de vente par une interaction directe avec les ventes et indirecte en influençant les principaux clients externes de la région. Exécutant des activités estivales de création de demandes, y compris des essais chez les producteurs à grande échelle et des sites de démonstration dans la région. Il est chargé de fournir des données utiles pour atteindre les objectifs de vente et répondre aux questions sur l’utilisation des produits. Surveillant et en influençant positivement les principaux centres d’influence tels que les universités, les consultants, le personnel chargé de la vulgarisation provinciale et le commerce de détail agricole en établissant des relations et des contacts réguliers. Il fournit à ces centres d’influence des renseignements sur les produits, des mises à jour de la marque et des résultats techniques. Jouant un rôle clé dans le transfert des connaissances sur les nouveaux produits et les cultures vers d’autres régions de vente, en interagissant régulièrement avec les chefs de marque, les représentants des ventes au détail et des producteurs, les responsables de comptes stratégiques, les responsables du marketing technique, de la réglementation et de la biologie. Si vous avez... Un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en agriculture ou en biologie avec un accent sur la science des cultures, la malherbologie, l’agronomie, l’entomologie, la phytopathologie ou une discipline connexe est recommandé. Les candidats titulaires d’un baccalauréat en sciences et ayant un minimum de 5 ans d’expérience seront également pris en considération. Un professional agrologist, CCA ou CCSC (Certified Crop Adviser ou Certified Crop Science Consultant) avec au moins 2 ans d’expérience relative sur le terrain. Des compétences en développement et enlivraison de présentations aux clients externes et internes. Vous devez avoir d’excellentes compétences informatiques et maîtriser divers logiciels, notamment PowerPoint, Excel et Word. Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale est essentiel. Être efficace pour communiquer avec une grande variété de publics. jobs.name: Senior Auditor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME In the Coatings division, we offer far more than just paints and coatings. Our approach is to put the needs of our customers at the centre and always think one step ahead. Our motto ‘We always go beyond the surface’ makes it clear that we are not only focussed on the products themselves, but also on the reasons why we develop them. We are interested in creating innovative solutions that promote future growth and fulfil the requirements of the market. With our extensive knowledge and experience, we work to provide tailored coatings solutions that create real value and build strong partnerships. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT For our Internal Audit unit, we are looking for a committed and analytically minded Senior Auditor (m/f/d). In this role, you support the unit in enhancing and protecting the organization’s value by providing independent and objective audit services aimed at creating added value and improving organizational processes. In your role as Senior Auditor, you independently conduct risk-based audits at group companies globally. You analyze and assess business processes with regard to compliance, efficiency, and effectiveness. Moreover, you identify key risks and develop appropriate audit programs based on those risks. Furthermore, you document your work steps and audit results in a structured and transparent manner. You prepare audit results concisely and communicate them in a target-group-oriented way to senior management. Finally, you follow up on the implementation of agreed measures and contribute to the further development of internal audit methods and tools. WHAT YOU OFFER successfully completed university degree in business administration, economics, finance, accounting, or a comparable field several years of relevant professional experience, e.g., in internal audit, external audit, accounting, controlling, or risk management strong analytical skills as well as a structured and thorough working style high level of initiative, sense of responsibility, and professionalism strong communication skills and confident interaction across different management levels very good German and English skills; confident use of MS Office, SAP knowledge is an advantage WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. Tot 1 juli maakte onze organisatie deel uit van BASF. In het kader van de huidige overgang worden alle vacatures en het sollicitatieproces nog steeds gehost op het BASF‑platform en daarom volledig in BASF‑huisstijl weergegeven. Laat je hier niet door verwarren: alle functies zijn posities bij Surventis en jouw sollicitatie wordt bij ons ingediend. Bij Surventis kijken we een stukje verder — in alles wat we doen. We zetten de klant centraal, denken een stap vooruit en ontwikkelen oplossingen die echte waarde en langdurige samenwerkingen creëren. We inspireren elkaar om dieper te denken, verantwoordelijkheid over ons werk en streven er voortdurend naar om het mogelijke te vergroten. Als je jezelf volledig meebrengt, de voor de hand liggende antwoorden uitdaagt en wil groeien met een team dat het meent — dan is dit jouw plek. Als Accountmanager ben jij het vaste gezicht voor klanten in regio Zuid. Je bouwt aan relaties die blijven plakken, spot groeikansen en zet die om in duidelijke afspraken en slimme voorstellen. Jij houdt overzicht in je pipeline, legt alles netjes vast in Salesforce en schakelt met collega’s en interne teams om klanten elke dag vooruit te helpen. WAT JE KUNT VERWACHTEN Je stapt ’s ochtends de auto in, rijdt naar klanten in Zuid-Nederland en bent de sparringpartner die kansen ziet voordat ze op de radar staan. In deze rol combineer je relatiebeheer met new business en bouw je jouw regio stap voor stap uit, met Salesforce als jouw cockpit. Jouw speelveld: Zuid-Nederland Mix van relatiebeheer én nieuwe klanten binnenhalen Je werkt data gedreven met Salesforce en MS Office Korte lijnen: je schakelt direct met de Sales Manager en interne specialisten WAT JE AANBIEDT Met behulp van een scherpe en analytische blik weet je jezelf te onderscheiden en nieuwe kansen in de markt te signaleren, deze verder te ontwikkelen en om te zetten in new business met ondersteuning van het Salesteam. Je hebt minimaal een mbo-diploma en HBO werk- en denkniveau, aangevuld met commerciële trainingen. Je hebt commerciële skills en je weet hoe je deals opbouwt (en afrondt). Je hebt feeling met sales en marketing en vindt het leuk om met digitale tools te werken. Je woont in Zuid-Nederland (of super dichtbij) en kent de regio. Je bent bekend met CRM-Systemen zoals Salesforce MS Office. Bovendien heb je sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Je bent vaardig met Microsoft Office, waaronder Power BI en Excel. Ervaring in B2B sales is een plus. Je staat bekend om je hands-on mentaliteit, enthousiasme, en vooral veel gedrevenheid! WAT WIJ BIEDEN Veel vrijheid en vertrouwen: jij runt je regio en maakt het waar. Een vliegende start met onboarding, producttraining en coaching-on-the-job. Een team waar je op kunt bouwen: support van collega’s en interne experts. Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden, met ruimte voor resultaat (bonus/variabel). De tools om te knallen: alles wat je nodig hebt om onderweg goed te werken. 8,33% vakantietoeslag + eindejaarsuitkering + uitgebreide bonusregeling. 25 vakantiedagen, aangevuld met 6 ADV-dagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Een auto van de zaak. Diversiteit is onze grootste kracht! Maak deel uit van onze succesformule en ontwikkel samen met ons de toekomst -- in een wereldwijd team dat inclusiviteit en gelijke kansen omarmt, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, afkomst, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of geloof. B. bei Arbeiten an technischen Anlagen Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit sorgfältiges, eigenverantwortliches und teamorientiertes Arbeiten DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG eine spannende Ausbildung im weltweit führenden Chemieunternehmen in Kooperation mit der BBS Naturwissenschaft in Ludwigshafen maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote sowie die Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an EU-Austauschprojekten attraktive Vergütung – du startest mit 1147 Euro pro Monat im 1. jobs.name: GB/G Head of Finance Services
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Head of Finance India will lead all finance activities for the Service Delivery Unit (SDU) in India, ensuring strong financial control, insightful business partnering, and effective delivery of finance services that support the SDU’s growth and operational excellence. This role combines strategic leadership, operational finance management, process optimization, and people leadership to enable data-driven decisions and alignment with global finance standards. Key Responsibilities Financial leadership & strategy Develop and execute the SDU’s strategy in alignment with global objectives. Serve as the primary finance business partner to the global Finance GBS community, translating financial implications of strategic and operational decisions. Responsible for budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and scenario analysis; drive financial discipline and performance. Operational finance & process delivery Manage end-to-end finance processes delivered by the SDU (e.g., accounts payable/receivable, closing cycles, management accounting), ensuring efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and high service levels. Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and standardization Manage capacity planning, workload balancing, and operational resilience for peak cycles Performance management & reporting Define and monitor KPIs and SLAs (closing time, accuracy, payments on time, etc.) Use metrics to drive improvement plans and communicate performance trends and risks Talent & team leadership Build, coach, and retain a high-performing finance team Set clear objectives, development plans, and performance expectations; foster a collaborative, continuous-improvement mindset. Ensure proper delegation, succession planning, and capability development. Governance & stakeholder management Maintain strong relationships with Regional/Global Finance, Tax, Legal, and business stakeholders. Ensure timely escalation of financial risks and provide recommended mitigation actions. Represent the SDU in global finance forums and ensure alignment with corporate policies. Qualifications & Experience Chartered Accountant / MBA Finance / CIMA or equivalent professional qualification preferred. 12+ years of progressive finance experience, with at least 5 years in leadership roles; experience in SDU, shared services, or business unit finance preferred. Solid exposure to FP&A, accounting, controllership, and finance operations in an international or matrixed organization. Proven track record of process improvement and implementing finance automation/ERP systems. Strong business partnering skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate strategy into financial plans. Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated people leadership, team building, and talent development capabilities.

jobs.name: HRIS Global Process Owner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OUR TEAM If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our unit Digital Solutions & IT Architecture, EC/XD, we develop concepts and IT solutions for our global coatings and surface business. We drive innovative solutions, ensure seamless end-to-end processes, and identify global best practices for Surventis locations. As a Global IT Process Owner HRIS you are the application manager and solution architect for the global Surventis HRIS application landscape with SAP Success Factors and ADP Workforce Suite at the core. Your main responsibility is the design, development, and implementation of a dedicated and global IT landscape for Human Resources including a greenfield HRIS implementation. This landscape supports current business objectives and ensures compliance with legal and internal regulations, always in close collaboration with the Surventis HR department. In your role as Global Process Owner, you will also understand integrations to closely related systems such as S/4, Payroll, or Service Now. You build the bridge to our internal stakeholders and translate business requirements into IT demands. During projects and ongoing maintenance, you collaborate closely with technical implementation partners and independently lead rollouts and projects. You will lead future innovation and enhancements of the product landscape. Your consultancy is valued by our internal partners and leads to a lean but innovative future IT set-up. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Completed studies in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or Business Administration with a focus on IT and/or HR. Solid knowledge of IT landscapes and IT processes in the Human Resources area, ideally with SAP Success Factors, ADP Workforce Management or comparable, and connected systems. Proven track of records for project management skills and techniques. Experience in IT projects, in a leading role, in the HR context is desired. Strong communication and presentation skills in English. Further languages are an advantage. Analytical skills and enjoyment of teamwork to achieve optimal results together with internal and external partners. WHAT WE OFFER Continuous training and professional development with our internal vacancies. Safe environment where we promote your health. Restaurant ticket. Competitive economic offer with a base salary plus a variable for good performance. Hybrid work model and adapt your schedule according to your circumstances. Connect outside the office and practice sports with colleagues through company groups. Flexible remuneration that you can voluntarily allocate to transportation services, training, childcare, etc. Pension plans, life and accident insurance, personal loans and participation in company stock programs. Financial aid for schooling and other measures for families. HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCESS Send your CV in English through the job offer so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, we will call you from the Spanish Talent Acquisition team in Germany (prefix +49) and support you throughout the process. With each step, you will be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any further questions about this process, please contact: Antonio (antonio.casas-castro@basf.com*) *Please note that we will not be able to accept your resume via this email. Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. Hasta el 1 de julio, nuestra empresa formaba parte de BASF. Como parte de la transición actual, todas las ofertas de empleo y el proceso de solicitud siguen alojados en la plataforma de BASF y, por tanto, se presentan íntegramente bajo la imagen corporativa de BASF. Por favor, no te confundas por ello: todas las vacantes corresponden a puestos en Surventis y tu candidatura será enviada directamente a nosotros. En Surventis, vamos más allá de la superficie en todo lo que hacemos. Ponemos a los clientes en el centro, nos anticipamos a las necesidades y desarrollamos soluciones que generan valor real y relaciones duraderas. Nos inspiramos mutuamente para ir más allá, asumir la responsabilidad de nuestro trabajo y nos esforzarnos continuamente por ampliar los límites de lo posible. Si aportas tu mejor versión, cuestionas las respuestas evidentes y quieres crecer junto a un equipo que realmente cree en ello, este es tu lugar. LO QUE PUEDES ESPERAR En nuestra unidad Digital Solutions & IT Architecture (EC/XD) desarrollamos conceptos y soluciones de TI para nuestro negocio global de recubrimientos y superficies. Impulsamos soluciones innovadoras, garantizamos procesos integrales sin interrupciones (end-to-end) e identificamos las mejores prácticas globales para las ubicaciones de Surventis. Como Global IT Process Owner HRIS, serás el responsable de la gestión de aplicaciones y arquitecto de soluciones para el ecosistema global de HRIS de Surventis, con SAP SuccessFactors y ADP Workforce Suite como aplicaciones principales. Tu principal responsabilidad será el diseño, desarrollo e implementación de un entorno global de TI dedicado a Recursos Humanos, incluyendo una implementación greenfield de HRIS. Este entorno respaldará los objetivos actuales del negocio y garantizará el cumplimiento de los requisitos legales y las normativas internas, siempre en estrecha colaboración con el departamento de RR. HH. de Surventis. En tu función como Global Process Owner, también comprenderás las integraciones con sistemas estrechamente relacionados como SAP S/4HANA, nómina (Payroll) o ServiceNow. Actuarás como enlace con nuestros grupos de interés internos, traduciendo las necesidades del negocio en requerimientos de TI. Durante los proyectos y las actividades de mantenimiento continuo, colaborarás estrechamente con socios técnicos de implementación y liderarás de forma autónoma despliegues y proyectos. Además, impulsarás la innovación futura y las mejoras continuas del ecosistema de aplicaciones. Tu asesoramiento será altamente valorado por nuestros socios internos y contribuirá a construir una infraestructura de TI futura que sea eficiente, ágil e innovadora. LO QUE OFRECEMOS Nivel de puesto: JG 4 – JG 5, según cualificación y experiencia. Formación continua y desarrollo profesional con nuestras vacantes internas. Entorno seguro y donde promovemos tu salud. Ticket restaurante. Oferta económica competitiva con un salario base más un variable por buen desempeño. Modelo híbrido de trabajo y adaptar tus horarios, según tus circunstancias. Conectar fuera de la oficina y practicar deportes con compañeros/as mediante Grupos de empresa. Retribución flexible que puedes destinar voluntariamente a servicios de transporte, formación, guardería, etc. Planes de pensiones, seguro de vida y accidentes, préstamos personales y participar en programa de acciones de la compañía. Ayudas económicas para la escolarización y otras medidas para las familias. Los/as colaboradores/as que pierdan su puesto como resultado de proyectos de reestructuración tendrán prioridad en la cobertura de esta vacante. jobs.description: Corporate Real Estate Manager (m/w/d) Stellendetails | BASF SE Zum Hauptinhalt Stellen finden Sprache Ceština (Ceská republika) Dansk (Danmark) Deutsch (Deutschland) Ελληνικά (Ελλάδα) English (United States) Español (España) Español (México) Français (France) Magyar (Magyarország) Italiano (Italia) 日本語 (日本) 한국어 (대한민국) Norsk bokmål ‎(Norwegian Bokmål) Nederlands (België / Nederland) Polski (Polska) Português (Brasil) Português (Portugal) Slovencina (Slovensko) Svenska (Konungariket Sverige) ภาษาไทย (ประเทศไทย) Türkçe (Türkiye) 简体中文 (中国大陆) 繁體中文(台灣) Anmeldung für Mitarbeitende Stellenbeschreibung Corporate Real Estate Manager (m/w/d) STANDORT UNTERNEHMEN EINSATZGEBIET VERTRAGSART REFERENZCODE FLEXIBLE ARBEITSOPTIONEN STANDORT UNTERNEHMEN EINSATZGEBIET VERTRAGSART REFERENZCODE FLEXIBLE ARBEITSOPTIONEN Jetzt bewerben WILLKOMMEN BEI UNS Wir sind BASF in der Landwirtschaft und alles, was wir tun, tun wir aus Liebe zur Landwirtschaft und dem wichtigsten Beruf auf der Erde. Wir sind ein international erfolgreiches Unternehmen der BASF-Gruppe. Unsere Lösungen sind speziell für verschiedene Anbausysteme entwickelt. Sie verbinden Saatgut und speziell gezüchtete Pflanzeneigenschaften, Pflanzenschutzprodukte, digitale Tools und Nachhaltigkeitsansätze, um Landwirten, Züchtern und anderen Interessengruppen entlang der Wertschöpfungskette bestmögliche Ergebnisse zu bieten. Mit Teams im Labor, auf dem Feld, im Büro und in der Produktion tun wir alles, was in unserer Macht steht, um eine nachhaltige Zukunft für die Landwirtschaft zu schaffen. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Hier erfährst du mehr über unsere Vision bei BASF Agricultural Solutions! WAS DICH ERWARTET Wir bei Agricultural Solutions bereiten uns darauf vor, ein selbständiges Unternehmen innerhalb der BASF-Gruppe zu werden. Um für diese eigenständige Zukunft bestens aufgestellt zu sein, suchen wir dich als Unterstützung für unser neues Corporate Center (siehe hier: build your career on our Standalone Transformation ). In deiner neuen Position definierst und implementierst du die globale Immobilienstrategie eines führenden Unternehmens für landwirtschaftliche Lösungen mit einem Umsatz von nahezu 10 Mrd. € und Geschäftstätigkeiten in nahezu allen Ländern weltweit – im Einklang mit den Geschäfts- und Finanzzielen. Du leitest die Planung und Optimierung des Immobilienportfolios, identifizierst Kostenoptimierungs- und Wertschöpfungspotenziale, etablierst Governance-Strukturen, Richtlinien sowie ein Performance Management für sämtliche Immobilienaktivitäten und verantwortest das Immobilienbudget einschließlich Planung und Reporting. Darüber hinaus steuerst du globale Immobilientransaktionen (Mietverträge, An- und Verkäufe) sowie Investitionsprojekte, berätst das Senior Management und baust ein schlankes globales Team auf, das du führst und dessen Kompetenzen du kontinuierlich weiterentwickelst (Transaktionen, Datenmanagement und Asset Management). Du steuerst externe Dienstleister, treibst den Übergang zu einem unabhängigen Betriebsmodell voran und förderst die Digitalisierung sowie die Datentransparenz im Immobilienmanagement. Nicht zuletzt agierst du als vertrauensvoller Sparringspartner für den CFO und das Senior Leadership Team und unterstützt strategische Initiativen (z.B. M&A und Transformationsprojekte). WAS DU MITBRINGST erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Immobilienwirtschaft, Finance, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang mehr als 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Corporate Real Estate, Transaktions- oder Portfoliomanagement; Erfahrung im Agrarsektor oder im ländlichen Raum ist von Vorteil nachgewiesene Führungserfahrung in einem globalen oder multinationalen Umfeld sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Immobilienstrategie, Transaktionen und Finanzanalyse Erfahrung mit Outsourcing-Modellen und dem Management externer Dienstleister; Erfahrung in Transformations- oder IPO-Umfeldern ist von Vorteil ausgeprägte Affinität zu Digitalisierung und KI sowie die Fähigkeit, moderne Technologien und datenbasierte Ansätze zur Steigerung von Effizienz und Qualität einzusetzen ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Stakeholdermanagement sowie ein hohes Verhandlungsgeschick WAS WIR BIETEN Eine dynamische Arbeitsumgebung, die dich dazu ermutigt, deine Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Ein starker Fokus auf kontinuierliches Lernen, moderne Technologien und den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz von künstlicher Intelligenz. So arbeiten wir zukunftsorientiert, effizient und nachhaltig – und treiben Innovation aktiv voran. Inspirierende Netzwerke für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung deiner Ideen (z. B. Women in Business). Vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Karrierepfade für deine berufliche Entwicklung in andere Rollen innerhalb des Unternehmens. Wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei der Kinderbetreuung (z. B. Betrieblicher Kindergarten, Ferienprogramme) und bieten ein Fitness- und Gesundheitsstudio sowie ein medizinisches Zentrum mit zahlreichen Gesundheitsangeboten. Wir bieten nachhaltige Mobilitätsvorteile – ein vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket für den regionalen Nahverkehr, ein Jobrad-Leasingprogramm sowie E‑Ladestationen vor Ort für private Elektrofahrzeuge. So wird dein Arbeitsweg kostengünstig, gesund und klimafreundlich. SO ERREICHST DU UNS Lennart Boudgoust (Talent Acquisition), lennart.boudgoust@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56521 beantwortet gerne deine Fragen zu dieser Position. Technische Fragen können in diesem Termin nicht beantwortet werden. Unser Recruiting-Team erreichst du auch hier . Erste Informationen zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier . ÜBER UNS Die BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH bietet als zuverlässiger Partner der Landwirtschaft innovative, nachhaltige Lösungen speziell für verschiedene Anbausysteme. Unser Unternehmenssitz ist das Agrarzentrum in Limburgerhof, nahe der BASF-Konzernzentrale in Ludwigshafen. In der Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar erwartet dich beruflich wie auch privat ein attraktives Umfeld. Mehr über die BASF SE erfährst du unter: on.basf.com/BASFSE_LI Mehr über unser Team in Agricultural Solutions erfährst du hier Vielfalt ist unsere größte Stärke! Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft – in einem globalen Team, das Inklusion und Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Weltanschauung lebt. Und übrigens, wir überlassen es unseren Mitarbeitenden, ob und wann sie sich duzen. Jetzt bewerben Unsere Mitarbeitenden stehen im Mittelpunkt und setzen sich jeden Tag dafür ein, unseren Kunden einen echten Mehrwert zu bieten. Wir legen großen Wert darauf, unsere Mitarbeitenden heute und in Zukunft gezielt zu fördern, damit wir die Talente und Fähigkeiten haben, die für unseren Erfolg entscheidend sind. Vereint durch die Leidenschaft für die Landwirtschaft, entwickeln wir gemeinsam innovative Lösungen, arbeiten partnerschaftlich zusammen und streben nach den besten Ergebnissen – als ein Team. So schaffen wir Wirkung. Aus Liebe zur Landwirtschaft und dem wichtigsten Beruf auf der Erde. jobs.name: GB/G Project Accounting Analyst
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. BASF Overview: BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in About the Role: Provide support to business units throughout the entire project lifecycle: approval, cost allocation, asset capitalization, and write-offs. What's In It for You: Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiativeWork with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functionsCompetitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathwaysAccess to BASF's world-class learning & development programsInclusive, diverse, and collaborative work cultureHybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote) Key Responsibilities: Perform daily and monthly activities related to the Project Accounting process for BASF group companies and businesses in the Americas. Responsible for closing companies of medium complexity Ensure adequate data quality for the projects of their business units. Support the improvement of process design and flow by identifying opportunities for enhancement and automation through new technologies and systems, ensuring proper implementation. Support projects involving mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures of business lines or companies. Assist with key organizational tasks such as audits, internal controls, among others. Minimum Qualifications: Graduates of Public Accountant, Business Administration, Economics Min 5 to 8 years of experience in relevant domain. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, fast-paced global environment High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.Professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent (completed or pursuing). Technical Skills: SAP FICO/MM About BASF: At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it.At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive. How to Apply: Please apply via the BASF careers portal at www.basf.com/careers with your updated CV and a brief cover letter. For questions contact Muktha B.P, M: +91-8069541986.

jobs.name: Nematologist Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. Come join us on our journey to create solutions for sustainable agriculture at the Innovation Center of BASF Belgium Coordination Center CommV in Ghent, Belgium. We are seeking people who thrive in a culture of creativity, openness, responsibility, and entrepreneurial spirit. In our organization, we encourage and celebrate innovative thinking, where ideas flow freely and are nurtured. We value individuals who take ownership of their work and are accountable for their actions. We foster an entrepreneurial mindset, where taking calculated risks and seizing opportunities are encouraged to drive growth and success. Join our team and be part of an environment that values and rewards creative thinking, collaboration, and a can-do attitude. Within BASF Seed and Traits R&D, Trait Research we focus on the design, creation and testing of candidate leads as gene-based solutions for herbicide tolerance, pest and disease control in key crops including soybean, oilseed rape, wheat and cotton. We are currently seeking a talented, motivated, and inspiring Nematologist to join our Trait Research team at the R&D Innovation Center in Ghent, Belgium. In this role, you will develop and execute research strategies aligned with business goals to successfully commercialize innovative nematode resistant traits and germplasm. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You propose innovative nematode trait concepts and develop and implement nematode control research strategies using state-of-the-art know-how and technologies including suitable third-party collaborations to ascertain scientific competitiveness of the nematode program. You evaluate scientific progress of nematode control programs with the project leader and with support of team members (technicians and scientists in the lab and GH) and take decisions to ensure the achievement of scientific objectives and critical milestones with optimal use of available resources. You design and oversee the execution of nematode control assays to support program goals. You articulate a clear, innovative and competitive testing scheme to meet these goals and to ensure the efficient delivery of high-quality nematode traits. You proactively report on your scientific progress and new opportunities to all relevant stakeholders as requested. You develop the innovative ability and competence of research teams, and you act as a mentor and give scientific guidance across the organization. You support the program leader to ensure strategy competitiveness by working closely with Intellectual Property colleagues to build a proactive patenting (and, if needed, licensing-) strategy and ensure a competitor IP analysis in the program field. WHAT YOU OFFER You hold a PhD in Nematology with 12-15 years of relevant experience or equivalent. You are internationally acknowledged as a consistent innovator and leading authority in the field of Plant Nematology and have a profound knowledge of GM trait development. You provide innovative solutions for plant parasitic nematode issues and demonstrate knowledge and expertise from working directly with plant parasitic nematodes. You are familiar with crop business strategies and the principles of value creation for growers. You understand the connection between the lab and the field. You have a track record of providing scientific leadership for internal and external program work packages, effectively managing collaborations with partners, and excel in developing innovative research proposals that incorporate novel technology platforms to advance plant parasitic nematode control project objectives. You possess leadership and team coaching skills, motivating and inspiring others, while fostering collaboration in diverse environments through a multi-cultural mindset. You demonstrate proactivity, with well-developed communication skills that enable effective interactions with stakeholders. You build a culture of innovation by creating an environment that supports creativity and by coaching and developing people. You are fluent in English. WHAT WE OFFER A permanent contract within an attractive working environment in a professional and motivated team. Interesting and challenging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your job. An attractive base salary in relation to your diploma and competencies, an annual bonus and extra-legal benefits. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Regional Data & AI Engineer, Operations, Asia Pacific
jobs.description:
About the Role Regional Data & AI Engineer builds and advances a scalable data and AI backbone for smart manufacturing across Asia sites within Coatings business unit. It combines the development of a standardized production data architecture across sites with the ability to translate data into business value through advanced analytics, AI-ML, and agentic AI solutions. The role ensures that production data is consistently leveraged to improve performance, enable better decisions, and drive continuous optimization across the regional manufacturing network. How You Will Do It Production Data Architecture Define and implement the target architecture for the capture, integration, and provision of production and process data across multiple sites, ensuring scalability and alignment with global standards. IT/OT Integration Develop and implement standards and concepts for the integration of production-relevant data sources, including sensors, PLC, SCADA, historian, MES, LIMS, quality, and ERP systems, with a focus on data quality, availability, and cybersecurity. Data Modeling, Analytics and AI Enablement Design and structure production data models to support reporting, root cause analysis, process optimization, as well as advanced analytics and AI applications, establishing the foundation for scalable data products. Technical Leadership and Consulting Provide technical guidance and advisory support to business functions, production sites, and project teams; translate business requirements into robust architectural solutions and support the implementation of data-driven and AI-enabled initiatives. Standards and Governance Establish and maintain regional standards for data models, interfaces, documentation, and governance to ensure consistency, traceability, compliance, and reusability across the organization. Global Collaboration and Continuous Development Collaborate within an international network of sites, experts, and stakeholders; contribute to and drive global roadmaps; continuously advance the production data architecture in line with business and technology developments. AI and Agentic AI Solution Development Drive the design, development, and industrialization of AI-ML based and agentic AI-based solutions tailored to manufacturing operations, including predictive analytics, intelligent process control, and decision-support systems. External Innovation and Partnerships Identify, evaluate, and manage partnerships with external vendors, startups, and technology providers to incorporate advanced, manufacturing-specific AI and digital solutions into the operational ecosystem. What We Look For Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, Data Science / Artificial Intelligence or a comparable scientific or technical field. Working Experience: Min. 5 years of professional experience in data architecture, data integration, industrial data platforms or advanced analytics, ideally in a global production-related environment. Experience in designing scalable data architectures and a good understanding of data quality, governance, information security and standardization. Technical & Professional Knowledge / Others: Strong understanding of production processes and industrial system landscapes as well as solid knowledge of integrating IT and OT systems and relevant standards such as ISA-95, OPC or MQTT. Strong knowledge of data processing, data modeling and data analysis as well as technologies such as Python, SQL, ETL/ELT concepts and modern data platforms. Knowledge of Databricks platform, Agentic AI, Machine Learning techniques, including decision tree learning, clustering, artificial neural networks, etc., and their pros and cons. Strong communication and facilitation skills, confidence in working with global stakeholders, a strong team orientation, as well as a high degree of initiative and structuring capability. Very good written and spoken Chinese and English skills. jobs.name: Auditor, Corporate Audit
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. About The Role Why does this position exist?  With what permanent objectives? Corporate Audit supports the BASF Board of Executive Directors in its responsibility to perform supervisory, steering and control activities. It is an integral part of BASF’s internal control and risk management system. It has teams spread over 3 continents of the globe. This position will be a part of the Asia-Pacific hub of the global Corporate Audit function. How Will You Do It We are seeking for an experienced Internal Auditor who possesses strong set of internal audit skills including resilience and agility, business acumen, and critical thinking to join our team. Your role will involve conducting audits with a resilient and agile approach to assess the effectiveness of our organization's risk management, control, and governance processes and recommend improvements. You will also be responsible for conducting audits of our organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement and provide recommendations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of the process. It is also expected that you actively collaborate with Global experts (Domain Owners/ SPOCs) as regional subject matter expert for specific audit topic/ risk aspect. Main Task : Execute the internal audit plan in accordance with established audit standards and procedures. Evaluate the effectiveness of the organization's risk management, control, and governance processes. Conduct audits of the organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement. Provide value adding recommendations to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance with policies and procedures. Communicate audit observation and recommendations to management and other stakeholders. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and engage with stakeholders at all levels. Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and provide guidance as needed. Stay up to date with changes in laws, regulations, and industry best practices. Maintain integrity and ethical behaviour, conduct unbiased audits, ensuring transparency, compliance, confidentiality, professionalism, and teamwork mindset in the role. What We Look For Education: Chartered Accountant, Chemical Engineer, or Data Scientist. Preferable Candidate should have Professional Certifications such as: required CIA (Certified Internal Audit) – or work in progress, optional CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CISA (Certified Information System Audit) Working Experience 4 – 7 Years experience. Preferably worked on international assignments and working in diverse cultures of team members. Exposure to industries that are manufacturing based preferably chemical companies. Travel Requirement Travel requirement would be ~30%. Approx. 6 to 7 audits per annum with fieldwork for each audit ~3 to 4 weeks. Depending on the audit scope, a site fieldwork, may require travel between 1 - 3 weeks. Orther Proven experience in internal auditing, demonstrating resilience, agility, and critical thinking. Strong understanding of business dynamics that comes with complex organization, financial principles, and internal control frameworks. You will need to possess the aptitude to understand the intricacies of business dynamics, enabling you to provide valuable insights that strengthen the organization's management processes. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks and propose effective solutions. Ability to embracing technology and data analytics. With the increasing volume of data and the complexity of business operations, you will leverage data analytics tools to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Work Location Godrej One - Vikroli (Mumbai)

Impulsamos la innovación, el diseño y nuevas aplicaciones para satisfacer las necesidades de nuestros clientes y socios en todo el mundo, trabajando en equipos globales e interconectados. Nuestra cartera se complementa con “Beyond Paint Solutions” , una propuesta que va más allá de la pintura tradicional para crear nuevas superficies y materiales avanzados. LO QUE PUEDES ESPERAR Como IAM Architect, serás responsable de diseñar, evolucionar y garantizar la correcta implementación de nuestro entorno global de Identity & Access Management (IAM). Combinarás la visión estratégica de arquitectura con conocimientos técnicos prácticos, actuando como interlocutor clave de IT Infrastructure entre los equipos internos —especialmente Cybersecurity, SAP, Applications y las unidades de negocio— y los proveedores de servicios gestionados (MSP). En colaboración con el MSP, asegurarás que las soluciones IAM sean seguras, escalables y estén alineadas con los requisitos del negocio y de cumplimiento normativo. Asumirás la responsabilidad en los siguientes ámbitos de IAM: Entra ID / Azure AD, Access Governance, SSO, MFA, PIM/PAM, integración Joiner–Leaver–Mover, Password Management Vault, PKI y Key Management. Tus principales responsabilidades incluirán: Definir y evolucionar la estrategia global de IAM junto con los expertos de seguridad e infraestructura. Diseñar la arquitectura IAM end-to-end en todos los procesos del ciclo de vida de identidades: Joiner–Mover–Leaver. Actuar como contraparte profesional frente a los MSP, coordinando y supervisando la prestación de servicios externos. Garantizar operaciones IAM estables, seguras y conformes, así como su integración con la arquitectura empresarial, incluyendo I&O Platform, aplicaciones y cloud. Aportar experiencia práctica en el diseño de soluciones, integraciones y resolución de incidencias complejas. Dar soporte y asesoramiento a proyectos y stakeholders de negocio en temas relacionados con IAM. LO QUE OFRECES Titulación universitaria en Informática, Informática de Gestión o una cualificación equivalente. Varios años de experiencia práctica en Identity & Access Management (IAM), idealmente en un entorno industrial internacional con una fuerte presencia de SAP. Amplios conocimientos como profesional generalista de IAM, abarcando múltiples áreas de especialización. Experiencia práctica en los principales ámbitos de IAM, utilizando soluciones como Entra ID, SailPoint, CyberArk, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Keeper y DigiCert. Sólidos conocimientos en: Soluciones de Identity Governance (por ejemplo, SailPoint o One Identity) Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD Protocolos de autenticación (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect) Servicios de directorio (LDAP, Active Directory) Plataformas cloud (Azure y AWS) Experiencia trabajando con y coordinando Managed Service Providers (MSP). Conocimientos sólidos de infraestructura IT y entornos híbridos en la nube. Alta capacidad de colaboración y disposición para trabajar estrechamente con equipos internacionales y viajar a diferentes centros de trabajo, especialmente a la sede central en Münster (Alemania). Capacidad para transformar requisitos de negocio en soluciones prácticas, escalables y sostenibles. Estilo de trabajo estructurado, autónomo y orientado a la búsqueda de soluciones.Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y experiencia trabajando en equipos globales. Nivel fluido de Español e inglés. LO QUE OFRECEMOS Formación continua y desarrollo profesional con nuestras vacantes internas. Entorno seguro y donde promovemos tu salud. Ticket restaurante. Oferta económica competitiva con un salario base más un variable por buen desempeño. Modelo híbrido de trabajo y adaptar tus horarios, según tus circunstancias. Conectar fuera de la oficina y practicar deportes con compañeros/as mediante Grupos de empresa. Retribución flexible que puedes destinar voluntariamente a servicios de transporte, formación, guardería, etc. Planes de pensiones, seguro de vida y accidentes, préstamos personales y participar en programa de acciones de la compañía. Ayudas económicas para la escolarización y otras medidas para las familias. CÓMO CONTACTAR CON NUESTRO EQUIPO Envía tu CV en inglés a través de la oferta para poder conocernos. Si tu perfil encaja, te llamaremos desde el equipo español de Talent Acquisition en Alemania (prefijo +49) y te acompañaremos en el proceso. ¡Con cada paso estarás más cerca de conocer a tu futuro equipo! jobs.name: Assistant Manager - EHS
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Main responsibilities EHS Management System Gap analysis and implementation for the new EHS regulation and requirement. Maintains EHS management system (IMS) and documentations. Support to implement EHS standards to compliance according local and BASF requirement. Define training needs, coordinate/arranges/delivery EHS training. Introduce and initiate country EHS TA together with site TA. Work with the country EHS to deliver competitive, reliable and high quality EHS services according to site needs. Benchmarks the EHS performances in the site (i.e. Initiates measures and proposals to contain the potential issues and continuously improves EHS standards of the Sites). Stakeholder Management Interfaces with site management & Business unit. Interfaces with local industry groups on behalf of BASF for issue management and advocacy. Represents BASF to participant local industry organization. Dialogues regularly with site managements to evaluate level of service, prioritizes & allocates resources and improves effectively and efficiency of the EHS service. Implement service catalogue and conducts service dialogue with site and business unit to fine-tune the service scopes. TDS (Transportation & Distribution Safety) Ensure safety and security standards for all modes of transportation are implementing and compliance. Nomination as Country/Site Dangerous Goods Safety Advisor. Training and Guidance to TDS related personnel involved in distribution safety processes. Conduct TDS Reviews for all Responsible person. Conduct Safety and Quality Assessments of suppliers, service providers and customers that transport or store our raw materials or goods. Incorporation of Transportation and Distribution Safety Performance in the Procurement Process. Carrier/Trucker Qualification Checks and Performance Evaluation. Incident Investigation, Corrective Actions and Reporting. ER (Emergency Response) Nomination as Country Emergency Expert. Assist to develop, review On-site Emergency Response Plans and scenario, fire prevention concept and compliance to legal and BASF requirement. Conduct Fire prevention assessment and fire prevention concept to meet as per requirement. Provide expertise to support and review for fire prevention design and equipment installation. Crisis and Security Management Nomination as Country/Local Security Manager as per BASF requirement. Provide expertise to support Site Security concept. Conduct self-assessment site security and security risk assessment. Coordinate with regional team to provide security review. Lead to investigate security incident. Develop and prepare readiness Country Incident Management. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in EHS, Science, Engineering, Production, Chemical Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or PhD is an advantage. At least 5 years of experience in production, engineering, or EHS is required. Leadership experience is an advantage. A professional-level Safety Officer must hold at least a Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety or a related field. Proficiency in both spoken and written English is required. Strong communication and management skills, familiarity with local EHS legislation and legal requirements, and a solid understanding of EHS unit scope and functions are required. Work location Emporium office, Bangkok BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/th .

jobs.name: Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization
jobs.description: Now hiring! Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization Hillsboro, OR (Onsite) Come create chemistry with us! The Technical Sales Manager – Advanced Metallization will join BASF’s Electronic Materials team, focusing on driving growth and innovation in metallization solutions for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. This role is responsible for managing customer and equipment supplier projects, identifying new business opportunities, and supporting the development and commercialization of next-generation metallization products (e.g., copper, cobalt, ruthenium, and related chemistries for sub-10nm nodes and advanced packaging). At BASF Electronic Materials, we uphold a relentless passion to innovate the future of electronics with our customers by equipping them with the essential solutions and technologies to continuously succeed in the competitive electronics industry. BASF has been supplying electronic materials for more than 30 years. The experience we have earned and the chemical expertise we possess enables us to offer outstanding products and solutions to our customers. At BASF, we offer high purity and quality process chemicals and specialized solutions for semiconductors, flat panel displays, and lighting such as LED. With our team of passionate, dedicated experts from all facets of the industry fields working closely with our customers worldwide, we are steadfast in our philosophy to deliver the quality excellence, reliable services, and innovative solutions that exceed the highest standards. As a Technical Sales Manager- Advanced Metallization, you create chemistry by... As a Technical Sales Manager - Advanced Metallization, you create chemistry by... Identify industry trends, unmet customer needs, and key growth drivers in advanced metallization for semiconductor devices. Lead cross-functional projects with US customers and equipment suppliers (e.g., deposition tool vendors), ensuring timely execution and alignment with global technical teams. Evaluate business potential and secure new opportunities by launching new products or expanding existing product lines. Initiate and foster strategic collaborations with customers and tool suppliers to accelerate innovation and adoption of BASF’s metallization solutions. Gather and analyze market intelligence on emerging technologies, customer requirements, and competitive landscape. Provide technical support for new applications and product development, working closely with R&D, sales, and manufacturing teams. Translate customer and market requirements into actionable product specifications and project plans. Inspire creativity and manage abstract concepts in a highly collaborative, global environment. If you have... Experience with semiconductor industry standards, advanced node requirements (sub-10nm) and/or advanced packaging. Familiarity with process integration and qualification of metallization materials Management experience in directing, coordinating and managing team activities to accomplish highly technical tasks. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Minimum 10 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a focus on metallization, film deposition (CVD, PVD, ALD), electrochemical plating, or advanced packaging. Proven track record of managing complex technical projects and collaborating with leading semiconductor manufacturers and/or equipment suppliers. Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to convey detailed requirements and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated leadership and influencing skills in cross-functional, multicultural teams. Self-starter with excellent organizational skills and the ability to work independently. Willingness to travel up to 25%. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization Digital Plant (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Our GDD/D – Digitalization of Operations unit implements digital technologies and applications in production plants. This enables us to increase production effectiveness. At the same time, processes become more efficient and safer. RESPONSIBILITIES Our goal is the implementation of digital technologies and applications in chemical plants, to improve work processes and increase the production efficiency. As a part of the global Digital Plant team you will coordinate the creation of a digital, intelligently linked representation of a real asset – the so-called digital twin. The digital twin will therefore enable many future use cases in other products like augmented reality or artificial intelligence. Your activities will include the digitalization of a real plant, by following a standardized and proven procedure create validated 2D- and 3D-data. The implementation of the necessary technology, digital workflows and roles within the whole organization of a plant and the respective service providers will be part of your activities, too. You will guide users how to use digital methods and processes during the asset lifecycle, to raise the potentials of cost and lead time reduction combined with quality increase in engineering, construction, brownfield projects, plant modifications, maintenance, TARM and operations. On the way to the digital asset lifecycle, you will offer change management support, accompanied by training and coaching on easy-to-use tools and enhanced digital processes. QUALIFICATIONS Master Degree in Chemical/Process Engineering or Mechanical Engineering Minimum 3+ years’ experience in planning or construction of or in chemical plants Experience in usage of digital tools and methods in data driven engineering projects Very good project management and coordination skills Ideally working Experience in international projects and agil methods The will and ability to drive change and an entrepreneurial spirit Creative and motivated working style with a strong focus on innovation Ability to work in a multicultural and virtual team Excellent communication skills in English WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.name: Production Engineer
jobs.description: Objective of the Position Responsible for ensuring day-to-day plant operations run smoothly, with a strong focus on daily production safety, process reliability, quality, and regulatory compliance, while optimizing asset utilization and production efficiency. Assist the Production Manager in ensuring the operation of the production section is carried out on time according to EHS, quality and other agreed requirements. Key in driving continuous improvement, cross-shift standardization, and effective problem-solving to sustain high-performance operations. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activies EHS Strictly comply with and implement the company's EHS policies and ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification requirements. Guide and ensure shift operations to strictly follow SOPs regarding safety, environment, and occupational health in their operations. Take appropriate measures for any safety, environmental, or occupational health incidents and report to the Production Manager as per procedures. Using personal protective equipment (PPE) according to the Safe Work Guidelines or PPE Matrix Carry out emergency actions as required by procedures during emergency response events. Operations Ensure all environmental, health and safety rules and guidelines are being adhered to and maintained by the production personnel. Providing technical and operational leadership to support day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safe execution of production plans in full compliance with BASF Process Safety standards, and applicable environmental regulation. Acting as a technical authority and trusted advisor to Operations, leading complex troubleshooting efforts and guiding Daily Operations teams toward effective, sustainable solutions for process, production, quality, and EHS challenges. Driving continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma methodologies to improve asset efficiency, optimize equipment cycle times, reduce waste, and sustain nameplate production capacity. Influencing cross shift standardization, cost optimization, and asset performance by working collaboratively with Operations, Maintenance, and Asset Effectiveness teams to align priorities and maximize plant utilization. Leading cross functional coordination and technical input for inspections, outages, capital projects, and investigations (RCA, NCM), partnering with Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Regulatory teams to prevent repeat incidents and improve first pass quality. Lead production team in trial production of new products and internal test products (PTO). To check and revise if necessary; HIRA, Procedures, Working Instructions, and Work Checklists. Manage the inventory of materials and tools, including staging materials for production and packaging by conducting periodic stock counts. Support on evaluating training needs for the operation, to ensure they are provided the adequate training for operation and continuous improvement. Responsible as 5S leader coordinator for Production Department. Review process condition and downtime report, GAP reporting and propose for improvement. Represent the Production Manager on production matter during the Production Manager absence. Ensure effectiveness of the implementation audit for Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and IATF 16949 Quality Management System for the automotive industry. Ensure good housekeeping and proper handovers among shift team members. Other production-related tasks assigned by superiors. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Polymers Science or Chemical Engineering. At least 5 - 8 years’ of experience in delivering technical expertise in a plastics compounding manufacturing plant. Posses demonstrated track record of leading through influence, providing expert technical guidance, and partnering with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and EHS teams to achieve safe and reliable plant performance. Proficient in production management software (e.g., ERP systems, MES). Hold strong production and operations background with the ability to independently support troubleshooting, root cause failure analysis, and investigations across Production, EHS and Quality. Have proven continuous improvement capability, including practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies to drive efficiency, waste reduction, asset utilization, and sustained nameplate performance. Highly effective collaborator with strong attention to detail and communication skills, able to coordinate complex activities and influence priorities across cross functional teams without formal supervisory authority. Knowledgeable on ISO 9001, ISO 14001, TS 16949 and ISO 45001 requirements. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my
