jobs.name: Quality Management Lead
jobs.description: Now hiring! Quality Management Lead Hillsboro, OR (Onsite) Come create chemistry with us! The purpose of this role is to be the first contact for EDM North America (NA) customers to handle quality relevant topics with including NC handling, quality inquiry, customer audit coordination, CoA upload, and white paper/PCN communication. Providing local QM support in NA for business growth and customer satisfaction enhancement. Being local quality contact in NA for 3rd party QC lab evaluation and qualification and providing support for supplier management. As a Quality Management Lead, you create chemistry by... Maintain internal/external contact window for EDM NA customers on quality related inquiries/survey/quality audit/complaints / troubleshooting, etc… Customer relationship management with EDM US customers and take the responsibility to provide initial response to EDM US customers Collaborate with NA business team to meet quality requirements from EDM NA customers and maintain customer satisfaction Collect correct and necessary information to coordinate customer quality request internal/external communication, and implementation follow-up Coordinate customer inquiry/complaint investigation with internal cross function team and provide on-time response to customer including Kuanyin site in Taiwan and Ludwigshafen in Germany Process Change Notice (PCN) report and white paper preparation, communication and follow-up for on-time implementation Collaborate with production site CQM team to finish OCAP, worse chart, BKM, related quality requirements investigation, etc… Collaborate with production site CQM team in preparing regular PCS review, customer audit, and quality inquiring. Take the ownership for CoA and production resume upload for customer system and collaborate with Taiwan/LU team for COA/Production resume upload working model optimization for all batches shipped Being local quality staff in NA to evaluate/qualify 3rd party QC lab by closely working with the production site QC lab. Provide local support in NA for supplier management like supplier audit, visit.. If you have... 5 + years of experience in semiconductor or quality field (customer quality experience or supplier quality experience is preferred) Strong interpersonal/customer dealing skill/coordination, open-minded and positive thinking, value selling, and hands-on skill Master degree in Engineering, Industry Engineering, Chemical engineering, Chemical, Statistic, MBA..etc. Strong English speaking/writing/listening/reading skills are essential and Mandarin is nice to have Proficient at Microsoft Office, Statistic Software (JMP, statistic..), Digitalization, Database Programing is plus Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

B. für monatliche Teamtage oder Veranstaltungen der Einheit. Je nach Projekt/Kunde können auch Reisen zu anderen BASF-Standorten erforderlich sein. jobs.name: Junior Controller Transfer Pricing (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative,efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As part of our unit Business Reporting you take over the position as Junior Controller within our Intercompany Transfer Pricing Team. In compliance with legal and tax regulations, internationally recognized frameworks, and BASF guidelines, you calculate, monitor, and adjust transfer prices to ensure accuracy and compliance. You take ownership of a dedicated business area by analyzing financial statements, calculating entity-level margins, managing ad hoc requests, and conducting regular quality assurance reviews. As a trusted business partner, you collaborate closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Controlling, while acting as a first-level escalation point to facilitate solutions and support decision-making. You drive the continuous improvement, optimization, and automation of intercompany transfer pricing processes and contribute to effective knowledge management. Last but not least, you support colleagues and the Global Tax Department during audits and compliance activities while continuously developing your expertise within a digitally driven and innovative organization. WHAT YOU OFFER degree in Business Administration or Business Informatics with a focus on Accounting/Finance or Controlling background in tax related topics and a first professional experience is a plus strong understanding of financial statements including profit and loss statements familiarity with analyzing the development of financial KPIs strong command of MS Office Excel is a must, initial experience in the SAP environment (R/3 or S/4HANA) or Business Warehouse systems is welcome good communication skills in English, knowledge of other language is an advantage openness to learn different technology applications (e. g. VBA, Power BI or UiPath) WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience. In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success as well as individual performance. Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according toyour needs 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany – here a first impression Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration – get to know our location HOW TO REACH US Katarina Borisov (Talent Acquisition), Tel.:+49 30 2005-59269 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here. First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video. ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Pack/Ship Operator
jobs.description: Now hiring! Pack/Ship Operator Vidalia, LA. (Onsite) We are looking for a Pack/Ship Operator to join our Catalyst team in Vidalia, LA. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Catalysts division is the global market leader in catalyst technologies. The division develops and produces mobile emissions catalysts as well as process catalysts and offers precious metals trading, recycling and related products and services. As a Pack/Ship Operator in our BASF Vidalia site in Louisiana, you will support warehouse operations and ensure safe and efficient packing and shipping of materials. During your day shift as a Pack/Ship Operator, you will Be responsible for movement of material in the warehouse. Load and unload trucks. Weigh material. Pack material in various packaging types, ensuring that product is appropriately labeled. Successfully complete all required EHS and quality training, including forklift driving test. Safely lift 50 pounds. If you... Have a High School Diploma or GED. Have 2-5 years related work experience. Forklift experience preferred. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF This position is part of the United Steelworkers Union and is covered under the collective bargaining agreement.  All benefits are outlined in this agreement. About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact myhr@basf.com to report fraud. Pay transparency The pay rate for this role is $20.93/hr per the Union's collective bargaining agreement. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Payroll & People Data (Analyst) - Mandarin Speaker (12 month leasing) 1
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Seek to understand business needs and provide support, services and solution on payroll, HR data, HR systems and processes. Offer day-to-day support to service recipients on HR inquiries, work collaboratively with others and perform research on payroll and HR data practices by staying abreast of current and emerging market insights and legal legislations in local countries. Participate in process improvements, automation, and digitalization measures to offer best service delivery experience. Main Tasks Operational Excellence Ensure data quality and data integrity for Payroll and HR data processes. Receive, analyze, process and follow-up on personnel administration requests via multiple request channels, ensure accurate and timely interface to the respective internal/ external processing chains i.e. payroll, finance, data analytics, external service providers, local authorities etc. Manage entire termination workflow for all termination types which includes leaves calculations, information checks, letters preparation, systems updates, payment calculations and exit clearance. Responsible for time and attendance administrations, including manual calculations on time allowances/deductions, maintenance of work schedules, leaves, overtimes, and shift substitutions. Support the delivery of payroll inputs and administration i.e. employee subsidies, fleet management, long service awards etc. Support the salary review exercises on employee data preparation, letter generations and new salary processing. Responsible for the local labor administrative activities and scheduled statutory HR reporting, ensure timely and compliant deliveries as per legislation requirements. Responds to recurring or ad-hoc business needs to design and to deliver country specific or customized reports which could not be auto-generated by the analytics/reporting systems. Work closely with other teams and external service providers to ensure all service requests are completed accurately and timely. Service Engagement Providing advisory on employee enquiries, policy/guidelines clarifications, HR processes, HR systems guides, legislation processes etc. Monitor multiples service requests to ensure services delivered by the team are in accordance with established Service Level Agreement (SLA) and internal Key Performance Indicators (KPI). Perform research and information gathering on local market HR news, legislation updates and guidelines to maintain internal knowledge database. Analyze, clarify, and resolve operation issues and enquiries with close collaboration with relevant Country HR and Regional HR Business Partners to ensure quality services are delivered from the service hub. All unsolved and potential operational issues are escalated timely according to establish escalation process, with detailed analysis provided to Assistant Manager and Manager. Process Improvement and Project Initiatives Continuously review and update knowledge documents in areas of Payroll and People data to develop the formation of competence hub. Identify opportunities, prepare and analyze business case, and participate in digitalization and process optimization. Actively work on implementation of process improvements, automation and digitalization measures which will be rolled out predominantly in the GB KL Hub for achieving the efficiency target. Drive initiatives which contribute to the improvement of service experience Identify deviations from the established blueprints of multiple system processors in Payroll and HR data maintenance processes and escalate to Assistant Manager and Manager in ensuring the capturing of business requirements, system settings, configuration needs and change trackers. Provide inputs and participate in user acceptance testing in system maintenance and upgrade, follow up and escalate timely with respective party to ensure fixes or changes can be delivered on time. Team Collaboration Works with moderate supervision within established procedures and practices. Contribute positively to a knowledge sharing environment through generously sharing knowledge with others. Assist in orientation training and act as buddy to new team member. Job Requirements Education Relevant tertiary qualifications: Degree in Accounting, Mathematics, Commerce or Business Administration and Finance Work Experience With 1 - 2 years of related HR working experiences in Payroll and HR Operations Ability to read, write, and communicate fluently in Mandarin is required due to business needs and support for Mandarin-speaking markets Preferably experience in relevant HR procedures, practices, and country statutory Knowledge of integrated payroll systems, preferably SAP. Technical & Professional Knowledge Demonstrates a good level of proficiency in language and culture of the supported country/location. Preferably understanding of HR principals and/or Employee Laws of the supported country/location. Strong processing skills and analytical abilities (inclination for Mathematics/Finance/Problem solving). Service mindset with strong interpersonal and communications skills. Functional knowledge and skills in using Microsoft application i.e. Words, Excel, Power Point. About BASF in Malaysia BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Head of US Crop Protection Regulatory Affairs - Research Triangle Park, NC (preferred)
jobs.description: Now hiring! Head of US Crop Protection Regulatory Affairs - Research Triangle Park, NC (preferred) We are looking for a Head of US Crop Protection Regulatory Affairs to join our Agricultural Solutions team in [Location]. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Agricultural Solutions division connects innovation, customers, partners and agricultural experts and integrates sustainability criteria into all business decisions. We help farmers deliver the best possible outcomes, working to achieve the balance between economic, environmental and social value creation for sustainable and efficient agriculture. This position leads the regulatory function in the US, ensuring freedom to operate for the Crop Protection business units within the Agricultural Solutions business. The role requires a strategic, agile and highly collaborative senior manager with a deep technical understanding of regulatory affairs/science and demonstrated success interfacing with Federal and State regulatory agency senior leadership. As a key member of the APD North American Crop Protection leadership team and industry influencer, you will leverage your connections with management in the commercial, supply chain and development functions and apply your understanding of competitive threats, changing regulatory dynamics, and new technologies to set the regulatory direction that facilitates successful business outcomes. As a Head of US Crop Protection Regulatory Affairs - Research Triangle Park, NC (preferred), you create chemistry by... Synthesizing complex scientific and regulatory information in a continually changing regulatory environment into understandable, clear and effective regulatory strategies at the portfolio level. Ensuring maintenance and defense of existing products, and ensure new products have robust submission dossiers.  Provide active support and alignment on policies and procedures both within APN and globally. Setting expectations and reinforcing a culture that emphasizes empowerment and a drive to meet customer needs while meeting regulatory requirements. Ensuring appropriate roles and staffing levels to meet business needs, with clear responsibilities while meeting budget requirements. Serving as key interface between US Regulatory and key internal BASF stakeholders, proactively facilitating collaboration and coordination to assure strategic alignment and build relationships with stakeholder groups including EPA, USDA, and trade associations, including leadership. Ensuring compliance with all applicable regulatory standards and record-keeping requirements. Working with other key stakeholders (legal, supply chain, technical service, etc.), managing potential issues. If you... Have a Ph.D. with 5+ years, MS with 10+ years, or BS with 15+ years of agricultural chemical industry experience. Previous agricultural chemical regulatory experience required. Demonstrate expert understanding of US agricultural chemical laws and regulations, including FIFRA, TSCA, and state requirements, with a proven track record of successful registration of pesticide products. Have proven experience and ability to build and lead a high-performance team. Have experience working with US EPA Office of Pesticide Programs, USDA and other government agencies, and trade associations. Show ability to synthesize complex scientific and regulatory information into a coherent and effective regulatory strategy that provides clear guidance to the business. Display negotiation skills and ability to build relationships with key stakeholders and negotiate outcomes beneficial to the business, weighing both short and longer-term needs, both internally and externally. Decision making. Ability to manage through difficult situations to evaluate and provide optimal outcomes, managing relationships to ensure key stakeholder needs are met. Possess the ability to deliver challenging messages to stakeholders, willing to seek creative solutions, maintain focus and provide a regulatory perspective. Demonstrate strong interpersonal and networking skills and an ability to understand motivations of others and build and maintain key relationships. This includes key leadership at government agencies (US EPA, USDA, state lead agencies, etc.), with the BASF global regulatory team, global supply chain, and the US Crop, Seed Treatment, and P&SS businesses. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Unified Communication Specialist
jobs.description: Who we are: We are BASF, the largest chemical company in the world, with over 150 years of experience. In Montevideo, we are a Hub made up of more than 1,000 employees who provide services for all BASF companies in the Americas. We offer professional solutions in finance, purchasing, reporting, logistics, technology, human resources, projects, communication, legal matters, environment, safety, health, and quality. Main Objective As part of the service delivery team your main role will be to support in the daily coordination, external operation and governance of Unified Communication services delivered by our external provider, while acting as a liaison between customers, internal stakeholders and the provider to ensure reliable and business-aligned service delivery. Tasks Support the Service Delivery global team in the day-to-day coordination of Unified Communication services delivered by the external provider, ensuring business continuity working closely with all regional service managers. As first line of operational contact you will assist the Service delivery manager to ensure the service delivery performance is aligned with the agreed SLAs, KPIs, and operational expectations. Support the organization and coordination of regular service review meetings with the provider for changes, incidents, requests, problems, etc. Follow up on open actions, service issues, improvement measures, and escalations to ensure timely resolution. Act as a supporting contact for the external UC provider in operational and service-related matters. Help ensure that incidents, service requests, escalations, and changes are properly tracked and followed by the provider. Ensure critical tasks receive the proper level of attention. Assist in reviewing provider performance, identifying trends, and highlighting risks or recurring issues to the Service Delivery Manager. Support the coordination of provider activities with internal teams and business stakeholders. Support in major incidents when required. Serve as a day-to-day liaison between customers / stakeholders and the external provider for service-related topics. Collect and consolidate feedback, requirements, and service concerns from business stakeholders, sites, and internal IT teams. Help to transfer the business needs into structured inputs for the Product Owner and the external provider. Communicate status updates, planned activities, service issues, and follow-up actions to relevant stakeholders. Support coordination with critical business stakeholders (Fire Brigade) Support the tracking of major incidents, recurring issues, problems, and escalations affecting Unified Communication services. Ensure that escalated issues are documented, followed up, and visible to the Service Delivery Manager. Help coordinate communication and follow-up during major service disruptions impacting end users or business operations, establishing contact with service desk, management, and other stakeholders. Support the Problem management process, RCA analysis and improvement actions for repeated service issues. Coordinate, analyze, review, and approval of change requests. Support and work in close contact with Contract value management to identify gaps in the CMDB ensuring the provider applies the needed corrections and permanent remediation to the identified process gaps. Support reporting activities related to service quality, incident trends, provider performance, and user feedback. Assist in identifying opportunities for service improvement, standardization, optimization, cost reductions and better user experience. Support improvement initiatives, rollouts, and service transition activities as required. Ensure governance artefacts and service records are accurate and up to date. Requirements Education: Degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Business Informatics or in a comparable field. Working Experience: 6+ years of experience in Unified Communications technologies and services. 3-5 years of experience in IT service coordination, service delivery, and provider management. 3-5 years of experience working with ITIL service management processes. 3-5 years of experience working with external service providers and managed services. 3-5 years of experience supporting global enterprise environments. 1-3 years agile project experience (nice to have). Language skills: Advanced level in English. Technical skills: Advanced skills in Unified Communications technologies and services. Advanced skills in IT service management and service delivery governance. Advanced skills in ServiceNow and service management tools. Intermediate skills in cloud solutions, virtualization, and monitoring tools. Intermediate skills in networking and telecommunications infrastructure. Intermediate skills in IT security and vulnerability management. Intermediate skills in Agile methodologies and DevOps practices. Soft skills: Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills. Advanced organizational and coordination skills. Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills. Advanced decision-making and prioritization skills. Advanced self-organized working skills with a proactive mindset. Advanced collaboration skills in multicultural and global environments. Advanced continuous learning and growth mindset. What we offer: Living BASF means being part of a culture where the focus is on people and on their professional and personal development. Our diversity, collaboration, and leadership style make the difference. When you join our team, we offer you: A hybrid and flexible working model Access to a learning ecosystem with on ‑ demand resources and tools Private medical insurance for you and your family from day one, as well as life insurance Additional flexible leave days, in addition to your statutory vacation days The possibility of remote work from abroad for up to 6 weeks a year A day off on your birthday A day off for moving Annual bonus (subject to meeting the requirements established by internal policies) Well ‑ being benefits, such as on ‑ site nutrition services and massages BASF considers Law N° 19.691 and Decree N° 73/019 in all its hiring processes. Every qualified candidate who meets the requirements established in the job description will be considered in this hiring process with no distinction. Moreover, BASF is an equal-opportunity employer. We enthusiastically accept our responsibility to make employment decisions without regard to race, age, civil and social status, national origin, disability, sex, gender identity or expressions, or any other candidate or employee´s characteristic or group that is not related to their aptitude and suitability for the position. Our management is committed to following this policy concerning hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, termination, recruiting, pay, and other forms of compensation, training, and general treatment during employment.

jobs.name: EHS Specialist Italy
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Agriculture is all about balance. The balance that is crucial to everyone’s existence – also for our Agricultural Solutions division. We connect innovative thinking with practical action to find the right balance for success – for farmers, agriculture and future generations. With seeds and traits, crop protection and digital solutions, we help farmers produce food more efficiently, protect the land and meet the needs of society. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You will employed by BASF Agricultural Solutions Italy S.r.l. Managing EHS Specialist and RSPP responsabilities for BASF small sites in Italy, ensuring compliance with Italian Health & Safety legislation and internal EHS standards. Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the EHS management system, including BASF Responsible Care requirements, procedures, and governance. Promote a strong safety culture across Italian sites through EHS campaigns, training initiatives, Safety Days, and Behavior-Based Safety programs. Monitor regulatory developments and ensure the timely implementation of required actions related to health, safety, environment, process safety, and security. Coordinate risk assessments, incident investigations, corrective actions, emergency preparedness activities, and site safety reviews. Support environmental compliance activities, including emissions, water, waste management, supplier audits, and environmental assessments. Functionally coordinate EHS representatives across sites, organize follow-up meetings, monitor action plans, and support management reviews. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, external service providers, contractors, authorities, and regional EHS teams to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree in EHS, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field, with relevant experience in an industrial environment. 3–5 years of experience in Health, Safety & Environment roles, preferably within manufacturing, chemical, or industrial sites. Solid knowledge of Italian Health & Safety legislation, including D.Lgs. 81/08, and familiarity with RSPP responsibilities. Strong understanding of EHS management systems, risk prevention, process safety, environmental protection, and compliance requirements. Experience in risk assessments, incident investigations, safety procedures, emergency management, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to promote safety culture through training, communication campaigns, and engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Proactive, autonomous, and rigorous working style, with strong communication skills and the ability to adapt messages to different audiences. Fluent English, both written and spoken, is essential. Residence in Bologna or the surrounding area is required. Regular travel to the assigned sites: Lugo (RA), Fasano (BR), Colognola ai Colli (BI), Sant'Agata Bolognese (BO), and Ascoli Satriano (FG) is an essential requirement of the role. WHAT WE OFFER CCNL (National Chemical Collective Agreement). Indicative gross annual salary (RAL) between €50,000 and €55,000, to be assessed based on the candidate’s skills and relevant experience. Performance-based variable bonus. Company participation bonus. Corporate welfare program. Company car for both business and personal use. HOW TO REACH US Do you have questions about the selection process or the position? You can contact: talent-acquisition-italy@basf.com Initial information about the application process is available here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: - Cyber Security Risk Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are seeking an experienced Cyber Security Risk Specialist to join our CISO organization. As part of the Cyber Security Risk Management team, you will contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of our cyber security risk management framework. RESPONSIBILITIES You will be a part of our Cyber Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Product Family, which is the pilar of the second Line of Defense (2LoD) and manages the Cyber Security Framework for the whole BASF Group, following a risk-based approach. One major part of that is to develop and implement risk management tools, policies, and procedures in line with ISO 27001 and other relevant standards. Your core responsibilities will be: Provide support to Asset Owners and Risk Owners to facilitate the operationalization of Cyber Risk Management-related processes across both IT and OT (Automation Technology) environments, Foster collaboration with our global Risk Community, incl. OT stakeholders, by actively gathering their feedback, while effectively communicating updates and enhancements to ensure alignment and engagement. Provide awareness materials and moderate training sessions on Cyber Security Risk Management with dedicated modules for OT environments to promote continuous learning and compliance towards BASF Business Units Derive new processes or pilots to strengthen GRC in response to the evolving threat landscape in IT and OT (Automation Technology) Conduct research on new threats by leveraging different sources such as Google Threat Intelligence or Dragos Execute strategic risk assessments on-demand to identify and evaluate emerging risks in IT and OT, including risks to production continuity, safety, and environmental impact, that could negatively affect or harm BASF Maintain and improve the toolset that our team provides (RSA Archer, Power BI, Knowledge Base within SharePoint) ensuring integration of OT-specific risk scenarios, asset classifications, and network segmentation (e.g., Purdue model layers) Aggregate operational risks and translate asset-specific risks to generic risk scenarios on enterprise level to support senior management reporting and strategic as well as tactical decision-making Support the lifecycle update of group-wide cyber security governance regulations based on generic BASF risk landscape Work closely with cross-functional teams to support compliance of risk management processes with ISMS according to ISO 27001 and OT security requirements Collaborate with Asset Owners and Risk Owners to maintain a risk register of IT and OT risks and associated risk treatment plans up to date Monitor and report on the effectiveness of risk management controls including OT-specific compensating controls (e.g., network segmentation, jump hosts, monitoring) and support the reporting of significant risks to senior management. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field Experience with developing, implementing, and maintaining an ISMS based on ISO 27001 and familiarity with IEC 62443 or comparable OT security frameworks Profound experience in cyber security, particularly in GRC and cyber security risk management across IT and OT environments Strong experience in security for automation and laboratory environments, including industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA, DCS, PLCs, and LIMS/PIMSSolid understanding of OT architectures and concepts (e.g., Purdue Model, network segmentation, zones and conduits) and their implications for cyber risk management Strong understanding of risk management principles, frameworks and practices, especially in the field of risk aggregation as well as definition and evaluation of generic risks on enterprise level Experience with risk assessments, cyber threats and vulnerabilities Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations related to cyber security and OT security Ability to bridge communication between IT security teams and OT/engineering stakeholders in production environments Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal team members and cross-functional teams Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC are a plus additional OT-focused certifications (e.g., GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443) are highly desirable BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right. jobs.name: Observability Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. You will join the Visibility Team of BASF whose mission it is to build an AI and big data fueled observability solution to predict, avoid and analyze complex disturbances in BASF’s global infrastructure. The team provides and develops the platform that stakeholders such as infrastructure operations, application teams and other business partners can get the required insights from. Aim is to give BASF an end to end visibility solution for Application Performance Management (APM), Network Performance Monitoring (NPM) and IT Infrastructure Monitoring (ITIM). RESPONSIBILITIES Understand the needs of internal Business Partners and their use cases regarding observability. Steering of managed services. Own end-to-end accountability for the BASF observability landscape—from infrastructure design and tooling development through CI/CD deployment, operational monitoring, and continuous improvement. Combine the strengths of observability tools in place, e.g. Grafana. Gigamon. Traffic Broker. Zabbix. Cisco. Thousand Eyes. ELK. Find additional ways to leverage the collected system data to generate value for BASF. Leverage AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort in daily business QUALIFICATIONS Good overview across enterprise IT landscape architectures. Expertise in network infrastructure desirable. Proactive mindset. Cloud experience (AWS, Azure) highly beneficial. Python/JavaScript/Shell scripting. Experienced in using code repository (GitLab, Bitbucket). Knowledge about CI/CD tools is also a plus. Monitoring tools (not all mandatory, some background/understanding): APM: Datadog, Dynatrace. NPM: SolarWinds, NetScout. ITM: Zabbix, Nagios, checkMK. Log engines: ELK, Splunk. Steering managed services experience. Daily usage of AI tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot). Well understanding about AI concepts like: LLM. MCP Server. Agent. Skills. Good ability to gain competence in new assignment areas quickly and independently covering new technologies, methods and skills is essential. Extraordinary analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills. Out of the box thinking is desirable to understand and eliminate complexity and to find innovative solutions for complex problems. Able to work as part of a globally spread, virtual team. Strong will and ability to communicate within and outside the team is key. Education and Work Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree / University degree / University of applied Sciences degree (IT, Business IT) is required. Professional English skills mandatory. Minimum 5+ years job experience in security operations within mid & large-size enterprise environments. Technical career preferably in information technologies, telecommunications technologies, process control technology, communication technologies. Ability to work within small, creative teams as well as cross-functional teams. BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right. Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. CONTACT Do you have any questions about the application process or the position? Please reach out to Felipe Bianco ( felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com )

jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Provide Accounts Payable's payment process related support to deliver AP services to BASF companies in Asia Pacific in accordance with established processes and work procedures and in compliance with BASF policies, Financial Reporting Compliance (FRC), local company legal and statutory requirements. Ensure that timelines and quality are met within the service levels agreements. Work closely with respective team (eg: invoicing team) to reduce the SPOT and duplicate check error rate. To monitor and manage domestic payment method e.g. Bank acceptance draft To support forex payment (trade and non-trade) compliance check documentation e.g. tax clearance documents, customs clearance, shipping documents and invoice copy. To monitor payment traffic/Global Payment System (GPS) status and bank rejection once proposal executed. To ensure payment transaction is successfully transferred to bank. To prepare and perform manual payment, free format instruction (FFI) and obtain bank approval from authorizers before bank cut off time To download bank slip from bank portal and save them in shared drive upon payment execution. To liaise closely with bank authorizers in handling online bank transaction (manual payments, local bank, free format instruction) is and ensure timely approvals To support local business/ local finance and BSSCKL internal in urgent payment handling on stipulated deadline To attend request or inquiry on Account Payable especially payment related queries via payment functional mailbox, AP Service Desk and Payable Query mailboxes To support vendor management team (if required) in attending calls from 3rd party vendor, external parties as well as BASF users in payment related queries Be the Key person/ focal person to liaise with banks in payment rejection/payment failure related matters To support transition/projects activities and perform testing, whenever necessary To support centralized audit activities whenever required including system demo and provide required documentation and samples, and attend to audit queries etc. To response to payment related queries or concerns from local business/local finance, BSSCKL internal and vendors To act as back up to team members and perform payment task as when required. To ensure processes are complying to BASF policies & guideline, local company’s policy, bank/ legal and statutory requirements. To maintain awareness of the latest fraud trends especially phishing call and email. To ensure that all the emails sent/received are to/from accurate email addresses and avoid revealing company details to unknown callers. Quality and Continuous Improvement Identify and recommend new idea / solutions to Specialist/Expert & Managers for continuous improvement opportunities. Perform routine update to Accounts Payable documentation (e.g. Work Instruction, Process Definition, Job Aid< Knowledge Management) when required Support existing team members through proper knowledge transfer, sharing of resource, knowledge and experience and best practice thereby ensuring quality is maintained through any staff transition. Support regional and global project improvements activity e.g. involve in User Acceptance Test and Training Service Management Execute work in accordance with the service management framework by providing timely and excellent customer service. Stakeholder Management Develop and maintain working relationships with customers to ensure that solutions are adopted, implemented and maintained appropriately. Frequent cooperation within BASF Group and/or BSSCKL: Counterparts in local company and end-users Cross function teams within BSSCKL Manager, senior analyst and peers within Finance Delivery teams Other support functions within BSSCKL e.g. Control, Project, Quality & Compliance (PQC) team, Corporate Audit teams Requirements Education & Working Experience: Currently pursuing or completing the final year of a diploma or bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or other related disciplines. Able to commit to a minimum internship period of five (5) months. Fluent in Mandarin (spoken, written, and reading) to support Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and markets. Reputable knowledge and understanding of P2P and accounting functions is a plus. External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing is a plus. Technical & Professional Knowledge: Experience working in an SAP work environment is a plus. Knowledge and experience of MS office tools, CONCUR, SAP system or another ERP system is a plus.

Unvorstellbar! Als Chemikant:in übernimmst Du anspruchsvolle Aufgaben im gesamten Herstellungsprozess: vom Bereitstellen der Inhaltsstoffe bis zur Abfüllung der fertigen Lacke. Du bedienst und überwachst die Produktionsanlagen, entnimmst regelmäßig Proben und analysierst die Produkte – einschließlich der Dokumentation. Damit bekommst Du nicht nur einen Einblick in unsere spannende Produktwelt, sondern bist bei der Produktion mittendrin statt nur dabei. Du wirkst daran mit, dass wir die besten Produkte herstellen. DAS LERNST DU WÄHREND DEINER AUSBILDUNG Verantwortung für Vorbereitung, Steuerung und Überwachung der Produktionsprozesse Mitwirken bei der Verfahrensentwicklung zur Herstellung chemischer Produkte aus organischen und anorganischen Rohstoffen Durchführen von Wartungsarbeiten Entnahme von Produktproben und Untersuchungen im Labor Erhalten der hohen Standards bei Umweltschutz und Arbeitssicherheit DAS BRINGST DU MIT Fachoberschulreife Begeisterung für Chemie und Technik Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit großes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Genauigkeit und Sorgfalt beim Arbeiten DAS BIETEN WIR IN DEINER AUSBILDUNG eine spannende Ausbildung mit Besuch des Hans-Böckler-Berufskollegs in Münster (Westfalen) verschiedenste Einblicke in unterschiedlichste Abteilungen wie bspw. Infrastrukturbetriebe, Lackproduktion und Harzfabrik attraktive Vergütung – Du startest mit über 1.200 € im 1. Ausbildungsjahr und erhältst zahlreiche Zusatzleistungen (z. B.: Weihnachtsgeld, 700 € Urlaubsgeld) wir übernehmen Dich bei erfolgreichem Ausbildungsabschluss– versprochen! Verkürzung der Ausbildung bei entsprechender Leistung möglich 30 Tage Urlaub maßgeschneiderte Schulungsangebote in Form von Seminaren und Workshops zum Weiterentwickeln deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Fähigkeiten Freizeitangebote (z. B. betriebliches Fitnessstudio), Mitarbeiterevents und Teilnahme an Azubiprojekten (z. B. Kennenlernfahrt) AUSBILDUNG GESCHAFFT - WAS DANN ? Deine Ausbildung ist der Startpunkt: Bei herausragenden persönlichen und fachlichen Leistungen unterstützen wir deine individuelle Entwicklung – ob durch fachliche Weiterbildungen, Spezialisierungen oder eine weiterführende Qualifizierung. Gemeinsam finden wir den richtigen Weg für deine Zukunft. DEIN WEG ZU UNS: Richtig bewerben - so geht's! Neugierde, Offenheit und Motivation. Für uns steht deine Persönlichkeit im Vordergrund. Noten sind nicht alles. Im ersten Schritt des Auswahlverfahrens bleiben die Schulnoten daher erst einmal unberücksichtigt. Für uns ist der Gesamteindruck entscheidend. Compliance Manager,Tokyo 勤務地 会社 ジョブフィールド 職種 ジョブID 柔軟な働き方の選択肢 勤務地 会社 ジョブフィールド 職種 ジョブID 柔軟な働き方の選択肢 今すぐ応募する 輸出入・通関・貿易コンプライアンスマネージャー 勤務地 ：東京 グレード ：5 ポジション概要 日本における輸出入業務、通関業務および貿易コンプライアンス全般の責任者として、ハブ組織および日本国内の関係部門と連携しながら、物流・通関オペレーションの最適化とコンプライアンス遵守を推進します。社内外のステークホルダーとの窓口として機能し、物流サービスプロバイダーの管理、業務改善、リスク管理、デジタル化推進などを主導します。 主な職務内容 1. 輸出入・通関オペレーション管理 日本における輸出入および通関業務のKPI達成、品質維持、法令遵守を統括 フォワーダー、通関業者、船会社、タンクオペレーター等の物流サービスプロバイダーを管理 サービスレベル、コスト、パフォーマンスの継続的改善を推進 日本およびAPAC地域のサプライチェーンチームと協働し、安定した物流オペレーションを実現 業務効率化、デジタル化、自動化プロジェクトを推進 2. 通関・貿易管理 関税法、外国為替及び外国貿易法などの関連法規および社内ポリシーの遵守を確保 輸入関税・消費税等の適正な申告・支払いプロセスを管理 税関や関係当局との窓口として監査、照会、紛争対応を実施 EPA/FTA（経済連携協定・自由貿易協定）を活用した関税最適化を推進 AEO制度、保税制度、フリートレードゾーンなど各種優遇制度の運用管理 グローバルおよびリージョナルへの各種レポーティングを担当 3. 物流ベンダーマネジメント 物流サービスプロバイダー（3PL/LSP）の契約・サービス管理 業務移管、ナレッジトランスファー、変更管理の推進 ベンダーパフォーマンスの評価・改善活動の実施 輸配送リスクおよびコンプライアンスリスクの管理 物流コスト最適化の推進 4. 貿易コンプライアンス 日本における National Trade Compliance Officer（NTCO）として機能 貿易管理・輸出管理規制の変更をモニタリングし事業影響を評価 規制対象品目、制裁対象者・取引先のスクリーニング管理 Internal Compliance Program（ICP）の維持・改善 貿易コンプライアンス教育および啓発活動の推進 5. リスク管理および継続的改善 アクセス権管理、データ保護、事業継続計画（BCP）を含むリスク管理の実施 業務プロセスの標準化および文書化 グローバル・リージョナルプロジェクトへの参画 データ分析を活用した業務改善とオペレーショナルエクセレンスの推進 応募資格 必須要件 大学卒業以上 （経営学、サプライチェーンマネジメント、国際物流、貿易関連分野歓迎） 通関・貿易実務またはサプライチェーン領域で5年以上の経験 多国籍企業またはグローバル環境での業務経験 サプライチェーンおよび物流オペレーションに関する知識 ステークホルダーマネジメント能力 英語による業務遂行能力（海外チームとの協業あり） 歓迎要件 通関士資格 貿易管理・輸出管理の知識 SAPの使用経験 BIツール（Power BI等）の活用経験 物流ベンダーマネジメント経験 プロジェクトマネジメント経験 今すぐ応募する A unique total offer: you@BASF jobs.description: Objectives of the Position • Manage import export, customs and trade compliance for Japan, jointly with hub and country GB. • Key contact in Japan for import export, customs and trade compliance relevant interactions with customer, service providers and local business units / stakeholders • Lead performance and development of import export and customs operations in Japan, with collaboration from regional / global supply chain • Lead management of logistics service providers (LSP+ and LSP) in Japan, leading to performance steering for import export & customs in Japan, meeting regional and global import export performance results. This includes effective monitoring and leveraging analytics to sustain high level of operating discipline • Responsible for risk management pertaining to team and service provider operations including but not limited to access management, data protection, business continuity process and periodic risk management reviews • Ownership, participation and collaboration on global and regional import export and customs community and initiatives and projects relevant to supply chain operations serviced by Global Business Service • Responsible for establishment, adherence, and adequate documentation of supply chain, import export and customs processes and compliance to global, regional policies and procedures. • Initiate continuous improvement measures with stakeholders, with focus on automation and digitalization initiatives Main Tasks General • Responsible for import export and customs operations targets, performance, deliverables and compliance • Responsible for service provider management of forwarder/customs brokers and liner /carrier / tank operators including performance management, service requirement and freight cost management. • Provide and recommend logistics solution and/ or subject matter advice to business, country, regional and global stakeholders, • Collaborate and support Japan supply chain caretaker in country operational matters and with regional shipping management, operational vendor management and regional customs • Active participation in global, regional, and country level projects and initiatives for companywide projects, continuous improvement, and business requirement, where relevant to the scope of service Customs & Foreign Trade • Responsible compliance to company policies and local regulatory and statutory requirements specifically on customs and trade • Responsible for customs operations processing by both internal team and service providers to ensure accurate duty & import tax processing up to duty payment processing within the scope of customs and foreign trade team. To ensure adequate verification and documentation of duty process and payment to customs authority in line with established payment process with finance Internal • Manage customs and authority adherence to rules as stipulated in the respective trade agreements • Responsible for customs broker management in line with global policies and customs broker management framework and guidelines • Manage operations of trade facilities within the country e.g. Free trade zone, Bonded facilities, AEO, Green Lanes, special exemptions where applicable and relevant to customs operations • Conform to global and regional customs requirements on reporting, information on dashboards, community reviews, global inquiries responses, initiative participation, etc Operation Vendor Management (Logistics changes; derive business impact • Evaluate regulated goods and sanctioned parties against national laws relevant o trade compliance • Maintain the Internal Compliance Program (ICP) for own jurisdiction Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position • Education: Degree in Business Administration or equivalent, Supply Chain Management, and other Degree with relevant work experience • Working Experience: Minimum 5 years in Customs & Foreign Trade, Supply Chain Management in Multinational Company with international exposure • Technical & Professional Knowledge: Supply chain management / operational logistics knowledge, Customs and International trade and regulation preferred, SAP experience preferred, Business Intelligence Tools, Non-conformance management, good jobs.name: SAP EWM, StRM, IM Consultant - (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. The role provides Application support for SAP logistics processes, ensuring stable operations, fast incident resolution and continuous improvement across SAP EWM, Inventory Management and Stock Room Management (SAP MM-IM or/and SAP WM) Key Responsibilities : • Application support: Receive, prioritize and document incidents and service requests with impact, evidence and reproduction steps. Analyze complex warehouse and inventory issues across configuration, logs, interfaces and process dependencies. • Standard issue resolution: Resolve user issues, authorization questions, errors and transaction problems using defined procedures and knowledge articles. Get supported by AI features for ticket handling support. • Cross-team coordination: Work with cross teams to resolve technical defects, interface failures and performance issues. • Problem management: Being able to early identify recurring issues and define PDCA to able to resolve problems • Change and release support: Support approved fixes, configuration changes, testing, transport preparation, release activities and cutover support. • Operational excellence: Maintain runbooks, support documentation and knowledge base articles to improve first-time resolution and system stability. • Escalation management: Escalate to Level 3 or development teams where required, providing full diagnostics, evidence and business impact assessment. Required Qualifications : • Several years of experience in SAP application support, preferably in logistics, warehouse management or inventory management environments. • Good functional knowledge of SAP EWM, SAP MM-IM and SAP SRM Stock Room Management (or Warehouse Management (SAP WM)), including inbound, outbound, stock movements, inventory handling and warehouse execution. • Strong experience with ITSM processes, ticket handling, incident management, change management and structured troubleshooting. • Basic technical understanding of SAP logs, jobs, interfaces, IDocs, RFCs and integration monitoring. • Basic understanding, monitoring and error handling for APIs, Kafka streams, BTP and debugging • Strong analytical skills, customer orientation and clear communication in English. Nice to Have • Experience with MES or other Level 3 system integrations connected to warehouse and inventory processes. • German, Spanish or Mandarin WHAT WE OFFER Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross-functional collaboration. Shape the future of BASF’s digital landscape, contributing to projects that drive sustainability and make a real impact. Thrive in a high-performance culture that supports your personal and professional growth, offering diverse learning opportunities and career development. Enjoy a modern, inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your curiosity and ambition are encouraged. Benefit from flexible working models, international networking, and a strong sense of purpose as we enable our customers’ green transformation and lead the way in digital excellence.

jobs.name: Canola Sites Operations Lead
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Canola Site Operations Lead, you will enjoy a diverse role overseeing the safety, compliance and efficient operation of BASF's canola seed sites across Australia. You'll be responsible for site governance, infrastructure, EHS and regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and CAPEX delivery while working closely with breeding, seed production and operations teams to drive operational excellence across multiple locations. How You Will Do It Lead the safe, compliant and efficient operation of BASF’s Australian canola seed sites, ensuring consistent standards across multiple locations. Drive site governance, infrastructure maintenance and asset management to support reliable and audit-ready operations. Coordinate contractors, suppliers and service providers, ensuring strong performance, compliance and operational excellence. Champion EHS, stewardship and regulatory compliance through audits, inspections, training and continuous improvement initiatives. Lead site CAPEX activities, partnering with key stakeholders to deliver operational improvements and business outcomes. Collaborate closely with breeding, seed production and operations teams to support successful canola seed production programs across Australia. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring experience in agricultural operations, along with a strong commitment to safety, compliance and operational excellence. You'll enjoy working across multiple sites, building relationships with diverse stakeholders and driving efficient, well-governed operations. You will: Hold a qualification in Agricultural Science, Business, or a related discipline. Have experience in agricultural operations, farming, seed production or rural business coordination, ideally within a multi-site environment. Demonstrate knowledge of EHS requirements, auditing processes and regulatory compliance within an agricultural setting. Be highly organised with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate contractors, suppliers and site activities effectively. Have a hands-on approach, with experience operating farm machinery or agricultural equipment highly regarded. Be a proactive communicator who can collaborate effectively across operations, breeding, seed production and support teams What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Contra Season Agronomy Lead, you will play a key role in delivering BASF's North American canola seed program from Australia. You'll lead agronomic strategy and execution across parent seed, breeding and hybrid production programs, providing technical leadership to agronomy teams while driving crop performance, seed quality and operational excellence. How You Will Do It Lead agronomic strategy and field execution across BASF's contra-season canola seed production programs, ensuring strong yield, quality and timeliness outcomes. Provide technical leadership, coaching and development to agronomists, seasonal employees and field teams to build high-performing operations. Drive field decision-making, crop monitoring and agronomic troubleshooting to optimise production performance and resolve issues quickly. Partner with North American stakeholders to align production plans, resources and delivery timelines with business requirements. Oversee seed quality, certification and compliance activities, ensuring adherence to industry standards and regulatory requirements. Champion a safety-first culture and ensure all field operations meet EHS, stewardship and quality requirements. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring extensive agronomy and seed production experience, along with a passion for leading teams and delivering outstanding crop outcomes. You'll enjoy balancing strategic planning with hands-on field leadership and thrive in a fast-paced agricultural production environment. You will: Hold a degree in Agricultural Science or a related discipline. Have minimum 7 years of experience in agribusiness, including significant seed production experience, ideally within hybrid canola systems. Bring proven leadership experience, with a track record of developing and leading high-performing teams. Have strong agronomic knowledge and practical experience in crop production, field operations and agronomy decision-making. Demonstrate excellent problem-solving, planning and stakeholder management skills in complex operational environments. Possess strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse teams across Australia and North America. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. BASF is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for all women. If you’d like to know more information about how we are supporting our employees, you can view our policies and benefits here . Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

jobs.description: About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a Technical Marketing Manager, you'll play a pivotal role at the intersection of agronomy, technical expertise and commercial strategy. Working closely with sales, customers and industry stakeholders, you'll lead the technical direction of BASF's crop protection portfolio, develop compelling technical marketing programs and drive the successful launch of innovative solutions across New Zealand. How You Will Do It Lead technical strategy and provide expert support for BASF's crop protection portfolio, helping drive customer success and commercial growth. Develop and manage agronomy trials, translating technical data and field insights into practical recommendations and commercial opportunities. Create technical marketing materials, product positioning and data-driven stories that support customer engagement and sales effectiveness. Partner with sales teams, customers and industry stakeholders to provide technical advice, training and product expertise. Lead the planning and execution of new product launches, including business case development, market assessments and launch strategies. Investigate field performance enquiries and provide technical guidance to optimise product performance and customer outcomes. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring a strong foundation in agronomy and crop protection, combined with the ability to translate technical information into practical solutions for customers and commercial teams. You'll enjoy building relationships, sharing knowledge and influencing outcomes across a diverse stakeholder network. You will: Hold a degree in Agricultural Science or a related discipline. Have significant experience within the crop protection, agrichemical or agribusiness industry, ideally with exposure to a broad range of crop segments. Bring proven agronomic expertise and experience working with crop protection products. Be confident presenting technical information, delivering training and engaging with customers, industry groups and commercial teams. Demonstrate strong analytical skills and the ability to convert data and field observations into actionable business insights. Possess excellent communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below.
