About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As a National EHS Specialist, you will be the trusted advisor for Environment, Health & Safety across BASF's Agricultural Solutions business in Australia and New Zealand. You'll partner with business leaders to strengthen our EHS culture, drive compliance, influence safe work practices and deliver continuous improvement across diverse agricultural operations, sites and supply chain partners. How You Will Do It Partner with business leaders across ANZ to provide expert EHS guidance and drive EHS priorities across the Agricultural Solutions (AP) business. Ensure compliance with Responsible Care principles, Australian and New Zealand legislation, and BASF EHS standards across sites, warehouses, contractors and suppliers. Champion and strengthen BASF's OneAP EHS culture through engagement, coaching, training and continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor emerging regulatory requirements, assess business impacts and implement practical compliance and risk management strategies. Analyse EHS performance data and KPIs to identify trends, drive improvements and support leadership decision-making. Vores produkter anvendes globalt i fødevare-, kosttilskuds- og medicinalindustrien, og vi beskæftiger ca. 130 engagerede medarbejdere. jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Do you want to work with passionate teams, providing excellent business and digital services to the Asia Pacific region? Do you want an open, supportive, and caring working environment? Do you view your development needs seriously as we do? If YES, then take your career to the #NextLevel with BASF ! Objectives of the Position The Purchase To Pay provides invoice verification services for Inbound / Outbound supply chain activities. It is the focal point for the relevant invoice verification activities before payment is initiated to the service providers. The analyst, will execute the process with a consistent high level of service to be able to meet the growing needs of the businesses in Asia Pacific Main Tasks Operations and Performance: Check and verify inbound and outbound invoices against contracted / approved Spot rates from service providers according to guidelines Coordinate with service providers / local country Supply Chain / Finance teams for invoice clarifications and corrections to avoid service interruptions Provide full and accurate supporting documents to Finance team for vendor payment Understand charging mechanism and process for relevant Supply Chain services Participate proactively in new workflows or process improvements for on time and accurate verification services Identify risk related to the process and propose mitigations Troubleshooting and problem solving Support and provide documents for internal and external audit purpose Requirements Bachelor degree in Business or Supply Chain Management or Finance and Accounting. Relevant experience in Purchase to pay, supply chain management/ shipping management, including hands-on experience in dealing with logistics service provider and shipping invoice handling. Supply Chain Management or Finance and Accounting /process knowledge, SAP Transportation Management experience, including hands-on experience in operational shipping / logistics management, good communication skills. BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre was established in 2005. Located in Kuala Lumpur, the regional service hub has approximately 1,100 employees and growing. Focused on being a competency and digitalization driven hub, it also provides quality functional and know-how services in the areas of finance, controlling, human resources, real estate and facilities management, communications, environmental, health and safety, procurement, import-export order management, and information services to BASF companies and affiliates in the Asia Pacific region. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay that cover the Europe and Americas regions. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 111,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises six segments: Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €87.3 billion in 2022. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the U.S. Further information at www.basf.com .

jobs.name: Senior Manager, Technology
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position Own and drive regional technology for Acrylic Acid & Acrylates as the single technology focal point for Asia Pacific. Lead technical execution of investment projects and ensure on‑time, on‑budget delivery. Drive OpEx and cost‑reduction initiatives to improve asset effectiveness and KPIs. Coordinate cross‑functional stakeholders to implement technology and reliability measures. Provide hands‑on technical support, troubleshooting and capability building across the region. Main Tasks Act as the accountable regional technology owner for Acrylic Acid & Acrylates in Asia - proactively drive technical support, decisions and improvements at all production sites. Lead technical dialogues with external partners and project teams to define, design and approve tie‑ins, plant integrations and raw‑material feed specifications; own the technical interface and ensure robust integration plans. Serve as the single interface between Global Technology & Strategy, Operations and Regional Business Management; prepare and steer internal decision packages and approval processes (Commissions S and F). Evaluate technical and economic viability of projects - from debottlenecking and new site assessments to alternative feedstock options - and recommend clear go/no‑go and make‑or‑buy decisions aligned with regional strategy. Drive and/or lead cost and technology benchmarking studies, delivering actionable recommendations to reduce manufacturing cost and improve competitiveness. Own process and product safety activities for the portfolio in Asia, including regulatory compliance and risk‑mitigation measures; escalate and resolve safety or compliance gaps. Lead Operational Excellence across all Acrylic Acid & Acrylates assets in the region: define targets, prioritize initiatives, sponsor implementation and ensure sustained KPI improvements. Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position Degree: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a closely related engineering/technical field. Experience: Minimum 6 years of hands‑on experience in chemical manufacturing or technology development, with demonstrated problem‑solving in production environments and proven responsibility in managing investment projects (engineering, commissioning or debottlenecking). Technical expertise: Strong, practical knowledge of Acrylic Acid & Acrylates production processes, including process design, plant operations and process control systems. Project and commercial skills: Solid track record in project management (scope, schedule, budget), technology and manufacturing cost evaluations, and executing make‑or‑buy assessments. Operational excellence & safety: Experience driving OpEx initiatives and applying process and product safety, regulatory compliance, and risk‑reduction measures in plant environments. jobs.name: Technician, Utilities & WWTP
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position • Supports the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Utilities plants to ensure continuous supply of utilities to the site and production plants according to required quality and operational demand. • Provides operational support to Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) activities through monitoring, sampling, laboratory testing and routine operational tasks to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, regulatory and operational requirements. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Boiler Operation 1. Supports the safe and reliable operation of Utilities plants and ensures equipment is maintained in good operational condition, including: i. Treated water storage and supply system, Water Demineralization Plant, Cooling Water System, and Fire Hydrant pumping facilities. ii. Steam generation plants and steam distribution system. iii. Air compressors and compressed air supply system. iv. Nitrogen Membrane Generator, LIN storage and evaporator, and nitrogen distribution system. 2. Support to operate and monitor the Diesel Engine Emergency Generator set during TNB power failure or emergency situations. 3. Records daily stock levels and consumption of utilities direct and indirect raw materials, including boiler gas fuel, water treatment chemicals, and other related consumables. 4. Supports the recording and updating of daily utilities supply data and operating parameters in computerized log sheets to ensure accurate operational records 5. Assists maintenance technicians during maintenance activities, major overhauls, plant shutdowns, troubleshooting, and repair works on Utilities equipment and machinery. 6. Supports the site Emergency Response Plan, including firefighting activities and other emergency requirements, as instructed. Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) Support Operations 1. Supports the operation and routine monitoring of the Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) to ensure stable operation and compliance with environmental, safety and operational requirements. 2. Support Performs routine wastewater sampling, field inspections, laboratory testing and operational checks in accordance with established procedures, monitoring plans and schedules. 3. Assists in monitoring and recording key operational and laboratory parameters, including pH, COD, flow, sludge-related observations and other relevant process indicators to support effective WWTP operation. 4. Assists the WWTP Technician/Competent Person in routine plant operation, troubleshooting activities, process monitoring and follow-up actions arising from abnormal operating conditions. 5. Supports sludge handling, dewatering, storage, documentation and scheduled waste management activities in accordance with applicable regulatory and site requirements. 6. Maintains accurate operational records, laboratory results, inspection findings and related documentation to support environmental compliance and reporting requirements. 7. Reports abnormalities, equipment issues, process deviations or potential compliance concerns to the superior or WWTP responsible person for further evaluation and action. Others 1. Supports the implementation and compliance of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, 5S, Process Safety Management, and other site management systems by practicing established procedures and requirements. 2. Maintains good housekeeping and cleanliness at Utilities plants, Wastewater Treatment Plant areas, and related work locations. 3. Supports safe work practices and complies with BASF safety, health, environmental, quality, and operational requirements at all times. 4. Performs any additional duties or tasks assigned by management from time to time. Job Requirements (minimum requirement to carry out the work) Minimum Diploma in Environment, Chemical or Mechanical background Possess a valid 2nd Grade Boiler Operator Certificate. Possess relevant DOE certifications such as CePIETSO-PCP and CePSWaM. Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Boiler Operation, with hands-on knowledge and skills in boiler system troubleshooting. Minimum 1 to 3 years of experience in Wastewater Treatment Plant operations would be an added advantage. Good understanding of local regulatory requirements related to boiler operation. Additional knowledge of utilities systems such as Water Demineralization Plant, Air Compressors, Nitrogen Membrane Generators, LIN Evaporator, and related distribution systems. Able to use computers for routine work management and familiar with common Microsoft Office applications such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Good command of English, with the ability to speak, read, and write effectively. Familiar with management systems and workplace practices such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001/18001, 5S, and other BASF site standards. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Manager for Natural Gas Trading/Origination
jobs.description: Now hiring! Manager for Natural Gas Trading/Origination Houston, TX (Hybrid) We are looking for a Manager for Natural Gas Trading/Origination to join our Direct Global Procurement team in Houston, TX. Global Direct and Logistics Procurement (GPD) oversees the strategic procurement of raw materials and logistics services for the BASF Group worldwide. Within this framework, Direct Procurement Americas (GPD/N) manages the procurement of raw materials for BASF sites across the Americas. This includes over 100 regionally managed categories such as power, sodium hydroxide, sulfuric acid, amines, and plastic additives. The team also optimizes the procurement of raw materials via distribution partners and negotiates contract manufacturing agreements. BASF International Trading (BIT) manages global commodity trading and supply strategies across energy and chemical markets, operating around the clock through key hubs in Europe, Asia, and North America. Leveraging expertise in physical and financial trading, BIT helps secure supply, manage risk, and create value for BASF and its customers worldwide. In this role, you will help manage and optimize one of the largest industrial natural gas portfolios in North America, leading physical trading activities, supporting risk management, and driving business growth through origination and commercial development. As Manager, Natural Gas Trading & Origination, you will play a critical role in securing reliable gas supply while generating value through strategic market positioning and trading opportunities. Come create chemistry with us! As a Manager for Natural Gas Trading/Origination, you create chemistry by... Monitoring North American energy markets and developing own market analysis of North American Natural Gas. Managing and optimize BASF's natural gas portfolio across the Gulf Coast and Southeast U.S., balancing physical supply requirements with market opportunities. Executing and managing physical natural gas transactions, transportation agreements, and financial hedges. Identifying and execute profitable physical and to a lesser extent financial trading strategies to capture value from market volatility, basis differentials, seasonal spreads, and infrastructure constraints. Developing and maintaining short-, medium-, and long-term market views and translate them into actionable trading and risk management strategies. Taking ownership of commercial opportunities that enhance portfolio performance and improve overall earnings. Acquiring pipeline capacity to support internal supply and external business opportunities. Negotiating commercial agreements for infrastructure, mainly focused on pipelines. Supporting other team members in their negotiations and/or directly negotiate structured transactions regardless of supply, market, AMA, transportation, or storage to generate overall profit. Collaborating with manufacturing sites, schedulers, risk management, and commercial teams to ensure secure and cost-effective gas supply to BASF's production assets. Acting as a key interface between trading, operations, accounting, risk control, and external counterparties to efficiently resolve market and operational issues. If you... Hold a Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, Accounting, Engineering, Energy Management, Science, or a related field. Bring 5+ years of experience in natural gas trading, with a strong understanding of market dynamics and trading strategies. Have experience using financial risk management tools to support trading decisions and optimize portfolio performance. Have origination experience and a proven ability to identify, develop, and execute commercial opportunities within the natural gas market. Possess a solid understanding of natural gas trading concepts and hands-on experience working with ETRM systems. Leverage strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies, reconcile data, and make informed business decisions. Demonstrate a commercial mindset with the ability to recognize and capitalize on market opportunities that create value. Bring business development and negotiation experience working with producers, marketers, utilities, industrial customers, or energy service providers. Communicate effectively and collaborate confidently with cross-functional stakeholders while exercising sound business judgment. Thrive in a fast-paced environment and are able to support time-sensitive operational needs, including occasional after-hours, weekend, or holiday coverage. jobs.name: Principal Analyst Cyber Security Defense Center (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. We value diversity and believe that varied perspectives enhance our team's effectiveness. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure equal opportunity for all candidates. As Principal Analyst, you are the most senior technical authority within the CSDC - a recognized subject matter expert who leads from expertise, not hierarchy. You shape the strategic direction of our detection and response capabilities, act as the technical bridge to adjacent security functions, and represent the CSDC in internal governance bodies and external communities. RESPOSIBILITIES Lead the technical response to our most complex and high-risk security incidents as Case Lead - from triage and analysis through containment, eradication, resolution, and closure Lead investigations and compromise assessments Analyze complex malicious artifacts (binaries, scripts, documents) through static and dynamic analysis and reverse engineering to determine their underlying, often obfuscated, functionality Drive our hypothesis-driven threat hunting program: design hunting campaigns, validate hypotheses against threat intelligence, and convert findings into durable detection coverage Design, review, and continuously improve detection logic, correlation rules, and SOAR playbooks on our Elastic Security platform, applying Detection-as-Code practices Shape the CSDC automation and AI roadmap: co-design AI-assisted triage and investigation workflows and supervise their operation with clear human-in-the-loop safeguards Define the strategic roadmap for detection and response capabilities together with CSDC leadership; evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and methodologies Act as technical advisor to CSDC leadership on capability development, and as senior escalation point and on-call resource for critical incidents Mentor and train Tier 2 and Tier 3 analysts; develop advanced training content and drive knowledge transfer across the team Lead cross-functional initiatives with adjacent teams (Cyber Threat Intelligence, Offensive Security, Vulnerability Management, Platform Engineering) and steer external service providers to meet BASF security requirements Represent the CSDC in internal security governance bodies and in external communities and trusted networks (e.g., BSI, Deutscher CERT-Verbund, CSSA, FIRST) QUALIFICATIONS Education and Experience Degree in computer science, IT security, or a comparable technical qualification 8+ years of professional experience in cyber defense, incident response, with a track record as a recognized subject matter expert Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and investigations under pressure in high-stakes situations Technical Expertise Expert-level knowledge of the internals of mainstream operating systems (Microsoft Windows, Linux) and of network protocols and traffic analysis Deep understanding of current attacker tradecraft: advanced persistent threats, actors, infrastructures, and TTPs, structured along MITRE ATT&CK Strong hands-on expertise with Elastic Security as SIEM and EDR: detection rule development and tuning, investigation and hunting; experience with Elastic automation capabilities (workflows, AI Assistant) and ES|QL is a strong plus Proficiency with modern DFIR tooling (e.g., OSQuery, Velociraptor, Volatility, Suricata, Wireshark) and with malware analysis and reverse engineering tools (e.g., Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg, WinDbg) Solid experience in cloud and identity threat detection and response (Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory, Azure, AWS) Ability to program in Python and ideally Go; confident scripting in common shells (Bash, PowerShell); ability to read C and x86/x64 assembly in the context of reverse engineering Working understanding of AI/ML applications in security operations (model-assisted triage, LLM-assisted investigation, explainability) is a plus Leadership and Communication Proven ability to lead technical experts through stressful situations and to remain a calm, structured decision-maker during critical incidents Strong mentoring and coaching mindset; genuine motivation to grow the analysts around you Confident communication in English, both spoken and written, up to executive level; German language skills are a plus Excellent organizational and time management skills; willingness to participate in an on-call rotation Certifications Relevant certifications are valued as supporting evidence of your expertise - none of them is a strict requirement. We particularly welcome: GIAC / SANS: GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GREM, GCTI, GDAT, or GCDA; the GIAC Security Expert (GSE) designation is a distinguishing qualification at this level Elastic: Elastic Certified Analyst or Elastic Certified Engineer Cloud security: Microsoft SC-200 or AZ-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or GIAC GCLD Offensive and intrusion analysis: OffSec OSCP or OSDA, or CREST Registered Intrusion Analyst (CRIA) BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, on sustainable actions, and on connected thinking and on you. Become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. HOW TO REACH US If you're interested in the position or know someone who might be and need support on how to take next steps, please send an email to felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com

Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. BASF Overview BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in About the Role Effectively manage, supervise and support the Financial Reporting team members to deliver services to BASF group companies. Ensuring that services are delivered in accordance with established processes and work procedures and in compliance with BASF policies, Internal Controls requirements and local company legal and statutory requirements. Ensure that service timelines and service quality are met in the delivery of Financial Reporting services. Coach and develop the Financial Reporting team members to meet defined service standards through structured training and on the job coaching. Backup, assist with and perform Financial Reporting tasks. What's In It for You Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways Access to BASF's world-class learning & development programs Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture Hybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote) Key Responsibilities Functional Tasks (including but not limited to): Provide technical, process and systems support to the Financial Reporting team members by managing and monitoring the delivery of Financial Reporting services and ensuring delivery quality in terms of accuracy, completeness and timeliness on a daily basis. Manage and review the booking of accounting transactions, master data maintenance, fixed assets and project accounting transactions, calculations, workings and account analysis as performed by the Financial Reporting team members. Manage and monitor to ensure month end close steps are executed in accordance with work instructions and month end close checklist Manage and monitor to ensure timely, accurate and complete preparation of month-end, quarter-end, year-end and statutory financial reports for BASF companies across Asia Pacific. This would include reports for group reporting, internal management reporting, statutory reporting as well as any agreed ad hoc reports required e.g. audit schedules, tax schedules etc Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, trend analysis, cost centre checks and transaction posting checks Ensure that all deadlines for Financial Reporting services are met consistently. Coaching and perform trouble shooting to resolve issues related to Financial Reporting processes. Coach and support a team to meet the Financial Reporting services requirements. Provide guidance and training to Financial Reporting team members to improve their ability on the job. Liaise with relevant stakeholders on Financial Reporting work issues and queries. Assume hands on / backup role when needed, to meet service delivery needs • Drive team motivation and morale. Act as counsel to Financial Reporting team members as and when needed. Act as a backup for Head of Financial Reporting on ad-hoc task as and when required. Perform other duties as and when delegated, including job rotation to other functional teams Compliance: Enforcing compliance with BASF policies, local company legal and statutory requirements Internal. Manage and participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control and ISO requirements. Others Drive the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives, Internal Control Requirements, Six Sigma, Balance Scorecard and any other ad hoc project roll outs etc. Be a “Key User” within the team, providing expert knowledge and support to colleagues and hands on support when required. Support the implementation of Business Continuity Plan (BCP) through resource planning, backup and communication. Coordination, monitoring and compilation of Key Performance Indexes (KPI). Such other tasks as BSSCKL management and changing business environment may require to be performed. Contribute and support team strategic plan and objectives. Supports Head of Finance in the role of a Business Partner, Advisor and Integrator of the total business view. Leading role in coordinating and liaising with respective counterparts i.e. Auditors, Local Accountants and Delivery Managers. Monitor the preparation and distribution of information that are to be furnished i.e. relating to Prepared by Client (PBC) list, Balances confirmation, notes to the Accounts including ensuring deadlines are met. Service Management: Manage the Financial Reporting team members to deliver services within agreed service levels Ensure the operations in accordance with the service management framework by providing timely and accurate customer service. Review backlog and cycle time reports; supervise team members to improve process flow times. Ensure all workflows are processed within agreed service timelines. Influence the development of the service level agreement and charging mechanisms for the services provided. Ensure customer queries are attended to and resolved in a timely, responsible and proactive manner. Monitor SLAs, Balance Scorecard and KPIs, to ensure continue improvement in operations and service to customers. Quality and Continuous Improvement. Identify, recommend and develop solutions in consultation with Head of Financial Reporting for continuous improvement opportunities. Ensure successful implementation across the team and in the local companies. Ensure update changes to process documentation when required • Work with the team members to share best practices. Contribute and support Global Finance Transformation (GFT) initiatives in General Accounting and Reporting team. Contribute and support standardization across regions and globally by focusing on alignment of end to end business process areas, system and tools. Drive in improving productivity of General Accounting and Reporting by conducting relevant benchmarking exercise and monitoring through Key Performance indexes. Lead to conduct Cross Functional Meeting (CFM) among all functional teams. Drive to initiate and participate Regional Review Meeting (RRM) with Local Company Knowledge Management: Ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development of knowledge within the team. Establish operational and strategic plan, implementation and continuous improvement of Financial Reporting internal functional training to maximize learning process based on current and future business needs. Develop, maintain and update a set of comprehensive and complete training materials of Financial Reporting internal functional training. Work with the relevant stakeholders to understand service delivery information and technical knowledge and keep up to date on changes that may impact the training content and training delivery. Conduct functional training in accordance with established training structure. Establish a knowledge database of work problems encountered and steps for resolution to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge throughout Financial Reporting team. Support new and existing team members through proper knowledge transfer; and sharing of best practice thereby ensuring quality is maintained through any staff transition. Resource Management. Allocate resources and responsibilities to deliver business results. Ensure resource strategy is flexible enough to respond to demand variations. Recruit in accordance to resource schedule, ensuring that candidates chosen are of good quality and that adequate backup/knowledge sharing for tasks is in place during any recruitment phase to maintain service levels. Continuously coach, develop and motivate team to meet defined service standards through structured training and on the job coaching thereby achieving the expected delivery service quality. Internal. Conduct regular team meetings, staff briefing sessions and individual reviews to ensure group and/or individual’s issues are recognized and resolved in a timely and orderly manner. To identify and nominate the appropriate training to achieve individual and company aspiration in line with HR learning and development schedule. Support career path for team members through BASF Employee Development discussion and talent management Professional guidance / multiple reporting lines. Guide and direct the work of Financial Reporting team members. Provide guidance, support and leadership to the Financial Reporting team members. Establish goals and KPI's for each team member and evaluates performance throughout the year in accordance with the BASF performance management system. Provide feedback and reinforcement to Financial Reporting team members regarding development needs and opportunities, and secure resources to support development efforts. Establishes good interpersonal relationships by helping team members feel valued, appreciated and aware of business performance issues. Follow BASF Group guidelines; accounting and reporting guidelines • Understand and follow local regulation and statutory requirements Frequent cooperation within BASF Group . Counterparts and/or relevant stakeholders in BASF companies, internal auditors and the other BSSCKL functional teams. Head of Finance, Managers, Senior Managers, Accountants and peer team members • Service Centre management team. Global/Regional Finance Reporting functional units Frequent cooperation outside BASF Group Work closely with external consultants, auditors etc Degree of Supervision Required in the job Work with minimal supervision Minimum Qualifications University degree in finance and accounting or business studies; and Chartered or Certified. Professional Accountant or equivalent Min 10 to 18 years of professional experience in finance or similar. Prior experience of leading a team of 10 employees. Experience in dealing with Tax Reporting, Asset Accounting, Financial Reporting Compliance, projects management and audit would be important. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and effective communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, fast-paced global environment High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy Excellent analytical, communication and problem-solving skills. Experience working in MNC and Captive GCC experience is preferred Technical Skills Advance Microsoft Office tools and SAP advance, basic/intermediate. Lean Six Sigma, Power BI (preferred) Excel VBA (nice to have) About BASF At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. jobs.name: Global strategic buyer (m/f)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The world needs innovation, and we need you! We create chemistry for a sustainable future and are looking for talented people who can help answer tomorrow's challenges. Join BASF Agricultural Solutions in France, where we produce innovative and sustainable agricultural solutions to optimize crop productivity. Are you ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to a more sustainable future in chemistry? WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In your new position, you develop and execute global sourcing strategies for assigned categories and drive their implementation across regions and sites; Right in the heart of things! You lead global tenders and negotiations, establish framework agreements, and build preferred supplier networks to create sustainable value; Furthermore, you consolidate demand, promote standardization initiatives, and identify cost reduction opportunities through bundling, optimization, and strategic sourcing approaches; Together with your colleagues, you manage supplier performance, mitigate risks, and collaborate closely with category managers, sites, engineering, and supply chain stakeholders worldwide; Sustainability is important to you! You monitor supplier performance indicators, support continuous improvement initiatives, and contribute to achieving procurement and sustainability targets. WHAT YOU OFFER Bachelor's or master's degree in business administration, supply chain management, procurement, engineering, or a comparable field; At least three to five years of professional experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or procurement within a global and multi-site environment; Strong expertise in RFx processes, supplier negotiations, contract management, supplier relationship management, cost analysis, and procurement analytics; Very good English language skills as well as sound knowledge of SAP and common Microsoft Office applications; Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills combined with strong analytical thinking, a structured way of working, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. WHAT WE OFFER An exciting opportunity within a committed and highly skilled team; A workplace that encourages innovation, idea sharing, and employee well-being; An international environment where you can develop your full potential. ABOUT US Agri-Production SAS is a manufacturing subsidiary of BASF Agricultural Solutions. Located near Lyon, the Genay site formulates and packages insecticides, fungicides, and seed treatment products for agriculture. It also serves as a storage and distribution center for BASF crop protection products. More than 120 employees work on site, focusing on safety, health, environmental protection, and the preservation of natural resources. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Sr Agronomic Solutions Advisor - Central California
jobs.description: Now hiring! Now hiring! jobs.name: Auditor
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Corporate Audit supports the BASF Board of Executive Directors in its responsibility to perform supervisory, steering and control activities. It is an integral part of BASF’s internal control and risk management system. It has teams spread over 4 continents of the globe. This position will be a part of the Asia-Pacific hub of the global Corporate Audit function. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities We are seeking an experienced Internal Auditor who possesses strong set of internal audit skills including resilience and agility, business acumen, and critical thinking to join our team. Your role will involve conducting audits with a resilient and agile approach to assess the effectiveness of our organization's risk management, control, and governance processes and recommend improvements. You will also be responsible for conducting audits of our organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement and provide recommendations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of the process. Demonstrates a proactive approach by actively using analytic tools and AI programs utilized such as Co-pilot, PowerBI, and Power Automate/Apps, to drive improved audit efficiency and effectiveness. You will also collaborate actively with global experts (Domain Owners/SPOCs) as the regional subject matter expert for specific audit topics and risk areas. Main Task : Execute the internal audit plan in accordance with established audit standards and procedures with the annual audit plan. Evaluate the effectiveness of the organization's risk management, control, and governance processes. Conduct audits of the organization's financial and operational processes to identify areas for improvement. Develop recommendations to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance with policies and procedures. Leverage data analytics and data management expertise to analyze financial and operational data, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement. Develop data-driven insights to support audit findings and recommendations. Communicate audit findings and recommendations to management and other stakeholders. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and engage with stakeholders at all levels. Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and provide guidance as needed. Stay up to date with changes in laws, regulations, and industry best practices. Maintain integrity and ethical behavior, conduct unbiased audits, ensuring transparency, compliance, confidentiality, and professionalism in the internal audit role. Requirements Chartered Accountant, Chemical Engineer, Software Engineer, Data Scientist. (Bachelor’s degree in Accounting / Engineering / Computer Science / Statistics / Business Technology related discipline) Preferable Candidate with Professional Certifications such as: CIA (Certified Internal Audit), CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CISA (Certified Information System Audit), ESG. Data analytics related experience etc. 4 – 7 Years of experience in these skills - internal audit, internal control, risk based auditing, financial controlling Preferably worked on international assignments and working in diverse cultures of team members. Exposure to industries that are manufacturing based preferably chemical companies and with ERP experience (SAP). Travel requirement would be ~30%. Approx. 6 to 7 audits per annum with fieldwork for each audit ~3 to 4 weeks. Depending on the audit scope, a site fieldwork, may require travel between 1 - 3 weeks. Proven experience in internal auditing, demonstrating resilience, agility, and critical thinking. Strong understanding of business dynamics, financial principles, and internal control frameworks. You will need to possess the aptitude to understand the intricacies of business dynamics, enabling you to provide valuable insights that strengthen the organization's management processes.

jobs.name: Executive Assistant to the CTO and the Value Creation & Delivery Office (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Surventis became an independent company on 30 June 2026. The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is a member of the Executive Committee and is responsible for enterprise transformation, value creation and execution across all businesses and functions. The Executive Assistant runs the Office of the CTO. You make sure the CTO’s time goes to the decisions that matter, that every management meeting is prepared to a board standard, and that agreed actions actually get done. You also take on selected project work. In your role, you help to ensure that the CTO is well prepared for daily priorities by coordinating schedules, organizing meetings and serving as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Together with the CTO and the Value Creation & Delivery leadership team, you maintain an overview of commitments, actions and follow-up activities to support transparent and effective collaboration. Working closely with leaders and business functions, you prepare leadership and management meetings to a high standard, coordinate decision papers and document outcomes and next steps clearly and concisely. You contribute to selected transformation and strategy initiatives by organizing information, preparing analyses and creating executive summaries that support informed decision-making. You also play an important role in bringing people together by coordinating workshops, leadership off-sites, site visits, internal communications and external advisor engagements. WHAT YOU OFFER university degree in business administration, economics, engineering or a comparable field, or an equivalent qualification at least five years of experience supporting a board member, CEO or executive leader, or experience in consulting, project management, strategy or transformation environments strong Microsoft 365 skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel, along with confidence using modern productivity and AI tools fluent German and English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups a collaborative, well-organized and dependable working style combined with empathy, strong communication skills, sound judgment and a commitment to high-quality outcomes WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position: Our Product Family (Industrial Connectivity, Workspace and Data Platform) delivers standardized, managed, and secure Industrial Workspace services for BASF production plants and warehouses worldwide. Covering industrial mobile devices, Windows and Linux platforms, and Industrial IoT solutions, we provide a comprehensive portfolio of endpoint and workspace services that enable reliable and secure operations in production and warehouse environments. With our global platforms and services, and as part of a global team, we enable and continuously evolve digitalization supporting BASF’s production and logistics processes. With our global platform and services and as part of a global team, we enable and continuously evolve digitalization that supports BASF’s production and logistics processes. In this role, you will be part of a global follow-the-sun organization responsible for the reliable operation and support of Industrial Workspace solutions. Working closely with product teams, technology experts, vendors, and business stakeholders, you will help ensure stable operations, resolve operational challenges, drive continuous improvements, and support global deployments and initiatives. Beyond daily operations, you will have the opportunity to contribute your ideas and experience to continuously improve services, processes, and ways of working in collaboration with product and technology teams. Main Tasks: Provide service and operational support for Industrial Workspace services as part of a global follow-the-sun support organization. Support our customers in production and warehouse environments in close collaboration with our global technology and regional consulting teams. Support and operate technologies such as Enterprise Mobility Management solutions, Windows and Linux platforms, container-based infrastructures, and Industrial IoT solutions, depending on your area of expertise. Collaborate closely with internal DevOps teams and external technology vendors to troubleshoot issues, implement enhancements, and ensure stable and secure service operations. Identify opportunities to improve service quality, operational processes, and platform stability, and contribute to their implementation together with product and technology teams. Work in project or operation teams and contribute to service enhancements, technology initiatives, and regional deployments and rollouts. Industrial Workspace Devices Lifecycle Management in BASF Greater China As part of global IWS team, follow the standard processes to steer the full lifecycle of industrial workspace devices, including enrolment, configuration, activation, suspension, return, and decommissioning Support the management of device inventory, device pools, and lifecycle status to ensure transparency and cost control. Support the qualification and onboarding of new industrial mobile devices, including local or special devices and applications into the BASF portfolio in compliance with Industrial Mobility standards and in close collaboration with teams. Stakeholder Coordination & Site Enablement in BASF Greater China Act as the main contact window for plants, lab, logistic, maintenance, and EHS regarding industrial mobile device topics. Support site onboarding activities, including device rollout, user enablement, and coordination of local requirements. Job Requirements: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with 3–5 years of relevant professional experience. Experience operating and supporting enterprise-scale endpoint, mobility, or platform services. Hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM) solutions in industrial environments (e.g., SOTI MobiControl, MobileIron) Windows platform operations Linux and container platform operations Knowledge of IP networks and wireless technologies. Understanding security and authentication technologies, including the interaction between devices, OS, backend systems, and connectivity models. Strong communication skills and fluent English language skills (written and spoken), combined with a proactive and collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively in a global team environment. We are looking for a curious and hands-on professional who enjoys operating reliable services, solving technical challenges, identifying improvement opportunities, and proactively driving them together with the responsible product and technology teams. Nice to h ave Experience working in global, agile teams. Experience with tools such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Power Automate, or Power Apps Knowledge of Industrial IoT or AutoID technologies

jobs.name: Trade Compliance Operations AP (Executive)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position Support BASF group companies to meet all legal and regulatory requirements related to trade compliance. Protect BASF’s license to operate by ensuring adherence to Import and export control, sanctions, and screening obligations. Main Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Execute trade control related activities for BASF companies to ensure compliance. Ensure timely update in Daily Operation Reports and regularly review compliance performance with relevant areas against business processes predefined criteria. Evaluate, analyze and verify trade compliance regulatory data and documentation to support system accuracy, database integrity, and ongoing compliance monitoring. Support in resolving issues related to service delivery including communication with internal customers / stakeholders / other business partners. Perform necessarily follow up action to ensure deliverables completed in a timely manner. Ensure that BASF’s trade compliance processes and standards are effectively applied across Asia Pacific (and other supported regions), covering import, export, and regulatory requirements. This includes managing stakeholders and implementing compliance activities using BASF tools and digital solutions. Sharing knowledge exchange for best practices, including participation in regional or cross-regional projects and initiatives Contribute to report preparation, including KPI reporting, cost charging, non-conformance monitoring and improvement initiatives, using BASF tools, Visual Dashboard, and digital solutions. Ensure timely review, update and continuous improvement of work documentation such as process descriptions, work instructions to maintain sustainable knowledge retention and process standardization within department. Support internal and external audits, including conducting Quality Checks to identify potential improvements and implement preventive measures Continuous improvement by leveraging digitalization tools, to enhance operational excellence and process efficiency. Execute assigned processes with a consistently high standard of service to effectively meet the growing demands of business operations across relevant regions. Effective communication with stakeholders as required in daily operation and timely escalation to leader on critical topics where relevant. Execute discussion independently within the team and collaborate for achievement. Commit to continuous self-development through proactive learning and development (70:20:10 approach) and actively contribute to building team capability. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in International Business, Law, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field. Background in Chemistry or related science is an added advantage for product-related compliance. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in trade compliance, country regulations, product regulatory affairs, or product safety and stewardship related to trade compliance. Experience in regulatory or compliance functions, supply chain operations, or procurement activities within a multinational environment is preferred. Practical experience with import and export processes, including documentation and custom procedures, is an added advantage. Basic knowledge of regulatory controls, import/export requirements, license/permit management, and trade compliance procedures and standards in Asia Pacific countries. Proficiency in MS Office application (Excel /Power Point essential) Experience with SAP systems in supporting compliance or logistics processes would be beneficial. Fluent in English (both written and spoken); proficiency in Chinese is an asset. Experience with digital tools and automation technologies (e.g., Excel automation using formulas, pivot table, basic macro) and data visualization tool (e.g., Power BI). Good analytical, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. High attention to detail, proactive mindset, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. Understanding global trade regulations (e.g. export control, sanctions, restricted party screening) would be an advantage. The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT The Global Controlling Specialist reports to the Global Head of RFN Controlling and is the key contact for Digitalization and Data Analytics topics in Controlling. Broad operational controlling and BI expertise combined with strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills are prerequisites to act as a business partner for the Refinish Leadership Team and lead cross-functional data analytics projects across regions. You contribute to the further development of global controlling reporting solutions, ensure high data quality, and support users in making the best use of reporting tools and analytics. Working closely with colleagues from Finance, IT, and Data & Analytics, you coordinate reporting requirements, foster effective cross-functional collaboration, and serve as a strong sparring partner on all Controlling and Digital matters. Together with international teams, you support the digital evolution of Controlling, share knowledge, and contribute to the development of digital skills across the organization. You help introduce automation and AI-supported solutions that improve reporting, analytics, and controlling processes while creating a positive user experience. You also contribute to financial analyses, performance monitoring activities, and ad hoc business requests, enabling informed and transparent decision-making. WHAT YOU OFFER master’s degree in finance, accounting, controlling, business analytics, information systems, or a related field with relevant professional experience in controlling, finance, business analytics, or a comparable area strong knowledge of Power BI, Excel including Power Query and Power Pivot, and a solid understanding of reporting and controlling processes self-organized and collaborative working style combined with strong communication skills, curiosity, and a continuous learning mindset fluent German and English language skills; experience with Databricks, data warehouse environments, and modern analytics platforms is beneficial ideally experience with automation tools such as Power Automate as well as project coordination or project management experience WHAT WE OFFER We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week. Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: 2027 Agricultural Solutions Professional Development Program - Engineering
jobs.description: Now hiring! 2027 Agricultural Solutions Professional Development Program - Engineering The Professional Development Program Experience Accelerate your career in an early-career role with BASF Agricultural Solutions. BASF’s Professional Development Programs, or PDPs, offer driven, mobile-minded university graduates the opportunity to launch their careers through immersive, real-world experiences. Participants rotate through diverse roles within our business, gaining hands-on exposure to cross-functional teams and meaningful business challenges. The program is designed to build professional skills, foster meaningful connections, and provide a holistic view of BASF’s operations through mentoring, executive engagement, site tours, and training seminars. Throughout the program, participants develop a strong foundation in BASF’s systems and processes while building their professional networks and exploring their career interests. With structured support and a focus on growth, the PDP experience empowers participants to solve complex problems and contribute to impactful work. Upon successful completion, participants may be considered for placement into a permanent role related to their program experience. Engineering PDP Program Summary As a highly motivated upcoming graduate, you will participate in a 24-month rotational development program consisting of two 12-month assignments across BASF Agricultural Solutions engineering and manufacturing locations. The program is designed to strengthen your technical foundation, leadership behaviors, business acumen, and site-based experience while preparing you for permanent engineering placement. Throughout your rotations, you will contribute to meaningful engineering work while gaining exposure to areas such as process engineering, reliability and asset management, project and capital execution, electrical systems, controls and automation, manufacturing excellence, continuous improvement, and technology and digital engineering You will work across sites, functions, engineering disciplines, and stakeholder groups to better understand how engineering decisions support safe, reliable, efficient, and sustainable operations. Your experiences, project outcomes, competency development, and feedback will help guide your growth and future placement within the organization. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a program participant, you will... Complete two 12-month rotational assignments across engineering, manufacturing, and technical organizations within BASF Agricultural Solutions. Build technical expertise through hands-on experiences in areas such as process engineering, reliability and asset management, project execution, automation, manufacturing excellence, and digital technologies. Own meaningful projects and deliverables that support business priorities and create measurable value for BASF. Apply engineering principles, data analysis, and problem-solving skills to improve safety, reliability, quality, productivity, and operational performance. Support engineering and capital projects through activities such as planning, design reviews, implementation, commissioning, and startup support. Collaborate with colleagues across Operations, Technology, Environmental Health and Safety, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, and other business functions to achieve shared objectives. Communicate technical findings, project updates, recommendations, and results through presentations, reports, and discussions with technical and non-technical audiences. Build business acumen by understanding how engineering decisions impact safety, quality, cost, service, and overall business performance. Participate in technical training, mentorship, coaching, networking, and leadership development opportunities throughout the program. Develop the skills, experiences, and professional network needed for future placement into an engineering role within BASF. Demonstrate a commitment to safety, quality, confidentiality, continuous learning, and BASF's Winning Behaviors. If you... Have completed a bachelor's degree program within 12 months of your date of hire, preferably in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (graduating between December 2026 and May 2027). A master's degree is a plus, but not required. Are authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future without restrictions or need for future sponsorship. Demonstrate strong collaboration, communication, critical thinking, systems thinking, project management, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute effectively in a cross-functional environment. Embody BASF’s Winning Behaviors: you take accountability, move with speed, and bring an improvement mindset to everything you do. Are self-driven and thrive in collaborative environments, even when working with geographically dispersed teams. Are open to working in multiple geographic locations throughout rotational program and upon place-off from the program. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously.
