jobs.name: District Manager - Ohio Valley
jobs.description:
Now hiring! District Manager - Ohio Valley We are looking for a District Manager Ohio Valley to join our Surventis Surface Treatment team. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. At Surventis Surface Treatment, we develop and manufacture tailor-made technology and system solutions for applied surface technology. Our products protect metals from corrosion, facilitate forming and treatment, prepare parts optimally for the painting process and ensure excellent coating adhesion. Our technologies and products are used in a variety of industries and end markets such as automotive, aerospace, aluminum finishing and metal forming. The chemical treatment of metal surfaces is Surventis Surface Treatment’s core competence. The focus of our worldwide activities is on the development and implementation of customized technology and system solutions for surface treatment. The District Manager oversees sales operations within a specific geographic area, leading a team to achieve sales targets and drive revenue growth. As a District Manager Ohio Valley, you will... Execute strategic sales plans to meet district quotas and expand market share within your assigned territory. Lead and manage a team of sales representatives, providing coaching, training, and performance feedback to enhance their skills and effectiveness. Analyze sales data and market trends to identify new business opportunities and adjust sales strategies accordingly. Have regular field visits with sales representatives allowing them to observe techniques, offer direct coaching, and support client interactions. Work closely with Key Industry Sales and Marketing to ensure alignment of sales efforts with company goals and provide market feedback. Assign Sales and Profit targets to align to strategic initiatives Be responsible for Performance management, talent development and talent retention. Develop and maintain succession plan for the Sale’s District. Hire, train and coach Technical Sales Representative, to develop effective Sales techniques, Technical problem solving, product knowledge and awareness of customer needs. Hire and identify needed training to develop effective Technical problem solving, product knowledge and awareness of customer needs. Manage pipeline and target accounts to meet our growth objectives. Execute Strategy of targets as identified as part of District Strategic Roadmap in collaboration with Regional Marketing and Regional Sales- Industries. Execute global strategies within each Industry Segment key customers. Keep track of competitors’ offers and action building a competitive awareness. Provide input for the development of pricing strategies. Be responsible for Business reviews completion at top 20 accounts. Develop strong business relationships with key decision-makers. Manage sales and pricing processes to align with the company’s pricing guidelines and marketing pricing strategy. Coordinate and execute sales strategies to develop target business. Prepare Supply Agreements within the given authorization framework. Lead the effort and education for the digital processes (Salesforce, Power BI, Power Apps etc). Coordinate with Industry Sales personnel on target account activities. Share market insights and trends with Sales Managers, Key Industry Sales management and Regional Marketing management. Manage AR and Consignment Inventory to assigned goals. If you have... BS Degree Desired 3-5 years of sales experience and leadership Industrial Technical Sales experience including pretreatment, surface treatment, and metalworking in the Specialty Chemical Industry. Sales and Business acumen (account & relationship management, value-based selling, etc.) Leadership skills: ability to motivate and develop a sales team Excellent communication and presentation skills Strong cross-functional collaboration skills Strategic thinking skills The District Manager will reside in his / her assigned District geography. The position requires 50% travel Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Pay transparency Surventis is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $146,000 - $175,000. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. [[LEGAL_ENTITY_OBJ]] Notice regarding responsibility and data processing The job offers published on this platform relate exclusively to positions at . BASF Group operates this platform solely as a technical service provider under a

jobs.description: Objectives of the Position This person will be responsible for transport operations for a country. The person will also take ownership of all transport management processes for BASF operations. Main Tasks Manage transport operation (inbound, outbound) for bulk and packaged with different modes of transportation Evaluate, monitor and improve the performance of 3rd party service providers, handle non-conformance service issues; participate and support 3rd party service provider selection; Optimize transportation processes based on market surveys and business feedback to meet customer and company requirements Coordination and management of service provider for vehicle placement Tracking delivery of products to customer (monitoring of in transit vehicles, shipments) Ensure transportation safety Evaluate service provider performance on monthly basis in line with BASF standards Coordination and management of order management Ensuring timely delivery of goods to customer Coordination with EHS, insurance and service provider in a case of accidents Ensuring utilization of dedicated vehicles Insurance management (raising insurance claim and recovery) incl. management of recovery from service providers Requirements Education: diploma or degree in supply chain or equivalent Open to fresh graduate, or minimum 1 year of experience in transport management Experience in SAP Must be able to work in India timezone (11AM-8PM MYT) and on Saturday (Sunday and 1 weekday off day) Only Hindi/Tamil speakers

jobs.name: Senior Engineer, Lab Technical Service, PE
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position HDPE product properties and competitor product technical properties benchmarking analysis. Optimize product properties and downstream technical application analysis. Support the Lab function establishment. Main Tasks: Lab Function Receive all kinds of training according to the company's arrangement and can provide analytical services. Participate in the installation and commissioning of new laboratory equipment and the establishment, calibration, and verification of methods. Participate in the preparation of analytical methods and management systems. Lab Operation Perform routine and non-routine analytical tasks safely, accurately and efficiently according to laboratory testing plans. Do daily maintenance and calibration of equipment. Carry out good daily housekeeping and proper waste disposal in the lab. Monitor and manage equipment abnormality. Technical Service Supporting Trouble shooting sample analysis. Support marketing and manufacture to development new product grade and new downstream application. Support to conduct Product Qualification & Certification Application. Product Development Meet and Improve product market competitiveness by optimizing grade properties Study product technical value proposition vs. competitor’s benchmark grades in lab Regular engagement and connecting with site technical department as focal point of HDPE TS team for product optimization and improvement topics. Job Requirements: Education: College degree or above, Chemistry/Industrial & Applied Chemistry/Physical Chemistry/Chemical Engineering or related area. Working Experience: At least 3 years working experience in Polyethylene business, rich experience of pipe extrusion, blow molding, blown film or injection prefer. Unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sind unser wertvollstes Gut und wir pflegen eine Kultur der Empathie, der Unterstützung und des Wachstums. Auf diese Weise befähigen wir unser Team, sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Mit vereinten Kräften engagieren wir uns für die Entwicklung nachhaltiger, digitaler und innovativer Lösungen für eine bessere Zukunft. Pflegende Hautcremes, milde Shampoos, Sonnenschutzmittel, schonende und umweltfreundliche Waschmittel und leistungsstarke Reiniger für Haushalt und Industrie – all diese Produkte nutzen Inhaltsstoffe aus unserem Bereich Care Chemicals. Darüber hinaus bieten wir beispielsweise Lösungen auf dem Gebiet des Pflanzenschutzes, für technische Anwendungen in der Bauchemie oder Rohstoffe für die Lackindustrie sowie digitale Services für unsere Kunden. Weltweit arbeiten wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden an innovativen Lösungen, die Endverbraucher:innen und industrielle Formulierer überzeugen – und das zunehmend auf Basis von natürlichen und nachhaltig gewonnenen Rohstoffen. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft entwerfen! WAS SIE ERWARTET In unserer Einheit bei der BASF Grenzach GmbH sind wir für die Produktion verschiedenster Stoffe aus dem Bereich Care Chemicals verantwortlich. Sie unterstützen den Produktionsmager in seinem Aufgabengebiet, sowie das Prozessmanagement im Rahmen der Querschnittsaufgaben und sind Ansprechperson für Engineering und Technik für die Sicherung langfristig planbarer Arbeiten. Durch frühzeitige Absprache mit Produktion und Technik stellen Sie den reibungslosen Ablauf von baulichen Maßnahmen parallel zum laufenden Produktionsbetrieb sicher. Darüber hinaus überwachen Sie den AES-Prozess inklusive Ausgabe, Verlängerung und Rückgabe der Erlaubnisscheine im Produktionsbereich und leisten die Qualitätskontrolle für zurückgemeldete Erlaubnisscheine. Bei parallel stattfindenden Baumaßnahmen in Ihrem Aufgabengebiet übernehmen Sie die Sicherheitskoordination. Sie qualifizieren die Mitarbeitenden im AES-Prozess. Des Weiteren überwachen Sie die Einhaltung von Vorschriften. Sie arbeiten außerdem bei der Umsetzung von Präventiv- bzw. Korrekturmaßnahmen in Zusammenhang mit AES mit. Das Durchführen von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen nach ArbSchG und GefStV rundet Ihr Aufgabenprofil ab. WAS SIE MITBRINGEN abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Industriemeister:in Chemie sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung in betrieblichen Produktions- und Logistikabläufen mehrjährige Erfahrung im BASF-Arbeitserlaubnisscheinsystem und Erfahrung mit Arbeitssicherheit Führungserfahrung als Leiter:in von Produktionsteams sowie ausgeprägte Führungseigenschaften selbstständiges und zuverlässiges Arbeiten, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, gute Organisationsfähigkeiten offene und überzeugende Kommunikation in deutscher Sprache WAS WIR BIETEN attraktive Vergütung nach Chemie-Tarifvertrag E10 - E11 (je nach Berufserfahrung zwischen 4.742 € bis 6.645 € monatliches Brutto-Tarifentgelt), zuzüglich tariflicher Zulagen, Schichtzuschläge 30 Urlaubstage sowie Schichturlaub Sozialberatung, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsförderungsangebote (Hansefit) und Aktienprogramm für Mitarbeitende ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld, da wir Sicherheit immer Vorrang geben und Ihre Gesundheit an erster Stelle steht SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Corinna Granterath (Talent Acquisition), corinna.granterath@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-59302 beantwortet gerne Ihre Fragen zu dieser Position. Unser Recruiting-Team erreichen Sie auch hier Erste Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess finden Sie hier . ÜBER UNS An ihrem Standort in Grenzach, dem BASF-Kompetenzzentrum für UV-Filter, betreibt die BASF Grenzach GmbH die globale Entwicklung, den Technischen Service sowie die Produktion von innovativen UV-Filtern. Unsere Produkte kommen in Sonnencremes, in Kosmetika und Körperpflegeprodukten zum Einsatz. Am Standort befindet sich zudem die globale Entwicklung und der Technische Service von antimikrobiellen Wirkstoffen. Die einzigartige Lage des Unternehmens im Dreiländereck Deutschland, Frankreich und der Schweiz mit der Nähe zum Schwarzwald und den Alpen bietet neben den beruflichen interessanten Möglichkeiten auch attraktive und vielfältige Freizeitaktivitäten. Mehr über die BASF Grenzach GmbH erfahren Sie unter: www.basf-grenzach.de Vielfalt ist unsere größte Stärke! Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft – in einem globalen Team, das Inklusion und Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Weltanschauung lebt. Und übrigens, wir überlassen es unseren Mitarbeitenden, ob und wann sie sich duzen. jobs.name: Assistant Manager, Quality & Technical Service Lab
jobs.description: Objectives In alignment with BASF Quality Policy, oversee day‑to‑day quality management of the site to ensure raw materials meet production specifications and finished products satisfy customer expectations. Be responsible for ISO‑related audit activities, and maintain and continuously improve the company’s quality management system. Main Tasks Production Safety Responsibilities ‑ Serve as the Production Safety lead for the Quality & Technical Service Lab Department. Comply with the principle of “whoever is in charge of business shall be accountable for safety; whoever manages production and operations shall be accountable for safety”, and fulfil dual responsibilities for safety performance within the scope of assigned duties. ‑ Be in charge of department‑level safety training, retain relevant records, develop and control safety training plans, assess employees’ safety‑related performance and arrange additional training where required. ‑ Ensure tools, instruments and equipment within the department are correctly deployed for daily operations. ‑ Identify potential workplace hazards and unsafe employee behaviours, and take appropriate corrective actions to eliminate such risks. ‑ Identify all work activities within the department requiring job hazard analysis, organise risk analysis exercises and implement risk‑mitigation measures. ‑ Investigate all incidents and accidents occurring within the department to identify root causes, implement corrective actions, propose disciplinary recommendations for accountable parties and deliver follow‑up employee training. ‑ Secure a safe working environment for employees and contractors, including provision of appropriate personal protective equipment, tools and materials. ‑ Ensure the Quality Control Supervisor implements corresponding obligations in accordance with all safety procedures. ‑ Cascading corporate safety requirements to every employee and contractor within the department. ‑ Ensure all safety rules, procedures and safe working practices are fully understood and followed by all department employees and contractors. Quality Management ‑ Schedule and oversee daily laboratory operations aligned with production and shipment plans. ‑ Ensure raw material and finished‑product conformance against specifications and requirements. ‑ Monitor raw material and finished‑product status in the SAP system; issue Certificates of Analysis (CoA) for delivered finished goods and obtain Quality Deviation Reports (QDR) for non‑conforming batches. ‑ Establish test methodologies for new raw materials and new products during new‑product launch phases. ‑ Guarantee effective implementation of the quality management system and maintain the system in compliance with ISO standards. ‑ Compile and analyse quality‑related data, and prepare relevant reports as requested by line management. Metrology Management ‑ Take charge of calibration for trade‑related measuring instruments onsite, including management of calibration procedures, calibration schedules and calibration‑related budget. Document Control ‑ Maintain and update laboratory operating manuals. ‑ Compile and revise quality‑control manuals. ‑ Ensure proper retention of all quality‑control‑related records. External Audits ‑ Plan, organise and execute internal and external audits for ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 to secure successful audit outcomes. ‑ Ensure timely completion of all corrective actions. Customer Complaint Handling ‑ Lead customer‑complaint investigations. ‑ Conduct root‑cause analysis, define corrective actions, and monitor timely closure of such actions. ‑ Host customer visits, build sound working relationships with customer quality teams and capture customer requirements. Product Stewardship ‑ Act as the site Product Stewardship focal point; collaborate with Greater China and Asia Pacific Product Safety & Stewardship (PSS) teams to prepare Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for products and raw materials used onsite, and deliver relevant training for internal stakeholders. 5S Management ‑ Implement and sustain well‑organised laboratory working environments in compliance with corporate 5S policies. People Management ‑ Set performance objectives for direct reports and conduct performance evaluations. ‑ Formulate individual development plans for direct reports based on incumbent competencies and business requirements. ‑ Address inappropriate behaviours of direct reports, and coordinate with Human Resources to administer disciplinary procedures per corporate policies. ‑ Foster an inclusive, transparent and high‑performance working culture to support talent development and retention. ‑ Manage attendance, overtime, training and leave arrangements for direct reports in line with business needs, corporate policies and applicable laws and regulations. Budget Management ‑ Develop, monitor and optimise annual quality‑function budgets in compliance with quality policies and compliance obligations. ‑ Strictly adhere to corporate finance and cost‑accounting rules. Deploy effective measures to cut maintenance costs, reduce material losses and eliminate waste. Other Assignments ‑ Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager. Requirements - Education: Bachelor’s degree or above, major in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Applied Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry. - Working Experience: Minimum 5 years of working experience in quality management and laboratory management within the chemical industry. ‑ Sound knowledge of polymerisation and polymer science. ‑ Bilingual proficiency in Chinese and English for day‑to‑day business delivery. ‑ Competency in office software and enterprise applications including SAP.

jobs.name: (Junior) Procurement Specialist with Dutch (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Join us with your own ideas and help us shape our processes as well as further development of our services! As (Junior) Procurement Specialist with Dutch and English, you are responsible for all operational purchasing activities. In detail, you ensure that our BASF companies in Europe are supplied with raw materials, technical goods and services. You play an active role: you implement and adhere to the company's procurement guidelines by conducting numerous Purchase-to-Pay process tasks. In collaboration and consultation with our internal business partners, you handle orders accordingly to the guidelines. Assuring timely deliveries and handling non-conformities are part of your daily tasks. In doing so, you are responsible for entering master data of contracts into our IT systems and keeping this data updated. In this context, you are the central point of contact for operational procurement processes and you answer questions from stakeholders (e. g. internal customers, suppliers, strategic buyers and colleagues from the finance departments). WHAT YOU OFFER bachelor's degree in commerce or a similar field, completed vocational education would be also possible initial professional experience in an area of business and commerce; preferably purchasing is a plus, but not compulsory excellent communication skills in Dutch and English, French and/or German are a plus good knowledge of IT standard applications, experience in working with SAP or other procurement related IT programs are a plus ability to identify customer needs and enjoy consulting WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 35.000 -39.000 € , depending on qualification and work experience -  In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the companys success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts HOW TO REACH US Maximilian Mette (Talent Acquisition), maximilian.mette@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-56084 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment . You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities at basf.com/servicehub-berlin . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us -- in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Transport Management (Assistant Manager)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position Manage transport management operations supporting global overseas delivery services of EMEA Manage team development and resource planning to Management Manage internal business partner relationship and requirements – through collaboration, engagement and high service quality Manage LSP service performance, provides input to service requirement and collaborate with LSP on issues, risks, business feedback and improvement for customer satisfaction Responsible for risk management pertaining to team and service provider operations, including but not limited to access management, data protection, business continuity process and periodic risk management reviews Drive knowledge management of service and ensure effective knowledge retention through structured review, update and process ownership M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Manage and lead the Transport management team that performs Transport planning activities for exports from Region EMEA via sea freight to our Internal and external customers. Plan and organize the resource requirements for the team. Ensure recruiting and development of talents, including team build up Collaboration/management of projects/initiative to further develop and optimize service delivery processes taking responsibility for defined cross-sectional tasks. Identify and address the requirements of internal business partners (Export & Transport Management and Site logistics teams) to ensure high level of service quality. Establishes active communication and build strong collaboration with internal business partners taking ownership and responsibility for problem solving to meet business & customer needs Manage LSP’s monitoring quality of services delivered, feedback rates, transport reliability and Tracking shipments & vessels to improve customer satisfaction. Responsible for reporting and analytics related to Operational data quality for management/Stakeholder review. Job Requirements Min. Degree in supply chain, business administration, international business. Other tertiary education can be considered with the availability of professional experience. At least 4 years Professional experience in logistics or supply chain management, preferably in logistics, transportation and international trade deliveries Has experience in leadership or supervising operational team & International liaisons Process implementation and tools/application familiarity incl. change management and digital applications for supply chain Strong customer and service orientation, proactive and able to provide solutions; with critical thinking skills High proficiency in verbal and written English with strong communication and presentation skills Team Management, Mentorship experiences or tendencies Experience with ERP in supply chain preferred. SAP or other ERP Innovation orientation and openness for automation and digitalization The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com .

jobs.name: Analista Semi Senior Financial Reporting (fixed-term project-based)
jobs.description: Este puesto se ofrece bajo un contrato a plazo fijo, basado en proyecto, con una duración mínima garantizada de seis meses. Quiénes somos: Somos BASF, la compañía química más grande del mundo, con más de 150 años de experiencia. En Montevideo, operamos como un HUB que brinda servicios a todas las empresas de BASF en las Américas. Ofrecemos soluciones profesionales en finanzas, adquisiciones, reportes, logística, tecnología, recursos humanos, proyectos, comunicaciones, asuntos legales, medioambiente, seguridad, salud y calidad. Área: En el HUB de Montevideo contamos con el área de Financial Reporting, la cual es responsable de asegurar que los estados financieros se completen de forma adecuada, cumpliendo con las normativas locales e internacionales. Se preparan reportes mensuales, trimestrales y anuales donde se trabaja con Finanzas Local, Controlling y la caza matriz. A fin de mes se toma toda la información desde los módulos de SAP System, para luego reportar nuestras versiones Financieras y Operativas en nuestro sistema oficial. Objetivo principal de la posición: Desempeñar tareas diarias y análisis periódicos relativos Financial Reporting, asegurando la integridad y exactitud de la información contable en SAP y otras bases de datos. Principales tareas: Asegurar la correcta ejecución de los procedimientos y controles de cierre de mes (cubriendo todos los procesos predefinidos como FRC controls), garantizando la calidad del reporte a casa matriz. Contribuir en la preparación de notas a los Estados Financieros, trimestrales y anuales. Realización de los Account Análisis mensuales de acuerdo con el mapping de cuentas predefinido. Preparación de las analíticas de acuerdo con el cronograma definido. Presentación de las mismas corresponda. Contribuir en diversos proyectos e iniciativas a lo largo del año relativos a documentación de procesos, FRC, testeos, auditoría, entre otros. Apoyo y coordinación con Local Finance en lo referente a las actividades bajo su scope (Account análisis, Analíticas, M&A). Proporcionar guía y soporte a los negocios en la aplicación de IFRS16. Ser responsable de la creación y mantenimiento en el sistema (RFEX) para los contratos que cumplan los criterios de capitalización en base a la normativa aplicable (IFRS16), asegurando la calidad de la información contable. Monitoreo integral de la Clearing Account, identificando desvíos y canalizando su resolución, velando por el correcto funcionamiento del proceso. Brindar soporte a los negocios en la estimación y proyección de costos asociados a los contratos de arrendamiento. Velar por la correcta gestión de los costos facturados. Colaborar con tareas relativas a Activos Fijos así como al proceso de Account Analysis. Estar en constante y proactiva comunicación con diversos clientes y stakeholders, trabajando de cerca con las diferentes áreas de la organización. Entender el proceso E2E y el impacto dentro del flujo de trabajo, evaluar y proponer mejoras en el proceso. Requisitos mínimos de educación y calificaciones para la posición: Educación: Estudiantes avanzados o graduados en Contador Público o Administración de Empresas. Experiencia laboral: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia contable en áreas de reporting. Idiomas: Manejo de inglés intermedio a nivel oral y escrito. Se valorará altamente el dominio del portugués. Habilidades técnicas: Conocimiento sólido de Microsoft Office, especialmente de Excel, se valorará la experiencia con macros. Buen dominio de las normas contables. Habilidades blandas: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación para mantener un contacto constante con clientes, stakeholders y otras áreas del HUB. Qué ofrecemos: Vivir BASF es ser parte de una cultura donde el foco está en las personas y en su desarrollo profesional y personal. Nuestra diversidad, colaboración y estilo de liderazgo marcan la diferencia. Al sumarte a nuestro equipo, te ofrecemos: Un modelo de trabajo híbrido y flexible Acceso a un ecosistema de aprendizaje con recursos y herramientas disponibles on‑demand Seguro médico privado para vos y tu familia desde el primer día, además de seguro de vida Días adicionales de licencia flexible, además de tu licencia legal Día libre por cumpleaños Día libre por mudanza Bono anual (sujeto al cumplimiento de los requisitos establecidos por las políticas internas) Beneficios de bienestar, como servicios de nutrición dentro de la compañía y masajes BASF considera la Ley N° 19.691 y el Decreto N° 73/019 en todos sus procesos de contratación. Cada candidato calificado que cumpla con los requisitos establecidos en la descripción del puesto será considerado en este proceso de contratación sin distinción. Además, BASF es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Aceptamos con entusiasmo nuestra responsabilidad de tomar decisiones de empleo sin tener en cuenta la raza, la edad, el estado civil y social, el origen nacional, la discapacidad, el sexo, la identidad de género o las expresiones, o cualquier otra característica o grupo de candidatos o empleados que no esté relacionado con su aptitud e idoneidad para el puesto. Nuestra dirección está comprometida a seguir esta política en lo que respecta a la contratación, colocación, promoción, transferencia, descenso, despido, terminación, reclutamiento, remuneración y otras formas de compensación, capacitación y trato general durante el empleo.

jobs.name: GB/G Manager - Project Accounting
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. BASF Overview BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in About the Role The Project Accounting Manager leads project accounting and asset accounting activities, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting. The role manages and develops the team, partners with internal stakeholders, oversees project and asset data quality, and ensures SLA adherence. It also provides expertise in IFRS, lease accounting, capitalization, reconciliations, audits, and internal controls , while driving process improvements, automation, and supporting M&A-related projects. What's In It for You Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways Access to BASF's world-class learning & development programs Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture Hybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote) Key Responsibilities Stakeholder Management Understand stakeholder requirements and provide timely, practical, and solution-oriented support. Develop strong end-to-end process knowledge to effectively support business partners. Ensure compliant and efficient delivery by establishing technical standards, controls, and process guidelines. Collaborate with Book-to-Report teams across regions on operational activities and strategic projects. Act as a business partner to BASF internal stakeholders, identifying and implementing appropriate solutions. Team Management Provide disciplinary leadership, including work allocation, target setting, performance management, and continuous feedback. Develop team members by identifying capability gaps, strengths, and career development opportunities. Build an engaging and collaborative team environment with open communication. Mentor Senior Analysts and Analysts, promoting best practices, quality, and strong team collaboration. Drive employee engagement, motivation, and team morale. Act as backup for the Director and support additional responsibilities as required. Project Management Lead process improvement and optimization initiatives, leveraging digital solutions and automation. Monitor SLAs, Balanced Scorecards, and KPIs to drive continuous improvement in service delivery. Ensure stakeholder queries and ad-hoc requests are addressed proactively and within agreed timelines. Understand business requirements and provide customized solutions while maintaining high service quality. Resource Management Plan and allocate team resources and responsibilities to ensure efficient and compliant service delivery. Manage recruitment in line with approved budgets and workforce requirements. Support employee development through structured development plans, coaching, and feedback. Conduct regular team meetings and individual reviews to identify and resolve issues. Manage and monitor the FTE budget for the team. Knowledge Management Ensure effective documentation and accessibility of process knowledge. Drive knowledge sharing and transfer to build sustainable capabilities within the team. Operational Activities Oversee Project Accounting activities for BASF group companies, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion. Review asset account closures and ensure appropriate accounting and reporting. Ensure project data quality across business units and drive corrective actions where required. Lead process design improvements, automation, and digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency. Lead accounting projects related to mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures of business lines or entities. Act as the SPOC for audits, internal controls, and other key organizational activities. Ensure operations are delivered in line with SLAs, quality standards, and agreed timelines. Review accounting transactions, fixed asset postings, master data maintenance, reconciliations, and account clearing. Review long-outstanding items for capitalization and ensure appropriate accounting treatment. Provide expertise in lease accounting and capitalization in accordance with IFRS. . Minimum Qualifications Professional qualification in Finance (e.g. CA, CMA, Inter CA or BCom with good experience.) or MBA or Master degree in finance / Accounting or related disciplines. 12-18 Years of experience. Prior experience of minimum 3 years in leading a team of 10 +FTE Experience working in MNC and Captive GCC experience is preferred Technical Skills Advanced knowledge in standard Microsoft Office software (word, excel, power point). Proficiency in English required with good communication in verbal, writing and interpersonal skills with high customer focus. Proficiency in other languages is a plus. Knowledge of SAP system is mandatory. About BASF At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it. At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive.

jobs.name: Technical Agronomy Summer Intern
jobs.description: Technical Agronomy Summer Intern – Grow Your Future with BASF As a Technical Agronomy Summer Intern , you’ll be part of a team that’s shaping the future of agriculture while building your own career foundation. Internship Details: Duration: 4 months (Summer 2027) Location: Winnipeg and Brandon, MB Compensation: $25 - $32 / Hour Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! Why Join Us? This isn’t your average internship. At BASF, you’ll: Make an Impact : Support large-scale agronomic trials and contribute to real-world agricultural solutions. Build Your Network : Engage with growers, retailers, and BASF teams across the business. Learn by Doing : Get hands-on experience with seeding, spraying, harvesting, and evaluating crop trials. Grow Your Career : Present your own research project to peers and senior leaders, and explore future career tracks. Have Fun : Participate in customer tours, field events, and team activities while working independently in the field. What You’ll Learn: Agronomic trial design and execution. Crop evaluation techniques including plant vigor and stand counts. Safe operation of ATVs, sprayers, and farm equipment. Stakeholder engagement and professional communication. Time management and independent work in a regional setting. What You’ll Do: Organize and manage large-scale trials (e.g., InVigor Demonstration Strip Trials). Conduct evaluations on seed treatments, herbicides, and fungicides. Support customer tours and presentations. Operate ATVs and pull-behind sprayers. Transport equipment between trial sites. Complete and present a demand creation or research project. What We’re Looking For: Currently enrolled in an agriculture science or related degree program. Enthusiastic about agronomy and eager to learn. Strong communicator with a commitment to safety. Able to travel within your assigned region and work independently. Valid driver’s licence required. Experience with farm equipment and sprayers is an asset. To be eligible for this internship, you must be currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and returning to studies following the internship. Applications from individuals who have already graduated will not be considered. Ready to grow with us?

jobs.name: Supervisor, EHS
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives According to the general guidance of the supervisor established on the base of the EHS mandatory requirements and Responsible Care ® principles and practices, support the implementation of the EHS programs, including organizing activities to raise employee awareness of risks and to reduce so as to support avoidance of hazards and occupational illnesses in the site. Main Tasks Implementation of EHS concepts (Mandatory and Responsible Care ) Collaborate with the employees and supervisors on the implementation and improvement actions in their work processes / areas to meet the EHS (environmental, health and safety) standards established according to the applicable company, corporate and mandatory EHS regulations and requirements. EHS Preventive measures and objectives Collaborate with the employees and supervisors to identify and correct potential safety and health hazards according to the applicable company EHS regulations and standards so as to recommend improvement actions to support meeting the EHS requirements. Assist in reviewing new/ existing products, equipment, and processes for potential hazards via studying the work and EHS requirements to identify conflicting technical objectives, unsuitability of standard procedures etc. Provide initial recommendations to the parties involved on modification needed. EHS (mandatory and Responsible Care ® ) education Prepare training / education need analysis vie interviews / questionnaire as defined by the supervisor   and consolidate the feedback / inquiries to propose schedules, programs and target groups to help strengthen the employees’ awareness on EHS. May need to assist in conducting workshops and seminars via material preparation and data collection. Organize the education/ training programs and follow-up on the course evaluations to help decision making on the use of such programs. May need to issue regular newsletters to collect EHS suggestions, concerns and inform employees of the EHS practices and requirements. Monitoring EHS performance Interpret the defined EHS and Responsible Care ® regulations and recommend priorities and actions for improvement, including developing safe work practices and measures with supervisors to monitor conformance through safety and housekeeping inspections in their respective work areas. Coordinate and prepare the internal and external EHS performance audits to ensure the effective realization of the audit activities. Act as Site Occupational Health Contact, to coordinate with occupational medical doctor to implement OH relevant issues. Accident follow-up According to the supervisor’s guidance and company requirements, assist in / lead the investigation of occupational accidents or problem areas and recommend improvement / preventive measures. Documentation Maintain a documentation system to keep company, corporate and mandatory EHS rules / regulations, communication materials, inspection and audit reports etc. to ensure that the major activities are properly documented according to needs. Under the guidance of the supervisor, prepare the EHS presentation materials, statistics and reports (e.g. accidents, survey) to support processes in monitoring the conformance of company / corporate/ mandatory EHS requirements. Be responsible for EHS reporting e.g. GID, REHSA Security Be responsible for the securities affairs of the site and ensure the operation of the security facilities and act as security representative to coordinator with Jiahua security issues. Information Protection Officer Be nominated as IPO in accordance with the global BASF policy for information protection. The other EHS related responsibility refers to EHS responsibility agreement. Requirements Education: Bachelor equivalent in Chemical or Engineering Working Experience: More than 3~5 year experience in chemical industry. Technical & Professional Knowledge: EHS management theory

jobs.description: Objectives of the Position • Provide Accounts Payable's related support to deliver AP services to BASF companies in Asia Pacific in accordance to Accounts Payable processes and work procedures and in compliance with BASF policies, Financial Reporting Compliance (FRC), local company legal and statutory requirements. • Ensure that timelines and quality meet the agreed service levels and targets. • To coordinate, train and support the Analyst in performing Accounts Payable's payment process related function. • Assist and support Payment Manager in daily task, implementation of project initiatives as when required. Main Tasks Functional Tasks (including but not limited to): • To be a "First Contact Point" within the team, by providing expert knowledge and support to peers and Analysts through proper knowledge transfer; sharing of resources, knowledge, experience and best practices. • To act as 1st backup for manager on daily task as and when required. • To monitor and ensure all payment transactions are executed within the given and agreed timeframe which defined in the BASF Asia Pacific Finance Services Accounts Payable Service Level Agreement (SLA). • To monitor down payment report executed by payment analyst daily and handle technical error when necessary. • To monitor high value invoice report to ensure the invoices are paid on timely manner. • To monitor and handle critical payment items - manual payments, project related one-time payment and ensure accuracy of payment made. • To monitor and ensure all payment processes are aligned to the established Work Instruction (WI) steps and Process Definition (PD) procedures, with the accordance to FRC. • To ensure the 'accuracy and the timeliness of payment process according to agreed Service Level Agreement (SLA) with BASC’s customer contract. • To coordinate and ensure that the analyst attends to the Accounts Payable Service Desk and Payment mailbox on timely manner. • To monitor the accuracy and completeness of clearing on Account Payable related outgoing payments. • To work closely with internal/external business partners (e.g. Procurement, Invoicing, HRS, MD, IQA, Local/Regional Finance and etc.) on resolving payment related topics. • Provide guidance to team members in resolving issues/queries. Groom and develop team members to be able to handle issues/queries independently • Ensure WI are reviewed on a half yearly basis, and new processes are clearly documented especially for new team members. • Support implementation of accounts payable policies based on guideline according to regional and global standard • Monitor & perform GRIR clearing on a monthly basis including statement of accounts reconciliation • Generate AP monthly aging report and perform analysis (aging/debit balances) with follow up on invoices and block status. • Input VAT management including input VAT verification, non-deductible input VAT adjustment and VAT reconciliation reports preparation. • Regularly analyse on root cause of late payment and propose for solution to improve payment timeliness. • Perform Risk Monitor on timely basis with follow up and stamp of action notes – Risk Monitor Missing Approval, Risk Monitor T&E, Risk Monitor Overdue and Risk Monitor Parked Document. • Support audit yearly audit activities and ensuring prepared by clients reports, audit samples collection, audit walkthrough and vendor balance confirmation letters are completed on time within audit schedule. • Schedule and prepare month end post mortem meeting with the manager on regular basis by having an analysis and status update on GRIR status, Risk Monitor reports, Payment Accuracy and any related areas which concern the impact on P2P operation. Customer Relationship Management • Monitor work execution in accordance with the service management framework by providing timely and accurate customer service. • Ensure key stakeholder's queries are attended to and resolved in a timely, responsible and proactive manner. • Monitor all activity are processed within agreed service timelines • Monitor customer queries are attended to and resolved in a timely, responsible and proactive manner with end-to-end approach. • Establish and maintain good working relationship with local companies & stakeholders. Process Excellence • Support Manager to identify, recommend and develop solutions for continuous improvement opportunities. Assist Manager to manage knowledge gained on work problems encountered and steps for resolution to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge throughout accounts payable team. • Act as AP Digital Assistant to improve AP performance indicators towards strategic and data-driven position • Ensure quality of service offerings are maintained through knowledge transfer & retention of team members. • Provide support to ensure on-time implementation on global and regional P2P projects. • Collaborate closely with Expert/Specialist community in process enhancement related topics. • Drive process changes in the team by recommending and proposing solutions to local company. • Ensure quality of service offerings are maintained through knowledge transfer & retention of team members. Education & Working Experience: • Degree in accounting, finance or business administration • More than 5 years’ experience in Finance and Accounting including 1 - 2 years of experience in supervising a team. • Basic knowledge and understanding of P2P and accounting functions.

Rejoignez xarvio Digital Farming , l'entité agriculture numérique du groupe BASF, et participez au développement d'une approche innovante de la protection des cultures : le service HEALTHY FIELDS. Avec HEALTHY FIELDS, les producteurs céréaliers souscrivent à un contrat de Performance sur leurs hectares cultivés plutôt qu'à l'achat de produits phytosanitaires. Ce service innovant de protection des cultures repose sur des modèles agronomiques et épidémiologiques combiné à du suivi terrain afin d'optimiser les interventions et de contribuer à une utilisation raisonnée des intrants. Nous recherchons un étudiant ingénieur motivé pour participer régionalement au développement et à l'amélioration du service, auprès des agriculteurs et de nos partenaires de la distribution agricole. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Complètement intégré à la petite équipe xarvio HEALTHY FIELDS (5 personnes), vous participez à: Suivi agronomique terrain : Assurer le suivi d'un réseau de parcelles engagées dans le service HEALTHY FIELDS et confronter les prévisions des algorithmes à la réalité terrain ; Évaluation des outils numériques : Analyser les performances de l'Outil d'Aide à la Décision  et participer à l'exploitation des données agronomiques ; Expérimentation et innovation : Mettre en place et suivre des essais en grandes parcelles chez des agriculteurs partenaires, évaluer l'intérêt agronomique, économique et environnemental des résultats obtenus ; Compréhension des usages : recueillir les retours des agriculteurs et techniciens utilisateurs du service et établir des recommandations d'amélioration de l'expérience client et de la proposition de valeur du service ; Prospective et développement : réaliser une veille sur les services agricoles innovants, participer à la réflexion stratégique d'évolution du service ; Contribuer à des événements techniques et professionnels aux côtés des équipes xarvio. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de 6 mois dès février 2027 dans le cadre de votre dernière année d'école d’ingénieur en agriculture ou agronomie ; Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour l'agriculture de précision et les technologies numériques ; Vous avez des bases en production végétales et en protection des cultures (grandes cultures) ; Vous aimez travailler sur le terrain, au contact des techniciens et des agriculteurs ; Vous êtes basé dans l'ouest de la France (région Pays de la Loire, région Centre-Val de Loire, voire le sud de la Normandie) et possédez le permis de conduire afin d’effectuer des déplacements réguliers sur le secteur (véhicule fourni par BASF) ; Vous êtes autonome, avez le sens pratique et le goût pour le travail collaboratif en distanciel. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Gratification de stage selon la réglementation en vigueur ; Un accompagnement personnalisé favorisant le développement de vos compétences métier; Une immersion au cœur des enjeux de l'agriculture de précision ; Une expérience terrain au contact direct des agriculteurs et conseillers agricoles ; Une découverte concrète des outils numériques appliqués à l'agronomie (OAD, modélisation, données satellitaires) ; Une contribution à des solutions favorisant la performance économique et la transition agroécologique ; Un sujet particulièrement adapté à un mémoire de fin d'études ingénieur associant analyse stratégique, terrain, agriculture numérique et transition agroécologique. CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Cela ne vous prendra que quelques minutes. Nicolas, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et enverra un courriel aux candidats présélectionnés pour les inviter à un entretien vidéo MS Teams de 30 minutes. jobs.name: GB/G Business Reporting Trainer/ Subject Matter Expert (SME)
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. BASF Overview BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Accounting and Reporting Trainer / Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support knowledge transition and capability development within our Business Reporting team. The incumbent will be responsible for receiving process handovers from the sending location, documenting process knowledge, and delivering structured training programs to new Hub colleagues at the receiving location. The role requires strong expertise in Business reporting, business accounting costing, and cost management processes, hands-on SAP experience, and excellent communication and presentation skills. The ideal candidate will serve as the bridge between global and local teams, ensuring seamless knowledge transfer, process standardization, and sustainable capability development. What's In It for You Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways Access to BASF's world-class learning & development programs Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture Hybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote) Key responsibilities Knowledge Transfer & Transition Management Individual contributor who acts as the primary point of contact for process transition from colleagues at the sending location. Design and deliver structured classroom, virtual, and on-the-job training for receiving entity. Translate business accounting and reporting, costing, cost management, and SAP concepts into clear, practical learning content for varied audiences. Build sustainable process capability through robust documentation, knowledge validation, coaching, and post-training support. Participate in transition sessions, process walkthroughs, and knowledge transfer activities. Ensure smooth and effective handover of responsibilities to the receiving team. Training & Capability Development Leverage SAP knowledge to train users on business accounting and reporting, costing, cost management, and related transactional and reporting processes. Design, develop, and deliver functional training programs for business accounting and reporting, costing, and cost management processes. Conduct classroom, virtual, and on-the-job training sessions for new and existing team members. Prepare training materials, user guides, process maps, and job aids. Assess trainee understanding through evaluations, assessments, and feedback sessions. Identify knowledge gaps and recommend development plans to improve team capabilities. Proven ability to conduct knowledge transfer, facilitate training, create process documentation, and assess learner readiness. Stakeholder Management Collaborate effectively with global teams, particularly sending locations, to ensure successful transition outcomes. Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams and business partners. Communicate complex process concepts clearly to diverse audiences. Ability to collaborate effectively across cultures and time zones, including flexibility to coordinate with colleagues from sending location during the transition period. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline; CA/CMA or equivalent qualification is an advantage. 8 - 10 years of relevant experience in business accounting and reporting, costing, cost management, record-to-report, controlling, or a shared-services environment. Demonstrated subject matter expertise in business accounting and reporting, costing, and cost management, including period-end close, reconciliations, cost allocation, cost-center accounting, variance analysis, management reporting, and financial controls. Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills. Experience working in MNC and Captive GCC experience is preferred Technical Skills Hands-on experience with SAP ERP (ECC and/or S/4HANA), including relevant business accounting, costing, and cost management processes, with the ability to explain transactions and system activities to end users. Working knowledge of SAP costing and cost management concepts, including cost-center accounting, cost allocation, cost analysis, and variance reporting. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. About BASF At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it. At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive.

This position is responsible for quality assurance testing of in process samples, raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods within the scope of the Company Quality Policy. Using appropriate software to evaluate data based on internal and external specifications, support the continuous improvement of lab and plant processes through QA/QC activities and meet and/or exceed customer expectations. During your 12-hour shift as a Laboratory Technician II, you will - Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product - Analyze samples, provide quality data and become an active member along with the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to provide innovative ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrate continuous improvement - Know, understand and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, LabWare, SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. which enhance quality reporting - Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification and good quality control and assessment activities. - Generate quality data and significant statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements and continuously improve our product quality characteristics. Mit dem Bau der Anlage für Batteriematerialien legt die BASF in Schwarzheide den Grundstein für eine europäische Wertschöpfungskette der Elektromobilität. Um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu verbessern, setzen wir auf effiziente Produktionsverfahren, innovatives Kreislaufmanagement und eine nachhaltige Energiestrategie. Dazu zählt auch die Rückgewinnung der Rohstoffe durch Recycling um damit den Kreislauf zu schließen. Werden Sie Teil dieser Reise und entdecken Sie das vielseitige Produktportfolio von BASF. Wir identifizieren Defizite, Entwicklungspotentiale und Lösungen, überführen diese in Kleinmaßnahmen und Projekte und treiben so die kontinuierlichen Verbesserung voran. In Ihrer neuen Position bringen Sie die Anforderungen verschiedener Fachbereiche im Asset Management zusammen und schaffen durch eine zielgerichtete Kommunikation die Grundlage für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen. Profitieren Sie vom starken Tarifvertrag der Chemischen Industrie (attraktives Gehalt, Urlaubsgeld i.H.v. 1.200 €, 13. Monatsgehalt) sowie unseren zusätzlichen betrieblichen Leistungen. Zusätzlich erwarten Sie eine jährliche Erfolgsbeteiligung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, eine Pflegezusatzversicherung sowie ein Langzeitkonto für einen flexiblen Renteneinstieg inkl. Zuschuss von 550 € pro Jahr. Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit zur Unternehmensbeteiligung durch den Erwerb von Aktien. SO ERREICHEN SIE UNS Nina Schülzke (Talent Acquisition), nina.schuelzke@basf.com , Tel. +49 30 2005-58790 beantwortet gerne Ihre Fragen zu dieser Position. Wir stehen für Innovation, digitale Transformation und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren neuen Technologien und Arbeitsweisen übernehmen wir eine Vorreiterrolle innerhalb der BASF-Gruppe. Now hiring! Technical Service Specialist, Tupelo Mississippi Location- Remote / Homebased in Tupelo Mississippi or nearby Pay Range: $80,000 - $95 ,000 We are looking for a Technical Service Specialist to join our Surface Treatment team in Tupelo Mississippi. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. As a Technical Service Specialist (TSS) you will have responsibility that leads and coordinates all technical, purchasing, inventory, reporting activities, manage assigned projects, and respond to customer needs and complaints for our customer accounts within your territory. This position offers an incentive bonus plan, company car, laptop, phone, and all travel expenses covered by the company; travel for this role is 50% daily travel within your territory with occasional overnight travel. As a Technical Service Specialist, you will... Be the first in line for technical support with customers; providing in-depth technical service to key customers. Foster a Safety mindset acting as a safety ambassador for your customers. Complete all required Surventis compliance trainings, complete and pass all required technical training utilizing the CL3 platform, in person live training and adjacent technical seminars. Train plant personnel, line audits, startup of new processes, troubleshoot problems, continuous improvement, coordinate test work being done for the plant and participate in plant functions, such as system clean outs, team audit meetings, process analysis, and inventory management where necessary. Plan service visits with the purpose of bringing value to the customer (not just pinks and blues). The goal is to develop and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders. Communicate with a written service report utilizing clear purpose driven comments of action items and findings. Load service reports Salesforce and notify all key stakeholders. Participate in business reviews to continually reinforce our value proposition while keeping our customers out of the zone of indifference. Set up each account with the proper process instructions for the chemical process supplied by Surventis. Educate customers on proper handling of chemicals, reagents, and sample submission procedures. Assist & facilitate the installation, and troubleshoot and train proper use of process equipment provided by Surventis to the account. Look for opportunities to add business whenever possible, to be done in concert with the Technical Sales Representative (our best leads come from our customers). If you have... Bachelors Degree in Chemistry of Chemical Engineering is preferred. We are also open to high school diploma with more experience. Minimum of 1 year of technical experience with pretreatment, coatings, surface treatment, metalworking and adjacent industry applications is preferred. We are also open to fresh undergraduates with chemistry background. Ability to learn new skills and techniques associated with different product applications and chemical programs. (Products include metalworking fluids, paint pretreatment, e-coat, etc.) Ability to work autonomously, perform job responsibilities, and make consequential decisions without the need for continual direct supervision. Understanding of the chemical process, knowledge of Manufacturing Plant operations and the importance of safety. Technical expertise regarding products, specifications, processes, operations, testing, and data collection. Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills and analytical experience for testing and technical evaluation. Strong inventory management/control and product ordering is required. Relationship management experience, building and strengthening relationships with customer's technical department. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Basic computer skills are required. (MS Office Products, Salesforce, etc.) Ability to work collaboratively with internal and external teammates (Surventis and customers) to execute established account strategy and achieve established goals. Ability to lift 50lbs and stand for long periods of time. Travel for this position is 40% with occasional overnight travel within your territory. Support of the global harmonization of customs classification data and BASF’s IT processes on customs classification Support and understanding of BASF interests at national and international authorities and associations Ensuring regulatory compliance in collaboration with the business units and group companies Information, training and consulting support for the BASF Group companies, business units and group companies worldwide Monitoring and processing duty suspensions and tariff quotas if any Processing of IT-specific questions within the scope of the classification work and representation of the group interests in this work area C ustoms Compliance responsibilities Support Customs Compliance related assessment, health checks, audit and its documentation Support is desirable Good Microsoft office knowledge Good analytical and work management skills Good knowledge of SAP and SAP GTS is highly desirable English (fluent in spoken and written) Other countries’ language will be advantages The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Mit dem Bau der Anlage für Batteriematerialien legt die BASF in Schwarzheide den Grundstein für eine europäische Wertschöpfungskette der Elektromobilität. Um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu verbessern setzen wir auf effiziente Produktionsverfahren, innovatives Kreislaufmanagement und eine nachhaltige Energiestrategie. Dazu zählt auch die Rückgewinnung der Rohstoffe durch Recycling um damit den Kreislauf zu schließen. Werden Sie Teil dieser Reise und entdecken Sie das vielseitige Produktportfolio von BASF. WAS SIE ERWARTET Unsere Geschäftseinheit Technical Management ist Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Produktionsanlagen bei allen Themen rund um Instandhaltung und Infrastruktur. Wir stellen die Anlagenverfügbarkeit sicher und treiben Anlagenänderungsprozesse zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung voran. Als Projektingenieur:in führen Sie Studien durch, bewerten Varianten zur optimalen Lösung der Aufgabenstellung und treffen Entscheidungen innerhalb Ihres Verantwortungsspielraumes. Sie steuern den Anlagenänderungsprozess von der Kostenschätzung über die Planung bis zur Montage und Dokumentation. Zusätzlich unterstützen Sie bei der Inbetriebnahme durch den Betreiber. Sie erstellen Unterlagen zur Genehmigung der Projekte und erarbeiten Berichte über den monatlichen Projektstatus hinsichtlich Zeit-, Kosten- und Qualitätsaspekten sowie der Sicherheitsperformance. Für eine reibungslose Realisierung des Projektes erstellen Sie einen Projektplan vom Basic Engineering, unterstützen bei der Vergabe von Kontraktorleistungen und koordinieren interne Fachkräfte sowie externe Kontraktoren. Dabei sorgen Sie für die Einhaltung der Regeln zum Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- sowie Umweltschutz und verfassen nach erfolgreicher Projektumsetzung die Abschlussdokumentation. Nicht zuletzt wirken Sie proaktiv bei der kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Verfahrensanweisungen, Prozessen und Standards auf lokaler sowie globaler Ebene mit.
