Arbeiten Sie in einer offenen Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der die Vielfalt von Menschen, Meinungen und Erfahrungen willkommen ist und geschätzt wird. Profitieren Sie vom starken Tarifvertrag der Chemischen Industrie (attraktives Gehalt, Urlaubsgeld i.H.v. 1.200 €, 13. Monatsgehalt) sowie unseren zusätzlichen betrieblichen Leistungen. Zusätzlich erwarten Sie eine jährliche Erfolgsbeteiligung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, eine Pflegezusatzversicherung sowie ein Langzeitkonto für einen flexiblen Renteneinstieg inkl. Zuschuss von 550 € pro Jahr. Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit zur Unternehmensbeteiligung durch den Erwerb von Aktien. Sie erhalten 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr und die Beschäftigung erfolgt auf Basis einer 38,5-Stunden-Woche. Ihre Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen, deshalb bekommen Sie außerdem ein jährliches Guthaben in Höhe von 200,00 € für individuell gestaltbare Gesundheitsleistungen sowie einen zusätzlichen freien Tag. Wir stehen für Innovation, digitale Transformation und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren neuen Technologien und Arbeitsweisen übernehmen wir eine Vorreiterrolle innerhalb der BASF-Gruppe. Nutzen Sie die Chance und gestalten Sie mit uns zukunftsorientierte Lösungen. Vielfalt ist unsere größte Stärke! Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft – in einem globalen Team, das Inklusion und Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Weltanschauung lebt. jobs.name: Precision Technology Summer Associate
jobs.description: Now hiring! Precision Technology Summer Associate We are looking for a Precision Technology Summer Associate to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Saskatoon, SK. Location: Saskatoon, SK Contract Duration: 4 months (Summer 2027) Wage: $25 - $32 / Hour During peak periods in the season, overtime will be paid for evenings or weekends. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Precision Technology Summer Associate, you create chemistry by... Conducting precision technology-focused activities for field trials of local and global breeding programs aimed at developing hybrids that provide the highest return to growers. Preparing fields for aerial surveys, creating survey plans, scheduling data collection routines, validating processes, processing image data, acquiring data, and conducting data analytics for the breeding pipeline. Planning and conducting surveys using remotely piloted aircraft to gather data on specific phenotypic targets at different growth stages of the crop, subject to holding a valid basic operations drone pilot certificate. Utilizing your comfort with statistical programming in R or Python to take on data analysis and model development tasks that enhance your problem-solving skills. Engaging in a variety of field activities related to variety development and registration, including seed setup, land preparation, seeding, crop health diagnosis, pest control, pollination management, plot maintenance, parental development, harvesting, and supervising casual employees as needed. Working both independently and in a group setting, depending on the task at hand. If you have... A thorough understanding of plant breeding, agronomy, and precision technology in agriculture attained through your degree or diploma, or if you recently obtained your degree or diploma in the last 2 years. An educational focus on Agriculture or a related program/field such as Biology, Computer Science, or Engineering. A basic operations drone pilot certificate (this is an asset, and we are willing to guide you in obtaining the license if you don’t have it currently). A working knowledge of R or Python (this is an asset, but not a requirement). An interest in precision agriculture and canola breeding, even if you do not have direct experience in the Agriculture Industry. Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to be flexible as situations arise, minimizing impact on results. The ability to deliver results in pursuit of both individual and team goals.Previous farm, machinery, or drone experience (this is an asset but not a requirement, as these skills will be developed on the job). About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Join us in shaping the future as part of a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunity – regardless of gender, age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or personal beliefs. Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy Statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Pay Transparency BASF is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $25 - $32 hourly. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment BASF is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where our employees can be their authentic selves. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, place of origin, ethnic origin, colour, religion/creed, sex/pregnancy, marital status, family status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.name: Cyber Security M&A Risk Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. You will be a part of our Cyber Governance, Risk and Compliance Team, which manages the Cyber Security Framework for the whole BASF Group. In this role, you will work closely with Corporate M&A, Legal, Data Privacy, IT, business units, and transaction teams to assess and manage cyber security risks in Corporate M&A Projects (Investments/Divestitures). RESPONSIBILITIES Analyzing investments and divestitures from a cyber security perspective throughout the M&A lifecycle, from initial assessment and due diligence through signing, closing, integration, or separation, as well as participation in Post-Merger Audits. Identifying, assessing, and prioritizing cyber security risks of target companies, joint ventures, and divested businesses, and defining appropriate controls and mitigation measures based on the transaction context. Evaluating the cyber security posture of relevant organizations, systems, assets, infrastructure, applications, cloud services, data, third parties, and operational technology, where applicable, using a risk-based approach. Collaborating closely with Corporate M&A, Legal, Data Privacy, IT, business representatives, and external advisors to ensure that cyber security considerations are reflected in transaction decisions and contractual arrangements. Facilitating cyber security due diligence assessments, risk workshops, threat analyses, and targeted vulnerability assessments to identify material risks, dependencies, and potential deal impacts. Maintaining deal-specific cyber security risk registers and associated risk treatment plans, including clear ownership, priorities, target dates, and escalation of material or residual risks. Providing cyber security GRC guidance for Day-1 readiness, integration, carve-out and separation activities, transition service arrangements, and the implementation or transfer of required security controls. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field 4-7 years of relevant work experience Experience in cyber security, particularly in cyber security governance, risk management, and compliance and Project Management; experience in M&A, investments, divestitures, or corporate transactions is highly desirable Strong understanding of cyber security risk management principles and the ability to translate technical findings into business, financial, contractual, and transaction-related risk implications Experience with cyber security due diligence, risk assessments, threat modeling, vulnerability assessments, and the evaluation of complex IT, cloud, third-party, and operational technology environments Knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to cyber security, including their application within international transactions Experience in project management, M&A integration or separation, transition service arrangements, or cyber security remediation programs is a plus. Passion for working in an international, cross-functional, and transaction-driven environment, including the ability to manage sensitive information and competing priorities Experience in Communications with Senior Management and defend Due Diligence findings Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary teams and present cyber security risks clearly to technical stakeholders, business leaders, and decision-makers Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or comparable qualifications are a plus Confident communication in English, both spoken and written. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

jobs.name: IT Delivery Lead - Finance (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. We value diversity and believe that varied perspectives enhance our team's effectiveness. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure equal opportunity for all candidates. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We are currently seeking a talented Delivery Lead to join our team at BASF's Agricultural Solutions department Digital Factory. RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for overseeing and managing the delivery of technology projects within our organization. This includes managing project timelines, budgets, resources, and ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of stakeholders. With an emphasis on experience with Finance applications, data, integration, and analytics projects., the ideal candidate should have a strong background in data management, data warehousing, and analytics. The ideal candidate should have experience managing complex data projects, including data integration, data migration, and data modeling. In addition, the candidate should be familiar with data governance, data quality, and data security. The IT Delivery Lead should be able to manage a team of data engineers, data analysts, and other IT professionals, and work closely with business stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements. They should also be able to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and provide regular updates on project progress, risks, and issues. Translate Finance-specific requirements, into IT delivery plans. Take ownership of providing technical expertise, consultation, and guidance to the Product Team. Understand the technical requirements of deliverables and ensure the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including developed code, stored in Azure DevOps. Support the Product Team with technical troubleshooting for the smooth implementation and maintenance of the solution, collaborating with the development team. Collect feedback, address impediments, and advocate for process improvement, teamwork, and adherence to APB/I's ways of working to drive continuous improvement. Facilitate productive team meetings, fostering equal participation through open communication to promote collaboration and innovation, align new requirements with team capacity, priorities, and report team performance to stakeholders and provide mentorship and guidance to ensure successful implementation, offering training or coaching for enhanced collaboration. Other responsibilities may include developing project plans and schedules, managing project budgets and resources, identifying and mitigating project risks, and ensuring that projects are delivered according to established standards and best practices. Manage vendors and contractors, including contracts, invoices, purchase orders. REQUIREMENTS OF THE POSITION Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Agile certifications such as Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) are preferred. Oracle SQL experience (databases, SQL queries, procedures), Github and REST APIs Varied and extensive experience in project management, with a focus on Agile methodologies. Proven track record of successfully delivering projects on time, within budget, and meeting stakeholder expectations. Experience delivering solutions supporting Finance processes, such as Accounting, Controlling, Planning, Treasury, Tax, ESG Reporting, or Credit Management. Experience managing complex projects related to Finance applications, data, integration, and analytics projects., including data integration, data migration, and data modeling. In-depth knowledge and experience with Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, or Lean. Ability to lead Agile teams, facilitate Agile ceremonies, and ensure adherence to Agile principles and practices Strong understanding of Agile project management tools and techniques, such as user stories, backlog management, sprint planning, and retrospectives. Experience experience working with Finance applications, data, integration, and analytics projects. tools such as data warehouses, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and data visualization tools. Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and data security best practices. Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, including technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with team members, stakeholders, and senior management. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing project requirements. Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and improvement, staying up to-date with industry trends and best practices in Agile methodologies and Finance applications, data, integration, and analytics projects. Ability to identify areas for process improvement, implement Agile practices, and mentor team members in Agile principles. Nice to have: Experience with enterprise Finance solutions, SAP environments, cloud-based applications, and their integration with ERP and data platforms is an advantage. Data and process integration experience with mulesoft, databricks, azure data factory. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided HOW TO REACH US Do you have any questions about the application process or the position? Please reach out to Felipe Bianco (felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com)

jobs.name: GB/G Master Data Analyst
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. BASF Overview BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in About the Role The Semi-Senior Master Data Business Partner Analyst controls and audits the accurate creation and modification of customer, supplier, and bank master data for the LATAM and North America regions within agreed service-level timelines. The role supports stakeholders, maintains strong customer focus, helps prevent fraud exposure, identifies process deviations, and contributes to local, regional, and global initiatives. What's In It for You •  Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative •  Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions •  Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways •  Access to BASF's world-class learning & development programs •  Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture •  Hybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote) Key Responsibilities •  Validate, audit, and perform quality checks on customer, supplier, and bank master data for creation and modification requests in accordance with internal policies and procedures. •  Help prevent potential fraud exposure by confirming that master-data requests meet applicable control, approval, and documentation requirements. •  Execute mass-change requests in compliance with internal policies and procedures. •  Serve as the point of contact for project teams when initiatives may affect the Master Data area. •  Maintain clear and proactive communication with stakeholders, global Master Data representatives, and other company functions to improve the user experience. •  Prepare presentations and reports, perform testing and duplicate analysis, maintain documentation, handle ad hoc requests, and deliver user training. •  Identify process deviations and improvement opportunities, communicate them promptly, and propose practical solutions. •  Respond to inquiries, provide reports and analyses, and follow up on local, regional, or global initiatives with support from the FEX, Team Coordinator, and Manager. Minimum Qualifications •  Education: Professional qualification in Finance (e.g. B com, CA, CPA, etc.) or MBA or Master degree in finance / Accounting or related disciplines •  Work Experience: 3-5 years of experience in master-data maintenance, procurement, credit, finance operations, or a related field. •  Process Knowledge: Solid understanding of customer, supplier, and bank master-data creation and maintenance, data-quality controls, duplicate analysis, service-level requirements, internal procedures, and fraud-risk prevention. •  Decision-Making: Tasks and responsibilities are completed under close guidance or alignment with the team lead. •  Leadership: No formal leadership experience is required. •  Project Experience: Formal project experience is not required, although the role serves as a contact for initiatives affecting the Master Data area. •  Core Skills: Teamwork, effective communication, customer focus, problem-solving, attention to detail, autonomy, organization, and stakeholder coordination. Technical Skills •  Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. •  Intermediate working knowledge of SAP. •  Advanced Spanish and intermediate English and/or Portuguese proficiency are required for the regional scope described in the source JD. •  Experience with customer, supplier, and bank master-data processes is preferred. •  Ability to prepare reports and presentations, perform testing and duplicate analysis, and maintain process documentation. •  Experience in a shared services, multinational, or GCC environment is preferred. About BASF At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it.At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive.

jobs.name: Sr E&I Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Now hiring! Sr E&I Reliability Engineer Hannibal, MO We are looking for a Sr. Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) Reliability Engineer I to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Hannibal, MO. In this role, you will lead site reliability for electrical power distribution, instrumentation, control systems, and safety-related assets throughout their lifecycle. You will also be responsible for providing reliability support to the site by implementing and driving reliability programs and providing guidance for repair, maintenance and inspection activities. You will use tools such as FMEA, RCFA, RBI, criticality analysis, and other reliability-based maintenance engineering principles to improve electrical, instrumentation, and controls performance. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Sr E&I Reliability Engineer, you create chemistry by... Ensuring that all E&I reliability-related activities, including electrical power systems, control systems, and critical instrumentation, are compliant with the company Responsible Care Management System, ISA standards, and applicable statutory regulations, and that relevant asset management systems, procedures, and standards are followed to maintain compliance at all times. Applying appropriate reliability tools to drive improvements, optimize costs, and improve Asset Effectiveness (i.e. Bad Actor Program, FMEA, RBI, RBM, RCM/Criticality Analysis, RCFA, etc.) for E&I assets. Maintaining site reliability programs for critical instrumentation and safety instrumented systems (SIS), electrical distribution assets (e.g., generators, transformers, MCCs, heat tracing, utility power), and control systems. Monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for proactive identification and resolution of reliability issues, including findings from inspection reports. Supporting capital projects by supplying E&I engineering expertise in the specification, design, commissioning, and startup activities in accordance with plant design requirements, as well as regulatory and BASF standards, utilizing your general understanding of industrial maintenance procedures, including work planning, preventive maintenance, and repair parts acquisition. Designing maintenance strategies, procedures, inspection plans and methods for E&I assets. If you... Possess a Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering or related E&I technical discipline. Have a bachelor’s degree and 6 or more years’ experience within a manufacturing or engineering role with technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, instrumentation, and control systems; OR have a master’s degree and 4 or more years’ experience within a manufacturing or engineering role with technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, instrumentation, and control systems. Have strong troubleshooting and diagnostic capabilities within operations and maintenance teams, with experience applying several reliability concepts to electrical and instrumentation assets in an industrial environment. Have strong interpersonal skills. Possess knowledge of Reliability Management tools: maintenance strategies, inspection strategies, Bad Actor Program, RCFA. Have the ability to develop and maintain metrics to measure reliability and efficiency of equipment, including the use of digital tools (e.g. Power BI). Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We as Global Digital Services enable BASF’s digitalization. In agile teams, we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF and its customers, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes. We provide IT that works and offer know-how and access to latest technologies in the areas of cloud computing, blockchain or big data. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a Senior SAP HCM Payroll Consultant within the Payroll Product Team Europe & Americas, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of SAP Payroll solutions with a strong focus on German Payroll and Company Pension Schemes (Betriebliche Altersversorgung, bAV). As the subject matter expert for German Payroll and Company Pension Schemes, you take ownership of end-to-end processes and ensure compliance with German tax, social security and occupational pension regulations. You will analyze complex legal, regulatory and business requirements and translate them into sustainable solutions within SAP Human Capital Management (SAP HCM), including SAP HCM for SAP S/4HANA and connected cloud applications. A key aspect of your role will be designing and continuously improving payroll and pension solutions including payroll schemas, rules, wage types, calculations, interfaces, reporting and reconciliation. You will lead payroll and pension-related projects and workstreams, covering requirements engineering, testing, quality assurance, deployment, release planning and prioritization in an Agile and DevOps environment. In close collaboration with Human Resources (HR), Finance, pension specialists, external vendors and implementation partners, you act as a trusted advisor and ensure seamless integration across the system landscape. You will actively shape our technology transformation by evaluating and implementing innovative solutions such as SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), SAP Fiori/UI5, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and SAP HCM for SAP S/4HANA. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Human Resources, Business Administration or an equivalent qualification minimum 8–10 years of SAP Human Capital Management (SAP HCM) Payroll consulting experience, with deep expertise in German Payroll (PY-DE) and German tax, social security and payroll regulations strong expertise in occupational pension schemes (betriebliche Altersversorgung, bAV), including pension calculations, employer- and employee-funded schemes, deferred compensation and pension settlements advanced technical knowledge of SAP HCM Payroll, including payroll schemas and rules, wage types, reporting, interfaces and Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP/ABAP OO) experience with SAP HCM for SAP S/4HANA, ideally combined with SuccessFactors integration, SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), SAP Cloud Integration (SAP CPI), DeconHR and SAP Fiori/UI5 proven project leadership and stakeholder management experience in complex international environments, with the ability to bridge business and IT requirements and manage external consulting partners strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, an independent and customer-focused working style, and fluency in German and English ideally, demonstrated expertise German Payroll and bAV, with hands-on experience implementing complex pension processes and supporting an SAP HCM to SAP S/4HANA transformation WHAT WE OFFER Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your own ideas (e.g. Women in BASF) Mentoring programs and learning opportunities for your professional and personal development Career paths as professional development to other positions in the company (also job rotation) Support with childcare (e.g. company crèche, holiday programmes) Fitness and health studio, medical center with numerous offers for your health Deutschlandticket as a discounted job ticket and job bike Mobile working in Germany Flexible working time models (e.g. part-time employment or job sharing) Attractive remuneration and a variable bonus HOW TO REACH US Yasemin Koparan (Talent Acquisition), yasemin.koparan@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-58540 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US BASF Digital Solutions GmbH offers innovative solutions for the design and optimization of business processes for the BASF Group around the world. As an experienced business solution provider, we create added value for BASF by developing new business models with digital technologies, thereby increasing the efficiency and effectiveness of processes through IT and digital solutions. Learn more about BASF Digital Solutions GmbH here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Because we are counting on innovative solutions, on sustainable actions, and on connected thinking. And on you. Become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Regulatory Finance and Competitive Intelligence Strategy
jobs.description: Now hiring! Regulatory Finance and Competitive Intelligence Strategy Research Triangle Park, NC We are looking for a Regulatory Finance & Competitive Intelligence Strategy Lead to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Research Triangle Park, NC. The Regulatory Finance & Competitive Intelligence Strategy Lead provides integrated leadership across financial governance, competitive intelligence, and strategic operations for the US and Canada Crop Protection Regulatory organizations. This role ensures regulatory leadership has clear financial insight, forward-looking competitive intelligence, and coordinated strategic support to enable sound decision-making, portfolio prioritization, and freedom-to-operate in the U.S. agricultural market. The role functions as a trusted strategic partner across regulatory, commercial, and functional teams and leads a small analytical organization. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Regulatory Finance and Competitive Intelligence Strategy, you create chemistry by... Leading and managing the RTP-based APD cost center budget and monthly forecasting processes, coordinating with other AP functions to ensure appropriate planning and resource availability. Leading and managing the US and Canada Regulatory Competitive Intelligence team, and serving as the US and Canada representative on the global regulatory competitive intelligence team. Providing oversight and support for the underlying data and cost analyses for US and Canada data compensation needs. Ensuring internal and external resources are planned appropriately, supporting local resource planning personnel, and enabling sound decision-making and portfolio prioritization. If you... Hold a PhD with 5+ years of experience in finance, controlling, the agricultural chemicals industry, or a related field, a master’s degree with 8+ years of experience in finance, controlling, the agricultural chemicals industry, or a related field, or a Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of experience in finance, controlling, the agricultural chemicals industry, or a related field; an MBA, CPA, or CMA is a plus. Bring 10+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, commercial strategy, competitive intelligence, regulatory affairs, or strategic operations. Have 6+ years of proven experience leading products and/or functional teams . Have demonstrated experience in U.S. or Canada agricultural markets, preferably within crop protection or closely related industries . Demonstrate expertise in budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and scenario analysis to support business decisions. Have experience forecasting and managing research budgets preferred . Have experience working with procurement, compliance and/or controlling IT tools/programs Bring strong financial acumen including budgeting, forecasting, and scenario modeling Excel at synthesizing complex financial, market, and regulatory data into clear, actionable business insights. Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization and influence stakeholders through strong written and verbal communication skills. Are able to travel up to 10%. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Sie verbinden Saatgut und speziell gezüchtete Pflanzeneigenschaften, Pflanzenschutzprodukte, digitale Tools und Nachhaltigkeitsansätze. In einem wertschätzenden und gemeinschaftlichen Umfeld trägst du dazu bei, das Risiko- und interne Kontrollsystem von BASF Agricultural Solutions zu stärken und kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. In deiner neuen Position unterstützt du die Durchführung von Risikobewertungen sowie die strukturierte Dokumentation und Berichterstattung von Risiken und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zu transparenten Governance-Prozessen. jobs.name: R&D Performance Management Specialist (h/f)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF Agricultural Solutions, and everything we do is driven by our love of agriculture. Our solutions are specifically designed for different cropping systems, connecting seeds and traits, crop protection, digital tools and sustainability approaches. We strive to deliver the best possible benefits to farmers, growers and other stakeholders across the value chain. We are committed to building a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth. Discover our Agricultural Solutions and career opportunities ! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In your new role, you will be responsible for governing the key performance indicator (KPI) system for the technical development of products in the EMEA and CIS region. You will establish harmonized KPI definitions, common calculation methods and a binding reporting calendar; To support the success of field trials and the efficiency of product development, you will design relevant dashboards and management reports, analyze performance variances and derive root-cause analyses, concrete action recommendations and robust decision-making insights; Working closely with your colleagues, you will harmonize metrics and data standards to ensure consistent reporting and reliable comparisons of field-trial and product-development activities across countries and country clusters; You will lead seasonal planning governance, ensure timely planning and the availability of trial protocols, and provide transparency regarding the capacities and skills required to successfully conduct field trials; Finally, you will translate business requirements into digital solutions and develop suitable tools to support planning, risk management and management decision-making. WHAT YOU OFFER Master’s degree or equivalent university degree, preferably in agricultural sciences, life sciences, data science, business informatics, decision analytics or a related field; At least ten years of relevant professional experience in performance management, field-trial data analysis, agricultural research and product development, or a comparable R&D environment; Excellent understanding of processes and data structures related to agronomic trials, as well as practical experience with specialized applications such as ARM, SPEAD, Tardis and PENALTI or DoQtor+, multi-trial analysis tools and data-completeness control tools; Excellent command of English and advanced skills in Microsoft Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Excel, including VBA or macros, Power Pivot and advanced data modeling; Analytical mindset and the ability to solve problems pragmatically; Ability to work independently, with precision and a strong sense of priorities. WHAT WE OFFER A stimulating and exciting opportunity in a committed and highly skilled team; An environment that fosters innovation, idea sharing and well-being; A setting that enables you to develop your potential within an international group. ABOUT US As a leading provider of agricultural solutions, BASF Agricultural Solutions France aims to support farmers in the agroecological transition through a portfolio combining modern crop-protection products, biological control, digital solutions, seeds and agronomic expertise. More than 300 employees based in Écully, near Lyon, and across the regions meet the needs of farmers and address the challenges facing French agriculture. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Gestalten Sie die digitale Zukunft unserer Logistik mit: Sie evaluieren und begleiten Digitalisierungs- und Automatisierungsprojekte, beispielsweise bei der Einführung von Applikationen zur Verwaltung von Fahrer-, Qualifikations- und Flottendaten. Sammeln Sie wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in der Supply Chain: Sie unterstützen unsere Einheit bei operativen Supply-Chain-Themen und wirken bei der Aktualisierung von Anweisungen zu §14 der Gefahrstoffverordnung (GefStoffV ) mit und tragen so zu reibungslosen Produktionsprozessen bei. jobs.name: TOP START International Business Leader Program (China) (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF With TOP START (China) , our exclusive three-year program for future leaders, we will prepare you for a leading position in general management. Contribute your creativity, passion and entrepreneurial drive at BASF and start your successful career with us! Learn more about TOP START here WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Are you eager to gain comprehensive insights into BASF from various perspectives and regions? Do you feel thrilled working on mission-critical projects in an international context? Do you appreciate diversity and a stimulating environment? Are you eager to step out of your comfort zone and grow as a leader every day? Our TOP START International Business Leader Program offers a unique opportunity for the best graduates around the world to experience all that while maximizing their potential and developing themselves into a leading position for a successful general management career. You are ready to take on responsibility? Actively participate in our diverse international environment from day one and contribute to BASF's success by leading business-driven projects. Are you flexible, open-minded, and feel at home in the world? Be part of three different units in various regions of the world, with at least one assignment based in China within three years. Gain an in-depth understanding of a variety of business areas both at the operational and strategic level. Personalized development and mentoring are of importance to you? Our coaching and development programs, combined with continuous feedback and an individual mentor from our top management, accompany and support you on your way to a successful career. Networking is an essential part of your professional life? Throughout the trainee program, you are in close exchange with our program manager and participate in numerous networking opportunities with trainees, alumni, and board members. WHAT YOU OFFER Outstanding performance - You have an excellent degree in the field of business/economics (Master, PhD, MBA) with no more than three years of work experience. On top of your strong management expertise, you ideally bring a general technical curiosity or even have a background that combines management and technology to quickly understand and navigate complex innovation-driven environments. Experiences out of your comfort zone - You have first practical experiences in leading companies, e.g., through demanding internships. Your international experiences have strengthened your communication skills and fluency in English and Mandarin. Think and act like a leader - Your analytical mindset helps you quickly capture complex topics and situations, and you enjoy an innovative and sustainable approach. Inspiration and openness - Your future-oriented actions and implementation of ideas are characterized by your entrepreneurial drive, empathy and a strong sense of collaboration. WHAT WE OFFER A successful start to your career at a global company with individual career planning tailored specifically to you, challenging and diverse tasks and a wide range of development measures. Attractive compensation, including occupational social benefits and outstanding development opportunities within an international company. The selection process includes a background check of the last diploma obtained and a criminal record certificate. Please submit the required documents only after our request. ABOUT US BASF has been a committed partner to Greater China since 1885. BASF posted sales of approximately €8.2 billion in 2025 to customers in Greater China and employed 12,452 people as of the end of the year. BASF currently operates 29 major wholly-owned subsidiaries, 11 major joint ventures, and maintains 30 sales offices in Greater China. BASF’s portfolio in Greater China comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; and the standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. These solutions are used in almost all areas of daily life such as in houses, cars, food, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, textile, household goods, electronic equipment and packaging. As of the end of 2025, BASF has cumulatively invested more than €15 billion in Greater China (more than €18 billion with partners) to build a locally competitive production, marketing, sales, technical service and innovation network. For further information, please visit: BASF – China (Mainland) Diversity is our greatest strength! jobs.name: Senior Specialist Digitalization Digital Plant
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position Digitalization of Operations unit implements digital technologies and applications in production plants. This enables us to increase production effectiveness. At the same time, processes become more efficient and safer. Job Responsibilities Our goal is the implementation of digital technologies and applications in chemical plants, to improve work processes and increase the production efficiency. As a part of the global Digital Plant team you will coordinate the creation of a digital, intelligently linked representation of a real asset – the so-called digital twin. The digital twin will therefore enable many future use cases in other products like augmented reality or artificial intelligence. Your activities will include the digitalization of a real plant, by following a standardized and proven procedure create validated 2D- and 3D-data. The implementation of the necessary technology, digital workflows and roles within the whole organization of a plant and the respective service providers will be part of your activities, too. You will guide users how to use digital methods and processes during the asset lifecycle, to raise the potentials of cost and lead time reduction combined with quality increase in engineering, construction, brownfield projects, plant modifications, maintenance, TARM and operations. On the way to the digital asset lifecycle, you will offer change management support, accompanied by training and coaching on easy-to-use tools and enhanced digital processes. Job Requirements Master Degree in Chemical/Process Engineering or Mechanical Engineering Minimum 3+ years’ experience in planning or construction of or in chemical plants Experience in usage of digital tools and methods in data driven engineering projects Very good project management and coordination skills Ideally working Experience in international projects and agil methods The will and ability to drive change and an entrepreneurial spirit Creative and motivated working style with a strong focus on innovation Ability to work in a multicultural and virtual team Excellent communication skills in English BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.description:

If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. The Role: The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading the process engineering and quality control functions at the Greenville, Ohio manufacturing site, which produces specialty resins for the automotive industry. This role provides technical leadership to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient support of the site's 24/7 manufacturing operations. The Engineering Manager drives process optimization, continuous improvement, quality performance, and operational excellence while supporting the site's safety, reliability, and business objectives. The department consists of approximately 20 employees, including process engineers, laboratory professionals, and hourly quality personnel. Reporting directly to the Site Director, the Engineering Manager serves as a member of the site leadership team and collaborates closely with operations, maintenance, technology, commercial, and supply chain functions. Process engineering and quality management are critical drivers of manufacturing performance, making this role essential to the site's ability to achieve its operational, business, and financial objectives. As a member of the site leadership team, the Engineering Manager partners closely with operations and maintenance leaders to help establish and execute the site's strategic direction. This position also serves as a vital link between the site and key corporate functions. The Engineering Manager acts as the primary liaison to corporate technology organizations, ensuring alignment on product formulations, process requirements, technology transfers, and new product introductions. In addition, the role serves as the site's primary interface with the global quality organization, coordinating quality initiatives, supporting audits and investigations, and ensuring effective communication between site operations and corporate quality teams. As an Engineering Manager, you will... Partner closely with Operations leadership to achieve production, quality, safety, and cost targets. Provide technical leadership during major plant upsets, quality problems, capacity constraints, and startup activities. Identify and execute opportunities that improve plant profitability and return on invested capital Champion Process Safety Management (PSM) and Responsible Care programs and ensure engineering activities support safe and compliant plant operations. Ensure process engineering support for Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs) Lead and sustain key Process Safety Management (PSM) elements, including management of change (MOC) and pre-startup safety reviews (PSSR), ensuring procedures are current, effective, and consistently executed while monitoring performance metrics and driving continuous improvement of process safety compliance. Ensure process safety incidents, near misses, and operational upsets are thoroughly investigated and corrective actions are implemented. Serve as the site liaison to corporate technology, R&D, and product management teams for new product commercialization and technical support. Develop and manage departmental operating budget while identifying opportunities to improve plant profitability. Build organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, and recruitment of engineering and quality personnel. If you have... The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com .

jobs.name: Risk Management System (RMS) Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: Build Your Career on Our Standalone Transformation ). In your new position, you support the implementation and maintenance, and continuous improvement of the RMS, including definition of requirements, setting standards, methodologies, and governance processes. You act as a sparring partner and the operational point of contact for business units and functions, ensuring the consistent application of RMS requirements and fostering a risk-aware culture across the organization. You provide expert guidance and challenge in risk identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation, supporting informed decision-making and effective risk management practices. You contribute to the identification and evaluation of emerging risks and risk trends and support the integration of these insights into business planning and management processes. With your expertise, you support the development and delivery of RMS training sessions and guidance materials and contribute to improving risk awareness across the organization. You facilitate risk review meetings with business units and functions, challenge risk assessments where appropriate, and ensure high-quality risk documentation and follow-up actions. Furthermore, you consolidate risk information and prepare meaningful risk reports and analyses for management and governance bodies. Last but not least, you actively contribute to increasing RMS maturity across the organization and collaborate closely with the RMS Expert 1, the Team Lead, and other key stakeholders to continuously enhance the effectiveness of the risk management system. WHAT YOU OFFER university degree in law, economics, natural sciences, or a comparable field at least three years of experience in an RMS department ideally within the agriculture, chemical, or another regulated industry strong knowledge of RMS methodologies including risk assessment, simulation and reporting, as well as familiarity with risk management software and automation tools excellent English skills as well as proficiency in standard IT applications strong analytical and communication skills combined with problem-solving ability, integrity, assertiveness, and the willingness to act as a role model for RMS culture WHAT WE OFFER Responsibility within a leading international agricultural company. Working in a fully international global environment with continuous exchange with colleagues across Agricultural Solutions worldwide. Opportunity to contribute to a robust and future-oriented governance environment. A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing are always our top priority. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. HOW TO REACH US Isabel Maisack (isabel.maisack@basf.com) will be happy to answer your questions for this position. ABOUT US Find out more about BASF Agricultural Solutions here. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d) 1
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Digitalization is a true part of BASF's DNA — creating new customer experiences, driving business growth, and making processes more efficient. Global Digital Services drives BASF's digital transformation through innovative, global, high-quality digital products and a strong agile culture, and the Digital Hub Madrid is one of our key global delivery locations. We are seeking an AI Architect for BASF's DevHub — the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) used by thousands of engineers and product teams across BASF. DevHub already ships an enterprise AI Gateway (50+ governed models, Entra ID, EU data residency, per-cost-center billing, Grafana observability) and a catalog that is a schema-validated knowledge graph of every product and its infrastructure. As AI Architect, you will own the technical vision and architecture of DevHub's AI capabilities: defining how AI is built, integrated, governed, and scaled across the platform. You will work directly with the Product Manager as the architectural counterpart, shaping the AI roadmap, setting technical standards, and ensuring the team builds the right things the right way. You will treat the platform as a product — designing the systems that serve both humans and agents, with the multi-tenant scoping, cost-tracking, guardrails and governance an enterprise platform demands RESPONSIBILITIES Own the AI architecture. Define and evolve the technical architecture for DevHub's AI capabilities: the AI Gateway, agentic services, retrieval/context pipelines, and platform-AI integration points. Produce and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs) and RFCs that guide the team. Set technical direction for the team. Be the architectural authority on pattern selection, technology choices, and build-vs-buy decisions. Ensure the team applies the right pattern for each problem: deterministic pipelines + structured outputs where outcomes are structured; multi-step/multi-agent orchestration only for genuinely open-ended tasks. Design platform-as-product AI capabilities. Architect reusable building blocks (shared retrieval/"context engine," guardrail and evaluation libraries, MCP/tool layer), scaffolder templates, SDK/API surfaces, and stable versioned interfaces — designed once, reused across features and teams. Architect for humans and agents. Design the MCP / SDK / API surface that exposes platform capabilities — read-first, RBAC- and tenant-aware — so internal and external AI clients can query and (later, gated) act on the platform. Drive evaluation and quality standards. Define the evaluation framework: eval harnesses, golden tests, retrieval-quality metrics, grounding and hallucination controls. Establish context engineering as the primary lever over model selection — the Gateway already solves model choice. Shape MLOps / LLMOps practices. Design the path from experiment to production: prompt/version management, model adaptation pipelines, CI/CD for AI artefacts. Ensure prompts and retrieval are treated as versioned, tested production assets. Architect for multi-tenancy and governance. Design per-product / per-tenant scoping of context, tools, and actions. Define the observability architecture (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, distributed tracing) and per-product cost/FinOps visibility. Ensure platform RBAC (Entra ID / AccessIT), OWASP LLM Top 10 defences, auditability, and BASF / EU AI Act compliance are embedded by design. Mentor and uplift the engineering team. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the AI engineers. Conduct architecture reviews, pair on complex problems, and raise the team's technical bar. You are not a people manager, but you are the person the team looks to for technical decisions. Represent AI architecture to stakeholders. Engage with Enterprise Architecture, Product Family leadership, and external partners (Databricks, Microsoft) on architectural alignment, technology strategy, and integration patterns. Translate business requirements into technical architecture and vice versa. QUALIFICATIONS Education: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or related field. Experience: 7+ years in software/platform engineering, including 2-3 years in technical leadership or architecture roles and recent experience in Generative AI and/or AI-driven systems. Strong Python expertise and production AI/LLM architecture experience, with a platform mindset and ability to set technical direction. Deep experience designing production-scale LLM systems, including RAG architectures, agentic patterns, context engineering, and appropriate use of autonomous agents. Strong system design skills for distributed, multi-tenant systems, including API boundaries, data flows, resilience, ADRs, RFCs, and architecture diagrams. Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM/RAG systems, including eval harnesses, golden tests, retrieval-quality metrics, grounding, and hallucination control. Expert-level Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, async) and production-grade API/platform service design. Experience designing reusable self-service platform components, templates, SDKs, and golden paths across teams. Deep Azure experience, Kubernetes/AKS at scale, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code (HCL/Terraform). Experience with PostgreSQL, vector stores such as Azure AI Search, and state management in multi-tenant platforms. Knowledge of LLM providers and platforms including OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, and MCP. Strong understanding of authentication/authorization, RBAC, tenant isolation, guardrails, auditability, OWASP LLM Top 10, and EU AI Act implications. Experience mentoring engineers, conducting architecture reviews, setting technical standards, and communicating technical decisions clearly. Nice to have: Databricks/Unity Catalog, TypeScript, Grafana, MLflow, FinOps for AI, A2A, agentic development standards, RabbitMQ, Azure Event Grid, and experience working with enterprise architecture and vendor teams. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, sustainable actions, connected thinking and on you, become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines.We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance.We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities

Um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu verbessern, setzen wir auf effiziente Produktionsverfahren, innovatives Kreislaufmanagement und eine nachhaltige Energiestrategie. Dazu zählt auch die Rückgewinnung der Rohstoffe durch Recycling um damit den Kreislauf zu schließen. Werden Sie Teil dieser Reise und entdecken Sie das vielseitige Produktportfolio von BASF.
