jobs.name: Regional Communications Specialist Southern EMEA (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OUR TEAM If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application comes directly to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it – this is your place. WHAT YOU WILL DO Our Communications team works closely with the business to ensure our strategy is understood and our story is heard. As Regional Communications Specialist Southern EMEA , you give the Surventis brand its voice in Spain, Portugal, Türkiye and across Southern Europe. You shape how Surventis shows up in your region: sharp communication and media strategies, a strong regional network, and stories that earn trust. You work hand in hand with our business units to strengthen our reputation and keep our people engaged and in the loop. You build and nurture relationships with media, industry associations and key external stakeholders, and make sure Surventis is visible and respected in the region. You craft tailored communication plans and messages that land, especially for strategic projects and organizational transformations. You coordinate crisis communication and issue management with internal partners, including EHS. You support our leaders with compelling speeches, presentations and briefing materials for media moments and corporate events. You create content for internal and external audiences, from press releases to intranet stories and social posts, in a voice that is unmistakably Surventis. You bring global messages to life locally and adapt them for employees, digitally and on site. You are an ambassador for our brand, as a company and as an employer, in your region. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism or a related field Several years of experience in internal and external communications in an international corporate environment Proven experience in media relations, change communications and crisis communications, ideally with an existing network in Spanish media Strong writing skills across formats, from speeches and press releases to social posts Strong advisory skills and proven experience working with leaders and stakeholders at all levels A creative mind, a proactive and structured working style, networking talent and a knack for solving problems Excellent presentation and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment Confident with communication tools and platforms (e.g., CMS) and genuinely curious about AI Excellent written and spoken English and Spanish; Portuguese, French, Turkish or Italian is a plus WHAT WE OFFER The chance to shape the image of Surventis in a fast-moving, supportive environment, with the latest AI tools built into everyday communications. 30 vacation days/year (full-time). Attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan. Local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. A feedback culture firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. HOW TO REACH US Submit your CV in English through the job posting so we can get to know each other. If your profile matches, our Spanish Talent Acquisition team based in Germany will contact you (phone prefix +49) and guide you through the process. With each step, you’ll be closer to meeting your future team! If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact Vanessa Morales (vanessa.morales-soto@basf.com*). *Please note that we will not be able to accept applications via this email address. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.description: NEGOCIO SOLUCIONES PARA LA AGRICULTURA En BASF somos apasionados por la agricultura y todo lo que hacemos nace de ese compromiso. Nuestras soluciones están diseñadas para responder a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y a los diferentes sistemas de cultivo, integrando semillas y traits, protección de cultivos, herramientas digitales y soluciones de sustentabilidad. Junto a productores y a toda la cadena de valor, trabajamos para generar resultados sostenibles y construir una agricultura cada vez más innovadora, productiva y preparada para el futuro. Por amor a la agricultura, el trabajo más valioso sobre la tierra.  #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth ACERCA DE LA POSICIÓN Como Especialista Sr. de Compensaciones y Beneficios, serás responsable por definir y ejecutar la estrategia de Total Rewards para el negocio en Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay, Chile y Perú, impulsando soluciones que contribuyan a la atracción, retención y experiencia de nuestros colaboradores. Trabajarás junto a líderes, a HRBPs y al equipo de Recursos Humanos, para promover prácticas competitivas, equitativas y sostenibles, conectadas con las necesidades de las personas y del negocio. Tus principales desafíos serán: Impulsar la implementación y evolución de las estrategias de Compensaciones y Beneficios de los países a cargo, asegurando la adecuación a las particularidades de cada mercado. Asesorar a líderes y HRBPs en aspectos vinculados con estructuras salariales, promociones, equidad, y esquemas de compensación. Liderar evaluaciones de puestos y análisis de competitividad externa, integrando información de mercado y tendencias para desarrollar recomendaciones que orienten la toma de decisiones vinculadas a Total Rewards. Gestionar programas de incentivos y reconocimiento, participando en iniciativas de Compensaciones y Beneficios asociadas a procesos de transformación organizacional. Administrar el portafolio de beneficios, incluyendo políticas, proveedores, costos y presupuesto, con foco en su competitividad, sostenibilidad y contribución a la experiencia de los colaboradores. Gestionar las métricas del área y transformarlas en inputs para identificar oportunidades y orientar la evolución de las prácticas del área. REQUISITOS DEL PERFIL Formación universitaria completa en Recursos Humanos, Administración de Empresas, y/o carreras afines. Inglés Avanzado. Serán valorados estudios de posgrado y/o especialización en Compensaciones, Beneficios o áreas relacionadas. Experiencia: Sólida trayectoria en Compensaciones y Beneficios, con participación en procesos de esquemas de remuneración, beneficios, evaluaciones de puestos, encuestas salariales e incentivos. Gestión de análisis de mercado, proveedores, costos y presupuesto. Se valorará el haber participado en proyectos de transformación organizacional y en iniciativas que requieran articulación con líderes, HRBPs y múltiples stakeholders. Conocimientos Técnicos: Arquitectura de esquemas de compensación y de beneficios Evaluación de puestos y estrategia organizacional Tendencias de mercado y competitividad salarial People Analytics aplicado a Total Rewards Gestión financiera, presupuesto y proveedores Marco normativo de Compensaciones y Beneficios Competencias de Gestión: Análisis estratégico con visión de negocio Perspectiva y foco en Employee Experience (EX) Ownership y orientación a resultados y a la mejora continua Mindset digital y toma de decisiones basada en datos Sólidas habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento. Articulación y trabajo en equipo con stakeholders Nuestra química valora el talento y la diversidad de género, edad, raza, color, nacionalidad, creencias, orientación sexual, identidad y expresión de género, discapacidad y todas las demás características, diferencias y semejanzas que son parte de la diversidad humana . ¡Te invitamos a postularte a nuestras vacantes!

jobs.name: Sales Specialist - Key Account Manager - NW Iowa, N NE, ND and SD Territory (Field)
jobs.description: Now hiring! Sales Specialist - Key Account Manager - NW Iowa, N NE, ND and SD Territory (Field) NW Iowa, N Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota Territory We are looking for a Sales Specialist - Key Account Manager to join our Agricultural Solutions team. This role for the Thurston Genetics business unit within BASF revolves around the customer experience and driving profitable growth. The foundation for this is a strong team that brings technical product and product placement, industry and market knowledge in order to understand the diverse markets where we build trusting and satisfying customer relationships. The person in this role will be responsible for managing 35-40 accounts across the assigned territory. Additionally, they will provide support on another 10-15 accounts located in Wisconsin and Canada. They will meet BASF specified targets by creating value for the existing customer base and prospecting for new opportunities for Thurston Genetics corn hybrids. They will report to the National Sales Manager. They will reside within the Northern Sales territory. Traveling up to 35% of the time overnight. Our opportunities can take you all over North America. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Sales Specialist - Key Account Manager - NW Iowa, N NE, ND and SD Territory (Field), you create chemistry by... Managing business relationships with assigned seed company accounts, which may include Corporate and/or Regional Business relationships. Relying on your Account Management experience and demonstrated corn germplasm knowledge, you will develop and communicate product information to accounts allowing for effective business solutions to be developed representing mutually successful and profitable results. Forecasting sales and seedstock supply needs are key to business units success as well as managing through inventory shortages. Thinking strategically and with high self-motivation, you will build strong relationships with accounts to ensure Thurston Genetics and BASF are positioned as preferred suppliers. Having strong business acumen and demonstrating understanding of the agricultural markets will help drive strategic decisions for the business, developing and executing strong business plans for results. Having opportunities to take on special projects related to candidate skills and experience. Participating in building product testing plans including field days, observation plots and research yield trials across North America. Utilizing your corn product management and field evaluation experience, you will focus on identifying and characterizing high performing corn inbreds and hybrids for commercial release. Being willing and able to travel approximately 35% of the time. Considerable time will be spent traveling with other account managers to learn customer and sales territory needs. Significant travel required initially with the amount of travel decreasing as the candidate becomes more experienced and knowledgeable in the territory. If you... Have a B.S. Degree in a Crop Genetics, or agronomy-related field is very desirable, and at least 10 years of experience in such a field is required. Have at least 5 years of experience in building and maintaining strong customer relationships. Have prior experience in corn product management or in corn hybrid evaluation. Have prior experience with plot data analysis software, hybrid advancement presentations, sales presentations, and interaction with sales personnel and growers. Are excellent in verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to work well with others on a wide range of topics is mandatory. Have self-motivation and the ability to work independently. Have strong computer skills and experience with relational databases and have the ability to use multiple presentation methods to effectively communicate to broad customer base is required. Are willing and able to travel 35%. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Order Management (Executive)
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position The Executive, Order Management, will execute the customer order management processes with a consistent high level of service across ASEAN, ANZ, Taiwan for the Customer Service which is still with GB. Main Tasks Operations and Performance Execute the Customer Order Management processes set up in KL Hub with the different models & interfaces Processing of sales and purchase orders from various customers in a timely manner Service contact for assigned countries – monitor order status and provide update information to the countries and customers BL draft checking (for LC orders, 3rd party supplier orders and key customer orders) Manage Insurance Certificate (if necessary) Follow up BL receipt status based on ETD Collection of Original Bill of Lading and other documents from goods suppliers Provide full and accurate required documents to customers Upload / maintain documents in SAP for audit trail Support documents for internal and external audit purpose Register all and follow-up with all non-conformances in the NCM system to ensure a quick and efficient customer response Participate proactively in new workflow for on time & accurate documents Ensure that delivery capability and reliability of all orders Ensure that a minimum internal cycle time of order processing is achieved by improving the process wherever possible Verifying pricing with Marketing and execute & monitor all guidelines implemented Troubleshooting and problem solving Process debit and credit notes wherever applicable (BU) Requirements Education Bachelor degree or High Diploma preferably in Business or Supply Chain Management Working Experience 2-4 years relevant experience in supply chain management, including hands-on experience in order management and shipping document handling Technical & Professional Knowledge Supply Chain Management / process knowledge, SAP (SD module) experience, operational order management including shipping documentation, foreign documentary trade, good communication skills. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Manager - Human Resources
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Main responsibilities Site HR Leadership & Business Partnership Act as the primary HR partner for Bangpakong and Rayong site, translating business requirements into practical people solutions aligned with company policies and local law. Advise site management and business leaders on workforce planning, organization changes, employee relations, performance matters, staffing, development, and employee exits. Monitor headcount, employee movements, turnover, and organization data to support workforce planning, succession, recruitment, and employee development decisions. Review site HR practices, procedures, and work instructions, and recommend improvements based on business needs, market practices, and regulatory developments. Employee Relations, Labor Relations and Workforce Advisory & Compliance Serve as the primary HR focal point for employee relations and workforce advisory matters at the site. Provide guidance to leaders and employees on workplace practices, employee concerns, performance management, organizational changes, and policy application. Facilitate fair, consistent, and compliant resolution of people-related matters while balancing employee experience, business requirements, and legal considerations. Support workforce transitions, organizational effectiveness, and change initiatives through proactive consultation and risk management. Maintain appropriate documentation and governance standards to ensure regulatory compliance and organizational integrity. Collaborate with HR Management, Legal, and business leaders on complex workforce matters and continuous improvement initiatives. Manage day-to-day employee relations matters for the assigned site and legal entity scope. Plan and implement employee communication and engagement activities, including employee surveys, communication meetings, and site initiatives that promote constructive dialogue. Legal Entity Accountability & Authority Interaction Act as the HR owner for labor-related matters at site and legal entity level within the assigned scope. Engage with relevant local authorities on operational HR matters and coordinate with specialist functions for topics involving labor, social security, tax, immigration, permits, or other regulatory requirements. Support government inspections, audits, and regulatory inquiries through accurate documentation, clear ownership, and timely responses. Monitor and support compliance with applicable national, provincial, municipal, district, and industrial-estate requirements affecting employment and site operations. Build constructive working relationships with government offices, external parties, industrial-estate representatives, and neighboring organizations where required for site operations. Core Site HR Operations Coordinate site recruitment, onboarding, employee orientation, and workforce-provider or outsourcing activities. Coordinate training delivery and records and work with line managers to monitor on-the-job training plans and completion. Administer site performance-management activities, including communications, documentation, and cycle readiness. Coordinate employee welfare and benefits administration at site level and facilitate employee support in line with company processes. Maintain appropriate site HR records and provide accurate data and inputs to HR processes, audits, and management reporting. People Leadership & Collaboration Lead, coach, and develop assigned team members and service-provider resources, setting clear priorities and performance expectations. Collaborate across HR, Legal, EHS, site operations, finance, and business functions to deliver coordinated solutions. Handle sensitive and confidential matters with professionalism, sound judgment, appropriate escalation, and respect for all parties. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Law, Political Science, Business Administration, or a related field. At least 7 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in employee relations, labor relations, site HR, or an HR generalist role within the manufacturing or chemical industry. Strong knowledge of Thai labor law, employment regulations, and compliance requirements. Proven experience in employee relations, labor relations, and workforce advisory. Proven ability to handle sensitive workforce issues and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments with both blue-collar and white-collar employees. Experience supporting multiple sites or legal entities is an advantage. Relevant certifications or qualifications required by local regulations. Work location Bangpakong, Chonburi BASF has been present in Thailand for more than 50 years. The company offers a wide range of products and solutions to support almost all the key industries in the country, including Agricultural Solutions, Intermediates and Process Catalysts, Monomers, Petrochemicals, Coatings, Dispersions and Resins, Performance Chemicals, Care Chemicals, Nutrition and Health, and Performance Materials. BASF in Thailand was established in 1966 and maintains its head office in Bangkok. It operates three production sites in Samutprakarn, Chonburi and Rayong, an Automotive Coatings Technical Competence Center, and a Performance Materials Technical Development Center in Samutprakarn. In 2024, BASF posted sales of €531 million to customers in Thailand and had 623 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/th .

Attraktive Vergütung einschliesslich betrieblicher Sozialleistungen, sowie hervorragende Entwicklungschancen in einem internationalen Unternehmen. Beruf und Privatleben im Einklang - mit einer frühzeitigen Einsatzplanung, modernen Schichtplänen in der Produktion und grosszügigen Zeit- und Geldzuschlägen. Das Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Basel und weitere Standorte in Kaisten, Pfäffikon (Schwyz) und Schweizerhalle. M ain Tasks Identify required models, methods and tools for Service Design Structure, group and prioritize business requirements Ensure usage of new information and communication technology to design or re-design supply chain services Evaluate options, make comparative studies and recommend appropriate approaches/models Develop new and extend existing services based on requirements from the business and align with service catalog Test new services prior to implementation Calculate cost of new service Deliver basis for technical concept in cooperation with Functional and Business Experts Drive automation and digitalization of GB/S services e.g. paperless document flows Drive integration of new businesses into GB/S service structure e.g. resulting out of M&A Manipulate/mine data from database tables using different business intelligence methods Interface with Global Stakeholders and Business Analysts across time zones to gather requirements by asking right questions, analyzing data, and drawing a conclusion by making and validating appropriate assumptions. Conduct deep dive analyses of business problems and formulate conclusions and recommendations; determine optimized courses of action Produce written recommendations and insights for key stakeholders to help shape solution design. Design, develop and maintain scalable and reliable analytical tools, dashboards, and metrics that drive key decisions in supply chain operations Simplify and automate reporting, metrics and dashboards; build solutions to have maximum scale and self-serviceability by users. Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation. Minimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position Education: Bachelor's in Logistics and Supply Chain Management or equivalent, Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or Information Systems Working Experience: Minimum 3-5 years in SCM / Logistics area Technical & Professional Knowledge: Supply Chain Management / process knowledge, strong SAP (OTC & TM module) experience, Business Intelligence Tools like SCI , Import Export Operations ,RPA, foreign documentary trade, analytical thinking, leading with key performance indicators, good communication skills. Ability to work across North America and EMEA time zones The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. jobs.name: Internship Granulation and Film Technology (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are a leading global research organization with over 3000 employees working in the field of material and analytical science, chemical synthesis, process development, bioscience, catalysis and digitalization. With our creative and diverse teams as well as our cutting-edge research, we help to make our customers more successful and drive the sustainability transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT The “Coating & Film Processing” unit develops manufacturing processes and products for future-oriented technologies such as lithium-ion batteries, electrolysis, fuel cells and CO2 capture. A core element of our development work is the coating of functional materials. Based on laboratory experiments, formulations and process conditions are developed to maximize product performance and establish scalable manufacturing processes. During a five- to six-month internship starting in February/March 2027, you have the opportunity to get to know BASF and make your first professional contacts. In addition, you can apply the expertise you have acquired to practical challenges. Your work will focus on the following topics: You become part of a highly motivated team of experienced engineers and laboratory technicians. In the development of new formulations, you support our laboratory team and apply various mixing and dispersion methods. You plan and conduct coating trials using new materials. Based on your observations during the experiments, you derive the next experimental steps. In doing so, you independently apply analytical methods such as rheology and microscopy, including image analysis. To gain a deeper understanding of the experiments, you support our colleagues in the electrochemical characterization of the samples produced. If required, you use in-house simulation tools or develop your own evaluation routines. You present your results in team meetings and discuss them with colleagues from the relevant specialist departments. WHAT YOU OFFER currently enrolled in a degree program in process engineering or chemical engineering with a strong academic record practical experience in conducting laboratory experiments knowledge of heat and mass transfer, particle technology, formulation technology, or drying technology with very good grades good command of MS Office and, ideally, some prior knowledge of Python good communication skills and a strong team spirit WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information you will find here Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Corinna Granterath (Talent Acquisition), corinna.granterath@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-59302 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Senior Specialist Product Regulatory (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we are connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our team, we evaluate the human safety of our pesticidal and biocidal active ingredients and our plant protection products. We ensure that our products are sustainable, meet the highest safety standards and that use of our products pose no risk to humans. In your new role, you collaborate with your team on data-driven frameworks involving New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) and In Vitro to In Vivo Extrapolation (IVIVE), with a particular focus on integrating physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modelling approaches. Together with your colleagues, you explore and further develop new methods in the area of NAMs and IVIVE, contributing to evolving approaches in regulatory toxicology. In close collaboration with internal and external partners, you support both development of new active ingredients as well as dossier submissions and contribute your expertise to a constructive and collaborative exchange with relevant stakeholders and regulatory authorities. You have opportunities to broaden your expertise across a diverse range of toxicological assessment approaches, including read-across and (Q)SAR, Next Generation Risk Assessment, benchmark dose modelling, OMICS approaches, AOP frameworks and ontology-based knowledge networks. As part of an interdisciplinary team of regulatory and experimental toxicologists, you contribute to shared learning and scientific exchange while receiving comprehensive onboarding and training in regulatory toxicology for pesticides. WHAT YOU OFFER a university degree in a relevant field such as life sciences, regulatory science or a comparable scientific discipline practical experience in PBPK modelling and an interest in applying and further developing this expertise collaboratively in a regulatory environment Basic knowledge of toxicology an interest in NAMs, IVIVE and evolving approaches to toxicological assessment, combined with curiosity and a willingness to continue learning excellent German and English language skills, a collaborative and supportive mindset, empathetic and clear communication skills, and enthusiasm for sharing knowledge and developing together with others WHAT WE OFFER A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business). Learning opportunities for your professional and personal development. Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company. We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health. We offer sustainable mobility benefits - a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly. HOW TO REACH US Romy Marie Brinsa (Talent Acquisition), romy.brinsa@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-56730 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH is a reliable partner to the agricultural sector, offering innovative and sustainable solutions tailored to a wide range of crop systems. With the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof, near the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you’ll find an attractive environment for both your professional life and your leisure time in the Rhine‑Neckar metropolitan region. jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Our Communications team works closely with the business to ensure our strategy is understood and our story is heard. As Team Lead Internal and External Communications, you give the Surventis brand its voice. You lead a team of communications specialists while staying hands-on yourself: from developing communication strategies and key messages to advising leaders and managing critical communications. You report directly to the Head of Global Communications. You lead and develop our global specialists for Media Relations and Internal & Change Communications, owning the team's performance and development. You develop and implement communication strategies, plans and content that support our business priorities. You guide and support the Surface Treatment Communications Lead in shaping and rolling out communications globally. You create, review and publish high-quality internal and external communications across a range of channels. You define media relations strategies, identify relevant stories and actively shape our engagement with the media. You drive internal and change communications and act as a trusted sparring partner for leaders. You serve as spokesperson in crisis situations and coordinate One Voice statements. WHAT YOU OFFER degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism or a related field several years of experience in internal and external communications in an international corporate environment, including change, transformation and restructuring communications ability to translate corporate strategy into compelling narratives, clear messages and effective communication measures strong advisory skills and proven experience working with leaders and stakeholders at all levels experience leading international teams and managing complex, cross-functional projects strong strategic thinking, political awareness and intercultural competence structured, pragmatic way of working and the ability to set priorities and drive change in a dynamic environment excellent German and English skills WHAT WE OFFER Maternity leave cover – fixed-term for one year, option to extend. Part-time possible under specific circumstances. At Surventis, diversity is more than a commitment—it is part of who we are. We are proud of our employee networks, including WomenInCoatings and CultiConnect. We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development. The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback. At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio “Freizeit” with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant “Auszeit” including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center “LackiKids” and a vacation program “LackiKids on Tour”. You are also welcome to book an online meeting . ABOUT US Learn more about our company here . Diversity is our greatest strength! jobs.name: HR & ESG Reporting & Analytics Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: Build Your Career on Our Standalone Transformation ). In your new position, you design, monitor, and manage HR reporting and analytics, covering internal and external HR‑related disclosures, including workforce, people metrics, and HR‑relevant ESG and risk topics. Together with your colleagues, you closely align with the HR Financial & ESG Reporting interfaces to ensure consistent, accurate, and decision‑relevant HR data and narratives. Right in the heart of things, you further develop HR reporting frameworks, KPIs, and analytics solutions, enabling transparency across the employee lifecycle and supporting strategic workforce decisions. Furthermore, you coordinate HR reporting interfaces across HR, Finance, ESG, and Risk, ensuring data quality, clear ownership, and harmonized end‑to‑end HR reporting processes. Last but not least, you actively drive the evolution of HR analytics towards a data‑driven and insight‑oriented HR function, supporting standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. As we are building up the organization now, you can actively contribute and shape the overall HR IT landscape of the future. WHAT YOU OFFER successfully completed master’s degree in human resources, business administration, economics, data analytics, or a comparable field several years of professional experience in HR reporting, HR analytics, HR controlling, or a comparable corporate HR environment strong knowledge of HR data models, workforce metrics, analytics concepts, and HR‑relevant ESG and regulatory requirements very good English language skills as well as proficiency in SAP (e.g. SAP HCM / SuccessFactors) and common MS Office applications strong analytical thinking, a structured and precise working style, and the ability to collaborate confidently across HR and cross‑functional stakeholder groups proven digital and AI focus with the ability to leverage modern technologies and data-driven approaches to enhance efficiency and quality passion for our industry and a love for farming to contribute to the biggest job on earth WHAT WE OFFER Responsibility within a leading international agricultural company. Working in a fully international global environment with continuous exchange with colleagues across Agricultural Solutions worldwide. Opportunity to contribute to a robust and future-oriented governance environment. A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing are always our top priority. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. HOW TO REACH US Isabel Maisack (isabel.maisack@basf.com) will be happy to answer your questions for this position. ABOUT US Find out more about BASF Agricultural Solutions here. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Business Controller - Agricultural Solutions
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About BASF At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees contribute to the BASF Group’s success worldwide. Our business comprises the Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, Surface Technologies, Nutrition & Care and Agricultural Solutions segments. We want to contribute to a better world with enhanced quality of life for everyone. That is why we have firmly anchored the three pillars of sustainability – the economy, environment and society – into our corporate purpose, our strategy, our targets and our operations. They are the core of what we do, a driver for growth and an element of our risk management. We believe that chemistry has a critical role to play in achieving greater sustainability. We are determined to move forward in this respect. Our employees are at the forefront of this transformation, across every role and function in the organization. Join us today in shaping a sustainable future together. About The Role At BASF we are entering an exciting time within our Agriculture business with an existing portfolio of world class products and a pipeline of new products that will bring significant benefits to the agriculture industry. As our Business Controller, you will be a trusted finance business partner to BASF's Agricultural Solutions business, providing insights that drive performance, profitability and strategic decision-making. You'll work closely with business leaders to analyse financial results, challenge assumptions, improve processes and help steer the business towards its operational and financial goals. How You Will Do It Partner with business leaders to provide financial insights, performance analysis and recommendations that support commercial decision-making. Monitor sales, costs and profitability against operational plans, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. Lead budgeting, forecasting and financial planning activities to support business performance and resource allocation. Deliver meaningful reporting and analysis to local and regional stakeholders, translating data into actionable business insights. Drive process improvement initiatives and strengthen financial controls to enhance operational efficiency and business performance. Partner with cross-functional teams and support audit activities to ensure strong governance, compliance and continuous improvement. What We Look For To be successful in this role, you'll bring strong commercial acumen, analytical capability and a genuine passion for partnering with the business to influence outcomes. You'll enjoy turning complex financial information into meaningful insights and thrive in a collaborative environment where your recommendations can shape business decisions. You will: Hold tertiary qualifications in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, with CPA is preferred. Have at least 5 years' experience in financial analysis business partnering or controlling business partnering roles. Demonstrate strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data and provide practical business recommendations. Have experience influencing stakeholders and partnering with business leaders to drive performance and decision-making. Bring a continuous improvement mindset with exposure to budgeting, forecasting, process improvement or business transformation initiatives. Be an effective communicator who can simplify complex financial information for diverse audiences. What We Can Offer You At BASF you get more than just compensation. Our total offer includes a wide range of elements to suit each one of our global team. By creating chemistry with us, you can look forward to: A diverse and inclusive environment, with an open and fair internal promotion process A competitive parental leave policy, regardless of gender, and a supportive return to work plan Give back to your community with our corporate volunteering scheme 4 weeks annual leave, with the offer to purchase additional leave throughout the year Opportunities to apply for international assignments – the perks of a global business! Connect to Create Chemistry If you’d like to join a diverse global business and create chemistry for a sustainable future, we want to hear from you! Click ‘apply’ below. Offers of employment will be subject to background checks including references, police checks and may include a pre-employment medical. Beware, Job Applicants. At BASF, we are committed to providing a safe and transparent recruitment process. Please be aware of job scams and fraudulent job postings. Only apply through the official BASF Career website to ensure your application is received by us. Be cautious of unsolicited job offers or communications that do not come from official BASF email addresses. Verify any doubtful communications through our HR department. Never provide personal information or make payment as part of the application process. #LI-Jobs

jobs.name: Senior Advanced Process Control Expert
jobs.description: Now hiring! Senior Advanced Process Control Expert Freeport, TX (Hybrid) We are looking for a Senior Advanced Process Control Expert to join our Global Engineering team in Freeport, TX. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF, we create chemistry through the power of connected minds. As the world’s leading chemical company, we help our customers in nearly every industry meet the current and future needs of society through science and innovation. The Global Engineering team leverages our technical know-how and expertise to deliver solutions that enable safe, sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive production BASF Corporation is seeking a Senior Advanced Process Control Expert at our Freeport, TX location responsible for building and leading the Advanced Process Control Team (APC) for North America. This position is part of the global E&M Strategy to establish and build and maintain knowledge in the area of Advanced Process Control in the North American region. Up to 50% domestic and international travel required to various BASF sites to support projects and initiatives. Local telecommuting permitted two days per week. No Direct Reports. As a Senior Advanced Process Control Expert, you create chemistry by... Developing and leading new APC projects for additional applications. Maintaining and revamping existing APC applications as required to ensure optimal utilization. Developing standardized work processes for APC project development, management and maintenance as well as for the required support infrastructure including application server installation, networks, and firewalls. Identifying, championing, implementing and maintaining Process Automation Systems, specializing in the Advanced Process Control Technology area. Leading optimization efforts to identify and correct base layer control strategies, making recommendations for and designing Advanced Regulatory Control opportunities. Leading studies to determine the economic feasibility of APC implementations. Leading the evaluation of new technology as it applies to Advanced and Basic Process Control, especially with regard to Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions. Representing BASF NA in global initiatives related to APC and emerging technologies. Leading the development and improvement of APC solutions by representing BASF’s interests to vendors providing Advanced Control solutions (APC, AI for Operations, Soft Sensors, etc.). Providing startup support for the Automation System of BASF plants worldwide (controller tuning, basic control concept optimization, troubleshooting). If you have... A Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a closely related Engineering field. Fifteen (15) years of related experience. Ten (10) years of experience which must include: Lead Advanced process control projects in the Chemicals, Refining or Petrochemicals industry including all aspects of project justification, development, implementation and ongoing support; Core chemistries experience including Acetylene, Acrylic Acid, Butadiene, Ethylene Oxide, MDI, TDI, and Steam Cracker technology for ethylene and propylene; Common process industry unit operations such as reactors, distillation towers, heat exchangers along with common techniques to control and optimize; Aspen DMCPlus & DMC3 from all aspects including data collection, model building and deployment, and maintenance; Control concepts including Control Theory, Basic and Advanced Regulatory Control, and Advanced Process Control; Loop Tuning for standard, Cascade, ratio, and split range control loop strategies with dynamic rates; Implementing AI based solutions suitable for Process Control; Control system technology including common instrumentation used in continuous plant processes; Control strategy development in standard DCS solutions: ABB 800xa, Emerson DeltaV, Honeywell Experion, and Schneider Foxboro; Design and implement control and advanced control improvements including Control Room Operators & Supervisors, Engineers, Plant Management and Vendors; Advanced Process Control, basic and advanced regulatory control and control theory including loop tuning and complex control strategies; Basic Process Control Systems (BPCS) base functionality with respect to regulatory control capabilities and implementation. Ensure that timelines and quality meet the agreed service levels and targets. To coordinate, train and support the Analyst in performing Accounts Payable's payment process related function. Assist and support Payment Manager in daily task, implementation of project initiatives as when required. Main Tasks To support Request fulfilment activities in planning and administration . jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About The Role The Production Executive is a key member of technical team, required for production activities in Multi Product Plant. This role will be responsible for specialized activities, if assigned, such as managing the production activities of Precious Metal Catalysts which requires high levels of monitoring in terms of value, quality, consistency, and security. This position will lead the shift activities in their respective shifts and ensure documentation of the plant processes and activities as per BASF standards. This position will also coach and develop the production officers, operators and workmen for smooth running of the plant operations and adhere to EHS standards. This position provides technical support and process definition needed to execute in shift activities. This position plays an important role in driving standardization across shifts, optimizes fixed and variable unit costs, improve quality, and works closely with other support groups to ensure that proper priorities are placed on items of backlog. This role will be responsible for the coordination, communication, accountability and expectation of day to day operations while working with the production team to ensure consistency in process and procedure. How Will You Do It Assist and support production officers, operators and workmen to achieve the production targets as per the plan along with Plant Manager and his deputy. Review and monitor the production batches as per the log sheets in their respective shifts; monitors key process control parameters and addressing when there is deviation. Ensure and engage in consistent communication, shift turnover, proactive action, mindset, and behavior are occurring over each shift. Coaching/mentoring of plant employees in goals, tasks, operational discipline, and organization discipline Expected to be on-call and respond to any after hour event that impacts production or EHS Work with supply chain to produce/receipt of raw materials as required per demand. (rationalize the production plan to make sure that it is aligned with all business needs) Review and validate production data and production reports as needed to support the production accounting process. Monitors key process control parameters addressing when there is deviation. Ensure shifts understand, adhere to, and key process parameters. Audit the process on all shifts and document and report in specified logbooks and records. Provide technical and leadership support to the Plant Manager and his deputy to implement plant trials as needed. Manage the production activities of Precious Metal Catalysts which requires high levels of monitoring in terms of value, quality, consistency, and security, if assigned. Understand necessary maintenance, back log, and PMs (including vessel inspections), ensuring they are getting accomplished and worked through safety, efficiently and within the due dates (maintenance KPIs). Acts as coach and provides direct execution for Operational Excellence and LEAN manufacturing tools Ensure proper definition and documentation of operating files, SOPs, emergency SOPs, records, reporting procedures, and technical files as well as the annual recertification of their applicability Support, lead, and role model EHS activities and EHS processes as Safety Representative. In case of an emergency, take the role as defined in the Onsite Emergency response Plan and act accordingly. Perform observations on safe work practices, compliance to basic rules, and set high standards for housekeeping What We Look For Education:  B.E. / B.Sc. (Tech.) / B.Sc. / M.Sc./ Diploma in Chemical Engineering Working Experience: Experience in a manufacturing environment, is preferred. Demonstrated plant experience in continuous improvement, problem solving, high volume part manufacturing, ergonomics, lean principles, control plans & process control, and mechanical aptitude required. Good knowledge on Safety standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 Ability to work effectively with operators, management, and possess strong influence skills working with indirect resource groups Work Location : Manglore

jobs.name: R&D Operations Country Manager
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Agriculture is all about balance. The balance that is crucial to everyone’s existence – also for our Agricultural Solutions division. We connect innovative thinking with practical action to find the right balance for success – for farmers, agriculture and future generations. With seeds and traits, crop protection and digital solutions, we help farmers produce food more efficiently, protect the land and meet the needs of society. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Lead the planning and execution of field trials across Italy, ensuring delivery within the allocated budget and agreed timelines. Ensure field trial results are validated and accurately reported within established deadlines. Oversee R&D testing facilities and their official certifications, ensuring compliance with Good Experimental Practice (GEP) and applicable national regulations. Drive continuous improvement in field R&D Operations by optimizing technical and digital tools and supporting the ongoing training and development of the field biologist team. Act as the key contact for national authorities on R&D activities and facilities, including GEP and Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) matters. WHAT YOU OFFER A university degree in agriculture, natural sciences, or a related field. Several years of experience in crop protection, preferably in product research and development. Solid knowledge of the technical and regulatory requirements for developing crop protection products. Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing teams. A proven track record of working in international and multicultural environments. Good working knowledge of MS Office applications and project management tools. Excellent knowledge of English, fluency in Italian, both written and spoken. WHAT WE OFFER Employment under the Italian Chemical Industry National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL), with A1 classification. An indicative gross annual salary of €80,000–€90,000, depending on your skills and relevant experience. Performance-based variable bonus. Company participation bonus. Corporate welfare program. Company car for both business and personal use. HOW TO REACH US Do you have questions about the selection process or the position? You can contact: talent-acquisition-italy@basf.com Initial information about the application process is available here: http://on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing are always our top priority. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. jobs.name: Agronomy Specialist, Agricultural Solutions
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a key member of the UK Field Sales Team, you will drive growth within strategic accounts by building trusted relationships with commercial and technical stakeholders, delivering tailored agronomic expertise, and executing account-specific initiatives. Working closely with Key Account Managers, Commercial Managers, and Business Development teams, you will help strengthen BASF's technical leadership, unlock new opportunities, and support the achievement of sales and customer objectives. Build and maintain strong relationships with commercial and technical stakeholders across strategic accounts through to the agronomists at ground level, acting as the primary agronomic contact and supporting account growth, customer engagement, and KPI delivery through effective CRM management. Execute account-specific technical activities, field trials, and demonstration programmes in collaboration with Key Account Managers, Commercial Managers, and Business Development Managers, ensuring alignment with business priorities and sales objectives. Contribute to account planning by providing technical and commercial expertise, identifying growth opportunities, and developing tailored approaches that address customer agronomic challenges and strengthen BASF's position as a trusted partner. Generate and share market, customer, and account insights through regular stakeholder engagement, using CRM data to support marketing campaigns, demand creation activities, market intelligence, and long-term business planning. Stay current with agronomic trends, product developments, competitor activity, and market dynamics, translating this knowledge into relevant technical guidance and value-added support for key accounts. Deliver high-quality technical communications and resolve customer queries and complaints promptly, ensuring compliance with BASF policies while maintaining exceptional customer experience and trust. WHAT YOU OFFER BSc in Agronomy or a related discipline, with a BASIS qualification. jobs.name: Global Category Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. About the Role The Global Category Manager for Merchandise Goods owns the global category strategy and value-delivery agenda while being based in Asia. The role defines category direction, leads strategic supplier relationships, governs complex negotiations, establishes portfolio and sourcing standards, and ensures a competitive, resilient, and sustainable supplier base across regions. The GCM is accountable for translating business priorities into a multi-year category roadmap and for aligning execution through Global Category Buyers, General Buyers, Procurement Technical Managers, Procurement Operations, Product Management, Supply Chain, Commercial teams, Finance, and other business stakeholders. Role boundary . This is a Global Category Manager role, not a General Buyer or operational purchasing role. The GCM owns category strategy, global supplier governance, negotiation direction, and value delivery. Regional and local execution is assigned through the integrated category team and relevant procurement operations. How You Will Do It Global Category Strategy Ownership Develop, maintain, and periodically refresh the global Merchandise Goods category strategy and multi-year roadmap. Define category objectives, sourcing models, supplier architecture, regional execution priorities, value levers, risks, and implementation milestones. Integrate business requirements, market intelligence, supplier capabilities, demand patterns, product economics, and regional insights into category decisions. Provide clear direction, priorities, targets, and decision principles to Global Category Buyers and other execution teams. Spend, Demand, and Portfolio Governance Establish a reliable global fact base by supplier, product family, SKU, country, region, channel, and business. Lead demand and portfolio governance, including assortment rationalization, specification simplification, SKU reduction, approved product lists, and prevention of uncontrolled product proliferation. Define governance for delegated spend, local sourcing, supplier onboarding, material creation, catalogs, approvals, and exceptions. Partner with Product Management, Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain to balance customer requirements, commercial value, complexity, and sourcing feasibility. Strategic Supplier and Market Management Define supplier segmentation and the target supplier panel for the category. Build and manage executive relationships with strategic suppliers, distributors, and private-label partners. Establish supplier power maps, development plans, performance routines, and clearly defined improvement milestones. Monitor supplier competitiveness, financial health, innovation capability, capacity, service, quality, sustainability, and supply risk. Develop global and regional market intelligence covering cost drivers, industry trends, alternative suppliers, emerging technologies, and channel developments. Negotiation Governance and Leadership Define the annual negotiation agenda, targets, governance, team composition, and escalation approach for strategic and complex negotiations. Lead or personally participate in major global negotiations and support GCBs in regional negotiations. Ensure negotiation strategies use robust fact bases, demand bundling, cost models, competitive alternatives, and appropriate commercial tactics. Govern sourcing recommendations and supplier awards within delegated authority, ensuring consistency with the category strategy. Promote negotiation excellence through preparation standards, Negotiation Board governance, coaching, lessons learned, and best-practice sharing. Private-Label, White-Label, and Alternative Sourcing Define the global strategy for private-label and white-label products, including portfolio priorities and supplier-selection criteria. Identify best-cost-country and alternative-sourcing opportunities while considering quality, lead time, supply-chain reliability, regulatory requirements, and implementation feasibility. Coordinate with Product Management and technical stakeholders on product specifications, qualification pathways, branding, packaging, and commercialization requirements. Drive scalable sourcing models that reduce fragmentation and improve margins, competitiveness, and supply resilience. Value Creation and Financial Performance Own the category value-creation pipeline and deliver validated savings, cost avoidance, cash, working-capital, margin, and process-efficiency contributions. Prioritize initiatives across supplier consolidation, demand bundling, assortment optimization, specification harmonization, best-cost sourcing, private-label expansion, and commercial-term improvement. Validate financial benefits with Finance or Controlling and maintain transparent implementation and benefit tracking. Communicate category developments, forecasts, opportunities, risks, and business implications to procurement and business leadership. Risk Management, Continuity, Sustainability, and Compliance Maintain a global risk view covering supplier concentration, capacity, geography, logistics, quality, continuity, compliance, and market exposure. Define mitigation plans, alternative sources, contingency arrangements, and escalation protocols for critical products and suppliers. Ensure category strategies and supplier decisions comply with procurement policies, approval requirements, contractual standards, legal obligations, sustainability expectations, and applicable product requirements. Drive supplier and product opportunities supporting responsible sourcing, reduced waste, improved packaging, lower environmental impact, and circular solutions where commercially and technically viable. Functional Leadership and Cross-Regional Execution Provide functional direction to GCBs and other assigned category resources without creating an additional disciplinary reporting line. Translate the global strategy into clear regional mandates, objectives, negotiation targets, work packages, and implementation priorities. Coach category-team members in strategy, supplier management, negotiation, analytics, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery. Establish a regular category operating rhythm covering strategy reviews, supplier reviews, initiative tracking, risk management, and decisions. Resolve cross-regional conflicts, facilitate decisions, and ensure continuity during handovers or organizational changes. Stakeholder and Business Partnership Act as the global procurement counterpart for business and functional leaders on Merchandise Goods. Partner with Product Management, Commercial teams, Supply Chain, Procurement Operations, Finance, Quality, Legal, Sustainability, and technical stakeholders. Align category decisions with business strategy, customer needs, margin objectives, product portfolio priorities, and operational requirements. Present fact-based recommendations to leadership and secure timely decisions, resources, and sponsorship for implementation. What We Look For Degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Chemistry, Materials, or a related discipline; an advanced qualification is advantageous. Substantial experience in procurement, category management, strategic sourcing, supplier relationship management, and complex commercial negotiations. Demonstrated experience developing category strategies and leading execution in a global or multi-regional matrix environment. Experience with merchandise goods, consumables, equipment, distribution, private-label products, or similarly fragmented portfolios is advantageous. Strong analytical capability and demonstrated ability to translate spend, market, margin, and supplier data into strategic decisions and implemented results. Working knowledge of procurement governance, contracting, supplier risk, sustainability, SAP processes, Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant analytics or reporting tools. Excellent written and spoken English; additional Asian or regional languages are an advantage. Strategic thinking and the ability to convert business priorities into category direction and executable plans. Commercial judgment, negotiation leadership, and executive supplier engagement. Functional leadership, coaching, influence without authority, and cross-cultural collaboration. Analytical problem-solving, decision quality, and disciplined prioritization. Change leadership, resilience, conflict resolution, and effective escalation. Integrity, transparency, accountability, and consistent role-model behavior. What We Offer A global category leadership role based in Asia, with direct exposure to business leadership, strategic suppliers, regional procurement teams, and transformation initiatives. The opportunity to shape an evolving merchandise category and establish scalable global governance, sourcing, supplier, and portfolio-management practices. A collaborative international environment focused on strategy, negotiation excellence, professional growth, and measurable business value. Continuous development through global procurement communities, market analytics, supplier innovation, category strategy, and digitalization.
