jobs.name: Assistant Manager, Sales, Engineering Plastics
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced sales professional to drive sustainable and profitable growth for our Engineering Plastics business in Taiwan. In this role, you will develop strategic customer accounts, expand opportunities in the Consumer Electronics and Medical segments, manage distributor partnerships, and work closely with local and regional teams to deliver value-added solutions. This is an individual contributor role with opportunities to demonstrate leadership and take on broader responsibilities as the business evolves. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities Develop and execute strategic account plans for key customers to achieve sales, profitability, growth, and market-share objectives. Build strong relationships across customer organizations and the value chain, understand customer needs, and create new business opportunities through value-added solutions. Manage distributor partnerships through joint business planning, performance reviews, opportunity pipeline development, and channel strategies. Own the commercial pipeline, including opportunity development, project prioritization, sales forecasting, annual planning, CRM management, and performance tracking. Lead the review, negotiation, and execution of commercial agreements with customers and distributors, balancing growth, profitability, compliance, and risk. Drive pricing and profitability through value-based selling, strategic pricing initiatives, and optimization of the product portfolio. Strengthen customer engagement through regular business reviews, seminars, technical workshops, and timely support on technical, quality, application, and commercial topics. Monitor market trends, customer demand, competitive activity, and industry developments to identify opportunities and manage risks. Collaborate with local and regional cross-functional teams to deliver customer solutions and support successful project commercialization. Partner with credit control to review customer credit needs, make appropriate recommendations, and support timely payment collection. Ensure business activities comply with applicable policies, quality standards, competition law, and audit requirements. T e c hn i c a l & Professional Knowledge Bachelor's degree in a related field, preferably Engineering or Materials Science. 5+ years of sales, business development, or key account management experience. Experience in engineering plastics or related materials preferred. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation, and customer management skills. Excellent communication skills and fluent English.

jobs.name: Teamlead Functional Controlling (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: Build Your Career on Our Standalone Transformation ). In your new position, you lead our global team of functional controllers and provide direction for functional controlling across the organization. You forecast, control, report, manage and budget overall SG&A costs across all departments in the CEO and CFO areas, including IT & Digital, Global Marketing, Strategy, Procurement, HR and Legal. Together with the leadership teams of our functional departments, you actively steer costs and ensure adherence to agreed budgets. You harmonize cost accounting and cost steering across all functions and work closely with Business Controlling to ensure effective cost controlling across all countries. There’s always room for improvement! Last but not least, you establish a continuous improvement culture to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of functional controlling. WHAT YOU OFFER university degree in business administration, finance, accounting, controlling or a comparable field several years of professional experience in controlling or finance, ideally in an international environment, combined with leadership experience strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, cost and performance accounting as well as cost steering excellent English skills as well as confident use of standard MS Office applications; SAP knowledge is an advantage strong leadership, communication as well as project management skills combined with an analytical mindset, a collaborative approach and a drive for continuous improvement WHAT WE OFFER Responsibility within a leading international agricultural company. Working in a fully international global environment with continuous exchange with colleagues across Agricultural Solutions worldwide. Opportunity to contribute to a robust and future-oriented governance environment. A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing are always our top priority. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. HOW TO REACH US Isabel Maisack (isabel.maisack@basf.com) will be happy to answer your questions for this position. ABOUT US Find out more about BASF Agricultural Solutions here. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Working Student HR Services (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation, and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Are you ready to gain hands-on experience and play an active role in our Belgium Payroll team? As a Working Student, you'll support the team with payroll and post-payroll activities for our Belgian employees, gaining exposure to key areas such as social security, taxes, time management, and compensation & benefits. Your responsibilities will include: Support the day-to-day HR administration across the employee life cycle, from onboarding to offboarding, for our employees in Belgium. Assist with monthly payroll and post-payroll activities, working closely with the Payroll team. Support activities related to time management, social security, taxes, and compensation & benefits. Maintain accurate employee data in SAP and other HR and payroll systems. Assist with HR reporting and data preparation. Contribute to HR and payroll projects and continuous process improvements. Support the maintenance and improvement of internal HR and payroll documentation and knowledge resources. WHAT YOU OFFER Currently enrolled in a university degree or master’s degree in business administration, Human Resources, Finance, or a comparable field, with an interest in HR and Payroll. Fluency in English, Dutch is a plus. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and confidence in learning new digital tools and systems. Well-organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with a careful approach to working with HR and payroll data. A collaborative and open-minded mindset, combined with the ability to work independently. Previous experience with SAP or other HR systems is a plus but not required. WHAT WE OFFER Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany. A modern, sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, a rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration. Onboarding to help you settle in quickly, ensuring you are part of the BASF team from day one. Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs. HOW TO REACH US You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. jobs.name: Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US Digital Hub Madrid attracts, grows, and develops passionate people who will meaningfully impact the digital future of BASF. Come join us and be a part of our digitalization journey. Global Digital Services (GDS) supports BASF's digital transformation by providing innovative, global, and high-quality digital products and services through a strong agile culture. As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading medium to large-scale digital initiatives across multiple product teams, functions, and geographic regions. You will ensure successful project execution from initiation through delivery while balancing business objectives, quality, scope, timeline, budget, and stakeholder expectations. You will work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Solution Designers, Development Teams, Business Partners, and senior stakeholders to drive strategic transformation initiatives and ensure sustainable business value creation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Lead and coordinate complex digital transformation projects across BASF's global organization. Drive project planning, execution, monitoring, risk management, and successful delivery. Facilitate alignment between business requirements, technical solutions, and strategic objectives. Establish and maintain project governance structures and reporting mechanisms. Manage stakeholder communication across all organizational levels. Coordinate cross-functional and international project teams in agile and hybrid delivery environments. Identify and proactively mitigate project risks, dependencies, and obstacles. Manage project scope, timeline, budget, and resource planning. Support organizational change management and business adoption activities. Prepare management presentations, steering committee documents, and executive status reports. Monitor project performance through relevant KPIs and ensure transparency of project progress. Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodologies and best practices within Global Digital Services. REQUIREMENTS OF THE POSITION Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a comparable qualification. In addition to the respective native language, (very) good command of written and spoken English. Several years of professional experience in project management within digital, IT, or business transformation environments. Proven track record in leading international and cross-functional projects. Experience in agile, hybrid, and traditional project delivery methods. Experience working with global stakeholder organizations. Strong expertise in project management methodologies and governance frameworks. Solid understanding of digital products, enterprise applications, and digital transformation initiatives. Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Experience in change management and organizational transformation initiatives is considered an advantage. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable certifications are a plus. Solid experience with SAP P2P processes, including hands-on knowledge of SAP MM and FI modules. Strong knowledge of end-to-end procurement processes, compliance, and operational best practices. S/4HANA implementation and roll-out experience. The role may provide project leadership to international and cross-functional project teams. WHAT WE OFFER A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided HOW TO REACH US Do you have any questions about the application process or the position? Please reach out to Felipe Bianco (felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com)

ART’s operating and financial system maintains data flows for both ART and bodyshopmall.com. Understanding the connection and separation between ART and BSM is essential. A high level of autonomy is expected in carrying out the core responsibilities. The position requires a self-starter mindset. Prepare, review, and post journal entries in accordance with company accounting policies and US GAAP requirements. Identify and reclassify transactions related to other business units to ensure proper accounting treatment. Support internal and external audit requirements, including preparation of schedules and supporting documentation. Support leadership with financial insights and reporting required for business decision-making. Accounts Receivable & Accounts Payable Oversight Oversee and coordinate Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes. Ensure transactions are processed accurately and in compliance with company policies and procedures. Monitor outstanding balances and support issue resolution when required. Inventory & Operational Accounting Support Support inventory reconciliation activities. Assist with physical inventory processes and related financial reporting requirements. Omdat we vertrouwen op innovatie in onze oplossingen, op duurzaamheid in onze acties en op onze verbondenheid in ons denken. En in jou. Word onderdeel van onze succesformule en ontwikkel de toekomst met ons - in een wereldwijd en divers team, dat staat voor gelijke kansen, ongeacht leeftijd, achtergrond, geslacht, seksuele identiteit, handicap, geloof of overtuigingen. In Heerenveen (ca. 230 medewerkers) ontwikkelen en produceren wij watergedragen polymeerproducten en formulation additives voor de Verpakkings- en Coatingindustrie. Met een multidisciplinair team (Marketing, Technical Service, Application & Syntheses Lab, Engineering, Supply Chain en Production) werken wij aan marktvragen van de Printing & Packaging industry. WAT JE KUNT VERWACHTEN Als Allround Maintenance Technician E&I bij BASF Heerenveen voer je preventieve en correctieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit en los je E&I gerelateerde problemen en storingen op. Dit zijn je belangrijkste taken: Je lost storingen op het gebied van E&I zelfstandig en tijdig op. Voor en na iedere werkzaamheid zorg je voor een heldere en duidelijke werkoverdracht tussen productie en directe collega's. Je zorgt ervoor dat benodigd materiaal op tijd opgestuurd wordt voor reparaties, je zorgt ervoor dat materiaal op tijd weer terug is en volgt eventuele bestellingen op in het systeem. Je voert E&I werkzaamheden te allen tijden binnen de gestelde BASF-specificaties en voorschriften efficiënt uit. Je documenteert de onderhoudswerkzaamheden in ons Maintenance Management Informatie Systeem (Ultimo). Je denkt en werkt mee aan het optimaliseren van de werkprocessen binnen de onderhoudsafdeling. Je leeft de regels op het gebied van milieu, veiligheid en gezondheid na. Tevens ben je verantwoordelijk voor het begeleiden van de uitvoering van werkzaamheden door contractoren en zorg je voor de handhaving en uitvoering van het veiligheidsbeleid. Als Allround Maintenance Technician E&I rapporteer je direct aan de Team Leader Maintenance. Wat wij verwachten Voor deze functie zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe collega die resultaat boekt door doorzettingsvermogen te tonen en effectief te communiceren. Bij het nemen van beslissingen houd je rekening met feedback en bied je spontaan hulp en ondersteuning wanneer dat nodig is. Daarnaast verwachten wij: Een Electrotechniek opleiding op MBO4-niveau (MTS) aangevuld met elektro-technische werkervaring (bij voorkeur binnen de industrie). Kennis van NEN-normen en assets in de proces industrie en de daarvoor gevolgde opleidingen of bereidwilligheid tot volgen van trainingen. Proactief meedenken aan het optimaliseren van de werkprocessen binnen de onderhoudsafdeling. Het naleven van regels op het gebied van milieu, veiligheid en gezondheid. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor het begeleiden van de uitvoering van werkzaamheden door contractoren en het zorgen voor de handhaving en uitvoering van het veiligheidsbeleid. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Bereidheid om in de toekomst consignatiediensten te draaien. WAT WIJ BIEDEN Uitdagende opdrachten met veel verantwoordelijkheid en een "on the job" training binnen een vakkundig en gemotiveerd team. Daarnaast ontvang je: Een baan in dagdienst met een passend maandsalaris. Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd. 8,3% vakantietoeslag + vaste 13e maand + bonus. 25 vakantiedagen + 6 adv dagen. Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationale organisatie. Een uitdagende baan bij één van de beste werkgevers van Nederland. HOE JE ONS KUNT BEREIKEN Solliciteren kan direct via de sollicitatie button. Voor vragen over de functie en/of het recruitmentproces kun je contact opnemen met ons recruitment team via: talent-acquisition-bene@basf.com. Diversiteit is onze grootste kracht! Maak deel uit van onze succesformule en ontwikkel samen met ons de toekomst -- in een wereldwijd team dat inclusiviteit en gelijke kansen omarmt, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, afkomst, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of geloof. Jusqu’au 1er juillet, notre activité faisait partie de BASF. Dans le cadre de cette transition, toutes les offres d’emploi ainsi que le processus de candidature sont encore hébergés sur la plateforme BASF et présentés sous l’identité visuelle de BASF. Merci de ne pas vous laisser dérouter par cette situation : tous les postes proposés sont des opportunités au sein de Surventis, et votre candidature nous sera directement transmise. Chez Surventis, nous allons au-delà des apparences dans tout ce que nous entreprenons. Nous plaçons nos clients au cœur de nos décisions, anticipons leurs besoins et développons des solutions qui créent une véritable valeur ajoutée ainsi que des partenariats durables. Nous nous inspirons mutuellement à voir plus loin, à prendre pleinement la responsabilité de notre travail et à repousser sans cesse les limites du possible. Si vous venez avec toute votre authenticité, osez remettre en question les évidences et souhaitez évoluer au sein d’une équipe qui met réellement ses valeurs en pratique, alors vous êtes au bon endroit. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES En tant qu’Assistant(e) Commercial(e), vous assurez un soutien administratif à la force de vente et contribuez au bon suivi des dossiers commerciaux et contractuels. À ce titre, vos responsabilités incluront notamment : La préparation, rédaction, enregistrement et suivi des contrats, ainsi que le contrôle de leur conformité et des éléments contractuels liés aux nouveaux clients ; La préparation et le suivi des devis et factures, dans le respect des engagements clients ; La gestion et la mise à jour de la base de données clients ; Le support administratif auprès de la force de vente pour les différentes demandes liées à l’activité commerciale ; La gestion des commandes sur les différentes plateformes, notamment les fournitures administratives et commandes EHS ; La gestion documentaire, incluant le courrier, le classement et l’archivage des dossiers. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes titulaire d’un Bac +2 minimum, idéalement dans le domaine administratif, commercial ou équivalent, et justifiez d’une expérience d’au moins 5 ans sur un poste similaire ; Vous êtes rigoureux(se), polyvalent(e), autonome et fiable ; Vous disposez de bonnes capacités de communication écrite, ainsi que d’un excellent sens de la planification et de l’organisation ; Vous savez gérer vos priorités et mener plusieurs missions administratives en parallèle afin d’accompagner efficacement l’équipe commerciale. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Une opportunité stimulante et passionnante dans une équipe engagée et compétente ; Un environnement propice à l'innovation, au partage d'idée et au bien-être ; Un univers qui vous permet de développer votre potentiel dans un groupe international. CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE? Pour postuler, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Cela ne vous prendra que quelques minutes. Emilie, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et contactera les candidats présélectionnés. Nous vous souhaitons bonne chance et sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature ! Seules les candidatures soumises via l’offre publiée sur notre site carrière seront étudiées. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? SURVENTIS Services SAS est spécialisée dans la commercialisation et la distribution de systèmes de peintures éco-efficaces destinées aux professionnels de la carrosserie. Grace à la réputation des marques centenaires et premium R-M et Glasurit, homologuées par les plus grands acteurs du secteur automobile, et à notre force d'innovation en matière de produits et services, nous sommes le leader français de la distribution peinture automobile en France. L'entreprise est présente sur tout le territoire national à travers plusieurs entrepôts et son siège social basé à Compans (77). La diversité est notre plus grande force! Rejoignez notre formule gagnante et venez développer le futur avec nous - au sein d'une équipe internationale qui encourage l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances indépendamment du genre, de l'âge, de l'origine, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou des croyances. jobs.name: France Financial Controlling Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
WELCOME If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As the Financial Controlling Manager for France, you will manage the financial performances and support teams in monitoring their results and achieving their objectives. Your responsibilities will include: Analysing business profitability, financial results, and margins; Defining and monitoring budgets, forecasts, and financial controlling processes; Analysing variances between forecasts and actual results, and proposing corrective actions; Designing and monitoring dashboards and decision-support tools; Assessing and monitoring financial risks and commitments; Supporting and advising teams through your expertise. You will also manage a team of two employees, supporting their development as well as their administrative and operational management. WHAT YOU OFFER You hold a Master’s degree, ideally in finance, controlling, accounting, or a related field, and have at least 7 years of experience in a similar role; You are fluent in French and have a good command of English, both written and spoken; You demonstrate strong analytical and decision-making skills, together with an excellent sense of responsibility and organisation; Your ability to work collaboratively and support a range of stakeholders enables you to contribute effectively to performance management and financial decision-making. WHAT WE OFFER A stimulating and exciting opportunity within a committed and highly skilled team; An environment that encourages innovation, idea-sharing, and well-being; An international environment where you can develop your full potential. ABOUT US SURVENTIS Services SAS specialises in the marketing and distribution of eco-efficient paint systems for automotive body repair professionals. Thanks to the reputation of the century-old premium brands R-M and Glasurit, approved by the leading players in the automotive industry, as well as our innovative products and services, we are the leading automotive paint distributor in France. The company operates throughout the country through several warehouses, with its head office located in Compans, Seine-et-Marne (77). Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. jobs.name: Intern, Customs Operation
jobs.description: What You Can Expect? A comprehensive exposure to customs operations within the supply chain, specifically for the chemistry industry. You will gain practical understanding of customs operations related Projects such as free trade agreements data analysis, Authorised Economic Operator (AEO), Customs broker management, duty drawback for legal entities in APAC. Main Tasks Learn the basics of customs operations and their critical role in the supply chain. Study foundational customs knowledge and terminology relevant to international Trade Perform data analysis for customs broker audit Project using digital skills. Coordinate various activities for AEO project for BASF legal entity in ASEANA region. Explore the effects of duties and taxes on international business transactions in the chemistry sector based on Free trade agreement. Gain knowledge about trade facilities, such as free trade agreements, Authorised Economic Operator (AEO), duty drawbacks etc. that benefit global commerce. Participate in improvement initiatives discussion to work on improvement plans and timelines like Power BI dashboard, audit workflow etc. Actively participate in Projects to apply gained knowledge and reinforce learning. Requirements Committed to a full-time 4 – 6 month internship Students Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration or any related discipline Fluent in english (written and spoken) Proficient in Microsoft Product (MS 365 - Word, Power Point, Excel) Knowledge of Power BI, advance excel would be added advantage A good team player with high level of maturity and independence BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989 and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF's Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. BASF posted sales to customers in Malaysia of approximately €340 million in 2024 and had 2,579 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com/my

jobs.name: Intern, IT Supply Chain
jobs.description: Main Tasks: SHIPSTA & Freight Rate Database Maintain, clean, validate and upload freight rate data in SHIPSTA. Check data accuracy and resolve data or system related issues. Support continuous improvement and automation opportunities within freight-rate management processes. Process Improvement & Problem Solving Work with logistics buyers across countries to understand and map as-is process, and improve existing processes. Identify process gaps, investigate issues, and support problem resolution with business and IT teams. Data Analysis & Reporting Use Advance Excel to analyze, validate, and analyze large freight rate datasets. Use SQL to query data and identify inconsistencies and perform data validation. Create analytical reports and dashboards to monitor data quality and performance Documentation Document business rules, user requirements, and system processes Job Requirements: Bachelor degree in Computer Science or  other disciplines such as Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good understanding of business processes and system/data flows. Advance in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookups, data transformation and handling large datasets. SQL : Basic to intermediate knowledge query skills Basic understanding of SAP and ERP concepts.

jobs.name: Product Development Specialist- Agricultural Solutions Turkey
jobs.description: Location: İzmir Grade: 4 WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT At BASF Agricultural Solutions, we develop solutions that help farmers produce more efficiently and sustainably. The role involves planning and managing field trials, analyzing product performance, interpreting technical data, and collaborating closely with R&D, marketing, regulatory, and sales teams to support product development and commercialization. Your responsibilities Lead and execute all R&D trials , with a primary focus on regulatory registration studies, while establishing product comparison and market support trials as required. Ensure that trials targeting diseases, pests, and weeds are conducted in suitable locations with adequate infestation, population, or pressure levels, in full compliance with approved protocols and methodologies. Manage BASF trial sites by planning all trial-related activities, including seasonal and daily labor requirements, and ensuring the proper operation and maintenance of agricultural equipment and trial tools. Actively communicate unexpected observations, developments, and trial results to relevant stakeholders. Monitor and supervise trials conducted by external contractors and research organizations within the assigned area of responsibility. Actively contribute to resistance monitoring and resistance management programs at the country level. Facilitate knowledge sharing within the organization, organize trial visits, and present trial results through relevant technical and business platforms. Serve as the technical expert and product owner for assigned products, supporting marketing activities such as the development of Unique Selling Propositions (USPs) and technical positioning strategies. WHAT WE OFFER Work with international teams in a global company Broad responsibility in product development projects Professional development and training opportunities WHAT WE EXPECT Degree in Agricultural Engineering, preferably from the Departments of Plant Protection, Field Crops, or Horticulture. Advanced academic qualifications (MSc or PhD) in one of these disciplines and is preferred. At least 5 years of experience in the design, management, and execution of Crop Protection product trials. Possession of a Fungicide Trial Authorization Certificate on Fungicide Trials is highly preferred. Advanced English Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills Ability to work across functions Excellent work organization and flexibility Use to work in complex situations and keeping the priorities clear Drive Innovation Collaborate for Business Success Demonstrate an Entrepreneurial Spirit

jobs.name: Overseas Delivery Services (Senior Executive)
jobs.description: About the Global Supply Chain Nerve Centre (SCNC) The Global Supply Chain Nerve Centre is a global capability team that connects supply chain expertise, performance intelligence, advanced analytics and digital solutions. SCNC works across Asia Pacific (APAC), Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA), North America and South America to strengthen operational decision-making, create consistent performance approaches and develop scalable solutions that improve service, reliability, efficiency and business value, for Overseas Delivery Services. Why Join This Role? •    Build a global career through direct exposure to operations and stakeholders across four regions. •    Drive Performance Solutions that influence service, reliability, efficiency and customer outcomes. •    Work at the intersection of supply chain operations, analytics, digitalization and automation. •    Join a growing SCNC capability and help shape the standards, solutions and best practices used across the global network. Objectives of the Position Lead sustainable operational improvement across the global supply chain network through end-to-end ownership and active management of designated Performance Solutions. Working closely with regional operational teams, the role leads performance monitoring, challenges current practices, facilitates root-cause evaluation, identifies improvement opportunities and drives corrective actions. The position bridges regional operations and the Supply Chain Nerve Centre Senior Executives, ensuring performance management is operationally relevant, action-oriented and consistently applied across APAC, EMEA, North America and South America. What We Mean by Performance Solutions Performance Solutions are structured business capabilities that combine performance measures, dashboards, review methodologies, analytical insights, operational standards and improvement workflows. They help teams measure operational performance, identify gaps & risks, evaluate root causes, prioritize corrective actions, track improvement effectiveness, alternative pathways and make consistent data-driven decisions across the global supply chain network. M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities (25%) Performance Solution Ownership •    Maintain end-to-end understanding of operational processes, measures and improvement opportunities associated with Performance Solutions. •    Drive regular solution reviews to ensure they remain relevant, usable and aligned with business priorities. •    Challenge and continuously improve existing Performance Solutions to maximize measurable business value. (25%) Operational Engagement & Performance Reviews •    Lead the performance contribution to regional operational and service reviews, facilitating fact-based discussions and clear decisions. •    Develop a strong understanding of regional operating models, priorities and constraints. •    Analyse digital performance signals, trends and recurring issues, and connect performance findings to operational realities. •    Build credibility as a trusted partner and key contact for assigned Performance Solutions. (20%) Root-Cause Evaluation & Corrective Actions •    Facilitate structured root-cause discussions with stakeholders. •    Drive development of practical corrective and preventive action plans with clear ownership and milestones. •    Lead action tracking to completion, validate outcomes and escalate risks or delays when required. (20%) Continuous Improvement & Best Practices •    Lead identification of opportunities to improve service, reliability, efficiency and operational effectiveness. •    Challenge existing practices constructively and recommend improvements. •    Capture successful regional practices and lessons learned and promote their adoption across the global network. •    Drive harmonization of performance management approaches across regions. (10%) Stakeholder Management & SCNC Collaboration •    Provide objective, fact-based recommendations and challenge stakeholders constructively to support leadership decisions. •    Influence stakeholders without authority to drive action and accountability. •    Lead collaboration with other ODS Senior Executives, support peer reviews and contribute operational knowledge to new Performance Solutions. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Economics or a related field. Data Analytics is an advantage. 3-5 years of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics, transportation, operations or operational excellence. Practical experience participating in operational reviews, KPI reporting, performance management, root-cause evaluation and corrective-action follow-up. Strong knowledge of supply chain operations and operational excellence, transportation and logistics, performance management, continuous improvement and process analysis. Working knowledge of SAP and Power BI, with exposure to digital supply chain, analytics and automation tools. Basic-to-intermediate SQL capability. Ability to interpret performance reports, structure problems and translate findings into operational actions. Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and influence without authority. BASF has been present in Malaysia since 1989, and operates a manufacturing plant in Pasir Gudang, Johor. BASF’s Regional Service Hub in Kuala Lumpur provides functional support services to BASF companies in 20 markets across Asia Pacific. BASF also provides infrastructure and utilities support services to its joint ventures BASF PETRONAS Chemicals and Toray BASF Resins at an integrated Verbund site situated in the Gebeng Industrial Zone, Pahang. jobs.name: Technical Agronomist
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Do you want to contribute to better agricultural solutions by delivering reliable trial results and supporting a collaborative team? This role offers the chance to make a real impact on how we develop and refine our products. In this role you will be responsible for c ompleting an allocation of R&D agronomic trials according to protocol, GEP and EPPO requirements . You will collaborate closely with a local grower, on farm, to establish a trials base to store equipment and act as a centre of operation within your region. You will establish links with local farmers, grower bodies and agronomists within region to enable access to other suitable trial sites. You will promote high standards of Health & Safety within in your region.  You will ensure regional bases, facilities and processes comply with BASF EH&S requirements and you will implement ongoing improvements as required. You will provide supervision and day to day support of temporary Assistant Technical Agronomists. You will be responsible for specific activities to aid effective the running of the R&D Operations function: including Calibration, vehicle maintenance, fire alarm checks, undergraduate temporary recruitment. You will build strong relationships with the BASF Sales team to support market development activities in your region. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree in Agriculture, Biological Sciences, or equivalent, in addition to 3+ years of hands-on trials experience. NPTC Certificate of Competence in the use of Pesticides (PA1 and PA6). Strong organisation, planning, and communication skills. BASIS certification with ongoing CPD to maintain professional registration. Solid IT proficiency, including Microsoft Word and ARM trial management software. Please note: A valid UK driver’s licence is essential for this position. WHAT WE OFFER At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. We offer a total package which includes: Attractive salary Bonus Defined contribution pension scheme 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays Company share scheme Private healthcare Life insurance On the job training and development opportunities Company Car We believe that diversity and inclusion make the difference. Only when people with diverse backgrounds come together, contribute their various experiences and attitudes, and look at challenges from different perspectives, will creative innovations and ground-breaking solutions be created. We celebrate diversity and we actively promote an inclusive work environment. In the UK we have an active Diversity & Inclusion Strategy Action Group and work closely with external partner Inclusive Employers. We are an equal opportunities employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard or reference to age, gender, race, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status and other protected characteristics. For more information please visit: https://www.basf.com/gb/en/careers/why-join-basf/basf-locally.html Location: Home-based (ideally located in Gloucestershire, Warwickshire or Northamptonshire) with frequent national travel. jobs.name: Seed Plant Manager
jobs.description: Now hiring! Seed Plant Manager Idaho Falls, ID. (On Site) We are looking for a Plant Manager to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Idaho Falls, ID. In this role, you will ensure safe, efficient and high-quality seed processing; lead and develop plant employees; coordinate production, maintenance and inventory activities; and partner across functions to achieve operating, quality, stewardship and business objectives. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Seed Plant Manager, you create chemistry by... Leading day-to-day canola seed-plant operations across conditioning, treating, blending and packaging to achieve production targets safely, efficiently and in accordance with stewardship, quality and Standard Operating Procedure requirements. Overseeing seed inventory and quality monitoring, including purity, cracks, seed color and treatments, while supporting quality assurance, audits, sustainability programs and accurate inventory valuation. Directing equipment troubleshooting, repairs and preventive maintenance, and managing plant upgrades, CapEx and OpEx projects, vendor relationships, contractors and external service providers. Leading and developing plant employees by setting schedules and goals, aligning training, managing performance and role progression, and building high-performing teams in a fast-paced seasonal environment. Promoting a positive safety and site-security culture by supporting EHS programs, inspections and training, ensuring compliance with applicable safety and quality systems, and halting operations when conditions threaten people, equipment or compliance. Managing operational and financial performance, including budgets, payroll, inventory and production planning, while developing and implementing process improvements and quality standards aligned with regional and global policies. Collaborating with seed agronomists, processing planners, Supply Chain, Logistics, Quality Assurance, Finance, Regulatory, Legal, Stewardship, Sales, Marketing and R&D, and maintaining productive relationships with growers, inspectors, equipment suppliers and regulatory agencies. If you... Hold a bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Seed Science, Plant Science, Agricultural Economics, Supply Chain or a related field; a master’s degree or MBA is preferred. In lieu of a degree, bring at least 15 years of relevant seed-production or agricultural-manufacturing experience. Bring at least 10 years of experience in seed processing or agricultural manufacturing, including at least two years of leadership experience. Demonstrate a strong understanding of seed conditioning, treating, blending, quality systems, cost control, budgeting and operational planning. Apply working knowledge of OSHA, safety and quality systems; experience with Responsible Care is preferred. Utilize SAP, Microsoft Office and inventory-management systems to support operational planning, reporting and decision-making. Lead with strong organizational, problem-solving and people-management skills, including the ability to manage employee role progression and enable high-performing teams. Manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced, seasonal manufacturing environment; Lean, Six Sigma or Operational Excellence certification is preferred. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Transport Management (Executive) 1 1
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. O bjectives of the Position: Responsible for ensuring transport management for inbound or outbound (as assigned) are as per stipulated guidelines, procedures and requirements Support process improvement, knowledge and risk management as per overseas delivery services M ain Areas of Responsibilities and Key Activities: Outbound Processing transports for packaged deliveries with a focus on sea freight to our customers in compliance with the required customer deadlines at cost-optimal conditions Managing the loading planning & consolidation/deconsolidation activities at the associated companies and external locations or sites, including monitoring of loading times. Legal, internal, safety-relevant and packaging-related regulations must be considered, and customer-specific service levels and other quality requirements must be met Monitoring of all necessary or relevant shipment milestones and ensuring prompt follow ups, updates and correspondences to all relevant stakeholders. Monitoring and assessing the quality of our service providers, transport reliability and feedback rates and tracking shipments & vessels Preparation of all necessary transport documents, control of the proper filing of documents, in particular freight accounting bases, and examination of additional costs incurred Inbound Processing transport for packaged deliveries with a focus on sea freight to our sites within EMEA Managing the loading planning & consolidation/deconsolidation activities at the associated companies and external locations or sites, including monitoring of loading times. Legal, internal, safety-relevant and packaging-related regulations must be considered, and site-specific service levels and other quality requirements must be met Monitoring of all necessary or relevant shipment milestones and ensuring prompt follow ups, updates and correspondences to all relevant stakeholders. Monitoring and assessing the quality of our service providers, transport reliability and feedback rates, and tracking shipments & vessels Preparation and monitoring of all necessary transport documents (e.g verifying draft documents), control of the proper filing of documents, in particular freight accounting bases, and examination of additional costs incurred Job Requirements: Edu c a t i o n: Fresh graduates from programs such as Transport Management, IT, Business Studies, or other relevant fields who are interested in exploring a career in supply chain. W o r k in g Experience: 1-2 years in logistics Career starters or first professional experience in transport management T e c hn i c al & Professional Knowledge: Experience in supply chain operations, distribution and warehousing processes Knowledge of the processes of filling and shipping units Experience in handling of MS Office products and, ideally, SAP R/3 quality management and transport management Structured, independent and process-oriented working width High degree of customer orientation High proficiency in spoken and written English The BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur (BASF Asia-Pacific Service Centre Sdn Bhd) is strategically located in the capital city of Malaysia. Since its inception in 2005, the hub has expanded from 130 employees to over 1,300 employees currently and is expected to keep growing. As an ISO 9001:2005 certified organization, the Service Hub Kuala Lumpur is committed to delivering high quality expertise and services in finance, people, supply chain, EHSQ (environment, health, safety, quality), product safety and digital. We take pride in providing our business services to BASF companies and affiliates across 20 markets in the Asia Pacific region and beyond. Moreover, we offer our services in 8 different languages to cater to the diverse needs of our stakeholders. Our focus on competency and technology-driven solutions allows us to consistently deliver exceptional services, thereby contributing to the success of our businesses. BASF also has two other regional hubs located in Berlin, Germany, and Montevideo, Uruguay, which cover the European and American regions. BASF Service Hub Kuala Lumpur was recognized with nine prestigious awards in 2024, reflecting its commitment to creating a vibrant, inclusive, and empowering workplace. These awards include winning the title of Operational Excellence in HR at the GBS Asia Awards 2024, multiple accolades at the Life at Work Awards 2024, where the hub was recognized as First Runner-up for Workplace Excellence (International Organization) and CEO Champion (International Organization), as well as Second Runner-up for Best International Organization. The hub also won the title for Excellence in Learning Tech Advancement System and a Certificate of Excellence in Talent Management and Leadership at the HRD Awards 2024. Furthermore, the hub secured a Bronze Award for Excellence in Digital Transformation at the HR Excellence Awards 2024 and received a Bronze Award for Human Resources Impact and an Honorary Award for Creative Talent Management Impact at the SSON Impact Awards Asia 2024. At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 112,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of €65.3 billion in 2024. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at www.basf.com.

jobs.name: SAP PP/DS DevOps Engineer  (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. We value diversity and believe that varied perspectives enhance our team's effectiveness. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure equal opportunity for all candidates. RESPOSIBILITIES Work in a self-organized DevOps team with an initial development focus (SAP S/4 PP/DS). Analyze production planning and detailed scheduling requirements with planners and business users and translate them into user stories and IT specifications. Design, configure, and implement SAP S/4 PP/DS solutions. Support the migration of legacy SAP APO PP/DS capabilities to SAP S/4 PP/DS. Guide developers on enhancements, user exits, interfaces, and user interface requirements and validate the resulting solutions. Create functional and integration test scenarios, support user acceptance testing, and coordinate defect resolution. Prepare functional documentation and training materials, coach end users, and support cutover, go-live, and knowledge transfer. Support the integration of SAP S/4 PP/DS with advanced planning platforms such as OMP. QUALIFICATIONS A bachelor's or master's degree in supply chain management, information technology, industrial engineering, business informatics, computer science, or a related field. Experience in SAP consulting, application development, or DevOps, with a focus on production planning and detailed scheduling. 3-5 years of hands-on experience with SAP S/4 PP/DS and SAP APO PP/DS. Strong functional knowledge of production planning, detailed scheduling, capacity planning, heuristics, scheduling strategies. Experience translating business requirements into functional specifications. Experience with implementation projects, global template rollouts, cutover, go-live, and functional, integration, and user acceptance testing. Knowledge of end-to-end supply chain planning and manufacturing processes and experience working across business, development, and solution architecture teams. Excellent communication skills in English. Strong functional and analytical mindset combined with sufficient technical understanding to guide development and validate solutions. Ability to bridge planners, business stakeholders, developers, and solution architects and to facilitate requirements workshops. Ownership of functional work items from requirements through implementation, testing, and deployment. Open-minded, collaborative, and able to work independently in a globally distributed multicultural team. NICE TO HAVE Experience migrating SAP APO PP/DS functionality to SAP S/4 PP/DS. Knowledge of advanced planning requirements such as dynamic setup, tank scheduling, shared capacities, and production heuristics. Experience integrating SAP PP/DS with OMP or another advanced planning platform. Experience with Azure DevOps, SAP Solution Manager, Jira, Confluence, and agile delivery methodologies such as Scrum. BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, on sustainable actions, and on connected thinking and on you. Become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. HOW TO REACH US If you're interested in the position or know someone who might be and need support on how to take next steps, please send an email to felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com

Nous créons de la chimie pour un avenir durable et nous cherchons des talents capables d'apporter des réponses aux questions de demain. Intégrez la division Agri Production de BASF en France, où nous produisons des solutions agricoles innovantes et durables pour optimiser la productivité des cultures. Êtes-vous prêt pour une nouvelle étape dans votre carrière et contribuer au futur d’une chimie toujours plus durable au sein de nos équipes ? VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Au sein de l’équipe Opérational Excellence, en charge des procédés de dépollution innovants, vous contribuez au suivi et à l’évaluation de pilotes, depuis la préparation des essais jusqu’à l’analyse des performances obtenues. À ce titre, vous : Mettez à jour et créez les cartographies nécessaires au suivi des pilotes, ainsi que les plans analytiques associés ; Concevez et gerez les prélèvements nécessaires à la réalisation des bilans opérationnels ; Collaborez avec le laboratoire pour définir et mettre en œuvre les plans analytiques adaptés aux essais menés ; Analysez et interprétez les résultats issus des prélèvements et des analyses afin d’évaluer les performances des procédés étudiés ; Réalisez les bilans matières permettant de caractériser et de comprendre le fonctionnement des pilotes ; Préparez et réalisez des expériences physiques en laboratoire en lien avec les problématiques rencontrées sur le terrain ; Exploitez et structurez les données recueillies afin de contribuer à l'amélioration et à l'optimisation des procédés de dépollution. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes étudiant en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou en Master 2, avec une spécialisation en génie chimique, génie des procédés ou chimie avec une option procédés, et recherchez un stage de 6 mois dés février 2027 ; Vous aimez le terrain et êtes à l’aise avec les manipulations et expérimentations en laboratoire ; Vous maîtrisez le Pack Office et disposez de connaissances en programmation et en traitement de données ; Vous maîtrisez l’anglais dans un contexte professionnel et technique ; Vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre capacité d’analyse et votre intérêt pour les procédés et les technologies environnementales. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Un package attractif (rémunération supérieure au minimum légal) ; Un accompagnement personnalisé favorisant le développement de vos compétences métier grâce à des tuteurs formés ; Un environnement stimulant et responsabilisant ; CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Cela ne vous prendra que quelques minutes. Nicolas, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et enverra un courriel aux candidats présélectionnés pour les inviter à un entretien vidéo MS Teams de 30 minutes. Nous vous souhaitons bonne chance et sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature ! Seules les candidatures soumises via l’offre publiée sur notre site carrière seront étudiées. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. Il vous reste des questions ? Vous pouvez nous contacter ici. QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? BASF Agri-Production Saint-Aubin lès Elbeuf, site clé de la chimie fine en Haute-Normandie, se consacre à la fabrication de matières actives destinées à la protection des cultures. Avec plus de 240 collaborateurs, ce site SEVESO joue un rôle stratégique en fournissant des usines de formulation BASF ainsi que d'autres entreprises industrielles réparties sur les cinq continents, répondant ainsi aux exigences d'un secteur globalisé et exigeant. La diversité est notre plus grande force ! Rejoignez notre formule gagnante et venez développer le futur avec nous - au sein d'une équipe internationale qui encourage l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances indépendemment du genre, de l'âge, de l'origine, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou des croyances. Postuler Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Saint-Aubin-les-Elbeuf, FRA BASF Agri-Production S.A.S. Nous créons de la chimie pour un avenir durable et nous cherchons des talents capables d'apporter des réponses aux questions de demain. Intégrez la division Agri Production de BASF en France, où nous produisons des solutions agricoles innovantes et durables pour optimiser la productivité des cultures. Êtes-vous prêt pour une nouvelle étape dans votre carrière et contribuer au futur d’une chimie toujours plus durable au sein de nos équipes ? VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Au sein de l’équipe Opérational Excellence, vous contribuez à l’amélioration de la performance énergétique et thermique des installations industrielles, dans le respect des exigences de sécurité. À ce titre, vous : Analysez les besoins et les dysfonctionnements des installations afin d’identifier et de proposer des solutions d’amélioration énergétique et opérationnelle ; Réalisez des bilans énergétiques et thermiques et participez à la création et à la mise à jour de schémas de procédés PFD et P&ID ; Analysez les réseaux de distribution d’utilités, les consommations énergétiques et les paramètres de conduite des procédés ; Dimensionnez et modélisez des installations, puis définissez les spécifications techniques nécessaires à leur optimisation ; Réalisez des essais et des calculs de modélisation afin d’évaluer la faisabilité et la performance des solutions envisagées ; Participez à l’analyse des risques et à la sécurisation des procédés chimiques, en intégrant les exigences de sécurité dans les solutions proposées ; Évaluez les gains financiers et les impacts sur les temps de cycle, puis contribuez à l’élaboration des cahiers des charges en tenant compte des besoins, délais, budgets et ressources disponibles. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes étudiant en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou en Master 2, avec une spécialisation en Génie Énergétique, Génie Chimique, Génie des Procédés, Performance Énergétique ou équivalent, et recherchez un stage de 6 mois dés février 2027 ; Vous avez une réelle appétence pour le terrain et l’environnement industriel et la résolution de problématiques techniques ; Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour la modélisation, l’analyse de données et l’optimisation des procédés ; Vous maîtrisez le Pack Office et disposez de connaissances en programmation et en traitement de données ; Vous maîtrisez l’anglais et êtes à l’aise pour évoluer dans un environnement professionnel international. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Un package attractif (rémunération supérieure au minimum légal) ; Un accompagnement personnalisé favorisant le développement de vos compétences métier grâce à des tuteurs formés ; Un environnement stimulant et responsabilisant ; CE POSTE VOUS INTERESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidatures. Cela ne vous prendra que quelques minutes. Nicolas, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et enverra un courriel aux candidats présélectionnés pour les inviter à un entretien vidéo MS Teams de 30 minutes. Nous vous souhaitons bonne chance et sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature ! Seules les candidatures soumises via l’offre publiée sur notre site carrière seront étudiées. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. Il vous reste des questions ? Vous pouvez nous contacter ici. QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? BASF Agri-Production Saint-Aubin lès Elbeuf, site clé de la chimie fine en Haute-Normandie, se consacre à la fabrication de matières actives destinées à la protection des cultures. Avec plus de 240 collaborateurs, ce site SEVESO joue un rôle stratégique en fournissant des usines de formulation BASF ainsi que d'autres entreprises industrielles réparties sur les cinq continents, répondant ainsi aux exigences d'un secteur globalisé et exigeant. La diversité est notre plus grande force ! Rejoignez notre formule gagnante et venez développer le futur avec nous - au sein d'une équipe internationale qui encourage l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances indépendemment du genre, de l'âge, de l'origine, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou des croyances. Postuler Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Saint-Aubin-les-Elbeuf, FRA BASF Agri-Production S.A.S. 主要顧客に対するアカウント戦略を策定・実行し、顧客組織内の主要な関係者とのネットワークおよび関係性を強化します。 顧客の事業戦略、ニーズ、課題を深く理解し、顧客とBASF双方に価値を生み出す最適なソリューションを主体的に提案します。 顧客内でのネットワークを拡大し、長期的なパートナーシップ強化につながる新たな機会を創出します。 製品・技術・ビジネス提案に関する効果的な顧客プレゼンテーションを企画・実施します。 新規ビジネス開発 既存製品ポートフォリオおよび新製品を活用し、パーソナルケア市場における新たなビジネス機会を発掘・創出します。 顧客ニーズとBASFの製品・技術・ソリューションを結び付け、将来の売上につながるプロジェクトを構築・管理します。 テクニカルサービス、マーケティング、プロダクトマネジメント、研究開発（R&D）などの社内関係者と緊密に連携し、新規プロジェクトの創出から事業化までを推進します。 市場機会を主体的に捉え、収益性と持続性のあるビジネスへとつなげます。 セールス・ビジネスマネジメント 売上、収益性、イノベーション目標の達成に向けて、営業戦略およびアクションプランを策定・実行します。 販売代理店とビジネス目標、優先事項、顧客開拓活動について連携し、長期的かつ相互に有益なパートナーシップを構築します。 効果的な市場開拓および製品プロモーションを支援するため、必要な製品・技術・マーケティング情報を提供します。 販売代理店の活動および成果を定期的に確認し、継続的な改善につながるフィードバックを行います。 市場・競合情報の収集・分析 市場動向、顧客動向、製品・技術の用途および競合他社の動向を継続的に収集・分析します。 競合製品について、市場でのポジショニング、製品性能、価格、製品ポートフォリオなどの観点からベンチマークを行います。 市場・競合情報を具体的なインサイトへと変換し、営業戦略、ポートフォリオ戦略および事業戦略の策定に活用します。 日本国内およびリージョン・グローバルの関係者に、市場情報やインサイトを積極的に共有します。 国内プロダクトマネジメント 担当製品ポートフォリオについて、日本市場におけるローカルプロダクトマネジメントの役割を担います。 リージョンのプロダクトマネージャー（PM）と緊密に連携し、リージョン・グローバルでの優先事項、供給・在庫状況、原材料価格動向、利益率、価格ガイダンス・Rock Bottom Priceなどの重要情報を把握します。 国内の製品ポートフォリオ戦略、供給戦略、および価格戦略の策定・実行をサポートし、事業の収益性向上に貢献します。 リージョン・グローバルとの連携 日本市場の知見、顧客ニーズ、新規ビジネス機会、および成果をリージョン・グローバルチームへ積極的に共有し、日本と海外チームをつなぐ役割を担います。 Sales、Marketing、Technical Service、R&D、Product Management、SCMなど、国内外の関係部門とのネットワークを構築・活用し、顧客への価値提供を最大化します。 部門横断的な協働を推進し、担当ビジネスに対するオーナーシップと責任感を持って成果創出に取り組みます。 応募資格 学歴 大学卒以上 化学、生物学、ビジネス、マーケティング、または関連分野を専攻された方歓迎 経験 jobs.name: Assistant manager, Sales,EM,Tokyo
jobs.description: Sales, Assistant Manager Location: Tokyo Position Purpose The Sales Assistant Manager is responsible for driving profitable and sustainable business growth in the personal care market in Japan by developing new business opportunities, strengthening strategic customer and distributor relationships, and managing assigned product portfolios. The role works closely with Technical Service, Marketing, Product Management, R&D, Supply Chain Management, and regional/global teams to deliver tailored solutions to customer needs and achieve sales and innovation targets.　Foster collaboration and accountability within the team by demonstrating winning behaviors. Main Responsibilities Customer & Key Account Management Develop and execute account strategies for key customers and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders across customer organizations. Build a deep understanding of customer strategies, needs, and challenges, and proactively develop tailored solutions that create value for both customers and BASF. Expand customer networks and identify opportunities to strengthen long-term partnerships. Prepare and deliver effective product and business presentations to customers. New Business Development Identify, initiate, and develop new business opportunities within the personal care market, covering both existing portfolios and new product launches. Build and manage a strong sales pipeline & Projects by connecting customer needs with BASF's products, technologies, and solutions. Collaborate closely with Technical Service, Marketing, Product Management, R&D, and other cross-functional teams to develop new projects and accelerate commercialization. Proactively identify market opportunities and convert them into profitable and sustainable business. Sales & Business Management Develop and execute sales strategies and action plans to achieve sales, profitability, and innovation targets. Manage key sales activities, including sales forecasting, inventory management, customer visit reports, Project management, and NCM. Monitor sales performance and business development activities and take appropriate actions to address gaps and opportunities. Support commercial negotiations, including pricing and business conditions, to secure profitable business and sustainable growth. Distributor Management Build strong and mutually beneficial partnerships with distributors by aligning on business targets, priorities, and customer development activities. Provide distributors with appropriate product, technical, and marketing information to support effective market development and product promotion. Regularly review distributor performance and activities and provide constructive feedback to support continuous improvement. Market & Competitive Intelligence Monitor and analyze market trends, customer developments, technology applications, and competitive activities. Benchmark competitors in areas such as market positioning, product performance, pricing, and product portfolios. Translate market intelligence into actionable insights to support sales, portfolio, and business strategy. Proactively share relevant market insights with stakeholders in Japan and regional/global teams. Local Product Management Act as the local product management representative for assigned portfolios in Japan. Maintain close communication with regional Product Managers to understand regional and global priorities, supply and inventory conditions, raw material price trends, margin development, and pricing guidance, including rock-bottom pricing. Support the development and execution of local portfolio, supply, and pricing strategies to improve business performance and profitability. Regional & Global Collaboration Act as a key interface between the Japan organization and regional/global teams by communicating local market insights, customer needs, business opportunities, and achievements. Build and leverage a strong internal network across Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, R&D, Product Management, and Supply Chain Management to deliver maximum value to customers. Contribute to cross-functional collaboration and demonstrate ownership and accountability in driving business results. Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor's degree or above. A degree in Chemistry, Biology, Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. Professional Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, business development, or marketing, preferably in the personal care, cosmetics, specialty chemicals, or related industries. Experience in the Japanese personal care/cosmetics market is strongly preferred. Skills & Competencies Proven ability to identify and develop new business opportunities and build a sustainable Sales Projects. Strong customer relationship management, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Strategic and analytical thinking with strong problem-solving capabilities. Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on achieving sales and profitability targets. Ability to work effectively across functions and within an international organization. Strong sense of ownership and ability to proactively drive projects and business opportunities. Languages Business-level Japanese and English communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with customers in Japan as well as regional and global stakeholders.
