jobs.name: Specialist Digitalization for End User Support Supplier Management (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ABOUT US At BASF Digital Hub Madrid we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from individuals with disabilities. We value diversity and believe that varied perspectives enhance our team's effectiveness. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure equal opportunity for all candidates. The Supplier Manager IT Support is responsible for managing external service providers delivering IT support services. The role ensures that supplier performance, contractual obligations, financial targets, and service delivery outcomes are aligned with business requirements and strategic objectives. Working closely with Procurement, Finance, IT Operations, Service Management teams, and suppliers, the Supplier Manager drives operational excellence, cost transparency, compliance, and continuous service improvement across the IT support landscape. RESPOSIBILITIES 1. Service Delivery Management Manage the operational performance of IT support suppliers and ensure compliance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Monitor supplier performance through regular service reviews, dashboards, and performance reports and handle exemption procedures. Participate supplier governance meetings and ensure action tracking and follow-up. Drive continuous service improvement initiatives and identify optimization opportunities. Manage supplier escalations and facilitate timely resolution of operational issues. Collaborate with internal IT service owners and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality service delivery. Support implementation of new services, process changes, and technology transitions delivered by suppliers. Ensure alignment with ITIL-based service management practices. Ensure suppliers fulfill contractual commitments and deliver agreed services. Contribute to contract changes and statements of work in collaboration with Procurement and Legal teams. Ensure compliance with internal policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards. Maintain accurate contract documentation and supplier records. 2. Vendor Relationship Management Establish and maintain operational relationships with suppliers and key stakeholders. Act as primary point of contact for supplier governance activities. Foster collaboration and constructive partnerships with suppliers. Conduct performance evaluations and supplier maturity assessments. Drive supplier accountability and promote a culture of continuous improvement. Support supplier risk management and business continuity planning. QUALIFICATIONS Education Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience may be considered. Professional Experience 3+ years of experience in Vendor Management, Supplier Management, IT Service Management, Procurement, or a comparable role. Experience managing outsourced IT support or managed service providers. Experience working in international and cross-functional environments. Technical Knowledge Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and frameworks. Knowledge of ServiceNow or comparable ITSM platforms. Experience with SLA, KPI, and operational performance management. Familiarity with supplier governance and risk management practices. Certifications ITIL Foundation (nice to have) Certified Supplier/Vendor Manager (nice to have). Project Management certification (PRINCE2, PMP, Agile, Scrum) (nice to have). Skills & Competencies Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Excellent negotiation and influencing capabilities. Strong analytical and financial acumen. Effective communication and presentation skills. Ability to manage conflicts and escalations professionally. Structured, organized, and results-oriented working style. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Fluent written and spoken English. Additional languages such as German, Spanish, Mandarin, Portuguese are a plus. BENEFITS A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always our top priority. Flexible work schedule and Home-office options, so that you can balance your working life and private life. Learning and development opportunities 25 holiday days per year 5 additional days (readjustment) A collaborative, trustful and innovative work environment Being part of an international team and work in global projects Relocation assistance to Madrid provided At BASF, the chemistry is right Because we are counting on innovative solutions, on sustainable actions, and on connected thinking and on you. Become a part of our formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief. At BASF, we are committed to upholding and ensuring compliance with company standards related to quality, environment, health, safety, and energy, in line with our global guidelines. We actively promote a culture of prevention and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration in initiatives related to quality, environmental protection, health, safety, and energy performance. We foster responsible energy use, promoting efficiency in daily operations and supporting the identification of improvement projects and energy-saving opportunities. HOW TO REACH US If you're interested in the position or know someone who might be and need support on how to take next steps, please send an email to felipe.bianco@partners.basf.com

jobs.name: Head of HR, Agricultural Solutions Canada
jobs.description: Now hiring! Head of HR, Agricultural Solutions Canada Calgary, Alberta. (Hybrid) We are looking for a Head of HR to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Calgary, Alberta. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. We are seeking a strategic and business-focused Human Resources leader to serve as HR Head, Canada for our Agricultural Solutions business. Reporting operationally to the Global Head of Human Resources, Agricultural Solutions and administratively to the Head of Agricultural Solutions Canada, you will lead the people agenda for Canada while helping shape and advance the broader global HR strategy. As a member of both the Canadian Leadership Team and the Global Human Resources Leadership Team, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and act as a key link between global strategy and local execution. In this role, you will ensure Canadian business, workforce, and regulatory considerations are represented within a global organization while driving enterprise HR priorities across Canada. As a Head of HR, Agricultural Solutions Canada, you create chemistry by... Leading the Human Resources strategy and agenda for BASF Agricultural Solutions Canada. Partnering with senior leaders to drive organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, and leadership development. Translating global HR strategies and priorities into effective solutions that support Canadian business objectives while balancing local needs and enterprise priorities. Representing Canadian business and workforce perspectives in global HR discussions and decision-making processes. Providing strategic counsel and coaching to leaders on organizational design, employee relations, culture, performance management, and change initiatives. Leading complex employee relations matters, organizational changes, and business transformation initiatives across Canada. Ensuring compliance with Canadian employment legislation, labor standards, human rights requirements, privacy regulations, and BASF policies. Delivering Human Resources programs and services through collaboration with global Centers of Expertise, shared service organizations, external providers, and business leaders. Fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture that supports employee engagement and business success. If you have... Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development, or a related field. 12+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including at least 5 years in senior HR leadership roles. Broad Human Resources leadership experience across talent management, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, employee relations, change management, leadership development, and succession planning. Strong knowledge of Canadian employment legislation and Human Resources practices. Experience operating within a complex, matrixed, multinational organization. Proven success partnering with executive and senior leadership teams to drive business and talent outcomes. Experience working across multiple geographies, cultures, and stakeholder groups. Demonstrated success leading organizational change, transformation, integration, or restructuring initiatives. Exceptional leadership, communication, influencing, coaching, and relationship-building skills. Preferred Qualifications Master's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Organizational Psychology, or a related field. Chartered Professional in Human Resources (CPHR) designation. Experience serving on both business leadership teams and HR leadership teams. Experience within agriculture, manufacturing, life sciences, chemical, industrial, or other complex operational environments Create your own chemistry with you@BASF Adding value to our customers begins with adding value to you. you@BASF is the suite of benefits, perks, programs and unique opportunities we offer to support you – the whole you – in all stages of your life and career. With you@BASF, you create your own chemistry. The total rewards that you receive as a BASF employee go way beyond a paycheck. From competitive health and insurance plans to robust retirement benefits that include company-matching contributions, to making sure you never stop learning, we believe investing in you is investing in our success. Working for a large, global organization, you’ll have a chance to grow professionally and personally, expand your network and build a rewarding and dynamic career.  We also provide engaging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your role. About us As the world’s leading chemical company, we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! We constantly strive to become an even better workplace. As a result of our commitment to our employees, BASF has earned various awards, including being recognized by Mediacorp in 2025 as one of Canada's Top Employers for eleventh consecutive year, one of the Greater Toronto Area's Top Employers for the twelfth year in a row, and twice being named one of Canada's Top Employers for Young People and Best Diversity Employers. We provide a fulfilling work environment with a strong emphasis on the physical and psychological safety of our employees and the communities we operate in. We are always working to form the best team with an emphasis on diversity, equity, and inclusion and through lifelong learning and development. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy Statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.name: Operatør med erfaring indenfor fødevare- eller pharmaproduktion
jobs.description: VELKOMMEN TIL BASF BASF A/S Ballerup har gennem årene ved konstant innovation udviklet en proces, som er helt unik. Vi er specialiserede i mikroindkapslede formuleringer af vitaminer og carotenoider. Vores produkter anvendes hovedsageligt til fødevare-, kosttilskud- og medicinalindustrien. Vi beskæftiger ca. 135 medarbejdere, men mangler operatører, for at få planen til at gå op. Derfor savner vi dig, din gode personlighed og kompetencer til at gøre en forskel sammen med nogle rigtig dygtige kollegaer. HVAD DU KAN FORVENTE Du vil indgå i et team, som har den primære opgave at sikre optimal produktion med processen af vitaminer. På sigt forventer BASF, at du kan bestride alle jobfunktioner i produktionen indenfor proces og pakning. - Som operatør inden for fremstilling af vitaminer har man ansvaret for spraytørringsanlægget samt de tilknyttede processer. Dette indebærer klargøring, betjening og overvågning af anlægget for at sikre en effektiv og sikker produktion. - Som operatør i pakkeafdelingen har man ansvaret for både de automatiske og manuelle pakkelinjer samt de processer, der foregår i forbindelse med disse. Dette inkluderer fremtagning, kontrol og afvejning af råvarer, opsugning og blanding samt styring af råvarelagret. Herudover indgår der i begge typer job: •    Skriftlig dokumentation og rapportering af produktionsforløb •    Prøveudtagning og proceskontrol •    Rengøring af anlæg, udstyr og lokaler Arbejdstiden planlægges typisk på skiftehold med et forskelligt antal vagter af enten 8, 12 eller 12,5 timer placeret over hele ugen (f.eks. kl. 6-14, kl. 06:00 – 18:30 og/eller 18:00 – 06:30). HVAD DU TILBYDER •    Du har en relevant uddannelse som procesoperatør, industrioperatør eller tilsvarende. Alternativt har du relevant erhvervserfaring, gerne fra levnedsmiddel- eller medicinalbranchen. •    Fleksibilitet, ordenssans, teknisk flair og hygiejneforståelse. •    Du har gode samarbejdsevner og frem for alt er du ansvarsbevidst. •    Gode kundskaber i skriftligt og mundtligt dansk. •    Du har kørekort til bil (type B). •    Kendskab til GMP og truckkort vil være en stor fordel. HVAD VI TILBYDER Ansvar fra første dag i et udfordrende arbejdsmiljø og med læring i jobbet som del af et engageret team.  En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke, der inkluderer sundhedsordning, sundhedstjek, fysioterapi, træningsrum, bruttolønsordning m.m. Herudover er BASF A/S Ballerup en røgfri arbejdsplads, med røgfri arbejdstid. SÅDAN SØGER OG KONTAKTER DU OS Du kan kontakte vores rekrutteringsteam her: https://www.basf.com/global/en/careers/contact . ANSØGNINGSFRIST Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rigtige kandidat. OM OS Hos BASF skaber vi kemi for en bæredygtig fremtid. Vi kombinerer økonomisk succes med miljøbeskyttelse og social ansvarlighed. De ca. 110.000 ansatte i BASF-koncernen arbejder for at bidrage til succes for vores kunder, som man finder i de fleste brancher og i næsten ethvert land over hele verden. Mangfoldighed er vores største styrke! Vi tror på, at succes skabes gennem diversitet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, oprindelse, seksuel orientering, religion eller funktionsnedsættelse til at søge stillingen.

jobs.name: Project Manager / Engineer, Plant Development
jobs.description: VELKOMMEN TIL BASF BASF i Sandefjord har ledig en spennende stilling for deg som ønsker å jobbe med teknologiutvikling! Vi søker Project Manager / Engineer til vår omega-3 fabrikk i Sandefjord. I denne stillingen vil du ha en sentral rolle i blant annet prosjektering og prosjektledelse hos oss. Produksjonsanlegget i Sandefjord spesialiserer seg på å lage aktive farmasøytiske ingredienser (API) og kosttilskudd av høykonsentrerte omega-3-fettsyrer. Rundt 130 personer er basert i Sandefjord og dekker også funksjoner som kvalitetsledelse, FoU, prosess- og anleggsutvikling, økonomi og HR. HVA DU KAN FORVENTE BASF i Sandefjord fokuserer på prosjekter tilknyttet kapasitetsøkning, fornybar energi og energigjenvinning, automatisering og utbytteøkning i produksjon. Som prosjektingeniør/prosjektleder vil du få ansvar for design og gjennomføring av multidisiplinære prosjekter. Arbeidsoppgavene dine vil blant annet være: Prosjektering og gjennomføring av større eller mindre endringsprosjekter i våre produksjonsanlegg Prosjektledelse i forbindelse med endringene Ha fagansvar for tekniske spesifikasjoner ved innkjøp av nytt utstyr/anlegg Være en pådriver for kontinuerlig forbedringer ved fabrikken Samarbeide tett med eksterne leverandører, entreprenører og interne driftsmiljø HVA DU TILBYR •    Bachelor eller mastergrad (mekanisk ingeniør eller prosessingeniør) •    Hvis du er nyutdannet, er vi også interessert i din søknad og ønsker deg velkommen til å søke •    Gjerne erfaring fra prosjektledelse (fortrinnsvis fra prosessindustri) •    Gjerne erfaring med design av prosessanlegg, enten innenfor mekanisk- eller prosessdisiplinene •    Gjerne erfaring med hygienisk design og krav som stilles til mat- og farmasøytisk produksjon •    Du er initiativrik og løsningsorientert •    Du trives med å jobbe i team, liker å ta ansvar og kan jobbe selvstendig •    Gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk kreves HVA VI TILBYR Vi kan tilby deg en spennende rolle i en bedrift med et globalt fokus. Vi har et faglig sterkt miljø og imøtekommende og hyggelige kolleger. Vi har som målsetning å skape innovative løsninger som oppfyller nåværende og fremtidige behov i samfunnet. Vi gir deg ansvar fra dag en, og vi arbeider kontinuerlig med utviklingen av vårt arbeidsmiljø og byggingen av en god prestasjonskultur. Vi er opptatt av de ansattes personlige vekst, og legger forholdene til rette for nye utfordringer og utviklingsmuligheter i hele konsernet. HVORDAN DU SØKER Du søker gjennom vår søknadsportal. Du må laste opp CVen din, søknadsbrev og dokumentasjon på utdanning, og svare på spørsmålene som er oppgitt i søknadsportalen. Vi vil intervjue kandidater fortløpende, så vi anbefaler at du søker så snart som mulig. Har du spørsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Elin Kulås, Technology Development Manager, elin.kulas@basf.com. Du kan kontakte vårt rekrutteringsteam her: Kontakt Informasjon om vår søknadsprosess kan finnes her: Søknad OM OSS Hos BASF skaper vi kjemi for en bærekraftig fremtid. Vi kombinerer økonomisk suksess med miljøvern og sosialt ansvar. Mer enn 111 000 ansatte i BASF-gruppen bidrar til suksessen til våre kunder i nesten alle sektorer og nesten alle land i verden. Vår portefølje er organisert i seks segmenter: Kjemikalier, materialer, industrielle løsninger, overflateteknologi, ernæring & helse og landbruksløsninger. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Officer/Accountant - Accounts Payable Team Benelux (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT The Accounts Payable Department Team Benelux provides professional invoice management for all affiliated European BASF Group companies. It cooperates with the procurement and local finance departments, actively involved in the creation of an optimized creditor process chain. You are responsible for accounting activities such as checking and posting invoices, clarifying accounts as well as verifying payment runs for our BASF Group Companies in North Europe. In the optimization of the purchase-to-pay process, you will take an active part and work in close cooperation with the purchasing and finance departments of the BASF Group. WHAT YOU OFFER commercial business training or a degree in Business Administration first experience in Accounting, Accounts Payable and projects communicative team player who is open to changes first experience with SAP fluent in English, Dutch would be an advantage WHAT WE OFFER Gross annual salary (full-time): 35.000 - 43.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location Team and company events in which we celebrate our achievements and live up our team spirit Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - Here a first impression Subsidy for public transport, personal employee benefit card and other discounts Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks HOW TO REACH US Viktoria Pohl (Talent Acquisition), viktoria.pohl@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-58390 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an online appointment. You can also reach our recruiting team here . First information about our application process can be found here . ABOUT US As an international service hub, the BASF Services Europe GmbH bundles a wide range of services for the BASF Group throughout Europe. In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our career opportunities here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Warehouse Manager - Buena Park CA
jobs.description:
Now hiring! Warehouse Manager Buena Park, CA We are looking for a Warehouse Manager to join our team in Buena Park, CA. New finish, Proven expertise. Bolder ambition. If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact, and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in. Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.  We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. Surventis is seeking an experienced Warehouse Manager to lead daily warehouse and site operations at our Buena Park distribution facility supporting the Automotive Refinish Coatings business. This role is accountable for safe, compliant and efficient warehousing, inventory integrity, transportation coordination, team leadership, site security, and customer-focused operational performance. As a Warehouse Manager, you will... Lead receiving, put-away, storage, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, returns and related warehouse activities. Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts, physical inventories, discrepancy investigation, root-cause analysis and corrective actions. Lead, coach, schedule and develop warehouse employees and temporary labor while building a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement. Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable OSHA, DOT, EPA, California, hazardous-materials, hazardous-waste, fire-code and local requirements. Coordinate inbound and outbound transportation with Customer Service, Supply Chain, carriers and service providers. Improve warehouse layout, slotting, space utilization, material flow, productivity, quality, service and cost performance. Serve as the primary on-site contact for operational issues, audits, inspections, security, emergency response, visitors and contractors. Use SAP tools to execute inventory and shipment transactions, monitor performance and resolve exceptions. If you have... Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Business, or a related field. At least 7 years of warehouse, distribution, or logistics experience, including 3 years leading warehouse teams. Experience handling hazardous materials or operating in a regulated distribution environment. Working knowledge of SAP or a comparable ERP or warehouse management system. Strong leadership, communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Experience in automotive refinish, coatings, chemicals, manufacturing, or a related industry preferred. Experience managing transportation providers or third-party logistics partners preferred. Lean Six Sigma, APICS/ASCM, CSCMP, or comparable training or certification preferred. Privacy statement Surventis takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. Pay transparency Surventis is committed to pay transparency practices. The competitive Pay Range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Actual pay will be determined based on education, certifications, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.name: Site Manager
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The BASF site in Bradford is a specialised manufacturing plant focused on producing dispersions and additives. These products serve as dispersants, thickeners, and specialty components in paints, inks, and coatings. They are utilised across a variety of industries, including automotive, furniture, printing, and cosmetics. Managed by BASF's Dispersions & Resins business unit, the site boasts an outstanding safety and environmental record BASF plc is a subsidiary of BASF SE, marketing a wide range of BASF products in the UK. These include agricultural solutions, automotive refinish paints, acrylic monomers, fine chemicals, intermediate chemicals, speciality chemicals, dispersions, and plastics. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You will have overall responsibility for Management of a lower-tier COMAH site, providing excellent leadership along with a clear vision and direction to the site. Key will be ensuring the site teams are motivated, developed and engaged in order to deliver high performance against operational, safety and financial targets, to deliver quality products in the most efficient way. The main areas of focus will be: Developing a culture of empowerment, openness, collaboration and embracing the challenges of change. Building and implementing a strategy in line with the strategic objectives of the business and ensuring responsibilities are clear across the site teams. Driving operational excellence across manufacturing and all site processes through lean manufacturing concepts, automation, and the use of digitalization. Delivering the financial targets of the business, including capital and fixed costs, to ensure cost competitiveness and high operational and manufacturing efficiency. Driving an EHS and Quality culture to provide compliance with internal and external requirements. Developing and maintaining relationships with key internal and external stakeholders. WHAT YOU OFFER You will be educated to degree level or equivalent in a chemistry or an engineering discipline and have a proven track record of manufacturing experience and delivering against demanding EHS, production and financial targets. You will be able to demonstrate excellent leadership skills as these are critical to success in this role. We are looking for an individual who can build trust and credibility through the way they lead, the integrity they have and the vision they create. Strong operational excellence skills are required, previous experience of approaches such as lean manufacturing and experience with automation and digitalization would be beneficial. Key strengths will be excellent communication and interpersonal skills, coupled with drive, empathy, optimism and courage. A driver of change, who has a proven track record of empowering and developing teams to deliver high performance. WHAT WE OFFER At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. We offer a total package which includes: Bonus Defined contribution pension scheme 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays Company share scheme Private healthcare Life insurance Company car or car allowance We believe that diversity and inclusion make the difference. Only when people with diverse backgrounds come together, contribute their various experiences and attitudes, and look at challenges from different perspectives, will creative innovations and ground-breaking solutions be created. We celebrate diversity and we actively promote an inclusive work environment. In the UK we have an active Diversity & Inclusion Strategy Action Group and work closely with external partner Inclusive Employers. We are an equal opportunities employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard or reference to age, gender, race, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status and other protected characteristics. For more information please visit: https://www.basf.com/gb/en/careers/why-join-basf/basf-locally.html Location: Bradford Closing Date: 23.11.2026 ABOUT US Since 1880, BASF has been a cornerstone of industry in the UK. With locations spanning from Littlehampton on England's South Coast to Callanish on the Isle of Lewis in Scotland, our presence is truly nationwide. Our UK headquarters in Stockport, Greater Manchester, is the hub for our dedicated sales and services teams. From our manufacturing sites across the UK, we supply essential raw materials to a diverse range of industries, including agriculture, automotive, chemicals, construction, energy, and pharmaceuticals. Discover more about our incredible BASF UK team and their contributions to innovation and sustainability here: https://www.basf.com/gb/en/who-we-are/BASF-in-the-United-Kingdom At BASF, our culture is driven by strong core values and winning behaviors. We foster innovation, collaboration, and empower every team member to contribute to our success. Explore Our Winning Behaviors & Our Values to see how we create a dynamic and inclusive workplace.

jobs.name: Production Technician
jobs.description: Now hiring! Production Technician Central, SC We are looking for a Production Technician to join our Performance Materials team in Clemson, SC. Come create chemistry with us! The Performance Materials division is at the forefront of the much-needed sustainability transformation in plastics. Our experts co-create products with customers to bring innovations to major industry sectors such as transportation, consumer goods, industrial applications, and construction.These solutions contribute to a sustainable future by pushing the boundaries in thermal resistance, robustness and lightweight applications. The BASF Performance Materials business responds quickly to customer needs, without cutting corners to sacrifice safety or quality.  The business services a wide range of customers in many different markets from automotive, construction, refrigeration, appliances, etc.  The operators within the Clemson Site must adapt to change safely, quickly, and efficiently while maintaining the highest quality requirements.   The Operator III manufactures blended resin systems for foam application to meet our customer needs. **This role works around a 3 rotating shift. Shift hours are: 1st Shift: 5am -1:30pm 2nd Shift: 1pm – 9:30pm 3rd Shift: 9pm – 5:30am During your rotating shift as a Production Technician, you will Use product recipes to produce blended resin systems in multiple blend vessels including the PSM process. Have knowledge of raw materials and the hazards, locations, etc. of those raw materials and knowledgeable of the process equipment. Use interface screens to the process control system to add exact quantities of chemicals to match product recipes, follow step by step batch instructions, and take samples as required. Load drums, totes, cylinders, and tank trucks with the final product. Unload raw materials via rail car to bulk storage, tank truck to bulk storage tank, tank truck to tote, and box vans of drums & totes. Follow standard operating procedures to unload and check-in various raw materials for production. Be an integral part of the site’s safety culture. This individual is responsible for certain areas of the plant from a safety and housekeeping perspective.  Operator I will also be required to master a certain number of standard operating procedure. Train in Department of Transportation (DOT). This individual must be able to understand hazard communication and DOT OSHA requirements for chemical transportation, storage, and handling. Understand how to use personal protective equipment to perform all necessary job functions within the process. Be able to become a certified forklift driver. If you... Possess a High School Diploma (2 Year technical degree preferred) Have good communication skills Have a high level of attention to detail Are able to lift at least 50lbs. ** ‘Selected candidate is going to be HAZMAT trained by the site for which he would need to be clean shaved. This is to ensure any activity that requires the candidate to wear a respirator, the fit is adequate. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. jobs.name: Counsel, Legal and Compliance Services Hub (Thai Speaker)
jobs.description: M ain Tasks Functional Tasks (Inclusive but not limited): You will draft, review, and negotiate until close out local or international contracts, agreements, using BASF approved templates and playbooks. You will provide legal and compliance support on various matters as assigned to you by your supervisor from time to time, including but not limited to documentary reviews, transactional due diligence, M&A projects, audits, compliance and legal investigations. You will manage the contract lifecycle, ensure process efficiency, and contribute to the maintenance and improvement of contract templates and knowledge management systems. You will interact with internal clients and external customers as required for your assigned tasks. You will perform ancillary tasks such as attending meetings, preparing minutes of meetings, presentations, usage of legal tech tools including AI, and handling translations. Minimum Education and Qualification Required You have successfully completed your university degree in law or any related field You have over 4 years of experience in draft and legal review of contracts, preferably with commercial law emphasis. Open to experiences in contracts & agreement, procurement, quantity surveyor. You are fluent in English and Thai language, enabling you to successfully contribute to an international environment. You are used to work with legal databases and standard IT applications with familiarity with AI an added advantage. You communicate effectively and in line with the target audience and use value-creating opportunities for cooperation, both in-house and across units. Able to communicate with teammates and stakeholders effectively and timely, raise concerns, employ utmost respect, respectful of the chain of command and deploys courtesy in all aspects of your work. Your very good analytical skills, your goal-oriented approach and your pronounced customer orientation make you an important member of our team.

jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives of the Position The primary function of this role is to implement Engineering Plastics, Performance Materials Greater China sales & marketing strategy in new business development and customers’ management by initiating contacts with existing and potential customers in line with company Code of Conduct principles. Develop the business on EE and Universal in East China according to the regional strategy and objectives Accountable on the business performance in the country and provide input for account plan, pricing strategy and market intelligence Establishes and fosters strong, long-lasting customer relationships to ensure sustainable business growth How You Will Do It Sales Development . Fully responsible and accountable for profitable business growth for assigned customers Develops sales plans; secures and expedites orders. Supervises and consolidates the accurate sales forecast. Strategic Tasks and Implementation Identifies key accounts and develops key account profiles. Implements the sales and marketing directions per agreed directions Product/Industry/Business Development Scouts for new business opportunities in the respective sales areas / key accounts and develops a business plan. Suggests product developments and requirements to Sales Manager or LBM and support its implementation. Customer Management Conducts field visits, seminars, presentations and attends to customers’ inquiries. Provides prompt response related to quality, technical applications, inquiries, and other related issues; conducts customers’ assessments and analysis. Aligns with Regional Business Unit and functions to solve customers’ issues. Credit Management Monitors the growth of the customers’ business, reviews and coordinates with credit control to assure appropriate credit recommendations. Follows up on payment collections and ensures customer’s on-time payment Marketing Implements pricing policy and supports product launch processes. Monitors and reviews marketing/promotion campaign’s execution. Supports public relation and marketing communication campaigns for related business. Market Intelligence Conducts studies/analysis on market trend, competitors, products’ applications and technology, service needs. Innovations, Sustainability, Embrace Digitalization Accelerates Innovation to achieve innovation sales target Live Sustainability: supports the Implementation of A-PMA/E Sustainability Roadmap in Greater China with projects acquired which includes Chemcycling, Mechanical Recycling, BMB solutions, Bio based Materials Embrace Digitalization: Enhances aligned use of salesforce Implement and enhances the use of PM Wechat China platform for promoting more new applications, technical webinar, and customer interaction What We Look For Education: Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Polymer, Chemistry or equivalent, such as Material Science, Chemical Engineering, Material Engineering, Mechanical Engineering. Work Experience: Minimun 5 years technical sales working experience preferably with Engineering Plastics industry. jobs.name: ASEAN Finance Manager (Platform & Operations)
jobs.description:
Objectives of the position: The ASEAN Finance Manager (Platform & Operations) leads local finance activities across Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and Singapore, ensuring effective statutory reporting, tax, treasury, audit, compliance and finance governance. The role provides functional leadership to country finance resources and coordinates closely with BPO providers and regional expert teams. Because the platform operates with a lean team, this is a hands-on leadership role. The manager directly participates in Thailand operational finance activities, reviews the work of the Thailand Senior Accountant and remains accountable for significant judgments, escalations and stakeholder coordination. Core responsibilities: ASEAN Finance Leadership Lead and coordinate local finance activities across the ASEAN platform. Set priorities, clarify accountabilities and align country resources with regional and global requirements. Ensure timely completion and appropriate review of statutory, tax, audit and compliance deliverables. Drive consistent accounting, control and governance standards across countries while respecting local requirements. Hands-on Thailand Finance Operations Actively participate in Thailand month-end, statutory reporting, tax, audit, treasury and compliance activities. Review key reconciliations, statutory schedules, tax filings and other deliverables prepared by the Senior Accountant or service providers. Provide technical guidance on complex or non-routine accounting and tax matters. Lead significant discussions with auditors, tax advisors, banks, authorities and internal stakeholders. Step into operational activities when required to ensure business continuity and timely delivery. Statutory Reporting, Audit & Compliance Oversee statutory reporting and external audit activities across the covered countries. Ensure local regulatory deliverables are completed accurately and on time. Monitor relevant accounting and regulatory developments and coordinate impact assessment. Track significant audit findings, compliance gaps and remediation actions. Tax Governance Oversee VAT or GST, withholding tax, corporate income tax and related local tax compliance. Coordinate with regional tax teams and external tax advisors. Review and escalate significant tax risks, uncertain positions and non-routine transactions. Support transfer pricing and other required tax documentation and governance activities. Treasury & Cash Management Oversee local banking, cash visibility and treasury coordination. Review cash forecasts and local liquidity requirements. Coordinate with regional treasury on bank accounts, funding and controls. Support resolution of significant banking and treasury matters. BPO & Service Provider Governance Govern outsourced finance services and define clear interfaces between local teams, BPO providers and regional functions. Monitor service levels, quality, controls and unresolved issues. Lead escalations and drive root-cause resolution and continuous improvement. Ensure retained local responsibilities are adequately performed and documented. Transformation & TSA Exit Lead finance readiness and transition activities for Day-2 operations. Support TSA exit, carve-out, ERP deployment and finance process transformation. Coordinate knowledge transfer, control readiness and stabilization activities. Drive sustainable process design and reduce unnecessary duplication between local teams and external providers. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead, coach and develop country finance team members. Build collaboration across Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and Singapore. Act as the principal finance contact for local management, regional finance, tax, treasury, auditors, advisors and BPO partners. Communicate risks, decisions, dependencies and progress clearly to senior stakeholders. Professional and educational qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field; CPA, ACCA or equivalent qualification preferred. Approximately 10-15 years of finance and accounting experience, including meaningful leadership responsibility. Experience supporting or overseeing multiple ASEAN countries. Strong hands-on background in statutory accounting, tax, audit and local compliance. Experience with shared services, BPO governance, carve-outs, TSA exits or finance transformation is highly desirable. Manufacturing or multinational company experience is preferred. Strong knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting, tax governance, internal controls and treasury processes. Ability to review detailed operational work and resolve complex accounting or compliance issues. SAP experience preferred; SAP S/4HANA and finance transformation exposure are advantageous. Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills. Professional proficiency in Thai and English. Hands-on leader who can balance regional governance with local execution. Sound judgment, strong risk awareness and disciplined escalation. Able to lead effectively in a lean organization with changing priorities. Collaborative and credible with country teams, senior stakeholders and external parties. Strong ownership of delivery, controls and license-to-operate requirements. jobs.name: Senior HR Business Partner (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Are you an experienced HR professional looking to make a significant impact in a globally renowned biotechnology company? We invite you to join us as an HR Business Partner, where you will play a crucial role in shaping the future through cutting-edge technologies and innovative applications. In this position, you will work closely with a diverse and passionate team, engaging intensively with leadership to drive strategic initiatives. As part of a matrix organization, your ability to foster collaboration, embrace innovation, and demonstrate cultural awareness will be key to our success. With a clear strategic mandate from HR, your expertise will be instrumental in driving meaningful change and enhancing our organizational effectiveness. Agriculture plays a fundamental role in fulfilling many of humanity’s basic needs: food, feed, energy. To support growers and those who take care of our environment, BASF develops innovative solutions for farming, pest-, disease- and weed control so that we can effectively contribute to improving people’s lives and business’ demands. Come join us on our journey to create solutions for sustainable agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT You act as trusted advisor and coach of leadership teams in all HR, leadership and personnel matters. You drive high-impact HR initiatives and encourage leadership to think and act strategically on critical people topics. You are building strong relationships with a broad network of senior business and HR stakeholders. You show a strong interest in understanding the business context, translate these insights into a pragmatic but impactful HR action plan and advise your leaders accordingly. You follow up employees in their career lifecycle (e.g. onboarding, internal mobility, personal development, exit). You provide critical analysis of HR data or HR-related questions, challenge requests and identify underlying needs to offer strategic, future-proof solutions. You foster cultural awareness and act as a skilled mediator in a highly diverse and multicultural environment. WHAT YOU OFFER You have a Master’s degree and a minimum of 10 years of HR experience in a global, matrix-driven organization. Fluency in Dutch and English enables you to communicate effectively across diverse teams. You possess a proven ability to prioritize and operate at both strategic and operational levels, making a tangible impact. You excel in insight-led decision-making, driving meaningful initiatives forward. Your professional maturity is reflected in your diplomatic and forward-thinking approach, focusing on pragmatic solutions. You have strong conceptual thinking skills that allow you to constructively challenge leadership and build trust-based partnerships. Your interpersonal skills enable you to build relationships and influence across cultures. You radiate positivity and resilience, contributing to a vibrant workplace culture. WHAT WE OFFER A permanent contract within an attractive working environment in a professional and motivated team. A role with challenging assignments and responsibilities. Interesting and challenging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your job. Work from home one day per week. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . Objectives: As project materials manager responsible for project procurement execution planning and reporting, timely sourcing of goods and if assigned services, PO generation, expediting, change and claims handling and closure of POs in CAPEX projects Overlook the project procurement process and create PSR and ESR reports ensuring transparency and serve as project specific procurement focal point in terms of progress and escalation management and implement company policies and guidelines into project procurement Identify and pursue cost saving opportunities with excellent negotiation skills and engage in supplier management during the whole process from MRQ to delivery together with category team and project stakeholders Main Responsibilities: Project Procurement Responsibilities: Ensure compliance in the procurement process in accordance with BASF Supplier Code of Conduct, in line with local laws, company compliance requirements and global procurement guideline. Responsible to generate project procurement execution plan and signing matrix timely for assigned projects and implementing global equipment procurement strategies within Responsible for generation of project master supplier lists and package bidders lists in collaboration with category team and project stakeholders from operating division and project engineering Responsible for timely sourcing of materials packages including expediting of MRQ from technical team, driving RfQ generation, tendering, expediting of TBE, conducting CNBs, negotiation, CBE, contract award as well as managing the expediting process post award Responsible for generating and tracking the Procurement Status Report and Expediting Status Report in a timely manner for assigned projects Review and approve purchase orders according to project signing matrices Supplier Management Responsibilities : Maintain relationship with key equipment suppliers, actively engage in expediting deliveries and conduct procurement lessons learnt for assigned projects Ensure process compliance for project based supplier audits and qualifications Procurement Planning & Strategy : Monitor and improve efficiency and speed in sourcing of materials packages Oversee the procurement process and implement company’s policies and guidelines Identify risks regarding delivery delays / supply chain interruption Stakeholder Communication and reporting: Coordinating all procurement activities together with the project team by providing regular updates, risks and budget status Supplier Communication: First line to address potential issues / non conformances towards the supplier. If required to be escalated via category team to Management. Close collaboration with PVT required with regards to supplier Audits / qualifications/ EHS standards required for large multi-national companies. Job Requirements: Strong negotiation skills for: prices, payment terms, delivery times, changes and claims are required Deep knowledge and understanding of supplier, market environment, products/services and technologies for all materials procurement categories Comprehensive understanding on category purchasing strategies, procurement Verbund team, supplier qualification and general procurement processes and guidelines is required Deep knowledge to establish a project procurement execution plan, supplier qualification, capturing and reporting of PSR and ESR as well as change and claims management is required Strong project management skills specifically for virtual teams without direct reporting lines is required. Solid knowledge on SAP including purchase order generation and usage of project materials management tools are required Excellent written and verbal communication skills for interaction with internal and external stakeholders. Full mobility within India for project relocation and willingness to travel to a significant extend to support projects in the region Asia Pacific Deep knowledge in MS Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word Solid IT skills for procurement related systems such as SAP R/3 Cobalt, SAP Business Warehouse, and Strategic Procurement Suite Knowledge of Power BI and SAP S4 Hana is an advantage Deep knowledge with digital tools related to project procurement, such as ERM, Smart Plant Materials Education & Qualification: Bachelor or Master Degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Economics or Finance > 7 years of work experience in related categories in Indirect Procurement and CAPEX projects Excellent in English & Iocal language, additional language is a plus

jobs.name: Senior Manager, Regional Customer Service
jobs.description: Objectives of the Position We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Regional Customer Service to lead end-to-end Customer Service excellence across APAC. In this strategic regional leadership role, you will ensure reliable order fulfillment, deliver a superior customer experience, strengthen operational resilience, and drive consistent execution of standardized Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes. You will also play a key role in advancing the Customer Service transformation agenda in line with the defined operating model. You will lead a multicultural regional Customer Service organization and serve as a key interface between customers, Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Digital, and other enabling functions. Through this role, you will help protect revenue, strengthen customer trust, enable profitable growth, and transform Customer Service into a scalable, digital-first and exception-based organization. Main Areas of Responsibilities Customer Experience & Service Strategy Own and drive the regional Customer Service strategy and roadmap, aligned with business priorities, customer expectations, and operating model objectives. Ensure a consistent and high-quality customer experience across customer segments and channels. Act as the senior escalation point for critical issues across the end-to-end OTC process. Drive customer satisfaction, service-level adherence, and effective issue resolution. Establish a structured Voice of Customer process and translate customer feedback into service, system, and process improvements. Support strategic customer initiatives and represent Customer Service in key business discussions. Regional Leadership & Organization Development Hold full disciplinary and functional leadership responsibility for the Customer Service organization within scope. Promote employee engagement, psychological safety, well-being, and effective cross-cultural collaboration. Foster a high-performing, customer-centric culture built on accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and inclusion. Build organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, coaching, and mentoring. Lead organizational change and transformation initiatives. Operational Excellence & OTC Governance Ensure consistent execution of end-to-end OTC processes across countries and SBUs. Establish and govern standardized operating procedures, KPIs and PPIs, internal controls, audit readiness, and compliance requirements. Ensure adherence to customer agreements, regulatory requirements, and company policies. Maintain regional business continuity and service resilience during supply disruptions, allocation periods, and demand volatility. Drive effective exception management and timely resolution of critical customer issues. Customer Service Transformation & Digitalization Lead the implementation of the Customer Service transformation roadmap for A-PMA in line with Core Shift. Drive the adoption of customer segmentation and differentiated service models. Govern and sustain service differentiation and segmentation compliance across customer groups. Lead the transition toward a digital-first operating model focused on automation and exception management. Promote customer onboarding and adoption of digital channels and self-service solutions. Drive adoption and utilization of PCS, MyBASFWorld, mySmartOrder, and relevant AI capabilities. Partner with GD and Process Excellence teams to optimize the Customer Service technology landscape. Champion process harmonization and increase the Hands-Free Order (HFO) rate across the region. Performance Management, Productivity & Cost Optimization Define, monitor, and continuously improve regional Customer Service KPIs. Monitor key performance measures including customer satisfaction, service levels, order accuracy, backlog, complaint volumes, resolution cycle time, cost-to-serve, productivity, digital adoption, and employee engagement. Monitor external benchmarks, emerging technologies, and Customer Service trends while promoting best-practice sharing across the region. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related discipline. Master's degree is preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, or related functions. Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience , including experience managing regional and multicultural teams. Demonstrated experience leading Customer Service transformation, digitalization, and process standardization initiatives. Strong experience managing customer-facing operations within a B2B environment . Experience within the chemical or related industries is preferred. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes and customer fulfillment operations. Experience with SAP, Salesforce, analytics, and digital collaboration tools . Strong understanding of customer segmentation, service differentiation, and digital customer journey concepts . Fluent English is required; additional Asian languages are an advantage.

jobs.name: Internship Management Consulting - Data Science/Data Analytics (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Welcome to the global management consultancy of BASF! We focus on strategic projects that drive the effective transformation of our businesses. Our teams work on a broad range of topics such as sustainability, organizational development, efficiency projects, M&A, and profitable growth through all types of innovation. We put people first: We are proud of our strong team spirit, and we cherish diversity. Become part of a great international team where your hands-on approach and desire to leave an impact are truly valued. Together, let’s create new ideas and offer the best solutions to our customers. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT From Januar 2027 on you are part of our Management Consulting department for a period of 3 - 6 months . The Management Consulting is a team that gives advice to the BASF group and its business units in the field of general management and is therefore actively supporting the change processes of BASF. As a full member of the team, you are involved in the preparation, coordination, and implementation of consulting projects for BASF management. You gain exposure to a broad range of topics such as strategy, marketing, organizational design, business optimization, and transformation initiatives. jobs.name: Product Manager - Personal Care, Commercial Excellence
jobs.description: Now hiring! Product Manager - Personal Care, Commercial Excellence Florham Park, NJ (Hybrid) We are looking for a Product Manager - Personal Care, Commercial Excellence to join our Care Chemicals team in Florham Park, NJ. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’ brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development site. As a Personal Care Product Manager and Commercial Excellence Lead, you will have responsibility for the profitability, growth, and strategic direction of BASF’s UV Filters and Vitamins portfolio in North America. In addition, you will facilitate margin management across the broader Personal Care portfolio and lead Product Management governance of CPQ and related pricing processes. You will leverage business analytics to improve transparency, strengthen pricing and margin discipline, and translate portfolio performance into actionable commercial decisions. You will connect market and customer needs with pricing, supply, operations, and long-term strategies across regional production and BASF’s global supply network. As a Product Manager - Personal Care, Commercial Excellence, you create chemistry by… Owning portfolio performance: Drive sustainable, profitable growth for the UV Filters and Vitamins portfolio through disciplined management of price, volume, product mix, cost, margin, and customer opportunities. Facilitating margin management: Lead the quarterly Margin Management cycle across Personal Care, integrating supply outlook, cost development, market dynamics, and business needs to shape pricing strategy and margin actions. Coordinate across Product Management to drive an effective commercial management cadence, facilitating meetings and consolidating inputs to enable timely and informed pricing decisions. Providing pricing process governance: Serve as the Product Management lead for pricing process governance across Personal Care, ensuring appropriate pricing structures, processes, data quality, and disciplined use of the tool. Coordinate improvements and help ensure process supports the broader pricing strategy and operating model. Developing product strategy: Develop, communicate, and execute product line strategies for the UV Filters and Vitamins Portfolio, including portfolio positioning, capacity requirements, asset utilization, supply-network options, technology, scale, and cost competitiveness. Leading pricing and margin management: Establish pricing strategies for UV Filters and Vitamins Portfolio with business management; support customer bids; strengthen pricing-process discipline; evaluate raw-material and other cost movements; and recommend timely corrective actions. Turning market and business intelligence into action: Monitor market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, supply-demand dynamics, market pricing, raw-material developments, and technology changes using internal and external sources to identify opportunities, risks, and actions for the UV Filters and Vitamins Portfolio. Managing business planning and KPIs: Support forecasting, scenario analysis, and portfolio-performance reviews for UV Filters and Vitamins. Track margin, volume, mix, asset utilization, forecast quality, and progress against strategic growth priorities. Building strong stakeholder alignment: Collaborate closely with Care Chemicals sales, marketing, finance, operations, production, supply chain, other product managers, global network partners, and BASF platform groups to advance both UV Filters and Vitamins portfolio priorities and broader Personal Care Commercial initiatives. jobs.description: Now hiring! Seed Science Operations Agronomy Manager Saskatoon, SK (Onsite) We are looking for a Seed Science Operations Agronomy Manager to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Saskatoon, SK. In this role, you will provide leadership and operational support for the InVigor hybrid canola breeding field trial programme at the Saskatoon Breeding Farm, the central hub for North American Canola Breeding Research & Development. You will help drive efficient field operations, develop site staff, maintain stewardship and regulatory compliance, and collaborate across teams to deliver high-quality data supporting product advancement. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. As a Team Lead, you create chemistry by... Leading and supporting the execution of the InVigor hybrid canola breeding field trial programme and day-to-day site operations. Coordinating operational plans, workflows, resources, assets, and budgets to support efficient and effective field trial activities. Ensuring Stewardship and Regulatory compliance standards are maintained throughout site and field operations. Executing field trial protocols and supporting the delivery of high-quality, reliable data for product advancement. Training, mentoring, and developing site staff while conducting employee development reviews and supporting local HR responsibilities for direct reports. Driving collaboration across Seed Science Operations and partnering with breeders, TDMs, pathologists, technology leads, and other colleagues. Communicating objectives, priorities, and expectations clearly to key stakeholders and ensuring activities are executed to a high standard. If you have... Have a PhD with plot trial experience, an MS with at least 6 years of relevant experience, a BS with at least 8 years, or a Diploma with at least 12 years of relevant experience. Bring relevant experience in crop yield trialling, high-throughput phenotyping, crop modelling, crop management, and experimental design. Have at least two years of people management experience, including setting day-to-day operational objectives and supervising employees. Bring experience managing operational workflows in dynamic, fast-changing environments. Have experience conducting research trials using statistical design and analysis, with knowledge of canola agronomy, botany, plant breeding, genetics, pollen flow, and genetic purity considered assets. Bring extensive knowledge of canola agronomics and practical crop management. Have experience operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting tractors, sprayers, planters, plot combines, and related small-plot equipment, including loading, unloading, and trailering equipment, considered an asset. Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and the flexibility to adjust plans as situations arise while minimising impacts on data and production. Bring strong organisational, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment. jobs.name: Hybrid Wheat Technician (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF Are you an experienced technician with a passion for plant breeding, greenhouse work and innovative agricultural technologies? We invite you to join us as Hybrid Wheat Technician in Belgium. In this position, you will support BASF's Hybrid Wheat program by executing the Single Seed Descent (SSD) method for the female breeding pipeline and by contributing to innovative wheat breeding technologies. You will combine hands-on greenhouse and post-harvest activities with planning, documentation, data review and reporting, helping to shorten generation cycles and develop high-performing female parental lines. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Independently execute greenhouse activities for female line development, including growing, maintaining and evaluating plants and seed samples, monitoring plant growth, phenology and diseases, and applying speed cycling where feasible. Perform crosses, harvest plant material, process seed, and plan leaf or seed sampling for genotyping and Marker Assisted Selection. Manage the seed storage inventory and troubleshoot and maintain seed-processing equipment, including laboratory threshers and sorters. Share technical knowledge and supervise interims or seasonal workers for specific workflows. Plan and supervise plant growth protocols, seed processing and other greenhouse activities, materials and equipment to ensure timely delivery. Maintain accurate digital records covering plant development, crossing, harvest, seed processing, sampling and storage. Review, record, compile, summarize and report data according to company standards. Follow work instructions, standard operating procedures and safety requirements, and collaborate with local teams and other functions on operational, technical and safety topics. WHAT YOU OFFER At least three years of relevant experience in agriculture, biology or a related discipline, including experimental work. Good knowledge and understanding of greenhouse operations, plant growth, crop protection, agricultural and laboratory procedures, cereal breeding or applied plant research. Experience with crossing, spike harvest, seed processing and relevant equipment, combined with the mechanical aptitude to operate, troubleshoot and adapt equipment. Willingness to perform approximately 85% hands-on greenhouse and post-harvest work. Ability to carry out activities independently, collaborate in a diverse team and communicate effectively. Proficient computer skills for documentation, inventory management and reporting. A strong commitment to safe work practices, including the safe handling of chemicals. Good English and Dutch language skills. A valid Belgian phytolicense is considered an asset. WHAT WE OFFER A fixed-term contract for a period of two years within an attractive working environment in a professional and motivated team. A role with challenging assignments and responsibilities in an innovative hybrid wheat breeding program. Interesting learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your job. HOW TO REACH US If you need more information about the process or the vacancy, you can reach our recruiting team here . ABOUT US We are BASF in agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. We do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture by connecting innovation, customers and society. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth Take a look at our Agricultural Solutions: Vision & Mission Diversity is our greatest strength!
