jobs.name: Power Distribution Technician
jobs.description: Now hiring! Power Distribution Technician Freeport, TX We are looking for a Power Distribution Technician to join our NAF team in Freeport, TX. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. As a Power Distribution Technician, you will utilize your expertise in maintenance, operations, and contractor oversight to support the safe and reliable performance of electrical power systems at BASF's Freeport, Texas site. In this role, you will be responsible for the operation, maintenance, and preventive and predictive maintenance activities associated with the site's electrical power distribution, transmission, and generation equipment. During your shift as a Power Distribution Technician, you will Perform work safely within established qualifications and authorization limits, following BASF requirements, applicable OSHA regulations, and approved procedures, while participating in job planning, hazard reviews, job briefings, incident reviews, and continuous improvement activities. Operate, inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical distribution, transmission, and generation equipment, including substations, transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, batteries, chargers, grounding systems, and associated controls, while interpreting electrical diagrams, schematics, equipment drawings, and technical manuals. Support testing and troubleshooting of medium-voltage motors, starters, and associated control and protection systems, as well as inspect, maintain, test, and troubleshoot protective and monitoring relays and circuits, including alarm and trip investigations, event record retrieval, and verification of operation and approved settings in coordination with Engineering and qualified testing personnel. Prepare, review, and execute switching orders and isolation procedures, including electrical switching, isolation, lockout, equipment status verification, system phasing, and restoration, while issuing electrical work permits and coordinating equipment release and return to service after completing required site qualifications. Respond to electrical alarms, disturbances, equipment failures, and power interruptions through systematic troubleshooting to support safe and timely restoration, while performing routine substation inspections and preventive and predictive maintenance, identifying abnormal conditions, initiating corrective work orders, and maintaining accurate inspection, switching, maintenance, permit, equipment, and work order documentation. Participate in the on-call rotation after qualification and work overtime, nights, weekends, and holidays as required for outages and emergencies. Support equipment installation, testing, commissioning, planned outages, turnarounds, and capital projects, while providing field oversight and quality control for contractors, line crews, testing technicians, and service providers to ensure compliance with safe work practices, approved drawings, specifications, manufacturer recommendations, and project scope, as well as operating or developing the knowledge required to operate site electrical distribution control and SCADA systems. If you... Hold a High School Diploma or GED, along with 5 or more years of high-voltage/power distribution experience and/or a NETA Level II certification. Possess a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering Technology (BSEET), an Associate of Applied Science (A.A.S.) degree in Power/Electrical Technology, and/or a NETA Level III/IV certification, it is strongly preferred. Bring 10 or more years of experience in medium- and high-voltage power distribution, transmission, generation, electrical testing, and power distribution equipment commissioning, with experience troubleshooting and maintaining low-, medium-, and high-voltage circuit breakers, it is preferred. Have experience with electrical equipment testing methods, including an understanding of protective relays, AC/DC systems, electrical controls, schematics, one-line diagrams, and relay three-line diagrams. Are familiar with protective relay programming and communication networks, as well as applicable electrical codes and standards, including NESC, NEC, NFPA 70E, ANSI, and IEEE. Have experience with communications, data acquisition, and protective relay programming, along with the ability to read, modify, and interpret circuit breaker and protective relay control schematics, and familiarity with meter and relay one-line diagrams and electrical protection principles. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF . We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

The role performs daily and monthly Cost Center Accounting, Income Statement, Profitability Accounting, and Non-Trade activities, ensuring accurate expense distribution, financial data consistency, timely reporting, strong controls, and continuous process improvement across BASF group companies and businesses. Ensure consistency and accuracy of information between financial and management accounting modules. Review and analyze the correct allocation of monthly and annual income statement positions. About the Role: Responsible for driving Process Safety, Occupational Safety, and EHS compliance across the manufacturing facility by implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving safety systems, procedures, and practices. The role focuses on ensuring adherence to statutory requirements, managing process safety initiatives, conducting risk assessments, supporting Responsible Care implementation, and fostering a strong safety culture across plant operations. Acts as a key partner to Operations, Engineering, EHS, and Site Leadership teams to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing operations. How Will You Do It: Process Safety & Operational Excellence: Implement and monitor safety measures in accordance with site standards, company guidelines, and regulatory requirements. Identify operational and safety gaps and drive corrective and preventive actions. Establish and maintain safety procedures, standards, and best practices where required. Recommend risk mitigation measures to ensure safe and reliable plant operations. Support production planning by ensuring resources, risks, and operational requirements are properly managed. Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to process safety and operational excellence. Environment, Health & Safety (EHS): Coordinate with the Site EHS Manager to ensure implementation of changing statutory and regulatory requirements. Report accidents, incidents, near misses, and process safety events through GID and lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations. Ensure timely implementation and closure of corrective and preventive actions arising from incident investigations. Cascade safety learnings, best practices, and process safety information from BASF sites globally. Lead risk assessments and periodically review jobs and processes for potential hazards. Conduct and facilitate Design Safety Reviews, HAZOP studies, and other hazard assessments. Ensure process safety risks are identified and managed through the Management of Change (MOC) process. Conduct routine safety audits, safety conversations, and process safety reviews across the site. Maintain and update Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) in coordination with Engineering and Operations teams. Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, procedures, and legal requirements. Identify areas of non-compliance and implement systems to prevent recurrence. Support emergency preparedness and response planning initiatives. Training & Safety Culture Development: Conduct safety training programs for supervisors, operators, contractors, and workmen. Develop awareness programs to strengthen the site's safety culture. Assess training effectiveness through feedback, observations, and periodic evaluations. Align plant personnel towards common safety goals and proactive safety ownership. Encourage reporting of unsafe conditions and safety concerns. Promote a culture of continuous learning and safety accountability. Documentation & Compliance Management: Maintain plant inspection records and coordinate corrective actions with plant engineering and operations teams. Monitor action closures through field trackers and compliance monitoring systems. Ensure MOC documentation is properly reviewed, approved, and implemented. Periodically review safety procedures, records, and documentation for accuracy and compliance. Support preparation and submission of statutory compliance reports and documentation. Maintain Responsible Care and process safety-related records. Site Safety Leadership: Monitor E-Yellow Card actions and site action trackers. Act as the Site MOC Coordinator. Support site-wide safety awareness programs and campaigns. Participate as an active member of the Site Safety Committee (RCSD). Serve as Process Safety Code Champion for the site. Support emergency response preparedness and first-aid activities. Other Responsibilities: Drive Responsible Care implementation across designated plant areas. Coordinate with regional and global EHS teams for policy deployment and best-practice implementation. Support compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 50001 management systems. Drive continuous improvement projects related to process safety, compliance, and operational reliability. Support audits, assessments, and certification activities. Promote implementation of safety best practices across plant operations. What We Look For: Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering. Diploma in Industrial Safety preferred. Minimum 5 years of experience in Chemical Manufacturing, Operations, Process Engineering, Process Safety, or EHS. At least 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Plant Safety and Process Safety Management. Strong knowledge of HAZOP, Risk Assessment, Incident Investigation, MOC, and Process Safety Management systems. Sound knowledge of statutory safety requirements and compliance under the Factories Act. Experience with Responsible Care programs and EHS management systems. Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 50001 standards. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Proactive mindset with a focus on safety excellence and continuous improvement. Proficiency in MS Office applications. Strong reporting, documentation, and compliance management skills. Key Competencies: Core Competencies Act with Entrepreneurial Drive Communicate Effectively Collaborate Across Functions Customer Focus Leadership Competencies Developing Self and Others Diversity and Inclusion Accountability Building Trust Professional Competencies Process Safety Management Risk Assessment & Hazard Analysis Continuous Improvement Work Management Safety, Health & Environment Awareness Regulatory Compliance Incident Investigation & Root Cause Analysis Management of Change (MOC) Excellence Area of Responsibility: PU System House Plant Engineering Plastics Plant Additional site areas as defined in the approved site responsibility matrix.

Liderar el monitoreo y análisis integral del mercado mediante el seguimiento de áreas y tendencias de áreas de siembras, precios commodities y cosechas, competidores, clientes, tendencias de consumo, innovaciones, variables macroeconómicas y desempeño del negocio, anticipando cambios que puedan impactar la estrategia de la organización. jobs.name: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. Objectives of the Position Support end-to-end recruitment for the Global Business Services in the Global Hub. You are responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment processes, from building a sourcing strategy, candidates sourcing, interview scheduling, offer management and onboarding stages, while developing and managing strong relationships with key stakeholders. Continuously look for process improvements, automation, and digitalization measures to offer best service delivery experience. Responsibilities Operational Excellence Accountable for recruitment process from requisition management, candidate sourcing, selection process, offer management, pre-hiring activities, satisfaction survey, onboarding, personnel record creation and maintenance. Collaborate with multiple parties to develop and deliver recruitment strategy and framework suited for the service recipients. Support the talent pipeline processes through gathering of local market talent insights, managing sourcing/recruitment channels, creating internal candidate data pools, and supporting recruitment campaigns and marketing activities. Support internal / external candidate relocation (secondment, delegation, domestic relocation, repatriation etc) and coordinate all related activities to ensure smooth transition while in compliance with legal legislation. Build and maintain a pool of potential candidates, managing relationships with them to ensure a strong talent pipeline. Provide market insights and recommendations to improve sourcing strategies. Track and report key metrics, such as the number of candidates sourced, conversion rates, etc Process Improvement and Project Initiatives Identify process improvement, automation and digitalization opportunities, prepare business case and participate in digitalization and process optimization implementation. Continuously review and maintain knowledge documents in areas of expertise to develop the formation of competence hub. Requirements Education Minimum with bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related discipline. Working Experience With 5-8 years of end-to-end recruitment experience. Experience working in large, diverse teams and able to communicate with different levels. Exposure to diversity, equity and inclusion hiring practices. Proven experience in managing multiple complex requisitions, direct-sourcing and passive-candidate engagement capability.. Technical & Professional Knowledge Strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment, talent sourcing, market mapping, candidate assessment, offer management, and employment laws. Proficiency in ATS system (SuccessFactors, Workday) and sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search techniques, Naukri and other job portals). Ability to use recruitment data to monitor time-to-fill, sourcing conversion, interview conversion, offer acceptance and offer-to-join ratios. Fluent in spoken and written English. Knowledge of any other Asian languages will be an added advantage.

jobs.name: Accounting Officer
jobs.description:
Objectives of the position: The Accounting Officer performs local finance activities in Thailand that require in-country execution and cannot be fully transferred to the BPO provider. The role focuses on purchase-to-pay operations, employee expenses, accounts receivable support, withholding tax checks and VAT reconciliation support. The position acts as a key interface between local business teams, suppliers, customers, tax colleagues and the BPO provider. The Accounting Officer reports directly to the ASEAN Platform Finance Manager and supports accurate, timely and locally compliant finance operations. Core responsibilities: Purchase-to-Pay Operations Receive, organize and scan supplier invoices and supporting documents for processing. Perform an initial review of supplier invoices for completeness and compliance with local documentation and tax requirements. Assist the BPO provider with invoice validation and provide local clarification or supporting documents when required. Coordinate resolution of rejected, blocked or incomplete invoices with suppliers, business requestors and the BPO provider. Support payment processing, including payment documentation, payment status follow-up and urgent payment coordination when approved. Respond to routine supplier inquiries and support investigation of invoice or payment discrepancies. Support employee travel and expense reimbursement activities, including document checks, query resolution and coordination with the BPO provider. Accounts Receivable & Collection Support Provide customers with invoices, bill placement packages and other required supporting documents on a timely basis. Maintain appropriate records of bill placement and customer correspondence. Support routine follow-up with customers when payment reminders are required. Coordinate customer payment information and unresolved collection matters with the BPO provider, commercial teams and the ASEAN Platform Finance Manager. Support local administration of collection-related documentation, including tax receipts or other documents where applicable. Withholding Tax & Invoice Tax Review Review supplier invoices to identify the applicable withholding tax treatment. Check the tax code and withholding tax classification used for invoice processing. Coordinate correction of identified tax-code or withholding-tax issues with the BPO provider and relevant tax colleagues. Prepare and maintain supporting information required for accurate withholding tax reporting. Escalate unusual or unclear tax treatment to the Senior Accountant, tax colleagues or ASEAN Platform Finance Manager for technical assessment. VAT Reconciliation Support Assist the BPO provider P2P team with monthly input VAT reconciliation. Review supplier tax invoices and supporting documents for VAT-related completeness. Investigate differences between supplier invoices, accounting records and VAT reconciliation reports. Collect missing documents and coordinate corrections of identified VAT discrepancies. Maintain organized supporting documentation for VAT filings, audits and tax reviews. Escalate unresolved or material VAT issues to the responsible tax colleague and ASEAN Platform Finance Manager. Local Compliance, Controls & Process Support Maintain orderly filing and archiving of finance and tax documents in accordance with local requirements and company policy. Support internal controls relating to invoice processing, payments, employee expenses and tax documentation. Provide supporting documents for internal audit, external audit and tax review requests. Support transition, stabilization and continuous-improvement activities between the local team and BPO provider. Follow established approval authorities, segregation-of-duties requirements and escalation procedures. Professional and educational qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. At least 2 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, Employee Expenses or related accounting activities. Practical exposure to Thai VAT and withholding tax requirements. Experience working with a BPO provider is preferred. Experience in a multinational or manufacturing company is advantageous. Experience using SAP or another ERP system; SAP S/4HANA exposure is advantageous. Experience with invoice workflow tools is an advantage. Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and disciplined document management. Ability to review invoices and supporting documents accurately and identify exceptions. Strong communication skills in both Thai and English. Sufficient English proficiency to effectively collaborate with regional teams and external service providers. Strong attention to detail and commitment to compliant execution. Service-oriented communication with suppliers, employees, customers and internal stakeholders. Able to manage recurring deadlines and follow up proactively on open items. Comfortable working in a lean team with direct access to the ASEAN Platform Finance Manager. Collaborative mindset and willingness to support activities across P2P, O2C and tax processes. jobs.name: Gunsan EHS Specialist
jobs.description: Global chemical company BASF has been a key player in Korea since entering market in 1954. As a leading foreign company in Korea’s chemical industry, BASF operates eight large-scale production sites across the country. Additionally, the company runs advanced Performance Materials and Electronic Materials R&D Centers, along with two technical centers focused on Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE), Polyurethane, and Personal Care. In 2024, BASF records approximately € 1.1 billion in sales to customers in Korea and employed 1,240 people as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com . *Position summary: In accordance with applicable EHS legal requirements and BASF EHS standards and principles, effectively manage the site’s safety and occupational health management system and support compliance with relevant requirements. Systematically manage safety and health risks in the workplace and drive necessary preventive and improvement actions to protect employees’ safety and health and maintain a safe and healthy working environment. Perform statutory duties as the designated Safety Manager - Plan and manage site safety and health training programs - Plan and conduct site safety and health inspections - Manage contractor safety and health activities - Monitor and manage site EHS KPIs - Prepare and manage the Process Safety Management (PSM) program and related documentation - Support incident investigations and recurrence prevention activities across departments - Manage site occupational health activities in collaboration with the external occupational health service provider - Coordinate and manage employee health examinations - Manage permits, regulatory requirements, and liaison activities with the Ministry of Employment and Labor (MOEL) - jobs.name: Yeosu AEM Production Manager
jobs.description: BASF has been a committed partner to Korea since 1954. As a leading foreign investor in the chemical industry in Korea, BASF operates eight world-scale production sites in the country. The company also maintains the Electronic Materials R&D Center in Suwon. In addition, one R&D center for advanced Performance Materials solutions and two technical development centers are located across Korea. In 2023, BASF posted sales of approximately € 1.3 billion to customers in Korea and employed 1,209 employees as of the end of the year. Further information is available on www.basf.com . *Position summary: The AEM Production Manager is responsible for planning, directing, coordinating, and controlling all production-related activities to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective manufacturing operations. Reporting to the Plant Manager, this role oversees production planning, material management, maintenance coordination, project execution, people development, and EHSQ compliance to meet business and customer requirements. AEM 생산과장은 안전하고 효율적이며 비용 경쟁력 있는 생산 운영을 보장하기 위해 생산 관련 모든 활동을 계획, 지휘, 조정 및 관리할 책임이 있습니다. 공장장에게 보고하며, 사업 및 고객 요구사항을 충족하기 위해 생산 계획, 자재 관리, 유지보수 조정, 프로젝트 수행, 인력 개발 및 EHSQ 준수를 총괄합니다. *Main Tasks of Production Manager: 1. Production Planning & Operations -Develop and execute production plans based on sales forecasts, customer requirements, and R&D demands. -Ensure production targets, product quality, delivery commitments, and cost objectives are achieved. 1. 생산 계획 및 운영 - 판매 예측, 고객 요구사항 및 R&D 수요를 바탕으로 생산 계획을 수립하고 실행합니다. - 생산 목표, 제품 품질, 납기 약속 및 비용 목표 달성을 보장합니다. 2. Manufacturing Performance Management -Monitor daily manufacturing performance and identify improvement opportunities. -Conduct routine plant inspections and implement corrective and preventive actions. -Drive operational excellence initiatives to improve productivity, reliability, and efficiency. -Manage production budgets and support cost optimization initiatives. 2. 생산 성과 관리 - 일일 생산 성과를 모니터링하고 개선 기회를 파악합니다. - 정기적인 공장 점검을 실시하고 시정 및 예방 조치를 이행합니다. - 생산성, 신뢰성 및 효율성 향상을 위한 운영 우수성 활동을 추진합니다. - 생산 예산을 관리하고 비용 최적화 활동을 지원합니다. 3. Material & Inventory Management -Manage raw material planning, inventory control, procurement coordination, and material availability. -Ensure accurate production and material data management through SAP and MES systems. 3. 자재 및 재고 관리 - 원자재 계획, 재고 관리, 구매 조정 및 자재 수급을 관리합니다. - SAP 및 MES 시스템을 통해 정확한 생산 및 자재 데이터 관리를 보장합니다. 4. Maintenance & Reliability -Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities to maximize equipment reliability and plant availability. -Support troubleshooting and resolution of operational and technical issues. 4. 유지보수 및 신뢰성 - 설비 신뢰성과 공장 가동률을 극대화하기 위해 예방 및 사후 유지보수 활동을 조정합니다. - 운영 및 기술 문제의 트러블슈팅과 해결을 지원합니다. 5. People Management -Provide technical leadership, coaching, and training to production personnel. -Foster a strong safety culture and promote continuous improvement practices. -Conduct first-level performance evaluations for operators and support employee development. 5. 인력 관리 - 생산 인력에게 기술적 리더십, 코칭 및 교육을 제공합니다. - 강한 안전 문화를 조성하고 지속적인 개선 활동을 촉진합니다. - 오퍼레이터에 대한 1차 성과평가를 실시하고 직원 역량 개발을 지원합니다. 6. Capital Projects & Plant Modifications -Lead plant expansion and modification projects. -Coordinate with engineering teams, contractors, equipment suppliers, and service providers. -Support equipment selection, project execution, commissioning, and startup activities. 6. 자본 프로젝트 및 공장 변경 - 공장 증설 및 변경 프로젝트를 주도합니다. - 엔지니어링팀, 도급업체, 설비 공급업체 및 서비스 제공업체와 협업합니다. - 설비 선정, 프로젝트 수행, 시운전 및 가동 개시 활동을 지원합니다. 7. EHSQ (Environment, Health, Safety & Quality) Management -Ensure full compliance with BASF requirements, local regulations, and applicable international standards. -Lead implementation of EHSQ programs, procedures, and improvement initiatives. -Manage risk assessments, Management of Change (MOC), emergency response preparedness, and safety inspections. -Review and maintain SOPs, operating manuals, work procedures, and ISO-related documentation. 7. EHSQ(환경·보건·안전·품질) 관리 - BASF 요구사항, 국내 법규 및 적용 가능한 국제 표준의 완전한 준수를 보장합니다. - EHSQ 프로그램, 절차 및 개선 활동의 실행을 주도합니다. - 위험성 평가, 변경관리(MOC), 비상대응 준비 및 안전점검을 관리합니다. - SOP, 운전 매뉴얼, 작업 절차 및 ISO 관련 문서를 검토하고 유지 관리합니다. *Education/Qualifications required: -Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline. -Minimum 4 years of experience in a chemical manufacturing plant environment. -Strong knowledge of production operations, manufacturing processes, and EHS requirements. -Strong problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional coordination skills. *필수 학력/자격요건: - 화학공학, 화학 또는 관련 기술 분야 학사 학위 - 화학 제조공장 환경에서 최소 4년 이상의 경력 - 생산 운영, 제조 공정 및 EHS 요구사항에 대한 높은 이해도 - 우수한 문제해결, 리더십 및 부서 간 협업 역량 *Competencies required: -Experience in CAPEX project management, process safety management (PSM) -Knowledge of Management of Change (MOC), risk assessment, and operational excellence methodologies. -Proficiency in English communication. * 필수 역량: - CAPEX 프로젝트 관리 및 공정안전관리(PSM) 경험 - 변경관리(MOC), 위험성 평가 및 운영 우수성 방법론에 대한 지식 *Special Requirements if any: 1.Hazardous Materials Industrial Engineer certification preferred 2.Professional Engineer Chemical Engineering preferred 3.Professional Engineer Industrial Safety certification preferred *우대사항: - 위험물산업기사 자격증 소지자 우대 - 화공기술사 자격증 소지자 우대 - 산업안전기사 자격증 소지자 우대 - 영어 의사소통 가능자 우대 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 개별통지하며, 제출하신 서류는 일체 반환하지 않습니다. 입사지원서 내용에 허위사실이 판명될 경우 입사가 취소될 수 있습니다. 국가보훈대상자와 신체장애자는 관련서류 제출시 관계법에 따라 우대합니다. 취업지원대상자 증명서 (제출처 : 한국바스프 반드시 기입) 발급받은 후 입사서류와 함께 제출하여야 가점 부여 가능합니다.

jobs.description:
Sobre a Surventis A Surventis é uma empresa química global especializada em revestimentos industriais, soluções para tratamento de superfícies e tecnologias para os setores automotivo e industrial. Com mais de 10 mil colaboradores em todo o mundo e presença em mais de 140 países, a empresa atua desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras que protegem, melhoram e valorizam superfícies, atendendo clientes por meio de marcas reconhecidas como Chemetall, Glasurit e R-M Descrição da vaga Estamos buscando um(a) Estagiário de Recursos Humanos para apoiar nos processos da área. Se você é estudante e tem interesse nessa área, queremos conhecer você! Principais responsabilidades: Apoiar os processos de admissão, desligamento e integração de colaboradores Realizar a administração e compra de benefícios Apoiar os processos de folha de pagamento e gestão de ponto Conduzir etapas de Recrutamento e Seleção, incluindo alinhamento de perfil, divulgação, triagem e entrevistas Elaborar e acompanhar indicadores de RH Realizar controles, conferências e envio de documentações de colaboradores e clientes Atender e acompanhar demandas de colaboradores Apoiar auditorias e processos de mudanças organizacionais Apoiar ações de comunicação interna e conteúdos de RH Requisitos obrigatórios: Ensino Superior cursando em recursos humanos, administração ou correlatas Benefícios: Plano de Saúde SulAmérica Plano Odontológico SulAmérica Iniciativas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida Wellhub (Gympass) Refeição no local Vale transporte Seguro de vida Venha fazer parte do nosso time! jobs.description: Now hiring! Agricultural Biologist Research Triangle Park, North Carolina. We are looking for an Agricultural Biologist to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Research Triangle Park, NC. In this role, you will work closely with team members to plan and carry out greenhouse, growth chamber, and laboratory experiments that support the development of new herbicide products and provide market support for commercial products. You will be responsible for day-to-day activities required to successfully conduct assigned greenhouse/lab studies supporting  projects across North America. You'll lead your own projects while actively collaborating with colleagues to achieve shared goals and drive collective success. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Agricultural Biologist, you create chemistry by... Designing and executing herbicidal research on new active ingredients and new product concepts, special problem-solving projects, and providing off-season support activities. Propagating and maintaining greenhouse plants; planning, coordinating, and managing greenhouse and laboratory herbicide trials; collecting, analyzing, and reporting data; preparing formal reports and delivering occasional presentations. Developing trial methodologies and protocols and providing recommendations for further research work or product use patterns. Identifying and pursuing opportunities to add value to products in the marketplace and/or R&D projects at the regional and global level. Providing technical support to Marketing, Sales, and external customers through information, materials, training, and presentations. Collaborating within a multidisciplinary team; supervising and training temporary staff or interns. Managing Responsible Care (RC) Program components, including chemical inventory and genetic resources; contribute to JSA/SOP development and train personnel on safe practices. If you... Have a MS or BS degree in Agricultural field. Have a MS degree with less to 1 year of relevant greenhouse or field experience or a BS degree with 3-5 years of relevant greenhouse or field experience. Demonstrate applied experience and knowledge of agronomic practices and crop protection research methods. Exhibit strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with an ability to communicate research results. Demonstrate practical knowledge of computers and software necessary for communication, data collection / analysis and knowledge sharing (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams). Experience with ARM Software, preferred. Display hands-on experience propagating and managing weed species and crops and conducting herbicide trials in greenhouse settings, preferred. Have knowledge of weed identification, herbicide chemistry and research design, preferred. Have experience conducting herbicide resistant screening trials in a greenhouse setting, preferred. Possess knowledge of North American crop production including corn, soybean, cotton, rice, and wheat, preferred. Are able to travel less than 5% of the time, domestically. Estamos buscando un(a) Gerente de Planta ED Altamira . Tendrá como objetivo administrar y dirigir el proceso productivo y recurso humano de la planta de Dispersiones asegurando la implementación y seguimiento de las estrategias e iniciativas globales y regionales del negocio de ED con la finalidad de cumplir con los objetivos de producción y costo, garantizando el cumplimiento de las políticas de seguridad y calidad, dentro de un clima laboral propicio que fomente la excelencia operativa y mejora continua. En este rol, estarás a cargo de: Dirigir el proceso de producción de la planta de Dispersiones poliméricas con la finalidad de proveer a los clientes del negocio de ED Norteamérica con productos de acuerdo con las especificaciones de calidad y en el tiempo solicitado. Asegurar la operación de la planta de Dispersiones de acuerdo con los lineamientos Globales y Corporativos de seguridad de BASF, la normatividad mexicana y el concepto de seguridad específico para el negocio de ED Global con el objetivo de lograr una cultura de cero incidentes en seguridad. Dirigir y asegurar el proceso de Aseguramiento de Calidad, manteniendo la imparcialidad y autonomía de los resultados, con el objetivo de mantener los estándares de calidad de nuestros productos. Desarrollar y ejecutar el roadmap de Digitalización de Planta, de acuerdo con el Plan BASF 4.0 para establecer estrategias que permitan alcanzar los objetivos de automatización establecidos por el Negocio. Asegurar el cumplimiento a los sistemas de Gestión de Calidad Corporativos a través de la administración de las actividades y cumplimiento a la normativa tanto internas como externas referentes al cumplimiento de Gestión de Calidad. Asegurar la ejecución del proceso de desarrollo de talento y planes de sucesión para el personal empleado y el proceso de Equipos de Alto Desempeño (EADs) para el personal sindicalizado, con la finalidad de soportar las estrategias del sitio Altamira y del negocio de ED Norteamérica. Asegurar la introducción de nuevos productos de acuerdo con los lineamientos de tecnología del negocio de ED con la finalidad de proveer soporte en el desarrollo de nuevos productos al negocio de ED México y Norteamérica. Dirigir la optimización de los procesos productivos (OpEx) a través del uso de herramientas de mejora continua con la finalidad de reducir el costo de manufactura de la planta y con ello contribuir a incrementar los márgenes de contribución al negocio de ED. Cumplir con las políticas, procedimientos y practicas aplicables en materia de responsabilidad Integral durante el desempeño de sus funciones con el objetivo de preservar la salud y seguridad propia y de los demás y prevenir cualquier afectación al medio ambiente. Cumplir con las políticas, procedimientos y prácticas aplicables en materia de Responsabilidad Integral durante el desempeño de sus funciones, con el objetivo de preservar la salud y seguridad propia y de los demás, prevenir cualquier afectación al medio ambiente y continuar con la operación del negocio de forma sustentable. Si cuentas con: Formación Universitaria completa en ingeniería química, industrial o similar. Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en: Producción en la Industria Química Gerencia y operaciones de planta Liderazgo de equipos (jefaturas y referentes de áreas) Seguridad Industrial y Procesos Aseguramiento de Calidad Habilidades de comunicación, liderazgo y desarrollo de personas, trabajo en equipo, stakeholder management y mejora continua. Estamos buscando un(a) Analista de EHS para San Luis Potosí. Tendrá como objetivo ejecutar y dar seguimiento a los programas de Seguridad, Ecología, Salud e Higiene Industrial del sitio SLP, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares BASF, los requisitos legales aplicables y los procedimientos internos mediante actividades de campo, inspecciones, auditorías, capacitación y seguimiento a acciones correctivas, contribuyendo al fortalecimiento de la cultura de seguridad y al cumplimiento de los objetivos de EHS del sitio. En este rol, estarás a cargo de: Ejecutar inspecciones y recorridos de seguridad, higiene y medio ambiente en las áreas operativas, identificando condiciones y actos inseguros y dando seguimiento a acciones correctivas. Gestionar y dar seguimiento al cumplimiento de ISO 9001, IATF 16949, Responsable Care y demás sistemas de gestión aplicables a EHS, así como de la Normativa Mexicana aplicable y requisitos legales federales, estatales y municipales, asegurando la gestión y vigencia de permisos, licencias, autorizaciones y demás trámites regulatorios necesarios para mantener el cumplimiento legal y contribuir a la continuidad del negocio. Realizar la investigación de incidentes y accidentes (AIM), así como en nuevos proyectos y procesos de Manejo de Cambio (MoC) del sitio, con el objetivo de identificar la causa raíz, realizar análisis de riesgo y dar seguimiento oportuno a las acciones derivadas. Asimismo, proporcionar recomendaciones técnicas de EHS durante la revisión de proyectos en sus distintas fases, a fin de identificar, documentar, eliminar y gestionar los riesgos, garantizando operaciones seguras mediante el uso de análisis cuantitativos de riesgo y promoviendo diseños seguros. Verificar el cumplimiento del sistema de permisos de trabajo mediante la revisión documental, validación en campo de las condiciones autorizadas, ejecución de auditorías de cumplimiento y seguimiento a desviaciones detectadas; asimismo, mantener actualizados los registros e indicadores (KPI's) asociados al proceso, elaborando reportes periódicos para asegurar la mejora continua y la reducción de riesgos en las actividades críticas del sitio. Administrar y revisar el programa de seguridad a contratistas, a través de la actualización de base de datos, capacitación, definición de actividades y KPI´s a medir, con el fin de garantizar que todo el personal contratistas conozca y actúe de acuerdo con los aspectos de EHS mientras se encuentren laborando dentro de las instalaciones de BASF Mexicana. Participar activamente en el programa interno de ERP mediante la identificación y reporte de comportamientos inseguros, condiciones de riesgo y barreras para la ejecución segura de las actividades, promoviendo la implementación de acciones preventivas y correctivas que fortalezcan la cultura de seguridad y reduzcan la probabilidad de incidentes en el sitio. Ejecutar programas de Higiene Industrial mediante la realización de monitoreos, inspecciones y evaluaciones de exposición a ruido, iluminación, vibración, calor y agentes químicos; dar seguimiento a las acciones de control derivadas, verificar que los controles de ingeniería, administrativos y de protección personal sean adecuados y efectivos, y asegurar la disponibilidad y uso correcto del equipo de protección personal requerido para cada actividad. Mantener actualizados los procedimientos, instructivos y estándares internos de EHS conforme a las modificaciones y nuevos requerimientos corporativos de Norteamérica, asegurando su oportuna implementación en el sitio; asimismo, verificar mediante auditorías, inspecciones y seguimiento en campo la correcta ejecución y cumplimiento de los procedimientos vigentes por parte del personal y contratistas. Administrar y asegurar el cumplimiento de la matriz de capacitación de EHS, coordinando la ejecución de entrenamientos, monitoreando el avance de cumplimiento mediante indicadores (KPI's), manteniendo evidencia documental actualizada y dando seguimiento a desviaciones o vencimientos. Administrar y fortalecer el Programa de Preparación y Respuesta a Emergencias según la NOM-002-STPS-2010, garantizando la preparación y capacidad de respuesta de las brigadas de Combate Contra Incendios, Primeros Auxilios, Búsqueda y Rescate, y Evacuación y Repliegue, mediante programas de capacitación y entrenamiento, inspecciones de equipos de emergencia, simulacros y ejercicios periódicos, evaluación del desempeño y seguimiento a acciones de mejora, asegurando una respuesta coordinada y efectiva ante situaciones de emergencia. Coordinar y dar seguimiento a la programación de los monitoreos ambientales del sitio aplicables según la NOM-085-SEMARNAT-2011 y NOM-043-SEMARNAT-1993, asegurando la ejecución oportuna de los estudios requeridos. Si cuentas con: Titulación en ingeniería química, ambiental o similares con experiencia relevante para el rol. 2-3 años de experiencia en: Gestión de Programas de Seguridad Ocupacional, Higiene Industrial y medio ambiente. Gestión de Programas de Seguridad de Procesos (Process Safety). Gestión de Programas de Respuesta a Emergencias. Conocimiento en legislación y normatividad en materia de EHS. Conocimiento en estándares internacionales en materia de EHS. Metodología de Análisis de Riesgos. Nivel de inglés intermedio o superior. jobs.name: Maintenance Administrator & Store Keeper
jobs.description: General Purpose: Perform administrative duties, including documentation management and data control for the Maintenance Department. Manage and coordinate warehouse/storekeeping operations within the Maintenance Department. Main Responsibility: EHS & Process Safety related: Comply and follow all EHS regulations Work safely and comply with all applicable Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) policies, procedures, and regulations established by PT BASF Indonesia, Merak Site Maintenance related: Prepare, organize, and maintain maintenance documentation in compliance with ISO 9001 requirements. Perform administrative and documentation activities related to material requisition requests (PR), purchase orders (PO), goods receipt processes, and related transactions. Maintain and control spare parts inventory stored in the Maintenance warehouse. Monitor and control spare parts availability for Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) and Mechanical equipment. Provide administrative and operational support to Maintenance Technicians in equipment repair, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and reliability improvement activities. Ensure the accuracy of maintenance records, inventory data, and supporting documentation. Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure timely procurement and availability of maintenance materials and spare parts.

jobs.name: Real Estate Data and Technology Specialist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT We in Agricultural Solutions are preparing to be an independent, pure-play agricultural company within BASF group. To be ready for independence, we are looking for you to join us in our new Corporate roles (see here: Build Your Career on Our Standalone Transformation ). In your new role, you own and continuously improve real estate master data across multiple systems, ensuring reliable availability for business users. You define, implement and monitor data governance standards, data quality controls and validation routines and coordinate data validation, cleansing and harmonization activities across regions and business units. Moreover, you develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs and management reports and analyze portfolio performance, occupancy trends, workplace utilization and sustainability-related data. You translate complex data into actionable insights for portfolio optimization, workplace strategy, forecasting and strategic planning. Furthermore, you manage and optimize real estate technology platforms, databases and digital tools, including facility, lease and property management systems, and lead system implementations, enhancements, upgrades, integrations and data migrations in collaboration with IT. You identify and implement automation, standardization, advanced analytics and AI-enabled solutions. In addition, you act as the central interface between Real Estate, IT, Finance, Procurement and other business stakeholders and manage external technology vendors and digital solution providers to support effective service delivery. Last but not least, you support global projects, system rollouts and process changes through user support, training and change management. WHAT YOU OFFER successfully completed bachelor’s or master’s degree in real estate, business administration, information systems, data science or a comparable field as well as several years of experience in corporate real estate, data management, business intelligence, digital transformation or a technology-related function profound expertise in data governance, master data management, analytics, KPI reporting and process improvement experience with integrated workplace management, lease management or property management systems, SAP RE-FX or comparable applications as well as confident use of reporting and analytics tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SAP or similar solutions good understanding of real estate portfolio, lease, workplace, occupancy and asset management data experience in project management, stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration as well as the ability to gather, structure and translate business requirements into practical reporting, analytics and technology solutions strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, attention to data quality and a structured way of working, combined with a collaborative mindset and confidence working with global, regional and local stakeholders excellent English communication skills and the ability to explain complex data and technology topics in clear business language as well as a passion for innovation, digital transformation and continuous improvement WHAT WE OFFER A high-impact role at the intersection of corporate real estate, data and technology. The opportunity to shape digital transformation, data quality and reporting standards across the real estate function. Broad exposure to portfolio, lease, occupancy, workplace, asset and sustainability-related data. Close collaboration with Real Estate, IT, Finance, Procurement and other cross-functional stakeholders. Involvement in global initiatives covering workplace management, portfolio optimization and technology enhancement. The opportunity to act as a subject matter expert for real estate data structures, reporting standards and KPI definitions. An environment that encourages innovation, automation, advanced analytics and emerging technologies. A role that combines strategic thinking with hands-on system, reporting and process improvement work. The opportunity to build practical solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, compliance and decision-making. The ability to influence how data and technology support the future of corporate real estate. HOW TO REACH US Isabel Maisack (isabel.maisack@basf.com) will be happy to answer your questions for this position. ABOUT US Find out more about BASF Agricultural Solutions here. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: Material Handler
jobs.description: Now hiring! Material Handler Spartanburg, SC (On-site) Starting pay rate is $24.00 hourly | Overtime pay eligibility We are looking for a Material Handler to join our Care Chemicals team in Spartanburg, SC. Come create chemistry with us! BASF’s Care Chemicals division is a globally leading supplier to the cosmetics, detergents and cleaning industries. We also offer solutions for technical applications and crop protection. Together with our customers, we create innovative solutions to meet the current and future needs of society more sustainably. We contribute to the long-term success of our customers’  brands with a broad range of products and concepts via our global network of production and development sites. As a Material Handler for the White Stone Surfactants plant (SC), you will be responsible for all aspects of personal safety, product quality, and handling of inbound raw materials and outbound finished products. Common daily job tasks of the role include the following: receipt and unloading of raw materials, loading and shipping of finished product, operating a fork truck to transfer material, and performing housekeeping items. This role will work 14 out of 28 days in a 12-hour rotating shift. jobs.name: Regional Key Account Manager,EV,Tokyo
jobs.description: Regional Key Account Manager,EV,Tokyo O bjectives of the Position Drive profitable and sustainable growth of the Lubricant Components business at assigned Global accounts (GAs) and regional key accounts (RKAs) in line with agreed sales targets and KPIs. Manage assigned key accounts in a global context , ensuring effective coordination across regions and countries . Understand the customer’s global organization, decision-making structures, strategic priorities and business footprint, and translate these into coordinated regional and cross-regional account strategies and actions. Develop and execute strategic Key Account Management plans , identifying growth opportunities, customer priorities, competitive dynamics, and actions to strengthen long-term customer partnerships in a global context. Build a strong understanding of customer needs, industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging business models , translating market insights into account strategies and new business opportunities. Manage the commercial performance of assigned accounts, including sales planning, budgeting, profitability, working capital, and risk management , with proactive recommendations and corrective actions. Lead commercial negotiations and influence stakeholders at different organizational levels, both internally and externally, to achieve mutually beneficial and sustainable business outcomes. Mobilize and guide cross-functional and cross-regional account teams , ensuring clear priorities, effective execution, and alignment around key account objectives. Ensure disciplined execution of relevant business processes, governance, and account management standards , while independently resolving issues within the position's area of expertise. M ain Tasks 1. Sales Planning & Performance Management Develop and execute annual and mid-term business plans for assigned regional key accounts, covering sales, profitability, volume, inventory/working capital and agreed KPIs. Provide reliable sales forecasts and monitor actual performance against budget and targets. Identify performance gaps, business risks and opportunities, and develop concrete countermeasures and growth actions. Manage pricing, commercial conditions and product/customer mix to support sustainable and profitable growth. Coordinate demand planning and business priorities with internal stakeholders across the region. 2. Strategic Key Account Management Develop, maintain and regularly update Key Account Plans for assigned strategic customers. Define account objectives, growth priorities, customer strategies, opportunity pipelines and action plans. Establish a coordinated global approach to customers operating across multiple regions and countries, ensuring alignment on commercial strategy, positioning and priorities. Coordinate local Account Managers and relevant functions to execute agreed account strategies and actions. Monitor implementation of the Key Account Plan and adapt priorities based on business performance and changing customer/market needs. 3. Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management Build and maintain strong, sustainable relationships with key decision makers, influencers and relevant functions within assigned accounts. Establish appropriate multi-level customer contacts across commercial, procurement, technical and management functions. Act as a key interface for strategic and complex commercial topics, coordinating internal resources when required. Lead commercial negotiations and manage customer issues independently within defined responsibilities. Strengthen BASF's position from a transactional supplier toward a strategic solution partner with key customers. 4. Business Development & Opportunity Management Identify and develop new business opportunities, applications and projects within existing and potential strategic accounts. Build and manage a healthy opportunity pipeline and drive projects from identification through customer qualification toward commercialization. Work closely with Technical Service, Marketing, Product Management and other relevant functions to develop customer-specific solutions. Leverage Lubricant Components portfolio knowledge, market expertise and customer relationships to create new projects and uncover unmet customer needs. Proactively identify opportunities for cross-selling and broader portfolio penetration within strategic accounts. 5. Market & Competitive Intelligence Continuously monitor lubricant market trends, customer developments, competitors, technologies and industry dynamics relevant to assigned accounts. Understand changes in customer strategies, sourcing models, formulation trends, regulatory requirements and regional market dynamics. Translate market and customer intelligence into account-level opportunities, risks and strategic actions. Share relevant market intelligence internally to support regional business and portfolio decisions. 6. Strategy Development & Regional Coordination Manage the broader global context of assigned key accounts, including customers with international operations that require cross-regional coordination. Proactively coordinate with global and regional counterparts to align customer strategy, commercial priorities, opportunities and actions across markets. Analyze customer, market and competitive developments to contribute to mid-term account and industry strategies. Facilitate internal alignment across Sales, Technical Service, Marketing, Product Management, Supply Chain and other relevant functions. 7. Cross-functional Team Leadership Lead and motivate cross-functional/cross-region/country account teams toward agreed customer and business objectives. Define clear priorities, responsibilities and follow-up actions for account team members. Provide guidance and commercial direction to colleagues involved in regional key account activities. Facilitate effective knowledge sharing and collaboration across countries and functions. Where applicable, support the development of sales and account-management capabilities of team members. 8. Commercial Governance & Risk Management Ensure key account activities comply with established commercial processes, contractual requirements and internal governance. Monitor working capital, payment conditions, inventory exposure and other commercial risks related to assigned accounts. Escalate significant business risks with clear assessment and recommended actions. Maintain appropriate documentation of account strategies, opportunities, customer agreements and key commercial decisions. M inimum Education and Qualification Required for the Position Working Experience >5 years in sales, Chemical, lubricant or fuel industry experience preferable Skillset ; Chemistry, English reading, writing & verbal communication, basic Computer Excel, Word PPT etc. Business-level proficiency in both English and Japanese.

Wir sind ein international erfolgreiches Unternehmen der BASF-Gruppe. Unsere Lösungen sind speziell für verschiedene landwirtschaftliche Anbausysteme entwickelt. Sie verbinden Saatgut und speziell gezüchtete Pflanzeneigenschaften, Pflanzenschutzprodukte, digitale Tools und Nachhaltigkeitsansätze. Mit Teams im Labor, auf dem Feld, im Büro und in der Produktion arbeiten wir daran, Landwirten, Züchtern und anderen Interessengruppen entlang der Wertschöpfungskette bestmögliche Ergebnisse zu bieten. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Hier erfährst du mehr über unsere Vision bei BASF Agricultural Solutions ! WAS DICH ERWARTET In unserer C-API Einheit bist du die maßgebliche Instanz für Cybersicherheit im Bereich Agricultural Solutions. Du legst die Sicherheitsstrategie, -standards und -governance im Einklang mit den Anforderungen von AP und der BASF-Gruppe fest, trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für die Cyberrisikolage und triffst die Entscheidungen, wenn Sicherheits- und Geschäftsprioritäten miteinander kollidieren. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere digitalen Produkte, Plattformen und Infrastruktur von Grund auf sicher und im Betrieb widerstandsfähig sind, und arbeitest mit der Cyber-Organisation, den Plattformverantwortlichen und unseren Partnern zusammen, um dies unternehmensweit umzusetzen. In deiner neuen Position entwickelst du gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholder:innen die Cyber- und Informationssicherheitsstrategie für Agricultural Solutions weiter und übersetzt sie in ein ganzheitliches Framework aus Governance, Standards, Richtlinien, Kontrollen und klaren Verantwortlichkeiten im Einklang mit Geschäftsanforderungen, regulatorischen Vorgaben sowie den Anforderungen der BASF-Gruppe. Gemeinsam mit der Cyber-Organisation, Plattform- und Digital-Product-Ownern sowie unseren Technologiepartnern gestaltest du ein wirksames Security Operating Model und unterstützt Security by Design sowie Zero-Trust-Prinzipien über Anwendungen, Cloud, Infrastruktur, Netzwerke und digitale Produkte hinweg; dabei behältst du auch Identity & Access Management, Privileged Access Management und den Schutz sensibler Informationen im Blick. jobs.name: Information Security Officer (CISO) in Agricultural Solutions (m/f/d)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we are connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our C-API unit you are the cyber security authority for Agricultural Solutions. You set the security strategy, standards and governance in line with AP and BASF Group requirements, own the overall cyber risk position and make the calls when security and business priorities collide. You make sure that our digital products, platforms and infrastructure are secure by design and resilient in operation, and you work through the cyber organisation, the platform owners and our partners to deliver that across the whole business. In your new role, you shape and continuously develop the cyber and information security strategy for Agricultural Solutions together with relevant stakeholders and translate it into a comprehensive framework of governance, standards, policies, controls and clear responsibilities aligned with business needs, regulatory requirements and BASF Group requirements. Together with the cyber organization, platform and digital product owners and our technology partners, you develop an effective security operating model and foster security-by-design and zero-trust principles across applications, cloud environments, infrastructure, networks and digital products, while providing direction for identity and access management, privileged access management and information protection. In close collaboration with the relevant teams, you guide enterprise cyber risk management and create transparency around risks, controls, security KPIs and compliance; at the same time, you strengthen cyber defense, threat detection, vulnerability management and incident response and provide senior-level guidance for coordinated containment, recovery and learning during major security incidents. You contribute to holistic business resilience by connecting cyber security with business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management and by working closely with manufacturing, engineering and operations colleagues to establish appropriate protection for OT, production environments, connected systems and IT/OT interfaces. Together with digital, data, legal, procurement and business stakeholders, you enable the secure use of AI, cloud technologies, automation and digital ecosystems, strengthen third-party and supply-chain cyber risk management, and align security investments, external partnerships and the development of the cyber organization with risk reduction and sustainable business value. WHAT YOU OFFER a master's degree in computer science, information security, engineering or a comparable field; a recognized security certification such as CISSP or CISM is an advantage extensive professional experience in information and cyber security, including several years in a security leadership role within a complex, international enterprise environment in-depth knowledge of security governance and risk frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST, combined with experience in security operations, incident response and securing cloud, OT and outsourced service environments business-fluent English; German or Spanish language skills are an advantage appreciative and clear communication, empathy and a collaborative mindset, combined with the ability to assess complex risks thoughtfully in challenging situations and communicate them clearly to senior management enthusiasm for providing orientation, supporting the development of people and teams, as well as fostering an open, learning-oriented and responsible security culture together with colleagues WHAT WE OFFER A dynamic work environment that empowers you to contribute your ideas, take ownership, and assume responsibility. A strong focus on continuous learning, modern technologies, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence, enabling us to work in a future‑oriented, efficient, and sustainable way while actively driving innovation. Inspiring networks for the development and implementation of your ideas (e.g. Women in Business). Learning opportunities for your professional and personal development. Career paths as professional development into other roles within the company. We actively support with childcare (e.g. company daycare, holiday programmes) and provide a fitness and health studio as well as a medical center with numerous offers for your health. We offer sustainable mobility benefits - a discounted Deutschlandticket for regional public transport, a job‑bike leasing program, and on‑site e‑charging stations for private electric vehicles to make your commute affordable, healthy, and climate‑friendly. HOW TO REACH US Lennart Boudgoust (Talent Acquisition), lennart.boudgoust@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56521 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are also welcome to book an appointment online. Technical questions cannot be answered at this meeting. You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here ABOUT US BASF Agricultural Solutions Deutschland GmbH is a reliable partner to the agricultural sector, offering innovative and sustainable solutions tailored to a wide range of crop systems. With the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof, near the BASF Group headquarters in Ludwigshafen, you’ll find an attractive environment for both your professional life and your leisure time in the Rhine‑Neckar metropolitan region. You can learn more about the Agricultural Center in Limburgerhof here . Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we are connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. #ForTheLoveOfFarming#TheBiggestJobOnEarth#AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! In your new position, you lead and execute national and international real estate transactions across the EMEA region, including acquisitions, disposals, lease negotiations, lettings, and property valuations, while ensuring full alignment with the corporate real estate strategy. Together with your colleagues, you manage and coordinate cross-regional real estate projects with a strong focus on headquarters requirements, overseeing implementation and steering external consultants, brokers, property managers, and additional service providers. Furthermore, you negotiate commercial, lease, purchase, and service agreements, conduct in-depth financial analyses and property valuations, and prepare high-quality decision papers and recommendations for senior management based on established methodologies. Your expertise is in demand! You ensure high-quality real estate data management, maintain accurate reporting and portfolio documentation, monitor relevant KPIs, and contribute to compliance with internal governance standards. Not least, you support the continuous development and optimization of the corporate real estate portfolio by identifying value-creation opportunities and contributing to long-term occupancy, investment, and workplace strategies, including modern office concepts. jobs.name: People Leadership and Organizational Capability
jobs.description: Now hiring! Site Maintenance Director - Freeport, TX We are looking for a Site Maintenance Director  to join our  team in Freeport, TX. While this position is primarily based at the Freeport Site, the role may also provide operational support to other BASF manufacturing sites in Texas as business needs evolve. Come create chemistry with us! The Site Maintenance Director serves as the maintenance leader for the Verbund site, setting strategy and governance and ensuring the safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective performance of maintenance execution, turnaround planning and execution, contractor and contract management, and workforce capabilities. Set the site maintenance vision, operating model, priorities, decision rights, and governance in alignment with site and business strategies. Maintain clear accountability across Maintenance Execution, Turnarounds, Central Mechanical, Instrument, Electrical, Controls, and contractor partners. Provide strategic oversight for routine maintenance and turnaround/outage execution, including spending, resources, workforce performance, and results. As a Site Maintenance Director - Freeport, TX, you create chemistry by... People Leadership and Organizational Capability Lead a centralized, sitewide high-performance team and culture focused on safety, reliability, accountability, execution discipline, and service to operating units. Build organizational capability through workforce planning, leadership development, succession, qualification, and technical skill development. Safety, Compliance & Responsible Care Champion Responsible Care, safety excellence, and consistent use of safe work practices across all maintenance activities for both BASF and contractor partners. Ensure maintenance personnel understand and apply site safety requirements, programs, and expected behaviors. Maintenance and Reliability Operations Establish and maintain the site maintenance operating model, execution strategy, and governance. Define and deliver the required level of maintenance support to operating units in partnership with Asset Managers. Asset, Capital and Resource Management Provide executive oversight for routine maintenance spending and turnaround/outage spending. Align maintenance resources and service levels with site priorities, operating-unit needs, risk, and reliability requirements. Contractor & Contract Management Provide leadership and accountability for contractor performance across maintenance activities. Establish safety, quality, productivity, cost, and service expectations for maintenance contractors. Performance Management & Continuous Improvement Lead continuous improvement in maintenance execution, reliability, and work processes using LEAN Manufacturing tools. Identify and remove waste, constraints, and process inefficiencies that affect safety, schedule attainment, reliability, and cost. Cross-Functional and External Leadership Represent the site in professional maintenance organizations and local councils. Collaborate with Asset Managers, Operations leaders, regional and global functional teams, global technical expertise, and other stakeholders to advance site and enterprise priorities. If you... Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in engineering, or a related field, with at least 15 years of manufacturing experience and at least 5 years of supervisory experience required. Advanced degree preferred; previous experience leading a plant optimization team is a plus. Demonstrated supervisory and leadership capability, with strong communication, interpersonal, conflict-management, and influencing skills. Leadership Competencies Demonstrate entrepreneurial action, strategic thinking, organizational awareness, and effective work management. Lead employees to success and build diverse, high-performing teams with a strong sense of shared ownership. Communicate effectively, manage conflict constructively, and influence across organizational boundaries. Demonstrate quality orientation, attention to detail, and a strong drive for achievement. Champion innovation, remove constraints, enable resources, and ensure services provide value to BASF and its customers. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us As one of the largest chemical companies in North America we have been finding solutions for your everyday needs and addressing the most complex economic, environmental, and sustainability challenges for more than 150 years! At BASF we empower our employees with the tools, guidance and opportunities they need to advance and succeed in work and life. Giving you the support you need to be your best and fulfill your personal ambitions is what helps us create chemistry. After all, our success is linked to yours. Whatever path you envision, BASF is a great place to build a rewarding, successful career. Belong to Something Bigger. #belongatBASF Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.name: Head of Sales - Pharma Solutions NA
jobs.description: Now hiring! Head of Sales - Pharma Solutions NA Florham Park, NJ (Hybrid) We are looking for a Head of Sales to join our Pharma Solutions team in Florham Park, NJ. Come create chemistry with us! At BASF Nutrition and Health, we develop, produce and market ingredients and solutions for the nutrition and health industries that fulfill the highest safety, regulatory and sustainability standards. We bring our passion and energy to work every day, knowing that through our cutting-edge research and global collaboration, we deliver products that support the health and wellbeing of humans and animals alike across the globe. Lead annual credit-limit reviews and assess proposed customer payment terms. Identify material or emerging credit risks and align mitigation measures with Sales, Business Units, Controllers and Finance stakeholders.
