Escalate material, judgmental or out-of-policy credit matters in accordance with the applicable approval matrix. Order Release Management Own the local credit-limit assessment process and ensure compliance with policies, delegated authorities and approval requirements. Review requests for new, renewed, temporary or increased credit limits, including requests arising from seasonal demand or exceptional business needs. Oversee sales orders blocked because of exceeded credit limits, overdue invoices or other credit-related conditions. Partner with Sales, Business Units and Controllers to assess the commercial background, total customer exposure and associated risks. Approve or recommend credit-limit changes and order releases within the applicable authority framework, escalating higher-risk cases appropriately. Monitor recurring order blocks and drive sustainable resolution of their underlying causes. Overdue Receivables Management Support the collection of overdue receivables as required and coordinate collection activities with the respective BPO provider, Sales, Business Units and Controllers. Analyze overdue aging, customer commitments, payment behavior and exposure trends to identify high-risk or long-outstanding cases. Review payment-extension and prolongation requests and assess their impact on overall credit exposure. Lead additional local collection actions and escalate material cases to management, Legal or external collection agencies where required. Provide relevant credit information to support bad debt assessments and other Finance decisions. BPO Governance Act as the local CCRM owner for relevant activities delivered by the respective BPO provider. Define clear responsibilities, review points and escalation paths between local CCRM, the BPO and business stakeholders. Monitor the quality and timeliness of dunning, overdue reporting and related operational deliverables. Coordinate resolution of credit-related exceptions, system issues and recurring service problems. Drive process standardization, root-cause resolution and continuous improvement across the end-to-end process. Systems, Reporting & Controls Ensure effective use of Smart Credit Optimizer and consistent credit data across SAP FSCM, GetPaid and relevant master-data systems. Use external credit reports and publicly available information to support assessments, working with approved global and local credit-information providers. Prepare regular reporting on customer exposure, credit limits, order blocks, overdue receivables and material risks. Own the local control environment for customer credit risk management and ensure compliance with policies, approval requirements and documentation standards. Maintain complete and audit-ready evidence for credit assessments, credit-limit decisions, order releases and overdue-management activities. Support internal and external audit requests and lead remediation of identified process or control gaps. Team Leadership & Capability Building Lead and develop local CCRM resources, establishing clear priorities, responsibilities and performance expectations. Provide technical guidance on credit assessment, financial analysis, order-release decisions and overdue management. Deliver regular and ad-hoc credit-risk training to Sales, local finance and other relevant stakeholders. Build consistent CCRM capabilities and promote collaboration across local, BPO service providers and regional teams. Support succession planning, knowledge transfer and the development of a sustainable CCRM organization. Transformation & Stakeholder Management Represent local CCRM requirements in regional and global finance-transformation initiatives. Drive process simplification, automation and sustainable control improvements. Support the transition from existing BASF arrangements to Surventis policies, systems and governance. Act as the principal local contact for customer credit risk management in Mainland China. Partner with Sales, Business Units, local finance , Legal and Compliance teams to support commercially sound and policy-compliant decisions. Communicate significant exposures, overdue cases, recommendations and required actions clearly to senior stakeholders. A relevant professional qualification in accounting, finance or credit management is preferred. A master’s degree or MBA is advantageous. Experience Approximately 10–12 years of progressive experience in customer credit risk, credit control, accounts receivable or collection management. At least 3–5 years of experience in a management, team-lead or senior credit decision-making role. Strong experience in customer credit assessment, financial-statement analysis and credit-limit management. Demonstrated experience in new-customer reviews, annual credit assessments, order-release management and temporary credit-limit decisions. Experience managing overdue receivables, payment extensions, collection activities and high-risk customer cases. Experience partnering with Sales, Controllers and Business Units in a multinational or matrix organization. Experience governing BPO activities is preferred. Experience in the manufacturing, industrial or B2B sector is advantageous. Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of customer credit risk management, credit control and accounts-receivable processes. Strong ability to analyze financial statements, cash flow, payment behavior and external credit information. Practical knowledge of credit limits, payment terms, order blocks, prolongations, dunning and collection processes. Ability to assess material customer exposure and recommend commercially practical mitigation measures. Experience with Smart Credit Optimizer or a comparable credit-management platform is preferred. Strong SAP experience; knowledge of SAP FSCM and SAP S/4HANA is advantageous. Experience with GetPaid or another collection-management system is advantageous. Strong Microsoft Excel, data-analysis and reporting skills. Languages Native-level Mandarin Chinese. Fluent business English. Key Competencies Hands-on manager with strong analytical judgment and commercial awareness. Able to balance business growth, customer relationships and responsible credit-risk management. Confident in challenging and influencing senior business stakeholders constructively. Able to make timely decisions and escalate material or uncertain risks appropriately. Strong ownership of customer credit exposure, overdue performance and collection outcomes. Strong stakeholder-management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Clear communicator who can explain complex credit matters in practical terms. Comfortable working through complexity, ambiguity and organizational change. High personal integrity and commitment to transparent, policy-compliant decision-making. The Customer Credit Risk Manager supports customer credit risk assessment, credit-limit management, order-release management and overdue receivables management for Surventis legal entities and businesses in APAC . The role works closely with Sales, Business Units, local finance , the BPO Provider and other relevant stakeholders to manage customer credit exposure, identify risks and coordinate appropriate mitigation and collection actions. Support timely completion of annual statutory audits and other required assurance activities. Assist with review of statutory financial statements and disclosures before management approval. Tax Review & KPMG Coordination Coordinate accounting data, reconciliations and supporting documents required by KPMG for tax compliance and filing activities. Review VAT, corporate income tax, withholding tax and other tax deliverables prepared by KPMG for completeness, consistency and reasonableness. Reconcile tax returns and supporting schedules to the general ledger and relevant source data. Review tax-related accounting entries, tax codes and tax provision inputs within the role’s scope. Coordinate clarification and correction of identified differences with KPMG, the BPO provider and internal tax colleagues. Track tax filing calendars, information requests, open issues and agreed actions. Support tax audits, tax inspections and authority inquiries by coordinating documents and internal responses. Escalate unusual transactions, uncertain tax treatments and material risks for technical assessment and management decision. Support implementation of tax recommendations and agreed compliance-control improvements. Treasury & Banking Coordination Support cash-flow reporting, cash visibility and local liquidity information requirements. Coordinate routine banking documents and local treasury administration. Support regional treasury teams with local banking, payment and compliance matters. Escalate significant banking, cash or treasury-control issues to the Senior Finance & Accounting Manager. BPO Provider Governance Review relevant accounting deliverables prepared by the BPO provider. Ensure local statutory, tax and documentation requirements are communicated to process teams. Coordinate resolution of accounting exceptions, reconciliation issues and recurring service problems. Monitor open items and support timely escalation when service quality or compliance requirements are at risk. Support process standardization, clear retained-organization interfaces and continuous improvement. Internal Controls & Local Compliance Execute and monitor finance controls within the assigned scope. Maintain evidence and supporting documentation for key controls and compliance reviews. Support internal audit, external audit and compliance-testing requests. Track control deficiencies and support implementation of remediation actions. Maintain relevant local compliance calendars and ensure assigned deliverables are completed on time. Support implementation of accounting policies, approval requirements and finance procedures. Participate in finance transformation, process migration and system-improvement initiatives. Support Day-2 readiness, carve-out, integration and legal-entity restructuring activities. Help document local requirements and ensure they are considered in regional or global process design. Coordinate with APAC Accounting, regional tax, treasury, controlling and BPO provider teams. Maintain effective working relationships with KPMG, external auditors and other professional service providers. Provide clear status updates on deliverables, risks, dependencies and unresolved issues. Support business stakeholders with practical finance guidance while following established governance and escalation requirements. What We Look For Education & Professional Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline. CPA, ACCA or other relevant professional qualification is preferred. Experience Approximately 6-10 years of relevant accounting and finance experience. Experience in statutory reporting, external audit coordination and local accounting compliance. Experience working in a multinational company or complex multi-entity environment. Experience coordinating with an outsourced tax provider, preferably a Big Four firm. External audit or Big Four experience is advantageous. Experience working with BPO providers is preferred. Manufacturing or industrial-sector experience is advantageous. Technical Skills Strong working knowledge of IFRS and applicable local accounting requirements in Mainland China. Practical understanding of Hong Kong statutory reporting requirements is advantageous. Working knowledge of VAT, corporate income tax, withholding tax and tax-related accounting reconciliations. Strong reconciliation, analytical review and documentation skills. SAP experience preferred; SAP S/4HANA exposure is advantageous. Strong Microsoft Excel skills. Languages Native-level Mandarin Chinese. Fluent business English. Cantonese capability is advantageous for Hong Kong stakeholder coordination. Key Competencies Strong attention to detail and disciplined follow-through. Able to review outsourced deliverables critically without duplicating the external provider’s work. Sound judgment and timely escalation of material or uncertain issues. Able to manage multiple deadlines across legal entities and stakeholders. Collaborative, hands-on and comfortable working in a lean transformation environment. Strong ownership of reporting quality, audit readiness and compliance support. Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us. At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships. We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In our unit Treasury & Credit Relations, you will combine global cash management, FX execution and reliable treasury operations with the opportunity to actively shape and redesign processes and systems. Together with the team, you will further develop the treasury systems landscape and turn ideas for integrated, automated processes into reality. You will play an active role in the transformation and see first-hand how your project work helps create a high-performing Treasury function. In your new role, you will work closely with the Treasury team to maintain a reliable global cash position by consolidating bank balances, intraday data and expected cash flows, managing liquidity and supporting cash pools and approved funding, investment and intercompany transactions. Together with your colleagues, you will support the global execution of internal and external FX hedges and liquidity-related FX transactions, helping to ensure transparent and reliable processing through careful review of limits, pricing and maturities. In close collaboration with Corporate Finance, Risk Controlling and Accounting, you will contribute to in-house banking and cash-pooling processes, integrate operating cash flows into the 13-week forecast and support reconciliations, month-end closing and hedge-accounting documentation. You will contribute to secure and transparent Treasury processes by reviewing confirmations and approved settlement instructions, monitoring payments through to final bank status and working with relevant partners to resolve and document exceptions or settlement issues. You will also help shape our evolving Treasury system landscape and post-carve-out transformation. Working collaboratively with IT, external providers and Finance teams, you will enhance processes and interfaces, support testing and controlled releases, and contribute to automation, knowledge transfer and stable Treasury operations. In addition, our bonus program allows employees to tailor benefits to their individual needs. Company-funded accident and supplementary long-term care insurance, as well as pension-related benefits, provide comprehensive financial security. At Surventis, diversity is more than a commitment—it is part of who we are. We are proud of our employee networks, including WomenInCoatings and CultiConnect. A strong feedback culture is firmly embedded in our organization through initiatives such as regular employee surveys and leadership feedback processes. jobs.name: Contract Manager
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities . About The Role As Project Contract Manager, be responsible for awarding and management of service and works contracts within CAPEX projects in India, including identification of cost-saving opportunities, timely award, post-award contract administration, change and claims management, and contract close-out together with project stakeholders. Oversee the project services procurement process and create Contract Status Reports ensuring transparency; serve as the project-specific Services Procurement focal point for progress, commercial risk and escalation management; and implement company policies, guidelines, approval requirements and documentation standards into project contracting. Support the project team with contractual and commercial advice to safeguard BASF positions, including scope changes, extension of time, acceleration and catch-up plans, contractor non-conformances, contractual remedies, final account and close-out. Develop and manage the contractor pool for CAPEX projects in accordance with business targets together with Engineering, EHS, category teams and other project stakeholders. Provide end-to-end contract and commercial management across the full greenfield project contracting portfolio – technology licence, EPC, construction, unit/package system and other CAPEX and OPEX service contracts – from project development through execution, commissioning and close-out. What Will You Do Project Contract Management Responsibilities: Ensure compliance in the procurement process in accordance with the BASF Supplier Code of Conduct, local laws, company compliance requirements and global procurement guidelines. Develop and implement the Contract Execution Plan and contracting strategy for assigned CAPEX projects in India, aligned with the project schedule, packaging strategy, market conditions, commercial risk profile and applicable IA/FA approval requirements. Lead the contracting strategy, tendering, negotiation, award and post-award administration for technology licence agreements, EPC contracts, construction contracts, unit/package system contracts, and other general CAPEX and OPEX service contracts for greenfield projects, ensuring appropriate allocation of scope, interfaces, performance obligations, guarantees, liabilities, risks and commercial terms. Generate service and works contract bidder lists in collaboration with stakeholders from the operating division, Project Management, Engineering and category teams. Support Cost Engineering to establish BOQs, base prices, unit-rate structures and commercial benchmarks; evaluate bids to identify cost optimization opportunities and potential claim exposure. Ensure timely award of contracts, including expediting MRQs and scope readiness, driving RFQ generation and tendering, expediting TBE, conducting CNBs, negotiation and CBE, and preparing award recommendations. Lead post-award management of assigned contracts during project execution, including obligations, contractual correspondence, securities, insurances, warranties, payment conditions, change orders, claims, non-conformances and status reporting. Generate and track the Contract Status Report and an integrated contract-performance dashboard for assigned projects, providing regular updates to the project team on award status, budget, obligations, milestones, KPIs, payments, securities, commercial risk, changes, claims, non-conformances, contractor performance, forecast exposure and required decisions. Review and approve purchase orders and change orders according to project signing matrices and delegated authority. Manage the contract lifecycle and digital visibility in SAP, Icertis, Mercanis, SAP Analytics Cloud, JIRA, P2P Toolbox or other designated systems, ensuring complete, timely and audit-ready records. Own readiness for internal, external and quality audits for assigned contracts and ensure corrective and preventive actions are closed. Maintain a project contract-management plan, obligation register and contract-governance RACI covering Procurement, Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Project Controls, Legal, Finance, EHS and Operations. Lead disciplined EOT, delay and disruption assessment using contemporaneous programme evidence, critical-path analysis, cause-and-effect records and cost substantiation appropriate to the contract. Maintain an India-specific contractual risk checklist covering governing law, notice requirements, variation mechanisms, liquidated damages, liability, indemnity, insurance, force majeure, termination and dispute resolution, with Legal validation where required. Contractor Management Responsibilities: Follow up on strategic contractor management and maintain regular exchange with core contractors; provide feedback to regional Procurement Management, Engineering and operating divisions; and transfer best practices and lessons learned. Conduct contractor audits and qualifications with the Procurement Verbund Team, EHS and project stakeholders, ensuring qualification covers technical capability, financial health, EHS, Responsible Care, sustainability, human rights, BPDD and EcoVadis requirements, as applicable. Act as first line for potential contractual issues and contractor non-conformances and escalate material issues to the Team Leader, Project Manager, Legal or regional management, as required. Support the Category Manager in developing the CAPEX contracting and contractor strategy. Coordinate contractor performance reviews, recovery actions, final evaluation and lessons learned for assigned projects. Apply risk-based contractor segmentation and differentiated governance for strategic, critical and routine contract packages. Define measurable contract KPIs covering safety, quality, schedule, productivity, commercial responsiveness, sustainability and close-out, with corrective-action or service-credit mechanisms where appropriate. Identify contractor capacity, workforce, subcontractor, regulatory, EHS and continuity risks and develop practical mitigation or alternative sourcing actions. Procurement Planning & Strategy: Align Procurement, Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Legal, Finance, Cost Engineering, Project Controls, EHS and Operations on scope readiness, commercial strategy, tender progress and execution priorities. Identify diverging stakeholder interests early and facilitate conflict resolution while safeguarding BASF’s contractual and commercial position. Complete contract close-out including final account, claims settlement, securities and warranty status, release documentation, records retention, contractor evaluation and lessons learned. Evaluate bids on total service cost, risk, compliance, quality, schedule and capability, not price alone, applying should-cost, clean-sheet, productivity and risk-adjusted analysis for major packages where reliable data is available; document the award rationale and residual risks. Lead end-to-end change and claims governance, including early warning, timely notices, entitlement assessment, substantiation, valuation, negotiation, settlement, recovery and formal closure; ensure no changed work proceeds without written authorization except under an approved emergency process. Track value realization against the approved business case and contract baseline, including savings, avoided cost, recoveries, value leakage and forecast exposure. Drive dispute avoidance through early-warning reviews, defined escalation protocols, documented settlement authority and timely involvement of Legal and project leadership. What We Look For Strong negotiation skills for prices, payment terms, securities, terms and conditions, changes, extensions of time and claims. Deep knowledge of supplier and contractor landscapes and types of contractual engagement in engineering, construction, EPC and EPCM projects. Deep knowledge of contract terms and conditions, deviation handling, contract administration, change and claim management, non-conformance remedies and contract close-out, including related tools and legal exposure. Comprehensive understanding of BOQs, unit rates, cost structures and procurement processes, with the ability to establish a Contract Execution Plan, carry out bidder qualification and shortlisting, and report contract status, changes and claims. Strong project-management and influencing skills for virtual and cross-functional teams without direct reporting lines. Solid knowledge of SAP, purchase orders, Microsoft Office (particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word) and contract/claims-management tools such as Icertis; knowledge of Mercanis, SAP Analytics, Power BI and SAP S/4HANA is advantageous. Solid knowledge of contractor audits, qualifications and EHS standards expected by large multinational companies. Excellent written and verbal English for stakeholder interaction and for drafting contractual notices, correspondence and management reports; an additional Indian or international language is an advantage. Full mobility within India for project relocation and willingness to travel extensively to support projects in India and, when assigned, Asia Pacific. Practical knowledge of FIDIC-based and bespoke EPC/construction contracts used in India, together with awareness of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 and the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996; Legal remains responsible for legal interpretation. Working capability in EOT, variation, delay, disruption and cost-claim substantiation; PMP, MRICS, CCM, CPCM or equivalent certification is advantageous but not mandatory. Minimum Education and Qualification required for the Position Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Law, Commerce, Economics, Finance or a related discipline. More than 7 years of work experience in Indirect Procurement, Contract/Commercial Management and CAPEX projects. Demonstrated experience managing service or works contracts through tendering, award, execution, change/claims and close-out. Location Mumbai - Vikhroli Godrej One

jobs.name: Laborant Analytik (alle*)
jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF We are the world’s leading chemical company because we offer intelligent solutions for our customers and for a sustainable future. To achieve this, we connect and develop people with a wide variety of talents worldwide. This opens up a diverse range of development opportunities for you. *At BASF, all employees are welcome, regardless of gender, disability, cultural, religious or social background, sexual orientation or identity, or origin. «Bring your passion for analytics and join us in setting new standards for quality and safety.» You can expect a wide range of responsibilities, from routine analyses to challenging special assignments where your expertise, independence and sense of responsibility are essential. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In your new position, you independently carry out routine assignments as well as challenging special assignments in analytics and quality control, ensuring that they are completed professionally and on time. During on-call assignments at night or on weekends, you assume the technical responsibilities and authority of the quality control laboratory manager and regularly report on any issues and emerging trends. You assume responsibility for testing and measuring equipment in accordance with the applicable quality assurance regulations and ensure complete documentation within your assigned area of responsibility. In coordination with the quality assurance laboratory manager or their deputy, you develop and evaluate proposals for new equipment, methods and laboratory tools. You independently troubleshoot equipment and involve internal or external service support when required. You consistently comply with EHS guidelines and responsible care requirements, lead by example in following the ten safety rules, and report unsafe actions and conditions using safety reporting cards. Furthermore, you actively support and continuously develop safety activities within the team, for example by participating in safety inspections, safety initiatives, mandatory training courses and the Global Safety Day. WHAT YOU OFFER You have completed an apprenticeship as a laboratory technician and have experience in analytics. Sound knowledge of the chemical processes involved in the products manufactured at the production site distinguishes you, as does your willingness to participate in on-call duty. In-depth knowledge of instrumental analysis and quantitative analysis, combined with good knowledge of production processes, rounds off your technical profile. Proficiency in German and intermediate English skills complete your qualifications. WHAT WE OFFER A challenging area of responsibility with a high level of personal responsibility. Your onboarding will take place "on the job" in a committed, competent team. Attractive remuneration including company social benefits, as well as excellent development opportunities in an international company. Work and private life in harmony thanks to our flexible working time model. Take up to one year of parental leave, we will keep the position vacant. In addition: higher child allowances than provided for by law and a voluntary family allowance. An attractive, extra-mandatory occupational pension plan with variable savings plans for maximum flexibility and generous employer contributions. Our other good reasons . HOW TO REACH US Do you have any questions about the application process? Julia Kiersch (Talent Acquisition), julia.kiersch@basf.com, Tel.: +49 30 2005-59139, will be happy to answer your questions about this position. You are also welcome to book an online appointment . Do you have technical questions about the position? Please contact Markus Hallhuber (Team Leader Plant Laboratory), email: markus.hallhuber@basf.com. You can find initial information about our application process here. ABOUT US BASF Schweiz AG occupies a central position as the Swiss representative of the BASF Group. The company is headquartered in Basel and has additional locations in Kaisten, Monthey, Pfäffikon (Schwyz) and Schweizerhalle. BASF Schweiz AG in Cooperation with recruitment agencies is not desired. Please note that we do not return paper applications, including application folders. Therefore, please submit copies only and no original documents. If possible, please upload your documents combined into one PDF. Discover more open positions: BASF Careers Switzerland. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

jobs.name: GB/G Collections Analyst
jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress. Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background.  At BASF, careers develop from opportunities. BASF Overview BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in About the Role The Semi-Senior Collections Analyst executes collection activities and reconciles accounts for low- and medium-complexity third-party customers and/or regions in a timely manner. The role manages customer communications, supports payment application and billing-discrepancy follow-up, monitors portfolio KPIs, assists with audit activities, participates in medium-sized projects, and identifies improvements to collection processes. What's In It for You •  Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative •  Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions •  Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways •  Access to BASF's world-class learning & development programs •  Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture •  Hybrid work model (mix of on-site and remote) Key Responsibilities •  Contact low- and medium-complexity customers through different communication channels, including email, telephone, and approved messaging channels, and send updated account statements to customers and responsible sales teams. •  Provide the Accounts Receivable team with the information required to apply received payments and keep customer information updated in the GetPaid collections tool. •  Communicate billing discrepancies reported by customers to the appropriate team for resolution. •  Participate in ad hoc meetings with customers and business teams. •  Comply with the processes and requirements established in the applicable guidelines. •  Assist with the analysis, preparation, and documentation required for internal and external audits. •  Participate in medium-sized projects with support from the designated focal point. •  Monitor portfolio KPIs, including overdue balances and DSO, for assigned low- and medium-complexity businesses and provide explanations when requested. Minimum Qualifications • Education: Professional qualification in Finance (e.g. B com, CA, CPA, etc.) or MBA or Master degree in finance Accounting or related disciplines . •  Work Experience: 3-5 years of experience in customer service, collections, finance operations, or a related field. • Process Knowledge: Understanding of collections, customer-account reconciliation, payment application support, billing-discrepancy follow-up, audit documentation, and portfolio KPI monitoring. •  Decision-Making: Processes and actions are predefined in accordance with applicable guidelines. •  Leadership: No formal leadership experience is required. •  Project Experience: Experience participating in medium-sized projects is preferred. •  Core Skills: Effective communication, attention to detail, conflict resolution, critical thinking, teamwork, customer focus, organization, and prioritization. Technical Skills •  Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel. •  Intermediate working knowledge of SAP. •  Advanced working knowledge of GetPaid or a comparable collections platform. •  Advanced English, Portuguese, and/or Spanish proficiency is required according to the region supported. •  Knowledge of collections KPIs, including overdue balances and DSO. •  Experience preparing internal and external audit documentation. •  Experience in a shared services, multinational, or GCC environment is preferred. About BASF At BASF, we believe that great chemistry starts with great people. We foster a workplace where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and a shared commitment to continuous growth - both for the business and for the individuals within it.At BASF, your development never stands still. Employees have access to structured learning pathways, international exposure, and cross-functional mobility across a truly global organization. We are committed to inclusion and equal opportunity, and we actively invest in the wellbeing, development, and long-term career growth of our people. Whether you are early in your career or bringing deep expertise, BASF offers the scale of a world-leading company with the sense of purpose and community that makes it a place where people genuinely thrive.

jobs.description: We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future. What We Lo ok For Responsible for Quarterly Advance tax compliances, overview of withholding tax compliance (Domestic as well as foreign vendors including Dividend payments), TCS, SFT compliances including monthly payments and quarterly returns Undertake Tax Compliances and Advisory work including Tax Audit, Transfer pricing Audit, Master file and CBCR compliances, Annual Tax Returns. Responsible for Quarterly and Annual Tax provision workings including deferred tax workings. jobs.name: Technical Account Manager - FCC Catalysts
jobs.description: WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT As a Technical Account Manager - You will own and develop the commercial relationship with assigned refinery accounts and manage the interface between customers and BASF. The role is primarily accountable for business performance, customer strategy, growth, and relationship management. You will address selected technical topics directly and work in close collaboration with the Technical Service Team for detailed evaluations, troubleshooting, modeling, and performance improvement programs. Manage the assigned territory and customer portfolio, including sales performance, pricing, forecasting, contracts, receivables, and account planning. Develop and execute customer growth strategies, identify new business opportunities, and strengthen relationships with key refinery stakeholders. Lead commercial activities including tenders, proposals, contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and value-selling initiatives. Serve as the primary customer interface, coordinating technical and commercial support with BASF Technical Service, R&D, Supply Chain, and business teams. Apply FCC technical knowledge to understand customer challenges, support solution development, and communicate value-driven recommendations. Monitor market, competitor, and customer developments and translate insights into actionable business plans. Represent BASF in customer meetings, technical discussions, negotiations, business reviews, and industry events. Collaborate effectively across multicultural and cross-functional teams while operating independently within the Middle East and Africa region. WHAT YOU OFFER Degree (BSc, MSc, or PhD) in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a closely related discipline. Strong, demonstrable FCC experience covering both technical understanding and commercial responsibility. This is an essential requirement. Applications that do not clearly demonstrate relevant FCC technical and commercial experience will not be considered. A minimum of 5 years of sales or account management experience, preferably in refinery catalysts, refinery technology, process solutions, or another technically complex B2B environment. The depth and relevance of this experience will be a key selection criterion. Demonstrated knowledge of the oil refining industry and a solid understanding of FCC operations and catalyst applications. Proven customer-facing experience and a track record of developing opportunities, winning business, and managing commercial relationships. Experience in pricing, tenders, contract negotiations, sales forecasting, and account strategy execution. Ability to understand technical analyses and operating data, engage credibly with customer technical teams, and collaborate effectively with specialist Technical Service colleagues. Fluent business English with strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferrably a dditional regional language capability, particularly Arabic or French. Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30-50% across the Middle East and Africa, with occasional international travel. Knowledge of the Middle Eastern and/or African refining markets and customer landscape would be a plus. Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.

Merci de ne pas vous laisser dérouter par cette situation : tous les postes proposés sont des opportunités au sein de Surventis, et votre candidature nous sera directement transmise. Chez Surventis, nous allons au-delà des apparences dans tout ce que nous entreprenons. Nous plaçons nos clients au cœur de nos décisions, anticipons leurs besoins et développons des solutions qui créent une véritable valeur ajoutée ainsi que des partenariats durables. Nous nous inspirons mutuellement à voir plus loin, à prendre pleinement la responsabilité de notre travail et à repousser sans cesse les limites du possible. Si vous venez avec toute votre authenticité, osez remettre en question les évidences et souhaitez évoluer au sein d’une équipe qui met réellement ses valeurs en pratique, alors vous êtes au bon endroit. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS Au sein du groupe SURVENTIS en France, la holding Bond France BidCo SAS anime les activités juridiques de 5 sociétés opérationnelles et accompagne notamment leurs activités commerciales Refinish, Mobility et Surface Treatment en France et à l'export. Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire pour participer activement à l'accompagnement juridique des équipes opérationnelles. Ce stage offre une exposition directe aux enjeux business et opérationnels d’un groupe industriel de la chimie, avec une forte dominante en droit des contrats, complétée par des problématiques de droit de la concurrence, et l'opportunité de participer à des dossiers de droit des sociétés. Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Juridique et Compliance France et Maroc, vous interviendrez principalement sur les sujets suivants : La rédaction et la revue de contrats : contrats de vente, contrats incentive clients, distribution, agent commercial, conditions générales, contrat de confidentialité et pré-contrats, fourniture et prestation de services, sous-traitance, contrats de licence ; L'accompagnement des équipes commerciales, achats, marketing et opérations sur leurs problématiques juridiques quotidiennes ; La préparation de notes juridiques courtes et pragmatiques destinées aux opérationnels ; L'analyse des risques contractuels et la formulation de recommandations adaptées aux enjeux business ; La participation aux réflexions relatives au respect du droit de la concurrence dans les relations avec les clients, distributeurs et partenaires commerciaux ; Un appui ponctuel sur certains sujets de droit des sociétés concernant les entités du Groupe. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de 6 mois de niveau BAC+5 ou BAC+6 (DJCE) durant l'année 2027 (début de préférence en Janvier ou en Février) dans le domaine du droit des affaires / droit des contrats ; Vous êtes curieux(se) et pragmatique, autonome et rigoureux(se), doté(e) d'un excellent esprit d'analyse, et vous apprécierez de développer des échanges avec des interlocuteurs non-juristes ; Vous avez de solides connaissances en droit des contrats et une bonne compréhension des enjeux commerciaux et contractuels. Une connaissance du droit de la concurrence constitue un atout ; Vous maîtrisez le pack Office et IA générative ; Vous maitrisez l'anglais, l'allemand serait un plus. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Un univers passionnant et exigeant ; La possibilité de développer votre potentiel au sein d'une équipe engagée et compétente ; De nombreuses perspectives de carrière dans un groupe international. CE POSTE VOUS INTÉRESSE ? Pour candidater, il suffit de cliquer sur le bouton « postuler » sur cette fiche de poste. Vous devrez alors créer votre profil et ajouter vos documents de candidature. Emilie, en charge de ce recrutement, reçoit et analyse toutes les candidatures et enverra un courriel aux candidats présélectionnés pour les inviter à un entretien vidéo MS Teams de 30 minutes. Nous vous souhaitons bonne chance et sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature ! Seules les candidatures soumises via l’offre publiée sur notre site carrière seront étudiées. Toute candidature reçue en dehors du processus prévu (par e-mail, par exemple) ne sera pas considérée. Pour bien comprendre le processus, vous pouvez vous rendre sur cette page dédiée. Il vous reste des questions ? Vous pouvez nous contacter ici. QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? SURVENTIS SAS est spécialisée dans le développement, la production et la commercialisation de différentes solutions de revêtement allant des traitements de surface à la peinture automobile. Nous soutenons l'innovation, le design et de nouvelles possibilités d'applications au sein d'une équipe internationale dont l'objectif est de répondre aux besoins de nos partenaires dans le monde entier. Notre gamme de services comprend également le programme « Innovation Beyond Paint » qui vise le développement de nouveaux marchés et de modèles commerciaux. La diversité est notre plus grande force! Rejoignez notre formule gagnante et venez développer le futur avec nous - au sein d'une équipe internationale qui encourage l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances indépendamment du genre, de l'âge, de l'origine, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou des croyances. Serving as a technical expert on cotton management practices, seed and trait portfolios, product placement, product management and competitive offerings, and contributing agronomic expertise to the variety-advancement process. Design and manage field-testing programs using strong experimental-design, statistical, analytical and data-management capabilities. Collaborate effectively across Commercial Operations, Marketing, Supply Chain, Production, Breeding, Trait Development, Technical Service, Sales and external agricultural networks. Communicate complex agronomic and product information clearly through training, presentations, technical guidance and sales-support materials for seed advisors, retailers, university personnel and growers. Think strategically, respond to market developments and make sound short- and long-term recommendations that support regional business growth and customer demand. jobs.description: Now hiring! Senior Counsel, Employment Law & Compliance Research Triangle Park, North Carolina Hybrid We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Employment Law & Compliance to join our Agricultural Solutions team in RTP, NC. In this role, you will serve as the primary legal advisor for employment and labor matters across the Agricultural Solutions U.S. organization. Reporting to the U.S. General Counsel, you will partner with Human Resources, business leaders, Legal and Compliance colleagues, and external counsel to provide practical, business-oriented advice, manage employment and compliance risk, and strengthen workplace policies, investigations and governance practices. This is an opportunity for an experienced employment attorney to work closely with the business, influence important workforce and organizational decisions, and help shape effective employment law and compliance practices within Agricultural Solutions Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Senior Counsel, Employment Law & Compliance, you create chemistry by... Serving as the primary legal advisor on U.S. employment and labor law matters, including hiring, promotions, compensation, leaves, accommodations, performance management, disciplinary actions and terminations. Partnering with Human Resources and senior leaders to identify and mitigate employment risk and support organizational design, workforce planning, restructuring, mergers, acquisitions and integration activities. Monitoring federal, state and local employment-law developments and translating their impact into actionable guidance, workplace policies, practices and programs. Advising on complex employee-relations matters and workplace investigations involving misconduct, discrimination, harassment, retaliation, ethics concerns and policy violations, and recommending legally compliant resolutions and corrective actions. Managing employment-related claims, litigation, administrative charges, regulatory inquiries and agency matters, including selecting and overseeing external counsel and promoting effective outcomes and efficient use of legal resources. Coordinating compliance and governance activities, including risk identification and assessment, mitigation planning, control testing, effectiveness monitoring, investigations, audits, policies, standards and governance processes. Supporting ethical and compliant business practices through compliance training, online-learning delivery, cross-functional collaboration and proactive measures that reduce legal and organizational risk. If you... Hold a Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school and an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, with eligibility to provide legal services across the United States. Bring at least five years of progressive experience practicing employment and labor law, including advising multi-state U.S. employers. Advise on employee relations, workplace investigations, employment litigation, administrative matters and corporate-compliance issues with strong knowledge of federal, state and local requirements. Apply expertise in wage and hour requirements, equal employment opportunity, leave and accommodation obligations, investigations, dispute resolution and multi-state compliance. Manage external counsel and employment-related legal matters with sound business judgment, appropriate discretion and focus on effective and efficient outcomes. Translate complex legal and compliance topics into clear, practical and actionable guidance for Human Resources, business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. Estamos buscando un Líder de Cultivo para México. Su objetivo será: Liderar la estrategia de negocio de los cultivos bajo su responsabilidad, transformando el entendimiento del mercado, clientes y competencia en decisiones de portafolio, posicionamiento, inversión y generación de demanda que impulsen un crecimiento rentable y sostenible. Alinear a las diferentes funciones alrededor de las prioridades del cultivo, definiendo los planes comerciales y de marketing de corto y mediano plazo, y asegurando su ejecución para alcanzar los objetivos de ventas, participación y rentabilidad. Dentro de sus tareas se destacan las siguientes: Analizar la dinámica, tamaño, tendencias, problemáticas, clientes y competencia de los cultivos bajo su responsabilidad, identificando oportunidades y segmentos prioritarios. Desarrollar el Plan de Cultivo País con visión a 1-3 años, estableciendo prioridades de crecimiento, participación de mercado esperada y líneas estratégicas que orienten el desarrollo sostenible del negocio. Determinar el rol de cada solución dentro de los cultivos y segmentos prioritarios, definiendo posicionamiento, propuesta única de valor (UVP) y prioridades de inversión. Gestionar el ciclo de vida del portafolio, considerando nuevos productos, reemplazos, canibalización, phase-out, inventarios y otras variables que impacten su competitividad y rentabilidad. Traducir la estrategia de cultivo y las propuestas de valor del portafolio en campañas, programas y actividades que generen conocimiento, preferencia y adopción. Definir las inversiones y acciones de generación de demanda, incluyendo muestras, días de campo, eventos y otras iniciativas, estableciendo audiencias, objetivos y resultados esperados. Construir, junto con Desarrollo de Mercado y Comunicación, propuestas de valor claras y diferenciadas para los productos prioritarios, definiendo qué comunicar, a qué segmentos, mediante qué canales y con qué mensajes, asegurando consistencia entre la evidencia técnica, la necesidad del productor y el beneficio económico/comercial. La formula para el éxito: contar con titulación en Agronomía, Adminsitración o a fines,  experiencia en roles de similar responsabilidad, manejo de cultivos, negociación y administración de cuentas. jobs.name: Logistics Coordinator - Regina SK
jobs.description: Now hiring! Logistics Coordinator - Regina SK Regina, Saskatchewan (Hybrid) We are looking for a Logistics Coordinator to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Regina, SK. In this role, you will coordinate the end-to-end movement of finished goods, align transportation plans with warehouse execution, and help ensure customer delivery requirements are met. You will serve as a central connection among Supply Chain, Customer Service, Distribution, Warehouse Operations and external carriers while supporting safe, compliant and continuously improving logistics operations. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a Logistics Coordinator - Regina SK, you create chemistry by... Coordinating and dispatching third-party carriers to align transportation schedules with customer delivery requirements, production priorities, warehouse capacity and On-Time Delivery targets. Overseeing daily warehouse execution, including loading, staging, labeling, SAP postings and inventory transactions, to ensure shipping plans are completed safely, accurately and efficiently. Acting as the central liaison among Logistics, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Distribution, Warehouse Operations and external carriers to maintain clear information flow, resolve issues and manage changing operational priorities. Providing day-to-day direction and process oversight to the Material Handler team by prioritizing activities, reinforcing standard work and supporting strong operational performance. Monitoring shipping adherence, inventory accuracy, FIFO practices and logistics KPIs, investigating performance gaps and implementing or recommending corrective actions. Driving continuous improvement through process standardization, stronger SAP utilization, efficient workflows and KPI tracking across transportation and warehouse operations. Supporting hazardous-waste staging, labeling, documentation and shipment activities in accordance with Environment Canada, Transport Canada and BASF policies and processes. If you have... A Grade 12 diploma or equivalent. At least three years of experience in logistics, dispatch or warehouse operations; experience across both transportation coordination and warehouse execution is preferred. Experience with SAP logistics, warehouse-management or comparable systems to support shipping, inventory and operational transactions. Led daily operational activities and influence team performance in a fast-paced environment without relying on formal supervisory authority. Analyzed shipping, inventory and KPI information, organized competing priorities and made sound decisions with general guidance. Communicated and collaborated effectively across Supply Chain, Customer Service, Distribution, Warehouse Operations and external-carrier partners. Applied working knowledge of Transportation of Dangerous Goods, 49 CFR and IATA requirements, together with inventory-management, FIFO and warehouse-process principles. Identified, led and implemented practical process improvements that strengthen safety, compliance, delivery performance, inventory accuracy and operational efficiency. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF Adding value to our customers begins with adding value to you. you@BASF is the suite of benefits, perks, programs and unique opportunities we offer to support you – the whole you – in all stages of your life and career. With you@BASF, you create your own chemistry. The total rewards that you receive as a BASF employee go way beyond a paycheck. From competitive health and insurance plans to robust retirement benefits that include company-matching contributions, to making sure you never stop learning, we believe investing in you is investing in our success. Working for a large, global organization, you’ll have a chance to grow professionally and personally, expand your network and build a rewarding and dynamic career.  We also provide engaging learning and development opportunities to help you make the most of your talents and your role. About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Diversity is our greatest strength! Join us in shaping the future as part of a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunity – regardless of gender, age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or personal beliefs. Estamos buscando un Coordinador de Channel Excellence Su objetivo será: Coordinar y asegurar el análisis integral del desempeño y desarrollo del canal de distribución en la región a cargo (Norte, Sur, Protegidos o Row Crop), integrando información comercial, de mercado y territorio con el propósito de transformar los datos en insights, escenarios y recomendaciones que orienten la toma de decisiones. Actuar como socio estratégico de los equipos comerciales, aportando una visión objetiva y sustentada en datos que permita identificar y cuestionar oportunidades, riesgos y desviaciones, fortalecer la gestión de socios comerciales y apoyar la preparación de negociaciones y Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR). Asimismo, impulsar acciones que mejoren el cumplimiento de acuerdos, la cobertura, el desempeño y la evolución sostenible de la red de distribución, promoviendo una ejecución comercial en la que el análisis, la evidencia y el conocimiento del mercado sustenten las recomendaciones y decisiones de negocio. Sus principales tareas serán: Performance y desarrollo integral del canal: Asegurar una visión integral del desempeño y desarrollo del canal de distribución, mediante la consolidación, análisis e interpretación de información comercial y de mercado que permita comprender la evolución del Sell In, Sell Out, inventarios y acuerdos de negocio en relación con el Market Share, Acceso y Share of Customer (SOC), transformando los datos en insights que permitan identificar drivers, desviaciones, riesgos y oportunidades, y recomendar acciones que fortalezcan la toma de decisiones comerciales. Escenarios y recomendaciones para la toma de decisiones: Desarrollar escenarios y recomendaciones de negocio sustentados en datos, integrando información histórica, tendencias, indicadores de desempeño y conocimiento del mercado para anticipar posibles impactos, evaluar alternativas y recomendar cursos de acción, aportando una perspectiva objetiva que fortalezca y, cuando sea necesario, cuestione constructivamente las decisiones comerciales. Business Partner para Ventas, negociaciones y QBR: Asesorar a los equipos comerciales en la gestión de socios de negocio, proporcionando análisis, escenarios, e información relevante que fortalezca la preparación de negociaciones y Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), aportando evidencia y recomendaciones que faciliten conversaciones comerciales y decisiones sustentadas en datos. Acuerdos de negocio y performance comercial: Asegurar el seguimiento integral de acuerdos y compromisos comerciales, evaluando su evolución y desempeño, identificando oportunamente desviaciones y recomendando acciones que favorezcan el cumplimiento de los objetivos establecidos y una gestión efectiva de los socios comerciales. Cobertura y optimización de la red: Evaluar la estructura, cobertura y calidad de la red de distribución y subdistribución, integrando información de territorio, potencial de mercado y desempeño comercial para identificar gaps y oportunidades de crecimiento, y recomendar acciones de expansión, optimización o racionalización del canal, en conjunto con los equipos comerciales. Datos, herramientas y transformación de Channel Excellence: Asegurar la calidad, consistencia, disponibilidad y evolución de la información y las herramientas analíticas de Channel Excellence, impulsando la adecuación, automatización y estandarización de scorecards, dashboards y soluciones de análisis de acuerdo con las necesidades del modelo de negocio, con el objetivo de optimizar la generación de información y aumentar la capacidad del equipo para transformarla en insights, escenarios y recomendaciones que aporten valor a la toma de decisiones. Política Comercial y Acuerdos de Negocio: Asegurar la correcta implementación e interpretación de la Política Comercial y los Acuerdos de Negocio (ADN), participando en su diseño, actualización y adecuación a las necesidades del negocio. Coordinar su comunicación y capacitación con los equipos internos y socios comerciales, proporcionando asesoramiento para su correcta interpretación y aplicación. Asimismo, generar la estandarización y personalización de la documentación de los acuerdos, así como el seguimiento a su formalización, alcances y cumplimiento, garantizando consistencia entre lo establecido, su medición y ejecución. Gestión y calidad de información de Sell Out e inventarios: Administrar y asegurar el proceso de información de Sell Out e inventarios de los socios comerciales, coordinando su recepción, revisión, validación y corrección de inconsistencias, con el propósito de garantizar información confiable y oportuna que represente adecuadamente la dinámica del negocio y constituya una base sólida para la generación de insights, escenarios, recomendaciones y decisiones comerciales. jobs.name: Analista Financial Reporting (fixed-term project-based)
jobs.description: Quiénes somos: Somos BASF, la compañía química más grande del mundo, con más de 150 años de experiencia. En Montevideo, operamos como un HUB que brinda servicios a todas las empresas de BASF en las Américas. Ofrecemos soluciones profesionales en finanzas, adquisiciones, reportes, logística, tecnología, recursos humanos, proyectos, comunicaciones, asuntos legales, medioambiente, seguridad, salud y calidad. Área: En el HUB de Montevideo contamos con el área de Financial Reporting, la cual es responsable de asegurar que los estados financieros se completen de forma adecuada, cumpliendo con las normativas locales e internacionales. Se preparan reportes mensuales, trimestrales y anuales donde se trabaja con Finanzas Local, Controlling y la caza matriz. A fin de mes se toma toda la información desde los módulos de SAP System, para luego reportar nuestras versiones Financieras y Operativas en nuestro sistema oficial. Objetivo principal de la posición: Desempeñar tareas diarias y análisis periódicos relativos Financial Reporting, asegurando la integridad y exactitud de la información contable en SAP y otras bases de datos. Principales tareas: Dar soporte a la correcta ejecución de los procedimientos y controles de cierre de mes (cubriendo todos los procesos predefinidos como FRC controls), garantizando la calidad del reporte a casa matriz. Contribuir en la preparación de notas a los Estados Financieros, trimestrales y anuales. Realización de los Account Análisis mensuales de acuerdo con el mapping de cuentas predefinido. Contribuir en diversos proyectos e iniciativas a lo largo del año relativos a documentación de procesos, M&A, FRC, testeos, auditoría, entre otros. Proporcionar soporte con tareas relativas a la contabilización de Activos fijos y en la aplicación de IFRS16 (Leasing). Apoyo y coordinación con Local Finance en lo referente a las actividades bajo su scope. Estar en constante y proactiva comunicación con diversos clientes y stakeholders, trabajando de cerca con las diferentes áreas de la organización. Requisitos mínimos de educación y calificaciones para la posición: Educación: Estudiantes avanzados o graduados en Contador Público, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines. Experiencia laboral: Entre 1 y 3 años de experiencia contable. Idiomas: Manejo de inglés intermedio a nivel oral y escrito. Se valorará altamente el conocimiento del portugués. Habilidades técnicas: Conocimiento de Microsoft Office y IFRS. SAP valorado. Habilidades blandas: Buenas habilidades de comunicación para mantener un contacto constante con clientes, stakeholders y otras áreas del HUB. jobs.name: QA/QC Coordinator
jobs.description: Now hiring! QA/QC Coordinator Sparks, GA (Onsite) We are looking for a QA/QC Coordinator to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Sparks, GA. Welcome to BASF We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture. #ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions! As a QA/QC Coordinator, you create chemistry by... Conducting all work in accordance with site safety procedures and supporting annual safety initiatives. Overseeing Non-Conformance Management (NCM) in SAP, including creation, review, auditing, reporting, and training. Coordinating non-conformance investigations with cross-functional teams and leading regular meetings to review investigation status and progress. Performing internal quality audits in accordance with established guidelines and managing Internal Lab Auditors to ensure compliance. Completing monthly QA metrics reporting by coordinating with designated production groups. Coordinating and managing SAP QM setups for new and existing product plans, including raw materials and finished goods. Managing inventory releases, including out-of-specification raw materials and finished goods. Managing and maintaining the Document Control System, including issuing approved revisions to Product Assurance Plans, test methods, and SOPs in accordance with established guidelines. Coordinating and managing off-site, long-term storage of department documents while adhering to record retention policies, and creating Certificates of Analysis upon request.Training employees on systems such as SAP, SharePoint, Lotus Notes, and other BASF intranet-based tools, while supporting Quality Data Clerk administrative functions and prioritizing additional activities based on business needs. If you... Have a High School Diploma or equivalent. Bring a minimum of 2 years of experience working in a manufacturing or laboratory setting. Have at least 1 year of Quality Assurance and/or Compliance experience. Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Microsoft applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Hold a Bachelor’s degree, preferably. Bring 4 or more years of experience in a manufacturing or laboratory environment, preferably. Offer 2 or more years of Quality Assurance and/or Compliance experience, preferably. Have at least 1 year of SAP experience, preferably. Create your own chemistry with you@BASF At BASF, you will have the chance to do meaningful work towards building a more sustainable future. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, BASF provides you with access to a wide range of elements to help you be your best. It’s what we call you@BASF. We are committed to providing benefits, programs, and opportunities that support our employees’ overall well-being, personal growth, and a safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment. Just some of the many benefits we offer include: Flexible work arrangements whenever possible Highly competitive retirement savings plan with company match and investment options Well-being programs that include comprehensive mental health support for you and your household family members Family forming benefits (fertility, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, maternity/parental leave, and more) Back-up child and elder care with discount programs for families of all ages and stages Mentoring and career development opportunities that allow you to share, learn, and thrive Matching gifts program that allows you to deepen the impact of your contributions to qualified charities. Employee crisis support for when the unexpected happens Access to our BASF wine cellar, employee discounts, and much more! About us BASF Agricultural Solutions is a trusted partner to the agricultural industry, delivering innovative and sustainable solutions that help farmers succeed across a wide range of cropping systems. Across North America, our teams work together to address some of agriculture's most important challenges while creating value for customers, communities, and the environment. At BASF, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented colleagues, and make a meaningful impact through work that matters. Find out more about our Agricultural Solutions team here . Our people are at the heart of everything, dedicated to delivering value for our customers every day. By focusing on enabling our people today and in the future, we will ensure we have the talent and skills needed to succeed. United by the love of farming, we innovate, collaborate, and strive for the best solutions together, creating connections and driving success as one team. This is how we make an impact. For the love of farming, the biggest job on Earth. Privacy statement BASF takes security & data privacy very seriously. We will never request financial information of any kind via email, private text message or direct message on any social medial platform or job board. Furthermore, we will never send a candidate a check for equipment or request any type of payment during the job application process. If you have experienced any of the above, please contact Careers.NorthAmerica@basf.com to report fraud. Equal employment opportunities We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, citizenship, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, disability status, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASF The Service Unit Global Engineering Services crafts and engineers a sustainable future with world class technical expertise. Our interdisciplinary, global, committed teams serve the BASF businesses to grow with our customers, products and markets. We add value by delivering competitive execution of investments. On construction sites across the globe, we deliver safe and reliable solutions to build and keep BASF assets operating at top performance. In doing so, we continuously improve and drive digital transformation. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT In the field of industrial communications technology, we support operations with industrial and hazard communication technology. In addition to conventional system technologies, we use innovative technologies for early hazard detection in the process industry. You will support us in the further development and implementation of our solutions. Possible topics include artificial intelligence (AI), PLC programming, computer vision, evaluation of innovative technologies. The focus of your work will be jointly determined depending on your interests and skills. At the Ludwigshafen site, you will work for this purpose in an interdisciplinary and cross-departmental team, in which you will present and discuss your results and implement them in the companies. WHAT YOU OFFER advanced bachelor's or master's degree in a STEM field of study good programming skills (e.g. Python, C/C++, Codesys) advantageous: knowledge in software versioning and MLOps (e.g. Git, DVC), machine learning, computer vision, network technology very good communication in German and English independent familiarization with new topics as well as the ability to actively contribute your ideas to the team we look forward to receiving your application documents, including a current certificate of enrollment. if it is a compulsory internship, please attach your study regulations or a corresponding document certifying the duration of the compulsory internship to your complete application documents WHAT WE OFFER Practical phase - actively apply theory in challenging and varied tasks/projects Teambuddy - contact person for all questions and regular feedback Networks - get to know different perspectives, ways of thinking and fields of work Internship compensation - a recognition of the commitment, more information here: on.basf.com/compensationBASFSE Flexible working hours - depending on the location and area of work HOW TO REACH US Yulia Haars (Talent Acquisition), yulia.haars@basf.com, will be happy to answer your questions for this position You can also reach our recruiting team here First information about our application process can be found here: on.basf.com/applicationprocess . ABOUT US BASF SE, located in Ludwigshafen am Rhein, is the corporate headquarters of the BASF Group and part of the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region. BASF stands for competence in chemistry since 1865 and is represented today in the world's major consumer markets, with a wide range of products. As the largest employer in the region, BASF SE offers multiple career opportunities for students, university graduates and professionals providing also training in over 30 professions. Leisure, sports, culture and a good infrastructure characterize the Rhine-Neckar Metropolitan Region, in which BASF is also involved with numerous activities. Learn more about BASF SE at on.basf.com/BASFSE_LU Diversity is our greatest strength! Become a part of our winning formula for success and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces inclusion and equal opportunities irrespective of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, disability or belief.
